# <span class="deva-large">व</span> <span class="iast-large">va</span>

<div class="dict-page-header">
  <span class="badge-count">2219 entrées</span>
  <a href="../" class="back-link">← Index du dictionnaire</a>
</div>

---

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry--va">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">॰व</span> <i>-va</i> forme des a. et s. indiquant la possession ou l'origine, et des adv. de manière.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry--vala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">॰वल</span> <i>-vala</i> pourvu de, abondant en.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry--van">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">॰वन्</span> <i>-van</i> forme des a. mas. (f. en -varī).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry--vara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">॰वर</span> <i>-vara</i> exprime «celui qui fait» après un verbe.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry--vas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">॰वस्</span> <i>-vas</i> forme des ppft. act. (m. nom. <i>-vān</i>, acc. <i>-vāṃsam</i>, n. nom. acc. <i>-vat</i>, f. <i>-uṣī</i>).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry--vat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">॰वत्</span> <i>-vat</i> var. <i>-mat</i> (forme des a.) comme, semblable à, qui est <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui a, qui possède; qui produit <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> transforme un sens passif en sens actif, not. un pp. en ppa. (cf. <a href="#entry-ktavatu" class="skt-link">ktavatu</a>) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> forme le nom. acc. voc. sg. d'un ppft. n. (cf. <a href="#entry--vas" class="skt-link">-vas</a>) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> (acc. utilisé comme adv.) selon, de la manière de, tel.<br> <i>ghaṭo</i> <i>ghaṭatvavān</i> [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] un pot est ce qui possède la qualité de pot.<br> <i>tattvavat</i> <i>tad</i> <i>eva</i> [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] La possession de la propriété charactéristique d'une notion est cette notion même (axiome de possession).<br> <i>tadvattvam</i> <i>tad</i> <i>eva</i> [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] L'extension de l'appartenance à une notion est cette notion même (axiome d'extension).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry--vin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">॰विन्</span> <i>-vin</i> cf. <a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_r_mh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वृंह्</span> <i>vṛṃh</i> cf. <a href="#entry-b_rh_1" class="skt-link">bṛh_1</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_r_s">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">वृष्</span> <i>vṛṣ</i> [relié à <a href="#entry-_r_s" class="skt-link">ṛṣ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(varṣati)</i> pft. <i>(vavarṣa)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vṛṣṭa</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>abhi</i>, <i>pra</i><i>)</i> pleuvoir, tomber en pluie; répandre la pluie (dieu, nuage), arroser <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> répandre en pluie <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> (au fig.) couvrir de richesses ou de maux — ca. <i>(varṣayati)</i> faire pleuvoir ou tomber en pluie; arroser (de ⟨i.⟩) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gr. ερση; fr. verser.<br> <i>vavarṣa</i> <i>rudhiram</i> [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] il pleuvait du sang.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_r_s_ni">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वृष्णि</span> <i>vṛṣṇi</i> [<a href="#entry-v_r_s" class="skt-link">vṛṣ</a><a href="#entry--ni" class="skt-link">-ni</a>] <a href="#entry-v_r_s_ni" class="skt-link">m.</a> bélier <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. du roi Vṛṣṇi «Viril», de la dynastie de <a href="#entry-Uyadu" class="skt-link">Yadu</a>; il est l'aîné des 100 fils de <a href="#entry-Umadhu" class="skt-link">Madhu</a>, et donc petit-fils de <a href="#entry-Ukaartaviirya" class="skt-link">Kārtavīrya</a>; ou bien il serait l'aîné des 7 fils de Sātvata, fils de Kratha, fils de Vidarbha, descendant de <a href="#entry-Ukro_s_taa" class="skt-link">Kroṣṭā</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. dynastie des princes descendants de <a href="#entry-Uv_r_s_ni" class="skt-link">Vṛṣṇi</a> [<a href="#entry-vaar_s_neya" class="skt-link">vārṣṇeya</a>]; y appartiennent not. <a href="#entry-Ubhoja" class="skt-link">Bhoja</a>, <a href="#entry-Uzuurasena" class="skt-link">Śūrasena</a>, <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a>, <a href="#entry-Usaatyaki" class="skt-link">Sātyaki</a> et <a href="#entry-Uugrasena" class="skt-link">Ugrasena</a>; <a href="#entry-Umathuraa" class="skt-link">Mathurā</a> était leur capitale.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_r_s_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वृष्ट</span> <i>vṛṣṭa</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-v_r_s" class="skt-link">vṛṣ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-v_r_s_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-v_r_s_ta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-v_r_s_taa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vṛṣṭā</i> tombé en pluie.<br> <i>vṛṣṭam</i> il a plu.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_r_s_ti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वृष्टि</span> <i>vṛṣṭi</i> [act. <a href="#entry-v_r_s" class="skt-link">vṛṣ</a>] <a href="#entry-v_r_s_ti" class="skt-link">f.</a> pluie <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>vṛṣṭayas</i> id. — ifc. pluie de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_r_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वृष</span> <i>vṛṣa</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-v_r_s" class="skt-link">vṛṣ</a>] <a href="#entry-v_r_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> mâle (animal); taureau; sperme [«qui féconde»] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> astr. signe zodiacal [<a href="#entry-raazi" class="skt-link">rāśi</a>] du Taureau; symbole de la justice <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> vertu, acte méritoire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Vṛṣa, mont de l'<a href="#entry-Uhimaalaya" class="skt-link">Himālaya</a> faisant face au <a href="#entry-Ukailaasa" class="skt-link">Kailāsa</a>, où médite <a href="#entry-Unandii" class="skt-link">Nandī</a>; là se trouve le mont aux herbes <a href="#entry-Umahodaya" class="skt-link">Mahodaya</a> où pousse l'herbe de résurrection [<a href="#entry-sa_njiivanii" class="skt-link">saṃjīvanī</a>]; cf. <a href="#entry-Uhanumaan" class="skt-link">Hanumān</a> — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. <i>(vṛṣasyati)</i> désirer le taureau (se dit de la vache) — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. <i>(vṛṣīyati)</i> souhaiter avoir un taureau <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>verres</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_r_sa_n">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वृषण्</span> <i>vṛṣaṇ</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-v_r_san" class="skt-link">vṛṣan</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_r_sa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वृषण</span> <i>vṛṣaṇa</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-v_r_s" class="skt-link">vṛṣ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-v_r_sa_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-v_r_sa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-v_r_sa_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vṛṣaṇī</i> qui fertilise — <a href="#entry-v_r_sa_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> du. testicules.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_r_sa_nazva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vṛṣaṇaśva</i> [<a href="#entry-azva" class="skt-link">aśva</a>] a. <a href="#entry-v_r_sa_nazva" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-v_r_sa_nazva" class="skt-link">n.</a> tiré par des chevaux mâles (chariot) — <a href="#entry-v_r_sa_nazva" class="skt-link">m.</a> véd. [RV.] np. du roi Vṛṣaṇaśva «Étalon», héros viril de très grande vigueur; son char était attelé de taureaux; il est père de la nymphe <a href="#entry-Umenaa" class="skt-link">Menā</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-v_r_sa_n" class="skt-link">vṛṣaṇ</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_r_saa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वृषा</span> <i>vṛṣā</i> [nom. <a href="#entry-v_r_san" class="skt-link">vṛṣan</a>] iic.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_r_saakapi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vṛṣākapi</i> [<a href="#entry-kapi" class="skt-link">kapi</a>] <a href="#entry-v_r_saakapi" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [RV.] np. de Vṛṣākapi «Singe mâle», ami d'<a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a>; il importuna sexuellement <a href="#entry-Uindraa_nii" class="skt-link">Indrāṇī</a>, qui repoussa ses avances et le corrigea — <a href="#entry-v_r_saakapaayii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vṛṣākapāyī</i> myth. np. de Vṛṣākapāyī, épouse de <a href="#entry-Uv_r_saakapi" class="skt-link">Vṛṣākapi</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-v_r_saa" class="skt-link">vṛṣā</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_r_sabha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vṛṣabha</i> [<a href="#entry-bha" class="skt-link">bha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-v_r_sabha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-v_r_sabha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-v_r_sabhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vṛṣabhā</i> vigoureux; viril — <a href="#entry-v_r_sabha" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Vṛṣabha, taureau-monture [<a href="#entry-vaahana" class="skt-link">vāhana</a>] de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>; plus tardivement, épith. de <a href="#entry-Unandii" class="skt-link">Nandī</a> «Pareil au taureau»; cf. <a href="#entry-U_r_sabha" class="skt-link">Ṛṣabha</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Vṛṣabha_2, fils d'<a href="#entry-Uarjuna_1" class="skt-link">Arjuna_1</a> <a href="#entry-Ukaartaviirya" class="skt-link">Kārtavīrya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_r_sabhaanu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vṛṣabhānu</i> [<a href="#entry-bhaanu" class="skt-link">bhānu</a>] <a href="#entry-v_r_sabhaanu" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. du <a href="#entry-vaizya" class="skt-link">vaiśya</a> Vṛṣabhānu, père de <a href="#entry-Uraadhaa" class="skt-link">Rādhā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_r_sabhadhvaja">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vṛṣabhadhvaja</i> [<a href="#entry-dhvaja" class="skt-link">dhvaja</a>] <a href="#entry-v_r_sabhadhvaja" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. épith. de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> «qui a le taureau pour bannière».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_r_sabhavaahana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vṛṣabhavāhana</i> [<a href="#entry-vaahana" class="skt-link">vāhana</a>] <a href="#entry-v_r_sabhavaahana" class="skt-link">m.</a> «Conduit par le taureau», se dit de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> accompagné de <a href="#entry-Unandii" class="skt-link">Nandī</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-v_r_sabha" class="skt-link">vṛṣabha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_r_sala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वृषल</span> <i>vṛṣala</i> [<a href="#entry-v_r_sa" class="skt-link">vṛṣa</a><a href="#entry--la" class="skt-link">-la</a>] <a href="#entry-v_r_sala" class="skt-link">m.</a> homme de basse caste (syn. <a href="#entry-zuudra" class="skt-link">śūdra</a>); homme méprisable — <a href="#entry-v_r_salii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vṛṣalī</i> femme <a href="#entry-v_r_sala" class="skt-link">vṛṣala</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> femme pubère non mariée; femme menstruant <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> femme stérile; mère d'un enfant mort-né.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_r_saliisevana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vṛṣalīsevana</i> [<a href="#entry-sevana" class="skt-link">sevana</a>] <a href="#entry-v_r_saliisevana" class="skt-link">n.</a> soc. commerce sexuel avec une femme <a href="#entry-zuudraa" class="skt-link">śūdrā</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-v_r_sala" class="skt-link">vṛṣala</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_r_san">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वृषन्</span> <i>vṛṣan</i> [<a href="#entry-v_r_sa" class="skt-link">vṛṣa</a>] <a href="#entry-v_r_san" class="skt-link">m.</a> véd. fécond; mâle, etc. <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Vṛṣā «Prolifique», épith. d'<a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> astr. np. de Vṛṣā_1 «Pubère», fils de <a href="#entry-Unaaradii" class="skt-link">Nāradī</a>, personnifiant l'an 15 d'un cycle de vie [<a href="#entry-sa_mvatsara" class="skt-link">saṃvatsara</a>] — ifc. meilleur parmi les.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_r_saparvan">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vṛṣaparvan</i> [<a href="#entry-parvan" class="skt-link">parvan</a>] <a href="#entry-v_r_saparvan" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de l'ondin [<a href="#entry-daanava" class="skt-link">dānava</a>] Vṛṣaparvan «aux membres puissants», père de <a href="#entry-Uzarmi_s_thaa" class="skt-link">Śarmiṣṭhā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_r_sasena">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vṛṣasena</i> [<a href="#entry-senaa" class="skt-link">senā</a>] <a href="#entry-v_r_sasena" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. de Vṛṣasena «à la Virile armée», fils de <a href="#entry-Ukar_na" class="skt-link">Karṇa</a>; dans la grande bataille il affronta tous les héros de l'armée des <a href="#entry-Upaa_n_davaas" class="skt-link">Pāṇḍavās</a>; <a href="#entry-Uarjuna" class="skt-link">Arjuna</a> le tua sous les yeux de son père, avant de tuer celui-ci.<br> <a href="#entry-v_r_sa" class="skt-link">vṛṣa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_r_sataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vṛṣatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-v_r_sataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> virilité; pouvoir créateur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_r_sii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वृषी</span> <i>vṛṣī</i> cf. <a href="#entry-b_r_sii" class="skt-link">bṛṣī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_r_sya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वृष्य</span> <i>vṛṣya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-v_r_s" class="skt-link">vṛṣ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-v_r_sya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-v_r_sya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-v_r_syaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vṛṣyā</i> méd. tonique; stimulant sexuel, aphrodisiaque — <a href="#entry-v_r_sya" class="skt-link">m.</a> natu. légumineuse bot. <i>Vigna radiata</i>; sa graine, comestible, (haricot mungo, soja vert) est utilisée dans de nombreuses préparations culinaires.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_r_syataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vṛṣyatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-v_r_syataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> virilité.<br> <a href="#entry-v_r_sya" class="skt-link">vṛṣya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_r_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">वृ</span> <i>vṛ_1</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">5</span>] pr. <i>(vṛṇoti)</i> pr. md. <i>(vṛṇute)</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(varati)</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">5</span>] pr. <i>(ūrṇoti)</i> aor. [<span class="skt-grammar">3</span>] <i>(avīvarat)</i> aor. [<span class="skt-grammar">5</span>] <i>(avārīt)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vṛta_1</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>anu</i>, <i>ā</i>, <i>ni</i>, <i>nis</i>, <i>pari</i>, <i>pra</i>, <i>vi</i>, <i>sam</i><i>)</i> couvrir, envelopper, entourer; cacher; obstruer, empêcher <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> fermer (une porte) — ca. <i>(vārayati)</i> empêcher, arrêter — int. md. <i>(ūrṇonūyate)</i> (av. <a href="#entry-pra" class="skt-link">pra</a>) empêcher continuellement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_r_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">वृ</span> <i>vṛ_2</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">9</span>] pr. <i>(vṛṇāti)</i> pr. md. <i>(vṛṇīte)</i> aor. md. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] <i>(avṛṣṭa)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vṛta_2</i><i>)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>vṛtya</i>, <i>vareṇya</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>pra</i><i>)</i> choisir, prendre pour ⟨dat. loc. i.⟩; demander en mariage — ca. <i>(varayati)</i> choisir, solliciter, favoriser — ca. md. <i>(varayate)</i> choisir, sélectionner, solliciter <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>volo</i>; ang. to will; all. wollen; fr. vouloir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rddha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वृद्ध</span> <i>vṛddha</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-v_rdh_1" class="skt-link">vṛdh_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-v_rddha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-v_rddha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-v_rddhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vṛddhā</i> augmenté, accru, grandi; adulte, âgé; vieilli, ancien, vieux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> instruit, expert, savant, éminent; sage — <a href="#entry-v_rddha" class="skt-link">m.</a> vieillard, senior <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. nom patr. d'un senior (par ex. <a href="#entry-Ugaargya" class="skt-link">Gārgya</a> pour le <a href="#entry-gotra" class="skt-link">gotra</a> de <a href="#entry-Ugarga" class="skt-link">Garga</a>); opp. <a href="#entry-yuvan" class="skt-link">yuvan</a> — ifc. l'aîné des; supérieur en, avancé en — <a href="#entry-v_rddhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vṛddhā</i> vieille femme.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rddhagarga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vṛddhagarga</i> [<a href="#entry-garga" class="skt-link">garga</a>] <a href="#entry-v_rddhagarga" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. de l'astronome Vṛddhagarga (vers le 1⟨sup⟩er⟨/sup⟩ siècle); on lui doit la Vṛddhagargasaṃhitā.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rddhak_satra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vṛddhakṣatra</i> [<a href="#entry-k_satra" class="skt-link">kṣatra</a>] <a href="#entry-v_rddhak_satra" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. de Vṛddhakṣatra «Vénérable seigneur», père de <a href="#entry-Ujayadratha" class="skt-link">Jayadratha</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rddhaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वृद्धक</span> <i>vṛddhaka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-v_rdh_1" class="skt-link">vṛdh_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-v_rddhaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-v_rddhaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-v_rddhikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vṛddhikā</i> vieux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rddhakumaarii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vṛddhakumārī</i> [<a href="#entry-kumaarii" class="skt-link">kumārī</a>] <a href="#entry-v_rddhakumaarii" class="skt-link">f.</a> vieille fille.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rddhapramaataamaha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vṛddhapramātāmaha</i> [<a href="#entry-pramaataamaha" class="skt-link">pramātāmaha</a>] <a href="#entry-v_rddhapramaataamaha" class="skt-link">m.</a> arrière-arrière-grand-père maternel — <a href="#entry-v_rddhapramaataamahii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vṛddhapramātāmahī</i> arrière-arrière-grand-mère maternelle.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rddhapranapt_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vṛddhapranaptṛ</i> [<a href="#entry-pranapt_r" class="skt-link">pranaptṛ</a>] <a href="#entry-v_rddhapranapt_r" class="skt-link">m.</a> arrière-arrière-petit-fils; le fils d'un arrière-petit-fils est dit <i>vṛddhaprapautra</i>, celui d'une arrière-petite-fille est dit <i>vṛddhapradauhitra</i> — <a href="#entry-v_rddhapranaptrii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vṛddhapranaptrī</i> arrière-arrière-petite-fille; la fille d'un arrière-petit-fils est dite <i>vṛddhaprapautrī</i>, celui d'une arrière-petite-fille est dit <i>vṛddhapradauhitrī</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rddhaprapitaamaha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vṛddhaprapitāmaha</i> [<a href="#entry-prapitaamaha" class="skt-link">prapitāmaha</a>] <a href="#entry-v_rddhaprapitaamaha" class="skt-link">m.</a> arrière-arrière-grand-père paternel — <a href="#entry-v_rddhaprapitaamahii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vṛddhaprapitāmahī</i> arrière-arrière-grand-mère paternelle.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rddhataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vṛddhatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-v_rddhataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> vieillesse.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rddhatva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vṛddhatva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-v_rddhatva" class="skt-link">n.</a> vieillesse.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rddhayavanajaataka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vṛddhayavanajātaka</i> [<a href="#entry-yavanajaataka" class="skt-link">yavanajātaka</a>] <a href="#entry-v_rddhayavanajaataka" class="skt-link">n.</a> astr. np. du Vṛddhayavanajātaka de <a href="#entry-Umiinaraaja" class="skt-link">Mīnarāja</a>, aussi appelé <a href="#entry-Umiinaraajajaataka" class="skt-link">Mīnarājajātaka</a>; c'est le résumé en 8000 vers d'un ouvrage perdu sur l'astronomie grecque.<br> <a href="#entry-v_rddha" class="skt-link">vṛddha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rddhi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वृद्धि</span> <i>vṛddhi</i> [act. <a href="#entry-v_rdh_1" class="skt-link">vṛdh_1</a>] <a href="#entry-v_rddhi" class="skt-link">f.</a> croissance, accroissement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> prospérité; richesse, fortune <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phon. augmentation d'une voyelle au 2⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ degré: la <a href="#entry-v_rddhi" class="skt-link">vṛddhi</a> de (‘<i>a</i>’, ‘<i>i</i>’, ‘<i>u</i>’, ‘<i>ṛ</i>’) est resp. (‘<i>ā</i>’, ‘<i>ai</i>’, ‘<i>au</i>’, ‘<i>ār</i>’) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> marée montante; lune croissante <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. intérêt, taux d'usure; cf. <a href="#entry-kaayikaa" class="skt-link">kāyikā</a>, <a href="#entry-kaalikaa" class="skt-link">kālikā</a>, <a href="#entry-kaaritaa" class="skt-link">kāritā</a>, <a href="#entry-zikhaa" class="skt-link">śikhā</a>, <a href="#entry-cakrav_rddhi" class="skt-link">cakravṛddhi</a>, <a href="#entry-bhogalaabha" class="skt-link">bhogalābha</a>, <a href="#entry-dharmav_rddhi" class="skt-link">dharmavṛddhi</a>, <a href="#entry-anyaayav_rddhi" class="skt-link">anyāyavṛddhi</a>, <a href="#entry-paramav_rddhi" class="skt-link">paramavṛddhi</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> natu. bot. <i>Habenaria intermedia</i>, orchidée dont les tubercules sont utilisés en médecine.<br> <i>vṛddhikṣayau</i> astr. croissance et décroissance de la lune.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rddhimat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vṛddhimat</i> [<a href="#entry--mat" class="skt-link">-mat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-v_rddhimat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-v_rddhimat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-v_rddhimatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vṛddhimatī</i> s'accroissant.<br> <a href="#entry-v_rddhi" class="skt-link">vṛddhi</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rdh_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">वृध्</span> <i>vṛdh_1</i> [relié à <a href="#entry-b_rh_1" class="skt-link">bṛh_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(vardhate)</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vardhati)</i> pft. <i>(vavardha)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vṛddha</i><i>)</i> ppr. md. <i>(vardhamāna)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>abhi</i>, <i>pra</i>, <i>vi</i>, <i>sam</i><i>)</i> croître, prospérer; augmenter, s'accroître — ca. <i>(vardhayati)</i> ca. md. <i>(vardhayate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vardhita</i><i>)</i> accroître; faire pousser, élever.<br> <i>diṣṭyā</i> <i>vṛdh</i> [«souhaiter la prospérité»] congratuler pour ⟨i.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rdh_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वृध्</span> <i>vṛdh_2</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-v_rdh_1" class="skt-link">vṛdh_1</a>] ifc. a. <a href="#entry-v_rdh_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-v_rdh_2" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-v_rdh_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> qui augmente, qui accroît.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">वृह्</span> <i>vṛh</i> [relié à <a href="#entry-b_rh_2" class="skt-link">bṛh_2</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">6</span>] pr. <i>(vṛhati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vṛḍha</i><i>)</i> arracher, déchirer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rhat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वृहत्</span> <i>vṛhat</i> cf. <a href="#entry-b_rhat" class="skt-link">bṛhat</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rj">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">वृज्</span> <i>vṛj</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">7</span>] pr. <i>(vṛṇakti)</i> aor. [<span class="skt-grammar">7</span>] <i>(avṛkṣat)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vṛkta</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>apa</i>, <i>pari</i>, <i>pra</i>, <i>vi</i><i>)</i> courber, tordre; arracher; cueillir (not. de l'herbe sacrificielle) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> écarter de, détourner de ⟨abl. g.⟩; exclure, aliéner — pr. md. <i>(vṛṅkte)</i> choisir, sélectionner; se réserver — ca. <i>(varjayati)</i> écarter, éviter; abandonner, renoncer à, s'abstenir de ⟨acc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> exclure.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rji">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वृजि</span> <i>vṛji</i> [<a href="#entry-v_rj" class="skt-link">vṛj</a>] <a href="#entry-v_rji" class="skt-link">f.</a> géo. np. du pays Vṛji, mod. Braj; cf. <a href="#entry-Uvraja" class="skt-link">Vraja</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rjina">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वृजिन</span> <i>vṛjina</i> [obj. <a href="#entry-v_rj" class="skt-link">vṛj</a>] a. <a href="#entry-v_rjina" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-v_rjina" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-v_rjinaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vṛjinā</i> tordu, courbé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> trompeur, faux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> désastreux — <a href="#entry-v_rjina" class="skt-link">m.</a> chevelure, boucle — <a href="#entry-v_rjina" class="skt-link">n.</a> vice; méchancheté; mauvaise foi <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> détresse, malheur — <a href="#entry-v_rjinaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vṛjinā</i> tromperie, intrigue; calamité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rjya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वृज्य</span> <i>vṛjya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-v_rj" class="skt-link">vṛj</a>] a. <a href="#entry-v_rjya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-v_rjya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-v_rjyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vṛjyā</i> qui doit être exclu ou détourné.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rk">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वृक्</span> <i>vṛk</i> cf. <a href="#entry-vrazc" class="skt-link">vraśc</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rk_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वृक्ण</span> <i>vṛkṇa</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vrazc" class="skt-link">vraśc</a>] a. <a href="#entry-v_rk_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-v_rk_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-v_rk_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vṛkṇā</i> déchiré, découpé, mis en pièces — <a href="#entry-v_rk_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> coupure, incision.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rk_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वृक्ष</span> <i>vṛkṣa</i> [relié à <a href="#entry-vrazc" class="skt-link">vraśc</a>] <a href="#entry-v_rk_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> arbre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rk_saamla">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vṛkṣāmla</i> [<a href="#entry-amla" class="skt-link">amla</a>] <a href="#entry-v_rk_saamla" class="skt-link">m.</a> natu. bot. <i>Spondias pinnata</i>, arbre aux feuilles composées, à l'écorce épaisse, aux fleurs nombreuses en panicules, aux fruits verts puis jaunes; il est utilisé en médecine — <a href="#entry-v_rk_saamla" class="skt-link">n.</a> natu. fruit de l'arbre tamarin, utilisé comme condiment acide syn. <a href="#entry-tinti_diika" class="skt-link">tintiḍīka</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rk_saaropa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vṛkṣāropaṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-aaropa_na" class="skt-link">āropaṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-v_rk_saaropa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> verger, plantation d'arbres.<br> <a href="#entry-v_rk_sa" class="skt-link">vṛkṣa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rk_saayurveda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vṛkṣāyurveda</i> [<a href="#entry-aayurveda" class="skt-link">āyurveda</a>] <a href="#entry-v_rk_saayurveda" class="skt-link">m.</a> traitement des arbres <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. np. du Vṛkṣāyurveda, traité d'horticulture dû à <a href="#entry-Usurapaala" class="skt-link">Surapāla</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rk_saayurvedayoga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vṛkṣāyurvedayoga</i> [<a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>] <a href="#entry-v_rk_saayurvedayoga" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. la pratique de l'horticulture, l'un des 64 arts [<a href="#entry-kalaa" class="skt-link">kalā</a>].<br> <a href="#entry-v_rk_saayurveda" class="skt-link">vṛkṣāyurveda</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rk_saka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vṛkṣaka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] <a href="#entry-v_rk_saka" class="skt-link">m.</a> arbuste — <a href="#entry-v_rk_sakaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vṛkṣakā</i> myth. dryade.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rk_samuula">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vṛkṣamūla</i> [<a href="#entry-muula" class="skt-link">mūla</a>] <a href="#entry-v_rk_samuula" class="skt-link">n.</a> racine d'arbre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rk_sasthala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vṛkṣasthala</i> [<a href="#entry-sthala" class="skt-link">sthala</a>] <a href="#entry-v_rk_sasthala" class="skt-link">n.</a> soc. arbre sacré de temple.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rk_savat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vṛkṣavat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-v_rk_savat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-v_rk_savat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-v_rk_savatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vṛkṣavatī</i> couvert d'arbres.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rk_sazaakhaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vṛkṣaśākhā</i> [<a href="#entry-zaakhaa" class="skt-link">śākhā</a>] <a href="#entry-v_rk_sazaakhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> branche d'arbre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वृक</span> <i>vṛka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vrazc" class="skt-link">vraśc</a>] <a href="#entry-v_rka" class="skt-link">m.</a> natu. zoo. loup, chacal; cf. <a href="#entry-zaalaav_rka" class="skt-link">śālāvṛka</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> véd. charrue — <a href="#entry-v_rkii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vṛkī</i> natu. louve <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gr. λυκος; lat. <i>lupus</i>; all. Wolf; ang. wolf; fr. loup.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rkabhiita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vṛkabhīta</i> [<a href="#entry-bhiita" class="skt-link">bhīta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-v_rkabhiita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-v_rkabhiita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-v_rkabhiitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vṛkabhītā</i> qui a peur du loup.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rkodara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vṛkodara</i> [<a href="#entry-udara" class="skt-link">udara</a>] <a href="#entry-v_rkodara" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. de Vṛkodara «Ventre de loup», épith. de <a href="#entry-Ubhiima" class="skt-link">Bhīma</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-v_rka" class="skt-link">vṛka</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rkta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वृक्त</span> <i>vṛkta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-v_rj" class="skt-link">vṛj</a>] a. <a href="#entry-v_rkta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-v_rkta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-v_rktaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vṛktā</i> tordu; tourné.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rnda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वृन्द</span> <i>vṛnda</i> [<a href="#entry-v_rdh_1" class="skt-link">vṛdh_1</a>] <a href="#entry-v_rnda" class="skt-link">n.</a> multitude, foule, rassemblement; troupe <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> agrégat; bouquet, gerbe; chœur, chorale <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> un très grand nombre; 100 milliards — f. cf. <a href="#entry-v_rndaa" class="skt-link">vṛndā</a>.<br> <i>vṛndam</i> adv. par groupes, en foule.<br> <i>...</i> <i>vṛnda</i> longue vie à ...
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rndaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वृन्दा</span> <i>vṛndā</i> [f. <a href="#entry-v_rnda" class="skt-link">vṛnda</a>] <a href="#entry-v_rndaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> basilic sacré; syn. <a href="#entry-tulasii" class="skt-link">tulasī</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Vṛndā «Prolifique», épith. de <a href="#entry-Uraadhaa" class="skt-link">Rādhā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rndaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वृन्दार</span> <i>vṛndāra</i> [<a href="#entry-v_rndaa" class="skt-link">vṛndā</a><a href="#entry--ra" class="skt-link">-ra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-v_rndaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-v_rndaara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-v_rndaaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vṛndārā</i> cf. <a href="#entry-v_rndaaraka" class="skt-link">vṛndāraka</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rndaaraka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vṛndāraka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] <a href="#entry-v_rndaaraka" class="skt-link">m.</a> le meilleur, le plus éminent, le chef, le plus beau d'une troupe — <a href="#entry-v_rndaarakaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vṛndārakā</i> <a href="#entry-v_rndaarikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vṛndārikā</i> la meilleure de son espèce.<br> <a href="#entry-v_rndaara" class="skt-link">vṛndāra</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rndaavana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vṛndāvana</i> [<a href="#entry-vana" class="skt-link">vana</a>] <a href="#entry-v_rndaavana" class="skt-link">n.</a> myth. np. de Vṛndāvana, le bois de <a href="#entry-Uv_rndaa" class="skt-link">Vṛndā</a>-<a href="#entry-Uraadhaa" class="skt-link">Rādhā</a>, près de la <a href="#entry-Uyamunaa" class="skt-link">Yamunā</a>, où le jeune <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a>-<a href="#entry-Ugopaala" class="skt-link">Gopāla</a> faisait paître les troupeaux avec les bouvières [<a href="#entry-gopii" class="skt-link">gopī</a>]; c'est ici qu'eurent lieu les amours de <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a> et de <a href="#entry-Uraadhaa" class="skt-link">Rādhā</a>; mod. Vrindaban/Brindaban <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. lieu de mémoire, où reposent les cendres des disciples de <a href="#entry-Umadhva" class="skt-link">Madhva</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Unavav_rndaavana" class="skt-link">Navavṛndāvana</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-v_rndaa" class="skt-link">vṛndā</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rndaavat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vṛndāvat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] <a href="#entry-v_rndaavatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vṛndāvatī</i> soc. pyramide carrée à 3 étages abritant une culture de basilic sacré, établie près des sanctuaires; des formes plus simples ornent les maisons.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rsii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वृसी</span> <i>vṛsī</i> cf. <a href="#entry-b_r_sii" class="skt-link">bṛṣī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rt_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">वृत्</span> <i>vṛt_1</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(vartate)</i> pft. <i>(vavṛte)</i> aor. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] <i>(avṛtat)</i> aor. [<span class="skt-grammar">3</span>] <i>(avīvṛtat)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vṛtta</i><i>)</i> ppr. md. <i>(vartamāna)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>ati</i>, <i>anu</i>, <i>abhi</i>, <i>ā</i>, <i>ut</i>, <i>upa</i>, <i>ni</i>, <i>nis</i>, <i>parā</i>, <i>pari</i>, <i>pra</i>, <i>vi</i>, <i>sam</i><i>)</i> tourner, rouler <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> être, avoir lieu, se produire, s'accomplir; procéder à ⟨acc.⟩; procéder de ⟨abl.⟩, provenir de ⟨loc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> rester, se maintenir; continuer à ⟨ind. abs.⟩; passer, s'écouler (temps) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> agir ainsi que, s'avérer comme ⟨i. acc. adv.⟩ (envers qqn. ⟨loc. dat. <a href="#entry-prati" class="skt-link">prati</a>⟩); servir à ⟨dat.⟩ — ca. <i>(vartayati)</i> faire tourner, rouler qqc.; opérer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> exister, vivre de ⟨i.⟩; être occupé à ⟨loc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> accomplir, produire; exposer, raconter — int. <i>(varīvartti)</i> véd. rouler; exister; prédominer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>verto</i>; all. werden.<br> <i>kiṃ</i> <i>vartate</i> que devient-il, comment va-t-il? <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> que se passe-t-il?<br> <i>āgacchan</i> <i>vartate</i> il arrive.<br> <i>kā</i> <i>velā</i> <i>vartate</i> quelle heure est-il?<br> <i>priyam</i> <i>vṛt</i> agir avec bonté.<br> <i>svāni</i> <i>vṛt</i> s'occuper de ses affaires.<br> <i>mūrdhni</i> <i>vṛt</i> être en tête, être important.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rt_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वृत्</span> <i>vṛt_2</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-v_rt_1" class="skt-link">vṛt_1</a>] ifc. a. <a href="#entry-v_rt_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-v_rt_2" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-v_rt_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> qui tourne, qui existe <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> (après nombre) ⟨iic.⟩ fois.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rta_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वृत</span> <i>vṛta_1</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-v_r_1" class="skt-link">vṛ_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-v_rta_1" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-v_rta_1" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-v_rtaa_1" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vṛtā_1</i> couvert, caché.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rta_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वृत</span> <i>vṛta_2</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-v_r_2" class="skt-link">vṛ_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-v_rta_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-v_rta_2" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-v_rtaa_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vṛtā_2</i> choisi, élu.<br> <i>vṛte</i> adv. le choix ayant été fait.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rthaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वृथा</span> <i>vṛthā</i> [<a href="#entry-v_r_1" class="skt-link">vṛ_1</a><a href="#entry--thaa" class="skt-link">-thā</a>] adv. au hasard; à volonté, à profusion, avec prodigalité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> vainement, inutilement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> faussement, indûment, à tort.<br> <i>vṛthā</i> <i>kṛ</i> rendre inutile.<br> <i>vṛthā</i> <i>bhū</i> être inutile, être frustré, être déçu.<br> <i>kālaṃ</i> <i>vṛthā</i> <i>na</i> <i>gamayet</i> il ne faut pas perdre son temps.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rtra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वृत्र</span> <i>vṛtra</i> [instr. <a href="#entry-v_r_1" class="skt-link">vṛ_1</a>] <a href="#entry-v_rtra" class="skt-link">m.</a> obstruction, influence hostile <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. véd. np. de Vṛtra «l'Obstructeur», <a href="#entry-asura" class="skt-link">asura</a>-dragon céleste [<a href="#entry-ahi" class="skt-link">ahi</a>] créé par <a href="#entry-Utva_s_taa" class="skt-link">Tvaṣṭā</a> comme son fils (et de ce fait <a href="#entry-braahma_na" class="skt-link">brāhmaṇa</a>) pour venger son aîné <a href="#entry-Utvaa_s_tra" class="skt-link">Tvāṣṭra</a>-<a href="#entry-Uvizvaruupa" class="skt-link">Viśvarūpa</a> tué par <a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a>; <a href="#entry-Utva_s_taa" class="skt-link">Tvaṣṭā</a> fit un sacrifice pour avoir un fils «vainqueur d'<a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a>» [<a href="#entry-indrazatru" class="skt-link">indraśatru</a>] mais se trompa d'accent et demanda à la place qu'il fût «vaincu par Indra» [<a href="#entry-indrazatru" class="skt-link">indraśatru</a>]; symbole de la sécheresse, <a href="#entry-Uv_rtra" class="skt-link">Vṛtra</a> retint les eaux prisonnières; il fut tué par <a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a> aidé de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>, libérant les eaux et créant les rivières; d'autres textes le disent fils de <a href="#entry-Udanaayu" class="skt-link">Danāyu</a> et <a href="#entry-Ukazyapa" class="skt-link">Kaśyapa</a> — <a href="#entry-v_rtra" class="skt-link">n.</a> pl. <i>vṛtrāṇi</i> véd. les forces d'obstruction, influences hostiles du Chaos résistant à la création du Cosmos.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rtrahan">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vṛtrahan</i> [<a href="#entry-han_2" class="skt-link">han_2</a>] <a href="#entry-v_rtrahan" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Vṛtrahan, épith. d'<a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a> «Tueur du Dragon».<br> <a href="#entry-v_rtra" class="skt-link">vṛtra</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rtrahatya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vṛtrahatya</i> [<a href="#entry-hatya" class="skt-link">hatya</a>] <a href="#entry-v_rtrahatya" class="skt-link">n.</a> myth. meurtre de <a href="#entry-Uv_rtra" class="skt-link">Vṛtra</a> par <a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a> — <a href="#entry-v_rtrahatyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vṛtrahatyā</i> id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rtratara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vṛtratara</i> [<a href="#entry--tara" class="skt-link">-tara</a>] <a href="#entry-v_rtratara" class="skt-link">m.</a> véd. <a href="#entry-Uv_rtra" class="skt-link">Vṛtra</a> en pire.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rtta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वृत्त</span> <i>vṛtta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-v_rt_1" class="skt-link">vṛt_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-v_rtta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-v_rtta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-v_rttaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vṛttā</i> accompli, produit, arrivé; maintenu, resté <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui a eu lieu, qui a existé; révolu, fini, mort <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> rond [«qui roule»] — ifc. qui se comporte comme; dérivé de — <a href="#entry-v_rtta" class="skt-link">n.</a> événement, aventure, affaire [«ce qui s'est passé»]; procédure, action; manifestation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> conduite, comportement, mœurs; cours, course <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> math. cercle; suite — <a href="#entry-v_rttaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vṛttā</i> phon. mètre (compté par syllabes).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rttaanta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vṛttānta</i> [<a href="#entry-anta" class="skt-link">anta</a>] <a href="#entry-v_rttaanta" class="skt-link">m.</a> [«ce qui a pour objet ce qui s'est passé»] événement, aventure; situation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> récit, histoire, nouvelle; information.<br> <a href="#entry-v_rtta" class="skt-link">vṛtta</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rttacuu_da">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vṛttacūḍa</i> [<a href="#entry-cuu_daa" class="skt-link">cūḍā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-v_rttacuu_da" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-v_rttacuu_da" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-v_rttacuu_daa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vṛttacūḍā</i> soc. ayant reçu la tonsure rituelle.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rttamuktaavalii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vṛttamuktāvalī</i> [<a href="#entry-muktaavalii" class="skt-link">muktāvalī</a>] <a href="#entry-v_rttamuktaavalii" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de la Vṛttamuktāvalī, œuvre de grammaire de <a href="#entry-Uzriik_r_s_nabha_t_ta" class="skt-link">Śrīkṛṣṇabhaṭṭa</a> (18⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rttaphala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vṛttaphala</i> [<a href="#entry-phala" class="skt-link">phala</a>] <a href="#entry-v_rttaphala" class="skt-link">m.</a> [«fruit rond»] grenade; jujube — <a href="#entry-v_rttaphalaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vṛttaphalā</i> natu. bot. <i>Solanum melongena</i>, aubergine.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rttaratnakara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vṛttaratnakara</i> [<a href="#entry-ratnaakara" class="skt-link">ratnākara</a>] <a href="#entry-v_rttaratnakara" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Vṛttaratnākara «Mine de métrique», ouvrage de combinatoire prosodique, dû à <a href="#entry-Ukedaara_1" class="skt-link">Kedāra_1</a> <a href="#entry-Ubha_t_ta" class="skt-link">Bhaṭṭa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rtti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वृत्ति</span> <i>vṛtti</i> [act. <a href="#entry-v_rt_1" class="skt-link">vṛt_1</a>] <a href="#entry-v_rtti" class="skt-link">f.</a> mouvement circulaire, roulement; écoulement (larmes); occurrence; dynamique <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> manière d'être ou d'agir, comportement; genre de vie, conduite <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> moyen d'existence, activité, occupation; profession, métier <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. fonction d'un mot; emploi d'un mot dans un sens donné; formation morphologique; style, genre; cf. <a href="#entry-pa_ncav_rtti" class="skt-link">pañcavṛtti</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. expression synthétique (opp. expression analytique [<a href="#entry-vaakya" class="skt-link">vākya</a>]) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. divinité attachée à une fonction <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. fluctuation, mouvement de la pensée; cf. <a href="#entry-cittav_rtti" class="skt-link">cittavṛtti</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] relation entre un mot et son sens [<a href="#entry-padaartha" class="skt-link">padārtha</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phon. mode de récitation; allitération <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. mode de composition; commentaire, glose — ifc. occupé à, engagé dans, qui a pour métier.<br> <i>vṛttiṃ</i> <i>kṛ</i> vivre de ⟨i. iic.⟩; faire vivre ⟨g.⟩.<br> <i>kuru</i> <i>priyasakhivṛttiṃ</i> <i>sapatnījane</i> comporte toi en amie envers tes rivales.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rttidiipikaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vṛttidīpikā</i> [<a href="#entry-diipikaa" class="skt-link">dīpikā</a>] <a href="#entry-v_rttidiipikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de la Vṛttidīpikā, œuvre de grammaire de <a href="#entry-Uzriik_r_s_nabha_t_ta" class="skt-link">Śrīkṛṣṇabhaṭṭa</a> (18⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rttiniyaamaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vṛttiniyāmaka</i> [<a href="#entry-niyaamaka" class="skt-link">niyāmaka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-v_rttiniyaamaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-v_rttiniyaamaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-v_rttiniyaamikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vṛttiniyāmikā</i> phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] se dit d'une relation factuelle [<a href="#entry-sambandha" class="skt-link">sambandha</a>]; opp. <a href="#entry-v_rttyaniyaamaka" class="skt-link">vṛttyaniyāmaka</a>.<br> <i>sambandho</i> <i>dvividhaḥ</i> <i>vṛttiniyāmakaḥ</i> <i>vṛttyaniyāmakaśceti</i> phil. [<a href="#entry-Upaaribhaa_sipadaarthasafgraha" class="skt-link">Pāribhāṣipadārthasaṃgraha</a>] Les relations sont de deux sortes: factuelles et conventionnelles.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rttitaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vṛttitā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-v_rttitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> conduite, mode de subsistance — ifc. dévouement à.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rttitva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vṛttitva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-v_rttitva" class="skt-link">n.</a> état de subsistance; occupation — ifc. phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] présence de ⟨g.⟩ en ⟨iic.⟩; résidence en ⟨iic.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rttyaniyaamaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vṛttyaniyāmaka</i> [<a href="#entry-aniyaamaka" class="skt-link">aniyāmaka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-v_rttyaniyaamaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-v_rttyaniyaamaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-v_rttyaniyaamaka" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vṛttyaniyāmaka</i> phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] se dit d'une relation conventionnelle [<a href="#entry-bhaava" class="skt-link">bhāva</a>]; opp. <a href="#entry-v_rttiniyaamaka" class="skt-link">vṛttiniyāmaka</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-v_rtti" class="skt-link">vṛtti</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rzcadvana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vṛścadvana</i> [<a href="#entry-vana" class="skt-link">vana</a>] a. <a href="#entry-v_rzcadvana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-v_rzcadvana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-v_rzcadvanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vṛścadvanā</i> qui détruit la forêt — <a href="#entry-v_rzcadvana" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. épith. d'<a href="#entry-Uagni" class="skt-link">Agni</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-v_rzcat" class="skt-link">vṛścat</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rzcana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वृश्चन</span> <i>vṛścana</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vrazc" class="skt-link">vraśc</a>] <a href="#entry-v_rzcana" class="skt-link">m.</a> natu. zoo. scorpion; syn. <a href="#entry-v_rzcika" class="skt-link">vṛścika</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rzcat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वृश्चत्</span> <i>vṛścat</i> [ppr. <a href="#entry-vrazc" class="skt-link">vraśc</a>] a. <a href="#entry-v_rzcat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-v_rzcat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-v_rzcantii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vṛścantī</i> déchirant, découpant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-v_rzcika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वृश्चिक</span> <i>vṛścika</i> [<a href="#entry-vrazc" class="skt-link">vraśc</a><a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] <a href="#entry-v_rzcika" class="skt-link">m.</a> natu. zoo. scorpion <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> astr. signe zodiacal [<a href="#entry-raazi" class="skt-link">rāśi</a>] du Scorpion.<br> <i>gomayād</i> <i>vṛściko</i> <i>jāyate</i> Le scorpion naît de la bouse de vache.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-va_daba">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वडब</span> <i>vaḍaba</i> <a href="#entry-va_daba" class="skt-link">m.</a> cf. <a href="#entry-va_dava" class="skt-link">vaḍava</a> — <a href="#entry-va_dabaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaḍabā</i> cf. <a href="#entry-va_davaa" class="skt-link">vaḍavā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-va_dava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वडव</span> <i>vaḍava</i> <a href="#entry-va_dava" class="skt-link">m.</a> cheval attirant l'étalon <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> var. <i>vaḍaba</i> id. — f. cf. <a href="#entry-va_davaa" class="skt-link">vaḍavā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-va_davaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वडवा</span> <i>vaḍavā</i> [f. <a href="#entry-va_dava" class="skt-link">vaḍava</a>] <a href="#entry-va_davaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> jument <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Vaḍavā, épith. de la nymphe <a href="#entry-Uazvinii" class="skt-link">Aśvinī</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> var. <i>vaḍabā</i> id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-va_davaagni">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vaḍavāgni</i> [<a href="#entry-agni" class="skt-link">agni</a>] <a href="#entry-va_davaagni" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Vaḍabāgni ou Vaḍavāgni «Feu de la jument», feu inextinguible sortant d'une caverne sous-marine dans les régions Sud, issu de l'ardeur de la pénitence d'<a href="#entry-Uaurva" class="skt-link">Aurva</a>; on dit que sa fumée est la source des éclairs; aussi <a href="#entry-Uba_davaagni" class="skt-link">Baḍavāgni</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvaa_davaagni" class="skt-link">Vāḍavāgni</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-va_davaamukha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vaḍavāmukha</i> [<a href="#entry-mukha" class="skt-link">mukha</a>] <a href="#entry-va_davaamukha" class="skt-link">n.</a> myth. np. du Vaḍavāmukha ou Vaḍabāmukha «Bouche de la jument», une des portes des régions infernales, située au pôle Sud.<br> <a href="#entry-va_davaa" class="skt-link">vaḍavā</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-va_davaanala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vaḍavānala</i> [<a href="#entry-anala" class="skt-link">anala</a>] <a href="#entry-va_davaanala" class="skt-link">m.</a> cf. <a href="#entry-va_davaagni" class="skt-link">vaḍavāgni</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-va_mza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वंश</span> <i>vaṃśa</i> <a href="#entry-va_mza" class="skt-link">m.</a> canne de bambou, de roseau, de canne à sucre; poutre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> colonne vertébrale <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> flûte (en bambou) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. lignée, race, famille, dynastie; multitude <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. chronique (d'une dynastie) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. caste; cf. <a href="#entry-triva_mza" class="skt-link">trivaṃśa</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. la généalogie des dieux et des sages, un <a href="#entry-pa_ncalak_sa_na" class="skt-link">pañcalakṣaṇa</a> — ifc. collection, assemblage de; multitude de.<br> <i>sūryavaṃśa</i> myth. lignée solaire; cf. <a href="#entry-Uvivasvaan" class="skt-link">Vivasvān</a>, <a href="#entry-Umanu" class="skt-link">Manu</a>, <a href="#entry-Uik_svaaku" class="skt-link">Ikṣvāku</a>, <a href="#entry-Udazaratha" class="skt-link">Daśaratha</a>, <a href="#entry-Uraama" class="skt-link">Rāma</a>.<br> <i>somavaṃśa</i> myth. lignée lunaire; cf. <a href="#entry-Ubudha" class="skt-link">Budha</a>, <a href="#entry-Upuuru" class="skt-link">Pūru</a>, <a href="#entry-Udu_syanta" class="skt-link">Duṣyanta</a>, <a href="#entry-Upuruuravaa" class="skt-link">Purūravā</a>, <a href="#entry-Ubharata" class="skt-link">Bharata</a>, <a href="#entry-Ukuru" class="skt-link">Kuru</a>, <a href="#entry-Uzaantanu" class="skt-link">Śāṃtanu</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-va_mzaanucarita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vaṃśānucarita</i> [<a href="#entry-anucarita" class="skt-link">anucarita</a>] <a href="#entry-va_mzaanucarita" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. l'histoire des dynasties, un <a href="#entry-pa_ncalak_sa_na" class="skt-link">pañcalakṣaṇa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-va_mzaavalii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vaṃśāvalī</i> [<a href="#entry-aavalii" class="skt-link">āvalī</a>] <a href="#entry-va_mzaavalii" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. chronique de dynastie.<br> <a href="#entry-va_mza" class="skt-link">vaṃśa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-va_mzastha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vaṃśastha</i> [<a href="#entry-stha" class="skt-link">stha</a>] <a href="#entry-va_mzastha" class="skt-link">m.</a> phon. nom d'un mètre homosyllabique de 12 syllabes par pada.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-va_mzii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वंशी</span> <i>vaṃśī</i> [f. <a href="#entry-va_mza" class="skt-link">vaṃśa</a>] <a href="#entry-va_mzii" class="skt-link">f.</a> flûte (en bambou) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. not. la flute de <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a>-<a href="#entry-Ugopaala" class="skt-link">Gopāla</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-va_mziiya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वंशीय</span> <i>vaṃśīya</i> [<a href="#entry-va_mza" class="skt-link">vaṃśa</a><a href="#entry--iiya" class="skt-link">-īya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-va_mziiya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-va_mziiya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-va_mziiyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaṃśīyā</i> de la famille <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> de bonne famille.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-va_mzin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वंशिन्</span> <i>vaṃśin</i> [<a href="#entry-va_mza" class="skt-link">vaṃśa</a><a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>] a. <a href="#entry-va_mzin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-va_mzin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-va_mzinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaṃśinī</i> appartenant à une famille.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-va_mzya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वंश्य</span> <i>vaṃśya</i> [<a href="#entry-va_mza" class="skt-link">vaṃśa</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-va_mzya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-va_mzya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-va_mzyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaṃśyā</i> qui a trait à la dynastie <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> issu de la colonne vertébrale (se dit d'os des membres) — <a href="#entry-va_mzya" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. membre de la lignée; prince de sang <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. soc. membres d'une lignée; descendants d'une dynastie.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-va_n_da">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वण्ड</span> <i>vaṇḍa</i> var. <i>baṇḍa</i> a. <a href="#entry-va_n_da" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-va_n_da" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-va_n_daa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaṇḍā</i> mutilé, estropié; castré, impuissant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-va_nij">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वणिज्</span> <i>vaṇij</i> <a href="#entry-va_nij" class="skt-link">m.</a> marchand, commerçant — <a href="#entry-va_nij" class="skt-link">f.</a> commerce.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-va_nija">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वणिज</span> <i>vaṇija</i> [<a href="#entry-va_nij" class="skt-link">vaṇij</a>] <a href="#entry-va_nija" class="skt-link">m.</a> marchand — <a href="#entry-va_nija" class="skt-link">n.</a> astr. signe zodiacal de la Balance <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> astr. sixième demi-jour lunaire [<a href="#entry-kara_na" class="skt-link">karaṇa</a>] (mobile) — <a href="#entry-va_nijaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaṇijā</i> trafic, commerce.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-va_sa_t">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वषट्</span> <i>vaṣaṭ</i> [<a href="#entry-vah_1" class="skt-link">vah_1</a>] interj. véd. que vienne ⟨dat.⟩ (invocation à une divinité par le <a href="#entry-hot_r" class="skt-link">hotṛ</a> à la fin de la récitation d'un rituel, après quoi l'<a href="#entry-adhvaryu" class="skt-link">adhvaryu</a> verse l'oblation dans le feu sacrificiel).<br> <i>pūṣṇe</i> <i>vaṣaṭ</i> invocation à <a href="#entry-Upuu_saa" class="skt-link">Pūṣā</a>.<br> <i>vaṣaṭ</i> <i>kṛ</i> soc. effectuer l'invocation <a href="#entry-va_sa_t" class="skt-link">vaṣaṭ</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-va_sa_tkaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vaṣaṭkāra</i> [<a href="#entry-kaara" class="skt-link">kāra</a>] <a href="#entry-va_sa_tkaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. performance de l'invocation <a href="#entry-va_sa_t" class="skt-link">vaṣaṭ</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-va_sa_t" class="skt-link">vaṣaṭ</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-va_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वट</span> <i>vaṭa</i> <a href="#entry-va_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> natu. bot. <i>Ficus indica</i>, arbre banian; syn. <a href="#entry-nyagrodha" class="skt-link">nyagrodha</a>, <a href="#entry-zufga" class="skt-link">śuṅga</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> fil, corde.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-va_taka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वटक</span> <i>vaṭaka</i> <a href="#entry-va_taka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-va_taka" class="skt-link">n.</a> globule, boulette; not. boulette de pâte de lentilles frite.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-va_tapattra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vaṭapattra</i> [<a href="#entry-pattra" class="skt-link">pattra</a>] <a href="#entry-va_tapattra" class="skt-link">n.</a> géo. np. de la ville de Vaṭapattra, sur les bords de la <a href="#entry-Uvizvaamitrii" class="skt-link">Viśvāmitrī</a>, au Gujarāt (mod. Vadodarā-Baroda); elle s'appelait autrefois Candravatī, puis Vīravatī; ce fief marathe fut arraché à l'empire Moghol en 1721 par le clan <a href="#entry-Ugaayakavaa_da" class="skt-link">Gāyakavāḍa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-va_tapuur_nimaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vaṭapūrṇimā</i> [<a href="#entry-puur_nimaa" class="skt-link">pūrṇimā</a>] <a href="#entry-va_tapuur_nimaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> soc. pleine lune du mois <a href="#entry-jyai_s_tha" class="skt-link">jyaiṣṭha</a>; dans l'Ouest de l'Inde, on y pratique la <a href="#entry-va_tasaavitriipuujaa" class="skt-link">vaṭasāvitrīpūjā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-va_tasaavitriipuujaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vaṭasāvitrīpūjā</i> [<a href="#entry-saavitrii" class="skt-link">sāvitrī</a>-<a href="#entry-puujaa" class="skt-link">pūjā</a>] <a href="#entry-va_tasaavitriipuujaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> soc. célébration de <a href="#entry-Usaavitrii_1" class="skt-link">Sāvitrī_1</a> lors de la <a href="#entry-va_tapuur_nimaa" class="skt-link">vaṭapūrṇimā</a>; les femmes y jeûnent en priant pour la santé de leur mari; elles font 7 fois le tour d'un banyan sacré [<a href="#entry-parikrama" class="skt-link">parikrama</a>], qu'elles entourent de fils de coton.<br> <a href="#entry-va_ta" class="skt-link">vaṭa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaa_daba">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाडब</span> <i>vāḍaba</i> var. <i>vāḍava</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-va_daba" class="skt-link">vaḍaba</a>] <a href="#entry-vaa_daba" class="skt-link">m.</a> étalon.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaa_dabaagni">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vāḍabāgni</i> [<a href="#entry-agni" class="skt-link">agni</a>] <a href="#entry-vaa_dabaagni" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Vāḍabāgni ou Vāḍavāgni «Feu Équin»; cf. <a href="#entry-Uva_davaagni" class="skt-link">Vaḍavāgni</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vaa_daba" class="skt-link">vāḍaba</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाण</span> <i>vāṇa</i> <a href="#entry-vaa_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> son; musique; harpe <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> [<i>bāṇa</i>] roseau; flèche — <a href="#entry-vaa_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāṇī</i> son; musique <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> parole, voix, diction; bonne diction; discours éloquent <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Vāṇī «Parole», épith. de <a href="#entry-Usarasvatii" class="skt-link">Sarasvatī</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. orchestre; chœur.<br> <i>sapta</i> <i>vāṇyaḥ</i> les 7 notes de la gamme.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaa_nija">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाणिज</span> <i>vāṇija</i> var. <i>bāṇija</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-va_nij" class="skt-link">vaṇij</a>] <a href="#entry-vaa_nija" class="skt-link">m.</a> marchand <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hi. <i>Banya</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaa_nijaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vāṇijaka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] <a href="#entry-vaa_nijaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> marchand, commerçant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaa_nijika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vāṇijika</i> [<a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] <a href="#entry-vaa_nijika" class="skt-link">m.</a> marchand, commerçant.<br> <a href="#entry-vaa_nija" class="skt-link">vāṇija</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaa_nijya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाणिज्य</span> <i>vāṇijya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-va_nij" class="skt-link">vaṇij</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-vaa_nijya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaa_nijyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāṇijyā</i> commerce.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaa_nijyaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vāṇijyaka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] <a href="#entry-vaa_nijyaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> marchand, commerçant.<br> <a href="#entry-vaa_nijya" class="skt-link">vāṇijya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaa_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वा</span> <i>vā_1</i> conj. cl. ou, ou bien, soit; à supposer que, comme <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> ou plutôt, ou mieux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> vraiment <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> toutefois, pourtant <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> même à supposer que ⟨futur⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> ⟨interr.⟩ donc; n'est-ce pas; est-ce que? <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. optionnellement<br> <i>na</i> <i>vā</i> sinon; optionnellement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> plutôt que.<br> <i>na</i> <i>...</i> <i>vā</i> ni ... ni.<br> <i>na</i> <i>vā</i> <i>...</i> <i>vā</i> id.<br> <i>vā</i> <i>...</i> <i>vā</i> soit ... soit.<br> <i>yadi</i> <i>vā</i> <i>...</i> <i>vā</i> id.<br> <i>vā</i> <i>na</i> <i>vā</i> oui ou non <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> rarement.<br> <i>vā</i> <i>na</i> <i>...</i> <i>vā</i> soit on n'a pas ... soit.<br> <i>yadi</i> <i>...</i> <i>vā</i> à moins que.<br> <i>atha</i> <i>vā</i> ou bien; mais.<br> <i>ke</i> <i>vā</i> (suivi d'une négation) tous.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaa_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">वा</span> <i>vā_2</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(vāti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vāta</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>nis</i>, <i>pra</i><i>)</i> souffler, venter; souffler sur ou vers ⟨acc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> s'exhaler; émettre (odeur) — ca. <i>(vāpayati)</i> faire souffler <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gr. αω; lat. <i>aer</i>; all. wehen; ang. air; fr. air.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaa_3">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">वा</span> <i>vā_3</i> var. <i>ve</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. <i>(vayati)</i> pr. md. <i>(vayate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>uta_2</i>, <i>ūta</i><i>)</i> tisser — ps. <i>(ūyate)</i> être tissé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaac">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाच्</span> <i>vāc</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vac" class="skt-link">vac</a>] <a href="#entry-vaac" class="skt-link">f.</a> voix, parole, son; verbe, langage, discours; parole sainte <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-saafkhya" class="skt-link">sāṃkhya</a>] la faculté [<a href="#entry-karmendriya" class="skt-link">karmendriya</a>] de parole, dont le régent [<a href="#entry-niyant_r" class="skt-link">niyantṛ</a>] est <a href="#entry-Uagni" class="skt-link">Agni</a>; son élément [<a href="#entry-bhuuta" class="skt-link">bhūta</a>] prédominant est <a href="#entry-aakaaza" class="skt-link">ākāśa</a> l'éther; la perception [<a href="#entry-tanmaatra" class="skt-link">tanmātra</a>] associée est le son [<a href="#entry-zabda" class="skt-link">śabda</a>] qui excite le sens [<a href="#entry-buddhiindriya" class="skt-link">buddhīndriya</a>] de l'ouïe [<a href="#entry-zrotra" class="skt-link">śrotra</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Vāk, la Parole personnifiée, épith. de <a href="#entry-Usarasvatii" class="skt-link">Sarasvatī</a> — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. <i>(vācyati)</i> souhaiter une parole.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaacaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाचा</span> <i>vācā</i> [<a href="#entry-vaac" class="skt-link">vāc</a>] <a href="#entry-vaacaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> parole; mot; texte.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaacaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाचक</span> <i>vācaka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vac" class="skt-link">vac</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaacaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaacaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaacikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vācikā</i> qui parle, qui récite; qui parle de ⟨g. iic.⟩ — <a href="#entry-vaacaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. essence sonore d'une divinité (<a href="#entry-svaruupamantra" class="skt-link">svarūpamantra</a>) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. mot dénotant; opp. <a href="#entry-dyotaka" class="skt-link">dyotaka</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaacaknavii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाचक्नवी</span> <i>vācaknavī</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vacaknu" class="skt-link">vacaknu</a>] <a href="#entry-vaacaknavii" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de Vācaknavī, patr. de la philosophe <a href="#entry-Ugargii" class="skt-link">Gargī</a> «fille de <a href="#entry-Uvacaknu" class="skt-link">Vacaknu</a>».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaacana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाचन</span> <i>vācana</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vacana" class="skt-link">vacana</a>] <a href="#entry-vaacana" class="skt-link">n.</a> récitation, lecture — <a href="#entry-vaacanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vācanā</i> leçon; chapitre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaacanaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vācanaka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] <a href="#entry-vaacanaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> récitation; not. de bénédiction [<a href="#entry-svasti" class="skt-link">svasti</a>].<br> <a href="#entry-vaacana" class="skt-link">vācana</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaacanika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाचनिक</span> <i>vācanika</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vacana" class="skt-link">vacana</a><a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaacanika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaacanika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaacanikii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vācanikī</i> gram. mentionné expressément, enseigné explicitement; opp. <a href="#entry-svaabhaavika" class="skt-link">svābhāvika</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaacas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाचस्</span> <i>vācas</i> [g. <a href="#entry-vaac" class="skt-link">vāc</a>] iic.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaacaspati">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vācaspati</i> [<a href="#entry-pati" class="skt-link">pati</a>] <a href="#entry-vaacaspati" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Vācaspati «Maître de la Parole», épith. de divers dieux, not. <a href="#entry-Ub_rhaspati" class="skt-link">Bṛhaspati</a>; il préside à la faculté humaine de la parole <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. titre de lettré [<a href="#entry-pa_n_dita" class="skt-link">paṇḍita</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. du philosophe Vācaspati_1 <a href="#entry-Umizra" class="skt-link">Miśra</a> (9⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle), de tradition moniste [<a href="#entry-advaita" class="skt-link">advaita</a>]; il est l'auteur de l'exégèse <a href="#entry-Ubhaamatii" class="skt-link">Bhāmatī</a> du commentaire <a href="#entry-Ubrahmasuutrabhaa_sya" class="skt-link">Brahmasūtrabhāṣya</a> de <a href="#entry-Uzafkaraacaarya" class="skt-link">Śaṅkarācārya</a>, et de la glose <a href="#entry-Utaatparya_tiikaa" class="skt-link">Tātparyaṭīkā</a> du <a href="#entry-Unyaayabhaa_sya" class="skt-link">Nyāyabhāṣya</a>; on lui doit aussi le <a href="#entry-Utattvabindu" class="skt-link">Tattvabindu</a>, le commentaire <a href="#entry-Utattvavaizaaradii" class="skt-link">Tattvavaiśāradī</a> du <a href="#entry-Upaata_njalayogazaastra" class="skt-link">Pātañjalayogaśāstra</a>, et la <a href="#entry-Usaafkhyatattvakaumudii" class="skt-link">Sāṃkhyatattvakaumudī</a>; pour son érudition, on lui donna le titre de <a href="#entry-sarvatantrasvatantra" class="skt-link">sarvatantrasvatantra</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> [<i>tarkavācaspati</i>] hist. np. de <a href="#entry-Utaaraanaatha" class="skt-link">Tārānātha</a> <a href="#entry-Utarkavaacaspati" class="skt-link">Tarkavācaspati</a>, (1806–1885), érudit bengali, lexicographe, auteur du <a href="#entry-Uvaacaspatya" class="skt-link">Vācaspatya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaacaspatya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vācaspatya</i> [<a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaacaspatya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaacaspatya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaacaspatyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vācaspatyā</i> relatif à <a href="#entry-Uvaacaspati" class="skt-link">Vācaspati</a> — <a href="#entry-vaacaspatya" class="skt-link">n.</a> éloquence <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. np. du Vācaspatya, encyclopédie du sanskrit dûe au <a href="#entry-pa_n_dita" class="skt-link">paṇḍita</a> <a href="#entry-Utaaraanaatha" class="skt-link">Tārānātha</a> <a href="#entry-Utarkavaacaspati" class="skt-link">Tarkavācaspati</a> (1884, Calcutta).<br> <a href="#entry-vaacas" class="skt-link">vācas</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaacika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाचिक</span> <i>vācika</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vac" class="skt-link">vac</a><a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaacika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaacika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaacikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vācikā</i> verbal; communiqué oralement — <a href="#entry-vaacika" class="skt-link">m.</a> discours.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaacin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाचिन्</span> <i>vācin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vac" class="skt-link">vac</a>] <a href="#entry-vaacinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vācinī</i> ifc. qui asserte; qui présume; qui signifie.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaacya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाच्य</span> <i>vācya</i> [ca. pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-vac" class="skt-link">vac</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaacya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaacya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaacyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vācyā</i> à dire, à énoncer; dont on doit parler; qui mérite d'être dit <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> à qui l'on doit ou peut adresser la parole <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> à dénoncer; répréhensible, blâmable — <a href="#entry-vaacya" class="skt-link">n.</a> blâme, reproche; ce qu'on doit dénoncer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. ce qui est exprimé; sens, connotation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. voix; il y a trois voix: l'actif, où le verbe dénote l'agent [<a href="#entry-kart_r" class="skt-link">kartṛ</a>], le passif, où le verbe dénote le patient ou le but [<a href="#entry-kart_r" class="skt-link">kartṛ</a>], et l'impersonnel, où le verbe dénote seulement le procès; les autres rôles sémantiques [<a href="#entry-kaaraka" class="skt-link">kāraka</a>] nécessités par la paraphrase doivent être fournis aux cas correspondants.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaacyaavacana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vācyāvacana</i> [<a href="#entry-avacana" class="skt-link">avacana</a>] <a href="#entry-vaacyaavacana" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. non énonciation de ce qui doit être dit, un défault esthétique de la poésie.<br> <a href="#entry-vaacya" class="skt-link">vācya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaad">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाद्</span> <i>vād</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-vad" class="skt-link">vad</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(vādayati)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>vādya</i><i>)</i> ppr. ps. <i>(vādyamāna)</i> faire parler, faire dire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> jouer d'un instrument de musique ⟨i.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाद</span> <i>vāda</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vad" class="skt-link">vad</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaada" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaada" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaadaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vādā</i> ifc. qui parle de, qui fait entendre, qui proclame — <a href="#entry-vaada" class="skt-link">m.</a> parole, déclaration, discussion; énoncé, narration; thèse, théorie <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil.
