[<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] débat intellectuel; <a href="#entry-Uak_sapaada" class="skt-link">Akṣapāda</a> distingue le débat honnête [<a href="#entry-vaada" class="skt-link">vāda</a>] où les adversaires cherchent à établir la vérité, le débat spécieux [<a href="#entry-jalpa" class="skt-link">jalpa</a>] dont le seul but est de gagner l'argument, et le débat offensif [<a href="#entry-vita_n_daa" class="skt-link">vitaṇḍā</a>] dont le but est de démolir l'adversaire par tous les moyens <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> controverse; dispute, querelle <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> son (d'instrument); chant (d'oiseau) — ifc. discussion de; mention de; doctrine de.<br> <i>ādau</i> <i>vāda</i> <i>āsīt</i> [Jean] Au commencement était le Verbe.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaadaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वादक</span> <i>vādaka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vad" class="skt-link">vad</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaadaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaadaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaadikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vādikā</i> musicien.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaadana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वादन</span> <i>vādana</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vad" class="skt-link">vad</a>] <a href="#entry-vaadana" class="skt-link">m.</a> musicien — <a href="#entry-vaadana" class="skt-link">n.</a> bruit — <a href="#entry-vaadanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vādanā</i> ifc. son de, musique de; jeu de (instrument) — loc. <i>vādane</i> ifc. mod. à (telle) heure.<br> <i>saptavādane</i> adv. mod. [«quand sonne 7 h»] à 7 h.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaadavidyaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vādavidyā</i> [<a href="#entry-vidyaa" class="skt-link">vidyā</a>] <a href="#entry-vaadavidyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] rhétorique; <a href="#entry-Uak_sapaada" class="skt-link">Akṣapāda</a> la théorisa.<br> <a href="#entry-vaadana" class="skt-link">vādana</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaadhuula">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाधूल</span> <i>vādhūla</i> <a href="#entry-vaadhuula" class="skt-link">m.</a> patr. de Vādhūla <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. np. du <a href="#entry-Uvaadhuula" class="skt-link">Vādhūla</a> <a href="#entry-zrautasuutra" class="skt-link">śrautasūtra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaadin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वादिन्</span> <i>vādin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vad" class="skt-link">vad</a>] ifc. a. <a href="#entry-vaadin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaadin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaadinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vādinī</i> qui parle, qui dit, qui énonce, qui affirme.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaadya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाद्य</span> <i>vādya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-vaad" class="skt-link">vād</a>] <a href="#entry-vaadya" class="skt-link">n.</a> musique (instrumentale) — <a href="#entry-vaadya" class="skt-link">m.</a> instrument de musique.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaadyamaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाद्यमान</span> <i>vādyamāna</i> [ppr. ps. <a href="#entry-vaad" class="skt-link">vād</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaadyamaana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaadyamaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaadyamaanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vādyamānā</i> étant joué.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaadyavidyaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vādyavidyā</i> [<a href="#entry-vidyaa" class="skt-link">vidyā</a>] <a href="#entry-vaadyavidyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> connaissance de la musique.<br> <a href="#entry-vaadya" class="skt-link">vādya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaaf">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाङ्</span> <i>vāṅ</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-vaac" class="skt-link">vāc</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaafmatii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vāṅmatī</i> [<a href="#entry--mat" class="skt-link">-mat</a>] <a href="#entry-vaafmatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> géo. np. de la Vāṅmatī «où coule la Parole», rivière sacrée du Népal; mod. Bāgmatī.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaafmaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vāṅmaya</i> [<a href="#entry-maya" class="skt-link">maya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaafmaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaafmaya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaafmayii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāṅmayī</i> concernant la parole; dont la nature est la parole — <a href="#entry-vaafmaya" class="skt-link">n.</a> language; éloquence, rhétorique; littérature — <a href="#entry-vaafmayii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāṅmayī</i> myth. np. de Vāṅmayī «Faite de parole», épith. de <a href="#entry-Usarasvatii" class="skt-link">Sarasvatī</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vaaf" class="skt-link">vāṅ</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaag">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाग्</span> <i>vāg</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-vaac" class="skt-link">vāc</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaagbha_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vāgbhaṭa</i> [<a href="#entry-bha_ta" class="skt-link">bhaṭa</a>] <a href="#entry-vaagbha_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. de Vṛddha Vāgbhaṭa l'ancien, médecin du 7⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle; on lui doit l'<a href="#entry-Ua_s_taafgah_rdaya" class="skt-link">Aṣṭāṅgahṛdaya</a> <a href="#entry-sa_mhitaa" class="skt-link">saṃhitā</a>, synthèse des connaissances médicales indiennes [<a href="#entry-aayurveda" class="skt-link">āyurveda</a>]; l'<a href="#entry-Ua_s_taafgasafgraha" class="skt-link">Aṣṭāṅgasaṃgraha</a>, ouvrage voisin en prose, lui est aussi attribué, mais son authenticité est contestée <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. du médecin Vāgbhaṭa_1 le jeune, descendant du précédent, qui aurait vécu un siècle plus tard <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. de Vāgbhaṭa_2, poète du 12⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle, auteur du <a href="#entry-Uvaagbha_taalafkaara" class="skt-link">Vāgbhaṭālaṃkāra</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. de Vāgbhaṭa_3, poète du 13⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle, auteur du <a href="#entry-Ukaavyaanuzaasana_1" class="skt-link">Kāvyānuśāsana_1</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaagbha_taalafkaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vāgbhaṭālaṃkāra</i> [<a href="#entry-alafkaara" class="skt-link">alaṃkāra</a>] <a href="#entry-vaagbha_taala_mkaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du Vāgbhaṭālaṃkāra, ouvrage de poétique dû à <a href="#entry-Uvaagbha_ta_2" class="skt-link">Vāgbhaṭa_2</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vaagbha_ta" class="skt-link">vāgbhaṭa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaagbhava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vāgbhava</i> [<a href="#entry-bhava" class="skt-link">bhava</a>] <a href="#entry-vaagbhava" class="skt-link">n.</a> [<i>vāgbhavabīja</i>] phil. [<a href="#entry-tantra" class="skt-link">tantra</a>] le <a href="#entry-biijamantra" class="skt-link">bījamantra</a> ‘<a href="#entry-ai_m" class="skt-link">aiṃ</a>’.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaagdaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vāgdāna</i> [<a href="#entry-daana" class="skt-link">dāna</a>] <a href="#entry-vaagdaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> soc. engagement d'une fiancée en vue d'un mariage.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaagdu_s_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vāgduṣṭa</i> [<a href="#entry-du_s_ta" class="skt-link">duṣṭa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaagdu_s_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaagdu_s_ta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaagdu_s_taa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāgduṣṭā</i> qui utilise un mauvais langage, grossier.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaagiiza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vāgīśa</i> [<a href="#entry-iiza" class="skt-link">īśa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaagiiza" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaagiiza" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaagiizaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāgīśā</i> éloquent, bon orateur; titre de poète — <a href="#entry-vaagiiza" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Vāgīśa, épith. de <a href="#entry-Ub_rhaspati" class="skt-link">Bṛhaspati</a> «Maître de la parole».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaagiizvara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vāgīśvara</i> [<a href="#entry-iizvara" class="skt-link">īśvara</a>] <a href="#entry-vaagiizvara" class="skt-link">m.</a> orateur éloquent <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bd. sage déifié; qualifie not. <a href="#entry-Uma_njugho_sa" class="skt-link">Mañjughoṣa</a> — <a href="#entry-vaagiizvarii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāgīśvarī</i> myth. épith. de <a href="#entry-Usarasvatii" class="skt-link">Sarasvatī</a> «Éloquente».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaagiizvarakiirti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vāgīśvarakīrti</i> [<a href="#entry-kiirti" class="skt-link">kīrti</a>] <a href="#entry-vaagiizvarakiirti" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. du maître tantrique bd. Vāgīśvarakīrti qui enseignait à <a href="#entry-Uvikramaziila" class="skt-link">Vikramaśīla</a> (10-11⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle) avec le titre de «Maître de la porte de l'Ouest» [<a href="#entry-dvaarapa_n_dita" class="skt-link">dvārapaṇḍita</a>]; il est l'auteur du <a href="#entry-Um_rtyuva_ncanopadeza" class="skt-link">Mṛtyuvañcanopadeśa</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vaagiizvara" class="skt-link">vāgīśvara</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaagmin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vāgmin</i> var. <i>vāggmin</i> [<a href="#entry--min" class="skt-link">-min</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaagmin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaagmin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaagminii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāgminī</i> éloquent — <a href="#entry-vaagmin" class="skt-link">m.</a> [«maître de la parole»] intellectuel, érudit.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaagvardhinii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vāgvardhinī</i> [<a href="#entry-vardhinii" class="skt-link">vardhinī</a>] <a href="#entry-vaagvardhinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> [<i>vāgvardhinīsabhā</i>] classe de perfectionnement en langue.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaagvid">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vāgvid</i> [<a href="#entry-vid_3" class="skt-link">vid_3</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaagvid" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaagvid" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaagvid" class="skt-link">f.</a> éloquent <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lettré; sage.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaagvin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vāgvin</i> [<a href="#entry--vin" class="skt-link">-vin</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaagvin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaagvin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaagvinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāgvinī</i> éloquent.<br> <a href="#entry-vaag" class="skt-link">vāg</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaah">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाह्</span> <i>vāh</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-vah_1" class="skt-link">vah_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(vāhayati)</i> conduire, diriger, se servir d'un véhicule <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> faire porter — ps. <i>(vāhyate)</i> faire porter, faire transporter ⟨2 acc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> guider (cheval); conduire (char).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaaha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाह</span> <i>vāha</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vah_1" class="skt-link">vah_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaaha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaaha" class="skt-link">n.</a> ifc. qui porte, qui charrie, qui conduit, qui coule <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> vent — <a href="#entry-vaaha" class="skt-link">m.</a> monture, véhicule; bête de trait, not. cheval.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaahana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाहन</span> <i>vāhana</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vaah" class="skt-link">vāh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaahana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaahana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaahanii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāhanī</i> qui tire, qui transporte, qui apporte — <a href="#entry-vaahana" class="skt-link">n.</a> conduite <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> véhicule <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> monture <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. animal associé à un dieu comme son suivant; cf. <a href="#entry-Ugaru_da" class="skt-link">Garuḍa</a>, <a href="#entry-Unandii" class="skt-link">Nandī</a>, <a href="#entry-Uparavaa_ni" class="skt-link">Paravāṇi</a>, <a href="#entry-Umakara" class="skt-link">Makara</a>, <a href="#entry-Uha_msa" class="skt-link">Haṃsa</a> — ifc. qui transporte; transport de.<br> <i>vāhanīkṛ</i> faire un véhicule de.<br> <i>vāhanībhū</i> devenir un véhicule.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaahanaayudhavartana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vāhanāyudhavartana</i> [<a href="#entry-aayudha" class="skt-link">āyudha</a>-<a href="#entry-vartana" class="skt-link">vartana</a>] <a href="#entry-vaahanaayudhavartana" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Vāhanāyudhavartana «Usage des montures et des armes», 9⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ chapitre du <a href="#entry-Uprati_s_thaalak_sa_nasaarasamuccaya" class="skt-link">Pratiṣṭhālakṣaṇasārasamuccaya</a>, qui traite de l'identification des divinités par leurs attributs.<br> <a href="#entry-vaahana" class="skt-link">vāhana</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaahika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाहिक</span> <i>vāhika</i> [<a href="#entry-vaah" class="skt-link">vāh</a><a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] <a href="#entry-vaahika" class="skt-link">m.</a> véhicule; transporteur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaahin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाहिन्</span> <i>vāhin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vaah" class="skt-link">vāh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaahin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaahin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaahinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāhinī</i> qui transporte, qui conduit — <a href="#entry-vaahinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāhinī</i> armée; not. division d'armée de 3 régiments [<a href="#entry-ga_na" class="skt-link">gaṇa</a>], comprenant 81 (3⟨sup⟩4⟨/sup⟩) éléphants et chars, 243 chevaux et 405 fantassins.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaahya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाह्य</span> <i>vāhya</i> [relié à <a href="#entry-baahya" class="skt-link">bāhya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaahya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaahya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaahyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāhyā</i> externe, situé à l'extérieur de ⟨abl. loc.⟩; opp. <a href="#entry-aabhyantara" class="skt-link">ābhyantara</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> extérieur, étranger à, contraire à <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> exclu, excommunié, hors-caste — <a href="#entry-vaahya" class="skt-link">m.</a> étranger.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaaja">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाज</span> <i>vāja</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vaj" class="skt-link">vaj</a>] <a href="#entry-vaaja" class="skt-link">m.</a> force; vigueur, énergie <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. nourriture rituelle <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. du <a href="#entry-_rbhu" class="skt-link">ṛbhu</a> Vāja «Force» — <a href="#entry-vaaja" class="skt-link">n.</a> nourriture; oblation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> véd. not. brouet de riz sauvage préparé par le prêtre pour le <a href="#entry-vaajapeya" class="skt-link">vājapeya</a> en sacrifice à <a href="#entry-Ub_rhaspati" class="skt-link">Bṛhaspati</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaajapeya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vājapeya</i> [<a href="#entry-peya" class="skt-link">peya</a>] <a href="#entry-vaajapeya" class="skt-link">n.</a> soc. [«boisson de vigueur»] rite royal véd. de sacrifice du <a href="#entry-soma" class="skt-link">soma</a> consacré à <a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a> et aux centaures [<a href="#entry-gandharvaas" class="skt-link">gandharvās</a>]; il célèbre la virilité d'un roi d'âge mûr; une course de 17 chars sur un parcours marqué de 17 flèches se termine rituellement par la victoire du roi; au centre du parcours un brâhmane, juché sur un mât [<a href="#entry-sthaa_nu" class="skt-link">sthāṇu</a>], y fait tournoyer une roue de char et chante des versets du <a href="#entry-U_rgveda" class="skt-link">Ṛgveda</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-yuuparoha_na" class="skt-link">yūparohaṇa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaajapyaayana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाजप्यायन</span> <i>vājapyāyana</i> <a href="#entry-vaajapyaayana" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. du grammairien antique Vājapyāyana.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaajasaneya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाजसनेय</span> <i>vājasaneya</i> <a href="#entry-vaajasaneya" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Vājasaneya, patr. de <a href="#entry-Uyaaj_navalkya" class="skt-link">Yājñavalkya</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. soc. l'école de <a href="#entry-Uvaajasaneya" class="skt-link">Vājasaneya</a> du <a href="#entry-Uyajurveda" class="skt-link">Yajurveda</a> blanc.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaajasaneyasa_mhitaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vājasaneyasaṃhitā</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_mhitaa" class="skt-link">saṃhitā</a>] <a href="#entry-vaajasaneyasa_mhitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de la Vājasaneyasaṃhitā, recension du <a href="#entry-Uyajurveda" class="skt-link">Yajurveda</a> blanc, établie par <a href="#entry-Uyaaj_navalkya" class="skt-link">Yājñavalkya</a>, et distribuée à ses 15 disciples; [AP.] elle est seule autorisée au <a href="#entry-kaliyuga" class="skt-link">kaliyuga</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaajasaneyi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाजसनेयि</span> <i>vājasaneyi</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-vaajasaneyin" class="skt-link">vājasaneyin</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaajasaneyin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vājasaneyin</i> [<a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaajasaneyin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaajasaneyin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaajasaneyinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vājasaneyinī</i> qui appartient à l'école de <a href="#entry-Uvaajasaneya" class="skt-link">Vājasaneya</a>-<a href="#entry-Uyaaj_navalkya" class="skt-link">Yājñavalkya</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. hist. école du <a href="#entry-Uyajurveda" class="skt-link">Yajurveda</a> blanc.<br> <a href="#entry-vaajasaneya" class="skt-link">vājasaneya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaajasaneyipraatizaakhya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vājasaneyiprātiśākhya</i> [<a href="#entry-praatizaakhya" class="skt-link">prātiśākhya</a>] <a href="#entry-vaajasaneyipraatizaakhya" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. le recueil <a href="#entry-praatizaakhya" class="skt-link">prātiśākhya</a> du <a href="#entry-Uyajurveda" class="skt-link">Yajurveda</a> blanc.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaajasaneyisa_mhitaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vājasaneyisaṃhitā</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_mhitaa" class="skt-link">saṃhitā</a>] <a href="#entry-vaajasaneyisa_mhitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de la Vājasaneyisaṃhitā ou <a href="#entry-Uyajurveda" class="skt-link">Yajurveda</a> blanc; cf. <a href="#entry-taittiriiya" class="skt-link">taittirīya</a>; on en distingue deux recensions [<a href="#entry-zaakhaa" class="skt-link">śākhā</a>]: la <a href="#entry-maadhyandiniiya" class="skt-link">mādhyaṃdinīya</a> et la <a href="#entry-kaa_nva" class="skt-link">kāṇva</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vaajasaneyi" class="skt-link">vājasaneyi</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaajavat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vājavat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaajavat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaajavat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaajavatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vājavatī</i> vigoureux, fort.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaajayu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाजयु</span> <i>vājayu</i> [<a href="#entry-vaaja" class="skt-link">vāja</a><a href="#entry--yu" class="skt-link">-yu</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaajayu" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaajayu" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaajayu" class="skt-link">f.</a> désireux de vaincre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaajazravas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vājaśravas</i> [<a href="#entry-zravas" class="skt-link">śravas</a>] <a href="#entry-vaajazravas" class="skt-link">m.</a> np. de Vājaśravā «Célèbre par sa vigueur».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaajazravasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vājaśravasa</i> <a href="#entry-vaajazravasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. [KU.] patr. de Vājaśravasa «fils de <a href="#entry-Uvaajazravaa" class="skt-link">Vājaśravā</a>»; il fit le sacrifice de toutes ses possessions [<a href="#entry-vizvajit" class="skt-link">viśvajit</a>], et envoya son fils <a href="#entry-Unaciketaa" class="skt-link">Naciketā</a> à la Mort [<a href="#entry-Uyama" class="skt-link">Yama</a>].<br> <a href="#entry-vaajazravas" class="skt-link">vājaśravas</a> <br> <a href="#entry-vaaja" class="skt-link">vāja</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaajii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाजी</span> <i>vājī</i> iiv. de <a href="#entry-vaaja" class="skt-link">vāja</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaajiikara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vājīkaraṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-kara_na" class="skt-link">karaṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-vaajiikara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> substance aphrodisiaque.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaajiikara_natantra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vājīkaraṇatantra</i> [<a href="#entry-tantra" class="skt-link">tantra</a>] <a href="#entry-vaajiikara_natantra" class="skt-link">n.</a> méd. la science des aphrodisiaques et de la vigueur sexuelle, une section de l'<a href="#entry-Uaayurveda" class="skt-link">Āyurveda</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vaajiikara_na" class="skt-link">vājīkaraṇa</a> <br> <a href="#entry-vaajii" class="skt-link">vājī</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaajin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाजिन्</span> <i>vājin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vaj" class="skt-link">vaj</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaajin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaajin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaajinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vājinī</i> valeureux, héroïque, viril; fort, efficace, prolifique — <a href="#entry-vaajin" class="skt-link">m.</a> cheval (symbole de la force).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaak">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाक्</span> <i>vāk</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-vaac" class="skt-link">vāc</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाक</span> <i>vāka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vac" class="skt-link">vac</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaakaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vākā</i> ifc. qui parle, qui récite; qui exprime — <a href="#entry-vaaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> récitation.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaakaa_taka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाकाटक</span> <i>vākāṭaka</i> <a href="#entry-vaakaa_taka" class="skt-link">m.</a> pl. hist. np. de la dynastie des princes Vākāṭakās; ils régnèrent au <a href="#entry-Umahaaraa_s_tra" class="skt-link">Mahārāṣṭra</a> du 3⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ au 5⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècles, succédant aux <a href="#entry-Usaatavaahanaas" class="skt-link">Sātavāhanās</a>; ils furent des mécènes de la religion et des arts; cf. <a href="#entry-Upravarapura" class="skt-link">Pravarapura</a>, <a href="#entry-Upravarasena_1" class="skt-link">Pravarasena_1</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaakkovida">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vākkovida</i> [<a href="#entry-kovida" class="skt-link">kovida</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaakkovida" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaakkovida" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaakkovidaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vākkovidā</i> expert en parole — <a href="#entry-vaakkovida" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. épith. de <a href="#entry-Uhanumaan" class="skt-link">Hanumān</a>, qui possède la science du langage.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaakovaakya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vākovākya</i> [<a href="#entry-vaakya" class="skt-link">vākya</a>] <a href="#entry-vaakovaakya" class="skt-link">n.</a> dialogue.<br> <a href="#entry-vaaka" class="skt-link">vāka</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaakpaaru_sya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vākpāruṣya</i> [<a href="#entry-paaru_sya" class="skt-link">pāruṣya</a>] <a href="#entry-vaakpaaru_sya" class="skt-link">n.</a> langage grossier, injurieux ou insultant; violence verbale.<br> <a href="#entry-vaak" class="skt-link">vāk</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaakpati">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vākpati</i> [<a href="#entry-pati" class="skt-link">pati</a>] <a href="#entry-vaakpati" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. de Vākpati «Maître du sanskrit», épith. du roi-poète <a href="#entry-Umu_nja" class="skt-link">Muñja</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaakya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाक्य</span> <i>vākya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-vac" class="skt-link">vac</a>] <a href="#entry-vaakya" class="skt-link">n.</a> parole, discours, langage, déclaration, édit, énonciation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. proposition, phrase (opp. mot [<a href="#entry-pada" class="skt-link">pada</a>]) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. expression analytique (opp. expression synthétique [<a href="#entry-v_rtti" class="skt-link">vṛtti</a>]) — <a href="#entry-vaakyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vākyā</i> ifc. parole de.<br> <i>samānavākye</i> adv. gram. dans la même phrase.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaakyaadhyaahaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vākyādhyāhāra</i> [<a href="#entry-adhyaahaara" class="skt-link">adhyāhāra</a>] <a href="#entry-vaakyaadhyaahaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> gram. paraphrase suppléant les termes omis d'une phrase elliptique.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaakyaartha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vākyārtha</i> [<a href="#entry-artha" class="skt-link">artha</a>] <a href="#entry-vaakyaartha" class="skt-link">m.</a> gram. sens d'une phrase; sémantique.<br> <i>vākyārthībhāva</i> gram. établissement du sens d'une phrase <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-miimaa_msaa" class="skt-link">mīmāṃsā</a>] transmission de l'intention communicative du locuteur; syn. <a href="#entry-taatparya" class="skt-link">tātparya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaakyaarthatva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vākyārthatva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-vaakyaarthatva" class="skt-link">n.</a> gram. qualité d'être le sens global de la phrase; syn. <i>vākyārthībhāva</i>.<br> <a href="#entry-vaakyaartha" class="skt-link">vākyārtha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaakyabheda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vākyabheda</i> [<a href="#entry-bheda" class="skt-link">bheda</a>] <a href="#entry-vaakyabheda" class="skt-link">m.</a> gram. segmentation d'une énonciation en phrases <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-miimaa_msaa" class="skt-link">mīmāṃsā</a>] ambiguité d'interprétation d'une injonction quant à viser un but unique; opp. <a href="#entry-vizi_s_tavidhaana" class="skt-link">viśiṣṭavidhāna</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. [«brisure de la phrase»] défault d'unicité du but communicatif d'une énonciation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. phrases contradictoires; discours incohérent.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaakyadarzin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vākyadarśin</i> [<a href="#entry-darzin" class="skt-link">darśin</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaakyadarzin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaakyadarzin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaakyadarzinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vākyadarśinī</i> gram. tenant de la théorie selon laquelle la phrase est l'unité de signification; opp. <a href="#entry-padadarzin" class="skt-link">padadarśin</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaakyaikatva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vākyaikatva</i> [<a href="#entry-ekatva" class="skt-link">ekatva</a>] <a href="#entry-vaakyaikatva" class="skt-link">n.</a> gram. principe de l'unicité du verbe dans la phrase <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> intégrité syntaxique.<br> <a href="#entry-vaakya" class="skt-link">vākya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaakyakara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vākyakaraṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-kara_na" class="skt-link">karaṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-vaakyakara_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> astr. np. du Vākyakaraṇa ou Vākyakaraṇasiddhānta, ouvrage d'astronomie dû à <a href="#entry-Uvararuci_2" class="skt-link">Vararuci_2</a> (vers 1282), origine de l'almanach Vākyapañcāṅga populaire en Inde du Sud.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaakyapadiiya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vākyapadīya</i> [<a href="#entry-pada" class="skt-link">pada</a><a href="#entry--iiya" class="skt-link">-īya</a>] <a href="#entry-vaakyapadiiya" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. [«à propos de la phrase et du mot»] np. du Vākyapadīya, nom d'un traité de linguistique de <a href="#entry-Ubhart_rhari" class="skt-link">Bhartṛhari</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-harikaarikaas" class="skt-link">harikārikās</a>, <a href="#entry-Utrikaa_n_dii" class="skt-link">Trikāṇḍī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaakyaracanaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vākyaracanā</i> [<a href="#entry-racanaa" class="skt-link">racanā</a>] <a href="#entry-vaakyaracanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> prise de parole; fait de parler <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. syntaxe.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaakyaspho_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vākyasphoṭa</i> [<a href="#entry-spho_ta" class="skt-link">sphoṭa</a>] <a href="#entry-vaakyaspho_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> gram. pouvoir évocatif d'une phrase.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaakyavajra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vākyavajra</i> [<a href="#entry-vajra" class="skt-link">vajra</a>] <a href="#entry-vaakyavajra" class="skt-link">n.</a> pl. [«mots qui tombent comme la foudre»] paroles de tonnerre; propos choquants.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaakyavakrataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vākyavakratā</i> [<a href="#entry-vakrataa" class="skt-link">vakratā</a>] <a href="#entry-vaakyavakrataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. [<a href="#entry-Ukuntaka" class="skt-link">Kuntaka</a>] qualité oblique des phrases; tortuosité d'une élocution.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaakyayojanaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vākyayojanā</i> [<a href="#entry-yojanaa" class="skt-link">yojanā</a>] <a href="#entry-vaakyayojanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> gram. analyse structurelle de la phrase.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaakyaze_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vākyaśeṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-ze_sa" class="skt-link">śeṣa</a>] <a href="#entry-vaakyaze_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> gram. ellipse <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> sens donné par le contexte.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाल</span> <i>vāla</i> <a href="#entry-vaala" class="skt-link">m.</a> poil, crin; not. de la queue d'un cheval.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaalakhilya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vālakhilya</i> var. <i>bālakhilya</i> [<a href="#entry-khilya" class="skt-link">khilya</a>] <a href="#entry-vaalakhilya" class="skt-link">m.</a> pl. <i>vālakhilyās</i> lit. collection de 11 stances apocryphes du <a href="#entry-U_rgveda" class="skt-link">Ṛgveda</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [VP.] nom d'une classe de sages [<a href="#entry-_r_si" class="skt-link">ṛṣi</a>] de très petite taille, fils de <a href="#entry-Ukratu" class="skt-link">Kratu</a> et <a href="#entry-Usantati" class="skt-link">Santati</a>; ou issus des cheveux de <a href="#entry-Uprajaapati" class="skt-link">Prajāpati</a> qui faisait pénitence pour obtenir la création d'êtres vivants; il y a 60000 Vālakhilyās, qui entourent le char du Soleil.<br> <a href="#entry-vaala" class="skt-link">vāla</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaali">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वालि</span> <i>vāli</i> [<a href="#entry-vaalin" class="skt-link">vālin</a>] <a href="#entry-vaali" class="skt-link">m.</a> cf. <a href="#entry-vaalin" class="skt-link">vālin</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaalin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वालिन्</span> <i>vālin</i> var. <i>bālin</i> [<a href="#entry-vaala" class="skt-link">vāla</a><a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>] <a href="#entry-vaalin" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] np. de Vālī ou Bālī «Queue poilue», roi-singe fils d'<a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a>; il humilia <a href="#entry-Uraava_na" class="skt-link">Rāvaṇa</a> s'étant attaqué à lui en le portant à sa ceinture aux quatre coins du monde, avant de s'en faire son allié; il tua l'<a href="#entry-asura" class="skt-link">asura</a> <a href="#entry-Udundubhi" class="skt-link">Dundubhi</a>; il combattit son frère cadet <a href="#entry-Usugriiva" class="skt-link">Sugrīva</a> dont il prit l'épouse <a href="#entry-Uruumaa" class="skt-link">Rūmā</a>; il fut tué d'une flèche tirée dans son dos par surprise par <a href="#entry-Uraama" class="skt-link">Rāma</a> qui installa <a href="#entry-Usugriiva" class="skt-link">Sugrīva</a> sur son trône; cf. <a href="#entry-Utaaraa_2" class="skt-link">Tārā_2</a>.<br> <i>rāmeṇa</i> <i>bāṇena</i> <i>vālī</i> <i>hataḥ</i> (exemple grammatical exhibant l'ambiguité agent/instrument) <a href="#entry-Uraama" class="skt-link">Rāma</a> a tué <a href="#entry-Uvaalii" class="skt-link">Vālī</a> avec une flèche.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaalmiiki">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाल्मीकि</span> <i>vālmīki</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-valmiika" class="skt-link">valmīka</a>] <a href="#entry-vaalmiiki" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. du sage [<a href="#entry-_r_si" class="skt-link">ṛṣi</a>] Vālmīki «(Pénitent) de la fourmilière»; renonçant à une vie de brigandage, il médita si longtemps sur le mot ‘mort’ [<a href="#entry-maara" class="skt-link">māra</a>] que son corps fut couvert de fourmis; on le dit fils de <a href="#entry-Ugaru_da" class="skt-link">Garuḍa</a>; on lui attribue la composition du <a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rāmāyaṇa</a> et à cet effet l'invention du mètre épique <a href="#entry-zloka" class="skt-link">śloka</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Uaadikavi" class="skt-link">Ādikavi</a>, <a href="#entry-Ukuziilava" class="skt-link">Kuśīlava</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaalmiikiiya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vālmīkīya</i> [<a href="#entry--iiya" class="skt-link">-īya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaalmiikiiya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaalmiikiiya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaalmiikiiyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vālmīkīyā</i> concernant <a href="#entry-Uvaalmiiki" class="skt-link">Vālmīki</a>; composé par <a href="#entry-Uvaalmiiki" class="skt-link">Vālmīki</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vaalmiiki" class="skt-link">vālmīki</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaaluka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वालुक</span> <i>vāluka</i> a. <a href="#entry-vaaluka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaaluka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaalukaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vālukā</i> sablonneux — <a href="#entry-vaalukaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vālukā</i> (en gén. pl.) sable, gravier.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaama_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाम</span> <i>vāma_1</i> a. <a href="#entry-vaama_1" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaama_1" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaamaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāmā</i> à gauche <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gauche, courbe <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bas, nain, vil.<br> <i>vāmena</i> adv. à gauche.<br> <i>vāmad</i> <i>dakṣiṇam</i> adv. de gauche à droite.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaama_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाम</span> <i>vāma_2</i> [obj. <a href="#entry-van" class="skt-link">van</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaama_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaama_2" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaamii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāmī</i> <a href="#entry-vaamaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāmā</i> charmant, beau.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaama_3">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाम</span> <i>vāma_3</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vam" class="skt-link">vam</a>] <a href="#entry-vaama_3" class="skt-link">m.</a> vomissement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaamaacaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vāmācāra</i> [<a href="#entry-aacaara" class="skt-link">ācāra</a>] <a href="#entry-vaamaacaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-tantra" class="skt-link">tantra</a>] la voie tantrique [<a href="#entry-zaakta" class="skt-link">śākta</a>] «de la main gauche», qui pratique les interdits impurs; cf. <a href="#entry-makaarapa_ncaka" class="skt-link">makārapañcaka</a>; opp. <a href="#entry-dak_si_naacaara" class="skt-link">dakṣiṇācāra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaamaacaarin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vāmācārin</i> [<a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaamaacaarin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaamaacaarin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaamaacaari_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāmācāriṇī</i> phil. [<a href="#entry-tantra" class="skt-link">tantra</a>] adepte des pratiques «de la main gauche».<br> <a href="#entry-vaamaacaara" class="skt-link">vāmācāra</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaamadeva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vāmadeva</i> [<a href="#entry-deva" class="skt-link">deva</a>] <a href="#entry-vaamadeva" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-zaivasiddhaanta" class="skt-link">śaivasiddhānta</a>] np. de Vāmadeva, visage protecteur de <a href="#entry-Usadaaziva" class="skt-link">Sadāśiva</a>-<a href="#entry-Uumaa" class="skt-link">Umā</a>, tourné vers le Nord, associé au monde de stabilité [<a href="#entry-prati_s_thaa" class="skt-link">pratiṣṭhā</a>], à l'élément eau et à la couleur rouge; on le représente avec des traits féminins <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de l'ermite Vāmadeva_1 <a href="#entry-Ugautama" class="skt-link">Gautama</a> «dont le dieu est charmant», qui composa l'essentiel du 4⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ <a href="#entry-ma_n_dala" class="skt-link">maṇḍala</a> du <a href="#entry-U_rgveda" class="skt-link">Ṛgveda</a>; [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] il avait des chevaux splendides que lui emprunta le roi <a href="#entry-Uzala_1" class="skt-link">Śala_1</a>; lorsqu'il vint les réclamer en vain, des géants surgirent pour le tuer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. [DKC.] Vāmadeva_2 est le sage conseiller du roi <a href="#entry-Uraajaha_msa" class="skt-link">Rājahaṃsa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaamaka_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वामक</span> <i>vāmaka_1</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vam" class="skt-link">vam</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaamaka_1" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaamaka_1" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaamikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāmikā</i> qui vomit.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaamaka_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वामक</span> <i>vāmaka_2</i> [<a href="#entry-vaama_1" class="skt-link">vāma_1</a><a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaamaka_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaamaka_2" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaamikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāmikā</i> adverse, cruel, dur — <a href="#entry-vaamikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāmikā</i> myth. np. de Vāmikā, épith. de <a href="#entry-Udurgaa" class="skt-link">Durgā</a> «Cruelle».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaamakezvaratantra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vāmakeśvaratantra</i> [<a href="#entry-iizvara" class="skt-link">īśvara</a>-<a href="#entry-tantra" class="skt-link">tantra</a>] <a href="#entry-vaamakezvaratantra" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Vāmakeśvaratantra, ouvrage de rites tantriques; cf. <a href="#entry-Usetubandha" class="skt-link">Setubandha</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vaamaka_2" class="skt-link">vāmaka_2</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaamana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वामन</span> <i>vāmana</i> <a href="#entry-vaamana" class="skt-link">m.</a> nain <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Vāmana «le Nain», fils de <a href="#entry-Ukazyapa" class="skt-link">Kaśyapa</a> et d'<a href="#entry-Uaditi" class="skt-link">Aditi</a>, en tant que 5⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ descente [<a href="#entry-avataara" class="skt-link">avatāra</a>] de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>, la première à forme humaine; il descendit s'incarner sur Terre pour combattre le <a href="#entry-daitya" class="skt-link">daitya</a> <a href="#entry-Ubali" class="skt-link">Bali</a>, roi tyran qui s'était approprié les trois mondes; venant à une fête de <a href="#entry-Ubali" class="skt-link">Bali</a> comme un brâhmane nain, il fit le vœu d'obtenir 3 enjambées de terre; quand <a href="#entry-Ubali" class="skt-link">Bali</a> le lui accorda (en désobéissant à son <a href="#entry-guru" class="skt-link">guru</a> <a href="#entry-Uzukra" class="skt-link">Śukra</a> qui avait reconnu <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>, et en perdant ainsi sa protection) il se transforma en Géant cosmique [<a href="#entry-Utrivikrama" class="skt-link">Trivikrama</a>] pour couvrir les trois mondes; on le représente en nain tenant le parasol du brâhmane <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de l'éléphant céleste [<a href="#entry-gajapati" class="skt-link">gajapati</a>] Vāmana_1, gardien [<a href="#entry-diggaja" class="skt-link">diggaja</a>] du Sud <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. de Vāmana_2, poète et grammairien du <a href="#entry-Ukazmiira" class="skt-link">Kaśmīra</a> de la fin du 8⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle; il était ministre du roi <a href="#entry-Ujayaapii_da" class="skt-link">Jayāpīḍa</a>; on lui doit le manuel de poétique <a href="#entry-Ukaavyaalafkaarav_rtti" class="skt-link">Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti</a> — <a href="#entry-vaamanikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāmanikā</i> naine.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaamanapuraa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vāmanapurāṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-puraa_na" class="skt-link">purāṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-vaamanapuraa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Vāmanapurāṇa, texte mythologique mixte, relativement récent.<br> <a href="#entry-vaamana" class="skt-link">vāmana</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaametara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vāmetara</i> [<a href="#entry-itara" class="skt-link">itara</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaametara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaametara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaametaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāmetarā</i> droit [«autre que gauche»].<br> <a href="#entry-vaama_1" class="skt-link">vāma_1</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaamin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वामिन्</span> <i>vāmin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vam" class="skt-link">vam</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaamin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaamin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaaminii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāminī</i> qui vomit — <a href="#entry-vaaminii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāminī</i> (avec <a href="#entry-yoni" class="skt-link">yoni</a>) (vulve) qui rejette le sperme.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaamoru">

    <i>vāmoru</i> [<a href="#entry-uuru" class="skt-link">ūru</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaamoru" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaamoru" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaamoruu" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāmorū</i> qui a de belles cuisses.<br> <a href="#entry-vaama_2" class="skt-link">vāma_2</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaana_1">

    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वान</span> <i>vāna_1</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vana" class="skt-link">vana</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaana_1" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaana_1" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaanii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vānī</i> relatif aux bois; habitant dans les bois — <a href="#entry-vaana_1" class="skt-link">n.</a> forêt épaisse.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaana_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaanada_n_da">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vānadaṇḍa</i> [<a href="#entry-da_n_da" class="skt-link">daṇḍa</a>] <a href="#entry-vaanada_n_da" class="skt-link">m.</a> métier à tisser, navette.<br> <a href="#entry-vaana_2" class="skt-link">vāna_2</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaanaprastha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vānaprastha</i> [<a href="#entry-prastha" class="skt-link">prastha</a>] <a href="#entry-vaanaprastha" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. brâhmane dans le 3⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ stade de la vie brâhmanique [<a href="#entry-aazrama" class="skt-link">āśrama</a>], ermite retiré dans la forêt; le <a href="#entry-vaanaprastha" class="skt-link">vānaprastha</a> doit avoir assuré sa descendance (par la naissance d'un fils de son fils) mais peut se retirer dans la forêt avec sa femme; le <a href="#entry-puru_saartha" class="skt-link">puruṣārtha</a> associé est <a href="#entry-dharma" class="skt-link">dharma</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vaana_1" class="skt-link">vāna_1</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaanara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वानर</span> <i>vānara</i> [<a href="#entry-vaana_1" class="skt-link">vāna_1</a><a href="#entry--ra" class="skt-link">-ra</a>] <a href="#entry-vaanara" class="skt-link">m.</a> singe — <a href="#entry-vaanarii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vānarī</i> guenon <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hi. <i>bandar</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaanaraketana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vānaraketana</i> [<a href="#entry-ketana" class="skt-link">ketana</a>] <a href="#entry-vaanaraketana" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Vānaraketana, épith. d'<a href="#entry-Uarjuna" class="skt-link">Arjuna</a> «Qui a le singe pour emblème».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaanaraketu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vānaraketu</i> [<a href="#entry-ketu" class="skt-link">ketu</a>] <a href="#entry-vaanaraketu" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Vānaraketu, épith. d'<a href="#entry-Uarjuna" class="skt-link">Arjuna</a> «Qui a le singe pour emblème».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaanarasenaa">

    <i>vānarasenā</i> [<a href="#entry-senaa" class="skt-link">senā</a>] <a href="#entry-vaanarasenaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] armée des singes, alliée du roi <a href="#entry-Uraama" class="skt-link">Rāma</a>; elle l'aida à conquérir <a href="#entry-Ulafkaa" class="skt-link">Laṅkā</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vaanara" class="skt-link">vānara</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaanta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वान्त</span> <i>vānta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vam" class="skt-link">vam</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaanta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaanta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaantaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāntā</i> vomi.<br> <i>vāntaṃ</i> <i>saṃskṛtam</i> sanskrit à vomir (mauvais sanskrit, aux phrases-questions finissant en ‘<i>vā</i>’).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaanti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वान्ति</span> <i>vānti</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vam" class="skt-link">vam</a>] <a href="#entry-vaanti" class="skt-link">f.</a> vomissement.
  </div>
</div>

    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाप</span> <i>vāpa_1</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vap_1" class="skt-link">vap_1</a>] <a href="#entry-vaapa_1" class="skt-link">n.</a> fait de raser.

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaapana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वापन</span> <i>vāpana</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vap_1" class="skt-link">vap_1</a>] <a href="#entry-vaapana" class="skt-link">n.</a> fait de raser.

    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वापी</span> <i>vāpī</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vap_2" class="skt-link">vap_2</a>] <a href="#entry-vaapii" class="skt-link">f.</a> étang (formé par des digues) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> réservoir, citerne.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaar">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वार्</span> <i>vār</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-v_r_1" class="skt-link">vṛ_1</a>] <a href="#entry-vaar" class="skt-link">n.</a> eau; mare, eau stagnante <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gr. ουρον; lat. <i>ūrīna</i>; fr. urine.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaar_s_neya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वार्ष्णेय</span> <i>vārṣṇeya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-v_r_s_ni" class="skt-link">vṛṣṇi</a><a href="#entry--iiya" class="skt-link">-īya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaar_s_neya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaar_s_neya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaar_s_neyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vārṣṇeyā</i> myth. descendant de <a href="#entry-Uv_r_s_ni" class="skt-link">Vṛṣṇi</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaar_sa">

    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वार्ष</span> <i>vārṣa</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-var_sa" class="skt-link">varṣa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaar_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaar_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaar_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vārṣā</i> concernant la mousson <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> annuel.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaar_saga_nya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vārṣagaṇya</i> [<a href="#entry-ga_nya" class="skt-link">gaṇya</a>] <a href="#entry-vaar_saga_nya" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. du sage Vārṣagaṇya, philosophe antique, précurseur du système <a href="#entry-saafkhya" class="skt-link">sāṃkhya</a> cité dans le <a href="#entry-Uvyaasabhaasya" class="skt-link">Vyāsabhāsya</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vaar_sa" class="skt-link">vārṣa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaar_sika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वार्षिक</span> <i>vārṣika</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-var_sa" class="skt-link">varṣa</a><a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaar_sika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaar_sika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaar_sikii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vārṣikī</i> pluvieux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> annuel — ifc. âgé de tant d'années.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वार</span> <i>vāra</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-v_r_2" class="skt-link">vṛ_2</a>] <a href="#entry-vaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> qui restreint, qui obstrue; couverture; porte, barrière <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> endroit convenu, emplacement propice ou convenable, lieu d'élection <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> moment favorable, instant choisi, heure dite; période convenue — cl. après num. fois <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> jour de la semaine (<a href="#entry-suurya" class="skt-link">sūrya</a> (dimanche), <a href="#entry-soma" class="skt-link">soma</a> (lundi), <a href="#entry-mafgala" class="skt-link">maṅgala</a> (mardi), <a href="#entry-budha" class="skt-link">budha</a> (mercredi), <a href="#entry-guru" class="skt-link">guru</a> (jeudi), <a href="#entry-zukra" class="skt-link">śukra</a> (vendredi), <a href="#entry-zani" class="skt-link">śani</a> (samedi)) — <a href="#entry-vaaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vārā</i> courtisane, prostituée <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gr. ωρα; lat. <i>hora</i>; fr. heure.<br> <i>vāram</i> adv. souvent, maintes fois.<br> <i>ekavāram</i> adv. une seule fois.<br> <i>bahuvāram</i> adv. de nombreuses fois, très souvent.<br> <i>vāraṃvāram</i> adv. quelquefois.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वारण</span> <i>vāraṇa</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-v_r_2" class="skt-link">vṛ_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaara_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaara_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāraṇī</i> qui restreint, qui résiste <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> dangereux; invincible — <a href="#entry-vaara_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> protection, armure <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> éléphant — <a href="#entry-vaara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> résistance; opposition, obstacle — <a href="#entry-vaara_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāraṇī</i> éléphant femelle.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaara_nasii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वारणसी</span> <i>vāraṇasī</i> cf. <a href="#entry-vaaraa_nasii" class="skt-link">vārāṇasī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaara_navata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vāraṇavata</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] <a href="#entry-vaara_navata" class="skt-link">n.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. de la villégiature de Vāraṇavata, située sur le Gange à une semaine de marche de <a href="#entry-Uhastinaapura" class="skt-link">Hastināpura</a>; <a href="#entry-Uduryodhana" class="skt-link">Duryodhana</a> y fit exiler <a href="#entry-Ukuntii" class="skt-link">Kuntī</a> et les <a href="#entry-paa_n_davaas" class="skt-link">pāṇḍavās</a> dans un palais de laque [<a href="#entry-laak_saag_rha" class="skt-link">lākṣāgṛha</a>] très inflammable, afin de les faire périr dans un incendie; le complot fut déjoué par <a href="#entry-Uvidura" class="skt-link">Vidura</a>, qui fit creuser un tunnel par lequel les <a href="#entry-paa_n_davaas" class="skt-link">pāṇḍavās</a> s'échappèrent.<br> <a href="#entry-vaara_na" class="skt-link">vāraṇa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaaraa_nasii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाराणसी</span> <i>vārāṇasī</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-varaa_nasii" class="skt-link">varāṇasī</a>] <a href="#entry-vaaraa_nasii" class="skt-link">f.</a> géo. np. de la ville de Vārāṇasī ou Vāraṇasī (Bénarès) «près de la <a href="#entry-Uvaraa_nasii" class="skt-link">Varāṇasī</a>»; c'est l'une des 7 villes sacrées [<a href="#entry-saptapurii" class="skt-link">saptapurī</a>]; cf. <a href="#entry-Ukaazi" class="skt-link">Kāśi</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> var. <i>vāraṇasī</i> id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaaraaha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाराह</span> <i>vārāha</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-varaaha" class="skt-link">varāha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaaraaha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaaraaha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaaraahii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vārāhī</i> relatif au sanglier, à l'<a href="#entry-avataara" class="skt-link">avatāra</a> <a href="#entry-Uvaraaha" class="skt-link">Varāha</a> — <a href="#entry-vaaraahii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vārāhī</i> myth. np. de Vārāhī, <a href="#entry-zakti" class="skt-link">śakti</a> de <a href="#entry-Uvaraaha" class="skt-link">Varāha</a>, une <a href="#entry-saptamaat_rkaa" class="skt-link">saptamātṛkā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

  </div>

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaari">

    <i>vārinātha</i> [<a href="#entry-naatha" class="skt-link">nātha</a>] <a href="#entry-vaarinaatha" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Vārinātha, épith. de <a href="#entry-Uvaru_na" class="skt-link">Varuṇa</a> «Maître des eaux».<br> <a href="#entry-vaari" class="skt-link">vāri</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaartaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वार्ता</span> <i>vārtā</i> forme dégéminée de <a href="#entry-vaarttaa" class="skt-link">vārttā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaartta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वार्त्त</span> <i>vārtta</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-v_rtti" class="skt-link">vṛtti</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaartta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaartta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaarttaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vārttā</i> <a href="#entry-vaartaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vārtā</i> qui a des ressources, qui a un métier; en bonne santé — <a href="#entry-vaartta" class="skt-link">n.</a> santé, état — f. cf. <a href="#entry-vaarttaa" class="skt-link">vārttā</a>.<br> <i>kā</i> <i>vārttā</i> que se passe-t-il? quoi de neuf?
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaarttaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वार्त्ता</span> <i>vārttā</i> [f. <a href="#entry-vaartta" class="skt-link">vārtta</a>] <a href="#entry-vaarttaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> profession, occupation; not. commerce, économie <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> la science de l'économie <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> (ce qui se passe) informations, nouvelles, rumeurs (sur ⟨g. iic.⟩) — <a href="#entry-vaartaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vārtā</i> id. — ifc. vivant de; de profession; parlant de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaarttaaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vārttāka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] <a href="#entry-vaarttaaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaarttaakii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vārttākī</i> natu. bot. <i>Solanum melongena</i>, aubergine; syn. <a href="#entry-vafgana" class="skt-link">vaṅgana</a> — <a href="#entry-vaarttaaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> son fruit.<br> <a href="#entry-vaarttaa" class="skt-link">vārttā</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaarttika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वार्त्तिक</span> <i>vārttika</i> [<a href="#entry-vaartta" class="skt-link">vārtta</a><a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaarttika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaarttika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaarttikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vārttikā</i> qui exerce une profession; professionnel <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> informateur, messager, espion — ifc. qui exerce le métier de, qui vit de; qui ne pense qu'à — <a href="#entry-vaarttika" class="skt-link">n.</a> explication <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. annexe explicative à un <a href="#entry-suutra" class="skt-link">sūtra</a>, remarque critique; not. commentaire supplétif de l'<a href="#entry-Ua_s_taadhyaayii" class="skt-link">Aṣṭādhyāyī</a> de <a href="#entry-Upaa_nini" class="skt-link">Pāṇini</a> par <a href="#entry-Ukaatyaayana" class="skt-link">Kātyāyana</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaarttikakaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vārttikakāra</i> [<a href="#entry-kaara" class="skt-link">kāra</a>] <a href="#entry-vaarttikakaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> gram. auteur de commentaire <a href="#entry-vaarttika" class="skt-link">vārttika</a>; not. <a href="#entry-Ukaatyaayana" class="skt-link">Kātyāyana</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vaarttika" class="skt-link">vārttika</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaaru_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वारुण</span> <i>vāruṇa</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-varu_na" class="skt-link">varuṇa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaaru_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaaru_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaaru_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāruṇī</i> relatif à <a href="#entry-Uvaru_na" class="skt-link">Varuṇa</a>; aquatique; occidental <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> humide, frais; syn. <a href="#entry-saumya" class="skt-link">saumya</a> — <a href="#entry-vaaru_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> animal aquatique <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Vāruṇa «fils de <a href="#entry-Uvaru_na" class="skt-link">Varuṇa</a>», patr. de <a href="#entry-Ubh_rgu" class="skt-link">Bhṛgu</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. myth. les <i>vāruṇās</i> «enfants de <a href="#entry-Uvaru_na" class="skt-link">Varuṇa</a>», race de guerriers <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> var. <i>vāruṇi</i> myth. np. de Vāruṇi «issu de <a href="#entry-Uvaru_na" class="skt-link">Varuṇa</a>», patr. de <a href="#entry-Ubh_rgu" class="skt-link">Bhṛgu</a>, <a href="#entry-Uagastya" class="skt-link">Agastya</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvasi_s_tha" class="skt-link">Vasiṣṭha</a> — <a href="#entry-vaaru_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāruṇī</i> myth. np. de Vāruṇī, <a href="#entry-zakti" class="skt-link">śakti</a> de <a href="#entry-Uvaru_na" class="skt-link">Varuṇa</a>, une <a href="#entry-yoginii" class="skt-link">yoginī</a>; épouse (ou fille) de <a href="#entry-Uvaru_na" class="skt-link">Varuṇa</a>, elle personnifie le vin produit lors du barattage de la mer de lait [<a href="#entry-k_siirodamathana" class="skt-link">kṣīrodamathana</a>] et elle «roule les yeux d'ivresse»; cf. <a href="#entry-Usuraadevii" class="skt-link">Surādevī</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> astr. 13⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ jour de la quinzaine sombre du mois <a href="#entry-caitra" class="skt-link">caitra</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. boisson alcoolisée obtenue par distillation de berce macérée dans du jus de palme.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaaru_naastra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vāruṇāstra</i> [<a href="#entry-astra" class="skt-link">astra</a>] <a href="#entry-vaaru_naastra" class="skt-link">n.</a> myth. arme magique de <a href="#entry-Uvaru_na" class="skt-link">Varuṇa</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vaaru_na" class="skt-link">vāruṇa</a>
  </div>
</div>

  </div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaasa_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वास</span> <i>vāsa_2</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vas_2" class="skt-link">vas_2</a>] <a href="#entry-vaasa_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> vêtement.

    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वास</span> <i>vāsa_3</i> <a href="#entry-vaasa_3" class="skt-link">m.</a> parfum, odeur agréable <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> impression, illusion <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de l'<a href="#entry-asura" class="skt-link">asura</a> Vāsa «Illusion»; cf. <a href="#entry-Ukiirti" class="skt-link">Kīrti</a> — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. <i>(vāsayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vāsita</i><i>)</i> parfumer, encenser <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hi. <i>bās</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaasaka_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वासक</span> <i>vāsaka_1</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vaasa_3" class="skt-link">vāsa_3</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaasaka_1" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaasaka_1" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaasikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāsikā</i> qui parfume — <a href="#entry-vaasaka_1" class="skt-link">m.</a> parfum — <a href="#entry-vaasaka_1" class="skt-link">n.</a> mus. mélodie récurrente, refrain; cf. <a href="#entry-dhruvaa" class="skt-link">dhruvā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaasaka_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वासक</span> <i>vāsaka_2</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vas_2" class="skt-link">vas_2</a>] ifc. <a href="#entry-vaasaka_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> habit; vêtement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaasamat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vāsamat</i> [<a href="#entry--mat" class="skt-link">-mat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaasamat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaasamat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaasamatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāsamatī</i> parfumé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hi. <i>bāsmatī</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaasana_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वासन</span> <i>vāsana_1</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vaasa_3" class="skt-link">vāsa_3</a>] <a href="#entry-vaasana_1" class="skt-link">n.</a> fait de parfumer — f. cf. <a href="#entry-vaasanaa" class="skt-link">vāsanā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaasana_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वासन</span> <i>vāsana_2</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vas_2" class="skt-link">vas_2</a>] <a href="#entry-vaasana_2" class="skt-link">n.</a> vêtement, habit, couverture <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> envelope, boîte, cassette.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaasanaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वासना</span> <i>vāsanā</i> [f. <a href="#entry-vaasana_1" class="skt-link">vāsana_1</a>] <a href="#entry-vaasanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> souvenir; désir, inclinaison, tendance; illusion <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. imprégnation; impression d'une sensation antérieure, souvenir subconscient; émotion, association de sentiments à la lecture ou à l'audition d'une œuvre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> math. preuve, démonstration; syn. <a href="#entry-upapatti" class="skt-link">upapatti</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaasanaak_saya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
