[<a href="#entry-tantra" class="skt-link">tantra</a>] la destruction des impressions ou tendances, but du rituel <a href="#entry-kaula" class="skt-link">kaula</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vaasanaa" class="skt-link">vāsanā</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaasantaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वासन्तक</span> <i>vāsantaka</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vasanta" class="skt-link">vasanta</a><a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaasantaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaasantaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaasantikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāsantikā</i> relatif au printemps; printanier — <a href="#entry-vaasantikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāsantikā</i> natu. bot. <i>Hiptage benghalensis</i>, arbuste grimpant aux fleurs blanches odoriférantes; syn. <a href="#entry-maadhavii" class="skt-link">mādhavī</a>.<br> <i>madhuśca</i> <i>mādhavaśca</i> <i>vāsantikavṛtuḥ</i> La saison du printemps comprend les mois de <a href="#entry-madhu" class="skt-link">madhu</a> et <a href="#entry-maadhava" class="skt-link">mādhava</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaasantikaspapna">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vāsantikaspapna</i> [<a href="#entry-svapna" class="skt-link">svapna</a>] <a href="#entry-vaasantikaspapna" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Vāsantikaspapna «Songe d'une nuit d'été», traduction de la pièce de Shakespeare «Midsummer Night», par R. Krishnamacharya (1892).<br> <a href="#entry-vaasantaka" class="skt-link">vāsantaka</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaasara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वासर</span> <i>vāsara</i> [<a href="#entry-vas_4" class="skt-link">vas_4</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaasara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaasara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaasarii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāsarī</i> matinal, clair — <a href="#entry-vaasara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaasara" class="skt-link">n.</a> jour (opp. nuit); jour de la semaine <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> temps, tour, succession.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaasareza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vāsareśa</i> [<a href="#entry-iiza" class="skt-link">īśa</a>] <a href="#entry-vaasareza" class="skt-link">m.</a> astr. régent d'un jour de la semaine: <a href="#entry-suurya" class="skt-link">sūrya</a> (dimanche), <a href="#entry-soma" class="skt-link">soma</a> (lundi), <a href="#entry-mafgala" class="skt-link">maṅgala</a> (mardi), <a href="#entry-budha" class="skt-link">budha</a> (mercredi), <a href="#entry-guru" class="skt-link">guru</a> (jeudi), <a href="#entry-zukra" class="skt-link">śukra</a> (vendredi) et <a href="#entry-zani" class="skt-link">śani</a> (samedi).<br> <a href="#entry-vaasara" class="skt-link">vāsara</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaasas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वासस्</span> <i>vāsas</i> [<a href="#entry-vaasa_2" class="skt-link">vāsa_2</a>] <a href="#entry-vaasas" class="skt-link">n.</a> vêtement (pour le bas du corps); costume; étoffe, tissu <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> du. <i>vāsasī</i> deux pièces d'étoffe formant vêtement complet.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaasava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वासव</span> <i>vāsava</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vasu" class="skt-link">vasu</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaasava" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaasava" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaasavii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāsavī</i> myth. relatif aux <a href="#entry-vasavas" class="skt-link">vasavas</a>; relatif à <a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a> — <a href="#entry-vaasava" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Vāsava, épith. d'<a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a> «Chef des <a href="#entry-vasavas" class="skt-link">vasavas</a>».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaasavadatta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vāsavadatta</i> [<a href="#entry-datta" class="skt-link">datta</a>] <a href="#entry-vaasavadatta" class="skt-link">m.</a> np. Vāsavadatta «donné par <a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a>» — <a href="#entry-vaasavadattaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāsavadattā</i> lit. np. du roman d'amour Vāsavadattā de <a href="#entry-Usubandhu" class="skt-link">Subandhu</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. son héroïne éponyme, la princesse Vāsavadattā_1 «Don des dieux», fille du roi <a href="#entry-Uz_rfgaarazekhara" class="skt-link">Śṛṅgāraśekhara</a>; après s'être opposée à ses parents souhaitant arranger son mariage par <a href="#entry-svaya_mvara" class="skt-link">svayaṃvara</a>, elle rencontra dans un rêve le prince charmant <a href="#entry-Ukandarpaketu_1" class="skt-link">Kandarpaketu_1</a>; ce dernier l'avait elle-même rencontrée en rêve, et avec l'aide d'un perroquet il la trouva et l'enleva; ils se cachèrent dans les monts <a href="#entry-Uvindhya" class="skt-link">Vindhya</a>, où une bataille de tribaux les sépara; dans sa fuite elle perturba un sage irascible, qui la changea en pierre; désespérant de la retrouver, <a href="#entry-Ukandarpaketu_1" class="skt-link">Kandarpaketu_1</a> se jeta dans l'océan, mais une voix venue du Ciel lui dit qu'ils seront réunis; lorsqu'il retrouve la pierre, en la touchant <a href="#entry-Uvaasavadattaa_1" class="skt-link">Vāsavadattā_1</a> revint à la vie, et ils vécurent heureux leur amour mutuel <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. [<a href="#entry-Ukathaasaritsaagara" class="skt-link">Kathāsaritsāgara</a>] np. de la princesse Vāsavadattā_2, fille du roi d'<a href="#entry-Uavanti" class="skt-link">Avanti</a> <a href="#entry-Upradyota" class="skt-link">Pradyota</a>-<a href="#entry-Uca_n_damahaasena" class="skt-link">Caṇḍamahāsena</a> et de la reine <a href="#entry-Uafgaaravatii" class="skt-link">Aṅgāravatī</a>; son père enleva le roi <a href="#entry-Uudayana" class="skt-link">Udayana</a> du pays <a href="#entry-Uvatsa" class="skt-link">Vatsa</a> pour lui servir de maître de musique; celui-ci s'évada avec la belle et l'épousa; <a href="#entry-Ubhaasa" class="skt-link">Bhāsa</a> mit en scène leurs amours dans la <a href="#entry-Usvapnavaasavadattaa" class="skt-link">Svapnavāsavadattā</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vaasava" class="skt-link">vāsava</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaasavi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वासवि</span> <i>vāsavi</i> [<a href="#entry-vaasava" class="skt-link">vāsava</a>] <a href="#entry-vaasavi" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. de Vāsavi, patr. d'<a href="#entry-Uarjuna" class="skt-link">Arjuna</a> «fils d'<a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a>» <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] patr. de <a href="#entry-Uvaalii" class="skt-link">Vālī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaasayoga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vāsayoga</i> [<a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>] <a href="#entry-vaasayoga" class="skt-link">m.</a> poudre parfumée; not. poudre rouge utilisée au festival de <a href="#entry-Uholii" class="skt-link">Holī</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vaasa_3" class="skt-link">vāsa_3</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaasi_s_tha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वासिष्ठ</span> <i>vāsiṣṭha</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vasi_s_tha" class="skt-link">vasiṣṭha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaasi_s_tha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaasi_s_tha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaasi_s_thaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāsiṣṭhā</i> issu de, relatif à, descendant de, composé par <a href="#entry-Uvasi_s_tha" class="skt-link">Vasiṣṭha</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaasi_ska">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वासिष्क</span> <i>vāsiṣka</i> <a href="#entry-vaasi_ska" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. du roi <a href="#entry-Uku_saa_na" class="skt-link">Kuṣāṇa</a> Vāsiṣka_1; il régna vers 150 <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. du roi Vāsiṣka_2; il régna vers 230.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaasin_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वासिन्</span> <i>vāsin_1</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vas_1" class="skt-link">vas_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaasin_1" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaasin_1" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaasinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāsinī</i> habitant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaasin_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वासिन्</span> <i>vāsin_2</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vas_2" class="skt-link">vas_2</a>] ifc. a. <a href="#entry-vaasin_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaasin_2" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaasinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāsinī</i> vêtu de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaasita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वासित</span> <i>vāsita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vaasa_3" class="skt-link">vāsa_3</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaasita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaasita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaasitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāsitā</i> parfumé; épicé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> affecté par, sous l'influence de ⟨i. ifc.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaastava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वास्तव</span> <i>vāstava</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vastu_1" class="skt-link">vastu_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaastava" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaastava" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaastavii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāstavī</i> réel, substantiel; vrai, authentique; caractéristique, représentatif <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> fixé, déterminé; établi, prouvé — <a href="#entry-vaastava" class="skt-link">n.</a> rendez-vous.<br> <i>vāstave</i> vraiment, assurément; syn. <a href="#entry-vastutas" class="skt-link">vastutas</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaastavatva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vāstavatva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-vaastavatva" class="skt-link">n.</a> réalité; substantialité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaastavika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vāstavika</i> [<a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaastavika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaastavika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaastavikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāstavikā</i> réel, substantiel; syn. <a href="#entry-vaastava" class="skt-link">vāstava</a> — <a href="#entry-vaastavika" class="skt-link">m.</a> réaliste.<br> <a href="#entry-vaastava" class="skt-link">vāstava</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaastavya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वास्तव्य</span> <i>vāstavya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vastu_1" class="skt-link">vastu_1</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaastavya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaastavya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaastavyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāstavyā</i> laissé comme reste <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. se dit de <a href="#entry-Urudra" class="skt-link">Rudra</a>, à qui on laisse les restes du sacrifice <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> résident, habitant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaasto_spati">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vāstoṣpati</i> [<a href="#entry-pati" class="skt-link">pati</a>] <a href="#entry-vaasto_spati" class="skt-link">m.</a> véd. dieu lare.<br> <a href="#entry-vaastos" class="skt-link">vāstos</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaastos">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वास्तोस्</span> <i>vāstos</i> [g. <a href="#entry-vaastu" class="skt-link">vāstu</a>] ind. du foyer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>vesta</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaastu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वास्तु</span> <i>vāstu</i> [<a href="#entry-vaas_1" class="skt-link">vās_1</a><a href="#entry--tu" class="skt-link">-tu</a>] <a href="#entry-vaastu" class="skt-link">n.</a> lieu, endroit; site; terrain; domaine, maison, foyer; salle — <a href="#entry-vaastu" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. syn. <a href="#entry-vasu" class="skt-link">vasu</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaastuja">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vāstuja</i> [<a href="#entry-ja" class="skt-link">ja</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaastuja" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaastuja" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaastujaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāstujā</i> domestique.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaastuma_n_dala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vāstumaṇḍala</i> var. <i>vāstupuruṣamaṇḍala</i> [<a href="#entry-ma_n_dala" class="skt-link">maṇḍala</a>] <a href="#entry-vaastuma_n_dala" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaastuma_n_dala" class="skt-link">n.</a> plan rituel architectural, not. de temple.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaastupuru_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vāstupuruṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-puru_sa" class="skt-link">puruṣa</a>] <a href="#entry-vaastupuru_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> arch. personnification du plan idéal d'un édifice; il symbolise le sentiment d'intégrité de l'espace paisible dans lequel est situé l'édifice; son plan intègre les dieux; <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a> occupe le carré central; 4 dieux principaux occupent une croix centrale: <a href="#entry-Up_rthviidhaara" class="skt-link">Pṛthvīdhāra</a> à l'Est, <a href="#entry-Usavitaa" class="skt-link">Savitā</a> au Sud, <a href="#entry-Uvivasvaan" class="skt-link">Vivasvān</a> à l'Ouest et <a href="#entry-Umitra" class="skt-link">Mitra</a> au Nord; autour un carré supporte 32 divinités mineures; le diagramme est complété par les gardiens des directions [<a href="#entry-dikpaala" class="skt-link">dikpāla</a>]: <a href="#entry-Usuurya" class="skt-link">Sūrya</a>, <a href="#entry-Uagni" class="skt-link">Agni</a>, <a href="#entry-Uyama" class="skt-link">Yama</a>, <a href="#entry-Unir_rti" class="skt-link">Nirṛti</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvaru_na" class="skt-link">Varuṇa</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvaayu" class="skt-link">Vāyu</a>, <a href="#entry-Ukubera" class="skt-link">Kubera</a> et <a href="#entry-Uiizaana" class="skt-link">Īśāna</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaastupuru_sama_n_dala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vāstupuruṣamaṇḍala</i> [<a href="#entry-ma_n_dala" class="skt-link">maṇḍala</a>] <a href="#entry-vaastupuru_sama_n_dala" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaastupuru_sama_n_dala" class="skt-link">n.</a> cf. <a href="#entry-vaastuma_n_dala" class="skt-link">vāstumaṇḍala</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vaastupuru_sa" class="skt-link">vāstupuruṣa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaastuvidyaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vāstuvidyā</i> [<a href="#entry-vidyaa" class="skt-link">vidyā</a>] <a href="#entry-vaastuvidyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> l'architecture, l'un des 64 arts [<a href="#entry-kalaa" class="skt-link">kalā</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaastuzaastra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vāstuśāstra</i> [<a href="#entry-zaastra" class="skt-link">śāstra</a>] <a href="#entry-vaastuzaastra" class="skt-link">n.</a> architecture.<br> <a href="#entry-vaastu" class="skt-link">vāstu</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaastuzamana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vāstuśamana</i> [<a href="#entry-zamana" class="skt-link">śamana</a>] <a href="#entry-vaastuzamana" class="skt-link">n.</a> soc. rite d'«apaise­ment du sol», préparation rituelle du terrain d'une construction.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaasu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वासु</span> <i>vāsu</i> [<a href="#entry-vaas_1" class="skt-link">vās_1</a><a href="#entry--u" class="skt-link">-u</a>] <a href="#entry-vaasu" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Vāsu, épith. de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a> «l'Immanent» [«qui demeure en toutes choses»].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaasudeva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वासुदेव</span> <i>vāsudeva</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vasudeva" class="skt-link">vasudeva</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaasudeva" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaasudeva" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaasudevaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāsudevā</i> myth. relatif à <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a> — <a href="#entry-vaasudeva" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. de Vāsudeva, patr. de <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a>, fils de <a href="#entry-Uvasudeva" class="skt-link">Vasudeva</a>; mais aussi «(Dieu) en qui tout réside», c.-à-d. <a href="#entry-Unaaraaya_na" class="skt-link">Nārāyaṇa</a>; phil. [<a href="#entry-pa_ncaraatra" class="skt-link">pañcarātra</a>] il est la première émanation [<a href="#entry-vyuuha" class="skt-link">vyūha</a>] de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>; au ciel spirituel il est la direction de l'Est <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> jn. personne éminente [<a href="#entry-zalaakaapuru_sa" class="skt-link">śalākāpuruṣa</a>] d'une épopée, dans le rôle du héros; not. <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a>, opposé à son ennemi juré [<a href="#entry-prativaasudeva" class="skt-link">prativāsudeva</a>] <a href="#entry-Ujaraasandha" class="skt-link">Jarāsandha</a>, et <a href="#entry-Ulak_sma_na" class="skt-link">Lakṣmaṇa</a>, opposé à <a href="#entry-Uraava_na" class="skt-link">Rāvaṇa</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de l'imposteur Śrīgālava Vāsudeva_1, roi de <a href="#entry-Ukaraviirapura" class="skt-link">Karavīrapura</a>; il fut tué par <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. du roi Vāsudeva_2 qui créa la dynastie <a href="#entry-Uka_nva" class="skt-link">Kaṇva</a> au <a href="#entry-Umagadha" class="skt-link">Magadha</a> en renversant le dernier des <a href="#entry-zufgaas" class="skt-link">śuṅgās</a> vers 71 ant. <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. de Vāsudeva_3 <a href="#entry-Usaarvabhauma_1" class="skt-link">Sārvabhauma_1</a>, logicien bengali du 15⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle; il étudia la logique à <a href="#entry-Umithilaa" class="skt-link">Mithilā</a>, où il mémorisa le <a href="#entry-Utattvacintaama_ni" class="skt-link">Tattvacintāmaṇi</a>; il s'établit comme logicien à <a href="#entry-Unavadviipa" class="skt-link">Navadvīpa</a>, où il se convertit aux enseignements de <a href="#entry-Ucaitanya" class="skt-link">Caitanya</a> en 1510; on lui doit le <a href="#entry-Usaarvabhaumanirukta" class="skt-link">Sārvabhaumanirukta</a>; <a href="#entry-Uraghunaatha_1" class="skt-link">Raghunātha_1</a> <a href="#entry-Uziroma_ni" class="skt-link">Śiromaṇi</a> fut son élève avant son départ pour <a href="#entry-Umithilaa" class="skt-link">Mithilā</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaasukeya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वासुकेय</span> <i>vāsukeya</i> [<a href="#entry-vaasuki" class="skt-link">vāsuki</a><a href="#entry--iiya" class="skt-link">-īya</a>] <a href="#entry-vaasukeya" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. <a href="#entry-Uvaasuki" class="skt-link">Vāsuki</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaasukeyasvas_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vāsukeyasvasṛ</i> [<a href="#entry-svas_r" class="skt-link">svasṛ</a>] <a href="#entry-vaasukeyasvas_r" class="skt-link">f.</a> myth. épith. de <a href="#entry-Umanasaa" class="skt-link">Manasā</a> «Sœur de <a href="#entry-Uvaasuki" class="skt-link">Vāsuki</a>».<br> <a href="#entry-vaasukeya" class="skt-link">vāsukeya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaasuki">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वासुकि</span> <i>vāsuki</i> <a href="#entry-vaasuki" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Vāsuki, roi dragon [<a href="#entry-naaga" class="skt-link">nāga</a>] utilisé comme corde entourant le mont <a href="#entry-Umandara" class="skt-link">Mandara</a>, reposant sur la tortue <a href="#entry-Uakuupaara" class="skt-link">Akūpāra</a>, pour baratter la mer de lait [<a href="#entry-k_siirodamathana" class="skt-link">kṣīrodamathana</a>] afin d'en extraire l'<a href="#entry-am_rta" class="skt-link">amṛta</a> au matin du monde; il est frère d'<a href="#entry-Uananta" class="skt-link">Ananta</a>-<a href="#entry-Uze_sa" class="skt-link">Śeṣa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaasupuujya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वासुपूज्य</span> <i>vāsupūjya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vasupuujya" class="skt-link">vasupūjya</a>] <a href="#entry-vaasupuujya" class="skt-link">m.</a> jn. patr. de Vāsupūjya, fils du roi <a href="#entry-Uvasupuujya" class="skt-link">Vasupūjya</a>, 12⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ <a href="#entry-tiirthafkara" class="skt-link">tīrthaṅkara</a> mythique; son corps est rouge, son symbole est un buffle.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaasya_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वास्य</span> <i>vāsya_1</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-vas_1" class="skt-link">vas_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaasya_1" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaasya_1" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaasyaa_1" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāsyā_1</i> à héberger.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaasya_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वास्य</span> <i>vāsya_2</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-vas_2" class="skt-link">vas_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaasya_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaasya_2" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaasyaa_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāsyā_2</i> à vêtir, à envelopper <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> enveloppé; couvert, porté.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वात</span> <i>vāta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vaa_2" class="skt-link">vā_2</a>] <a href="#entry-vaata" class="skt-link">m.</a> vent, air, souffle; souffle vital <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Vāta, épith. du dieu <a href="#entry-Uvaayu" class="skt-link">Vāyu</a> «Qui souffle» <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> méd. le souffle, une des 3 humeurs [<a href="#entry-trido_sa" class="skt-link">tridoṣa</a>]; syn. <a href="#entry-vaayu" class="skt-link">vāyu</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>ventus</i>; ang. wind; all. Wind; fr. vent.<br> <i>prativātam</i> adv. contre le vent.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaataa_n_da">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vātāṇḍa</i> [<a href="#entry-a_n_da" class="skt-link">aṇḍa</a>] <a href="#entry-vaataa_n_da" class="skt-link">n.</a> méd. testicule enflé — a. <a href="#entry-vaataa_n_da" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaataa_n_da" class="skt-link">n.</a> qui a les testicules enflés.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaataapi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vātāpi</i> [<a href="#entry-aapii" class="skt-link">āpī</a>] <a href="#entry-vaataapi" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. de l'ogre [<a href="#entry-raak_sasa" class="skt-link">rākṣasa</a>] Vātāpi «Flatulence», qui avec son frère <a href="#entry-Uilvala" class="skt-link">Ilvala</a> hantait la forêt <a href="#entry-Uda_n_daka" class="skt-link">Daṇḍaka</a>; il se déguisait en bélier du sacrifice pour être mangé par les brâhmanes, dont il faisait éclater le ventre lorsqu'<a href="#entry-Uilvala" class="skt-link">Ilvala</a> l'appelait; il connut son destin en étant digéré par <a href="#entry-Uagasti" class="skt-link">Agasti</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> géo. np. de la ville de <a href="#entry-Uvaataapi" class="skt-link">Vātāpi</a> au <a href="#entry-Ukar_naa_ta" class="skt-link">Karṇāṭa</a>, capitale des <a href="#entry-Ucaalukyaas" class="skt-link">Cālukyās</a> (540–757); capturée par les <a href="#entry-Upallavaas" class="skt-link">Pallavās</a> en 642, elle resta sous leur contrôle 13 ans, jusqu'à la restauration du royaume par <a href="#entry-Uvikramaaditya_1" class="skt-link">Vikramāditya_1</a>; mod. Badāmi.<br> <i>vātāpi</i> <i>jīrṇo</i> <i>bhava</i> [<a href="#entry-Uagasti" class="skt-link">Agasti</a>] Vātāpi, sois digéré.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaataayana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vātāyana</i> [<a href="#entry-ayana" class="skt-link">ayana</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaataayana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaataayana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaataayanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vātāyanā</i> qui se déplace dans l'air <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> rapide comme le vent (se dit d'un cheval) — <a href="#entry-vaataayana" class="skt-link">n.</a> fenêtre; balcon; terrasse.<br> <a href="#entry-vaata" class="skt-link">vāta</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaatika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वातिक</span> <i>vātika</i> [<a href="#entry-vaata" class="skt-link">vāta</a><a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaatika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaatika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaatikii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vātikī</i> venteux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> rhumatisant — <a href="#entry-vaatika" class="skt-link">m.</a> bavard; beau parleur, flatteur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaatsa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वात्स</span> <i>vātsa</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vatsa" class="skt-link">vatsa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaatsa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaatsa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaatsii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vātsī</i> np. patr. «descendant de <a href="#entry-Uvatsa" class="skt-link">Vatsa</a>» — <a href="#entry-vaatsii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vātsī</i> soc. épouse d'un <a href="#entry-Uvaatsya" class="skt-link">Vātsya</a> — <a href="#entry-vaatsi" class="skt-link">m.</a> <i>vātsi</i> soc. fils de <a href="#entry-Uvatsa" class="skt-link">Vatsa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaatsalya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वात्सल्य</span> <i>vātsalya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vatsala" class="skt-link">vatsala</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-vaatsalya" class="skt-link">n.</a> affection envers les enfants <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> tendresse envers ⟨g. loc. iic.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaatsii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वात्सी</span> <i>vātsī</i> [f. <a href="#entry-vaatsya" class="skt-link">vātsya</a>] <a href="#entry-vaatsii" class="skt-link">f.</a> soc. épouse d'un <a href="#entry-Uvaatsya" class="skt-link">Vātsya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaatsiiputra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vātsīputra</i> [<a href="#entry-putra" class="skt-link">putra</a>] <a href="#entry-vaatsiiputra" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. de Vātsīputra, philosophe fondateur d'une doctrine bd. hétérodoxe.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaatsiiputriiya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vātsīputrīya</i> [<a href="#entry--iiya" class="skt-link">-īya</a>] <a href="#entry-vaatsiiputriiya" class="skt-link">m.</a> pl. bd. np. de la secte des Vātsīputrīyās, considérée comme hérétique par <a href="#entry-Uvasubandhu" class="skt-link">Vasubandhu</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vaatsiiputra" class="skt-link">vātsīputra</a> <br> <a href="#entry-vaatsii" class="skt-link">vātsī</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaatsya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वात्स्य</span> <i>vātsya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vatsa" class="skt-link">vatsa</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaatsya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaatsya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaatsyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vātsyā</i> relatif au pays <a href="#entry-vatsa" class="skt-link">vatsa</a> — <a href="#entry-vaatsya" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. np. patr. de Vātsya «descendant de <a href="#entry-Uvatsa" class="skt-link">Vatsa</a>».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaatsyaayana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vātsyāyana</i> [<a href="#entry-aayana" class="skt-link">āyana</a>] <a href="#entry-vaatsyaayana" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. np. de <a href="#entry-gotra" class="skt-link">gotra</a> «descendant de <a href="#entry-Uvatsa" class="skt-link">Vatsa</a>» <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. np. de Vātsyāyana, philosophe du 5⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle, auteur du <a href="#entry-Ukaamasuutra" class="skt-link">Kāmasūtra</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. np. de Vātsyāyana_1, philosophe du <a href="#entry-Ubihaara" class="skt-link">Bihāra</a> du 4⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle, auteur du <a href="#entry-Unyaayabhaa_sya" class="skt-link">Nyāyabhāṣya</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vaatsya" class="skt-link">vātsya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaatula">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वातुल</span> <i>vātula</i> [<a href="#entry-vaata" class="skt-link">vāta</a><a href="#entry--la" class="skt-link">-la</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaatula" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaatula" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaatulaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vātulā</i> venteux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> flatteur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> var. <i>vātūla</i> f. fou <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> affligé de goutte ou de rhumatismes <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hi. <i>baul</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaavaata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वावात</span> <i>vāvāta</i> [<a href="#entry-van" class="skt-link">van</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaavaata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaavaata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaavaataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāvātā</i> cher, bien-aimé; favori — <a href="#entry-vaavaataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāvātā</i> soc. épouse royale favorite.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaavad">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वावद्</span> <i>vāvad</i> [int. <a href="#entry-vad" class="skt-link">vad</a>] int. <i>(vāvadīti)</i> parler fort; bavarder, trop parler.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaavaduuka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वावदूक</span> <i>vāvadūka</i> [<a href="#entry-vaavad" class="skt-link">vāvad</a><a href="#entry--uuka" class="skt-link">-ūka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaavaduuka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaavaduuka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaavaduukaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāvadūkā</i> bavard; éloquent.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाय</span> <i>vāya</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vaa_3" class="skt-link">vā_3</a>] <a href="#entry-vaaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> tissage — a. <a href="#entry-vaaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaaya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaayii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāyī</i> ifc. qui tisse ⟨iic.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> tisserand.<br> <i>tantuvāyaḥ</i> m. <a href="#entry-tantuvaayii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>tantuvāyī</i> tisserand.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaayasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वायस</span> <i>vāyasa</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vayasa" class="skt-link">vayasa</a>] <a href="#entry-vaayasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaayasii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāyasī</i> natu. zoo. corbeau, corneille — <a href="#entry-vaayasa" class="skt-link">n.</a> multitude de corbeaux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaayasavidyaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vāyasavidyā</i> [<a href="#entry-vidyaa" class="skt-link">vidyā</a>] <a href="#entry-vaayasavidyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> science (de divination par observation) des corbeaux.<br> <a href="#entry-vaayasa" class="skt-link">vāyasa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaayava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वायव</span> <i>vāyava</i> [<a href="#entry-vaayu" class="skt-link">vāyu</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaayava" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaayava" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaayavii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāyavī</i> concernant le vent, relatif à <a href="#entry-Uvaayu" class="skt-link">Vāyu</a> — <a href="#entry-vaayavii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāyavī</i> le Nord-Ouest.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaayaviiya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vāyavīya</i> [<a href="#entry--iiya" class="skt-link">-īya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaayaviiya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaayaviiya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaayaviiyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāyavīyā</i> qui concerne le vent; aérien.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaayaviiyapuraa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vāyavīyapurāṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-puraa_na" class="skt-link">purāṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-vaayaviiyapuraa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Vāyavīyapurāṇa, l'un des plus anciens textes mytho-ritualistes [<a href="#entry-puraa_na" class="skt-link">purāṇa</a>], de tradition shivaïte [<a href="#entry-zaiva" class="skt-link">śaiva</a>]; aussi appelé <a href="#entry-Uvaayupuraa_na" class="skt-link">Vāyupurāṇa</a>, <a href="#entry-Uzivapuraa_na" class="skt-link">Śivapurāṇa</a>, <a href="#entry-zaivapuraa_na" class="skt-link">śaivapurāṇa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaayaviiyasa_mhitaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vāyavīyasaṃhitā</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_mhitaa" class="skt-link">saṃhitā</a>] <a href="#entry-vaayaviiyasa_mhitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de la Vāyavīyasaṃhitā, recueil de textes concernant la doctrine et le rite shivaïtes.<br> <a href="#entry-vaayaviiya" class="skt-link">vāyavīya</a> <br> <a href="#entry-vaayava" class="skt-link">vāyava</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaayu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वायु</span> <i>vāyu</i> [<a href="#entry-vaa_2" class="skt-link">vā_2</a><a href="#entry--u" class="skt-link">-u</a>] <a href="#entry-vaayu" class="skt-link">m.</a> vent; air <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-vaize_sika" class="skt-link">vaiśeṣika</a>] la substance [<a href="#entry-dravya_1" class="skt-link">dravya_1</a>] du Vent ou de l'Air; [<a href="#entry-saafkhya" class="skt-link">sāṃkhya</a>] un des 5 éléments [<a href="#entry-bhuuta" class="skt-link">bhūta</a>]; son <a href="#entry-pa_ncabhuutasthala" class="skt-link">pañcabhūtasthala</a> est <a href="#entry-Ukaalahastiizvara" class="skt-link">Kālahastīśvara</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> méd. le souffle, une des 3 humeurs [<a href="#entry-trido_sa" class="skt-link">tridoṣa</a>]; syn. <a href="#entry-vaata" class="skt-link">vāta</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. véd. np. du dieu Vāyu, le Vent personnifié, messager des dieux, fils de <a href="#entry-Utva_s_taa" class="skt-link">Tvaṣṭā</a>, ou né du souffle de <a href="#entry-Upuru_sa" class="skt-link">Puruṣa</a>; son énergie provient de la force quittant <a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a> après son meurtre du <a href="#entry-braahma_na" class="skt-link">brāhmaṇa</a> <a href="#entry-Uv_rtra" class="skt-link">Vṛtra</a>; il est ami d'<a href="#entry-Uagni" class="skt-link">Agni</a>, serviteur d'<a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a>, père de <a href="#entry-Uhanumaan" class="skt-link">Hanumān</a>; il est le gardien [<a href="#entry-dikpaala" class="skt-link">dikpāla</a>] de la direction du Nord-Ouest, et le roi des <a href="#entry-gandharvaas" class="skt-link">gandharvās</a>; phil. [<a href="#entry-saafkhya" class="skt-link">sāṃkhya</a>] il est le régent [<a href="#entry-niyant_r" class="skt-link">niyantṛ</a>] du sens du toucher [<a href="#entry-tvak" class="skt-link">tvak</a>]; il est l'essence de la Parole [<a href="#entry-Uvaak" class="skt-link">Vāk</a>]; premier à boire le <a href="#entry-soma" class="skt-link">soma</a>, il est le plus fort d'entre les dieux; un jour de colère, il créa <a href="#entry-Ulafkaa" class="skt-link">Laṅkā</a> en soufflant dans la mer le sommet du mont <a href="#entry-Umeru" class="skt-link">Meru</a>; sous le nom d'<a href="#entry-Uanila" class="skt-link">Anila</a>, c'est l'un des 8 Trésors [<a href="#entry-vasu" class="skt-link">vasu</a>]; il est invoqué au début des rituels; on le représente comme un homme blanc, chevauchant une gazelle; astr. il préside le <a href="#entry-nak_satra" class="skt-link">nakṣatra</a> <a href="#entry-Usvaati" class="skt-link">Svāti</a> (Arcturus); cf. <a href="#entry-Upavana" class="skt-link">Pavana</a>, <a href="#entry-marut" class="skt-link">marut</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvaata" class="skt-link">Vāta</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaayubhak_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vāyubhakṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-bhak_sa" class="skt-link">bhakṣa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaayubhak_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaayubhak_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaayubhak_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāyubhakṣā</i> qui se nourrit d'air (se dit d'un ermite).<br> <a href="#entry-vaayu" class="skt-link">vāyu</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaayupuraa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vāyupurāṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-puraa_na" class="skt-link">purāṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-vaayupuraa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Vāyupurāṇa; cf. <a href="#entry-Uvaayaviiyapuraa_na" class="skt-link">Vāyavīyapurāṇa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaaz">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाश्</span> <i>vāś</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. md. <i>(vāśyate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vāśita</i><i>)</i> mugir, beugler; hurler, crier; gémir <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> fr. vache.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaa_nch">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाञ्छ्</span> <i>vāñch</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vāñchati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vāñchita</i><i>)</i> désirer, souhaiter, aspirer à ⟨acc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> ang. to wish; all. wunsc.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaa_nchaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाञ्छा</span> <i>vāñchā</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vaa_nch" class="skt-link">vāñch</a>] <a href="#entry-vaa_nchaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> désir, envie de ⟨loc. iic.⟩.<br> <i>vāñchāṃ</i> <i>kṛ</i> aspirer à ⟨loc.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaa_nchita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वाञ्छित</span> <i>vāñchita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vaa_nch" class="skt-link">vāñch</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaa_nchita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaa_nchita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaa_nchitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vāñchitā</i> désiré, aimé — <a href="#entry-vaa_nchita" class="skt-link">n.</a> désir, envie.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vac">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">वच्</span> <i>vac</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(vakti)</i> pr. md. <i>(vaṣṭe)</i> imp. <i>(voci)</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">3</span>] pr. <i>(vivakti)</i> pft. <i>(uvāca)</i> pft. md. <i>(ūce)</i> aor. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] <i>(avocat)</i> aor. ps. <i>(avāci)</i> aor. ps. <i>(avoci)</i> subj. <i>(vocati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>ukta</i><i>)</i> ppft. <i>(ūcivas)</i> inf. <i>(vaktum)</i> fut. péri. <i>(vaktā)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>vaktavya</i>, <i>vacanīya</i><i>)</i> abs. <i>(</i><i>uktvā</i>, <i>-ucya</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>adhi</i>, <i>anu</i>, <i>nis</i>, <i>pra</i>, <i>prati</i><i>)</i> parler; dire qqc. à qqn ⟨2 acc.⟩; appeler <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> réciter, invoquer — ps. <i>(ucyate)</i> être dit, être parlé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> être interpellé, être informé, être appelé — ca. <i>(vācayati)</i> ps. <i>(vācyate)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>vācya</i><i>)</i> faire dire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> énoncer, lire [«faire parler un écrit»] — dés. <i>(vivakṣati)</i> demander la parole; vouloir dire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>vocare</i>, <i>vox</i>; ang. voice; all. erwähnen; fr. voix.<br> <i>yad</i> <i>ucyate</i> on raconte que, il est dit que.<br> <i>kathāṃ</i> <i>vakti</i> il raconte une histoire.<br> <i>tvāṃ</i> <i>vakti</i> il te parle.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vacaknu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वचक्नु</span> <i>vacaknu</i> [<a href="#entry-vacas" class="skt-link">vacas</a><a href="#entry--nu" class="skt-link">-nu</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vacaknu" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vacaknu" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vacaknu" class="skt-link">f.</a> éloquent; bavard — <a href="#entry-vacaknu" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du sage Vacaknu, père de <a href="#entry-Ugargii" class="skt-link">Gargī</a>-<a href="#entry-Uvaacaknavii" class="skt-link">Vācaknavī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vacana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वचन</span> <i>vacana</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vac" class="skt-link">vac</a>] <a href="#entry-vacana" class="skt-link">n.</a> parole, langage; discours, énonciation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> dicton <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. paroles dévotionnelles adressées à <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> édit, ordre, conseil <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. nombre (<a href="#entry-ekavacana" class="skt-link">ekavacana</a> singulier, <a href="#entry-dvivacana" class="skt-link">dvivacana</a> duel, <a href="#entry-bahuvacana" class="skt-link">bahuvacana</a> pluriel).<br> <i>madvacanāt</i> adv. en mon nom.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vacanaazafka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vacanāśaṅka</i> [<a href="#entry-aazafkaa" class="skt-link">āśaṅkā</a>] <a href="#entry-vacanaazafka" class="skt-link">n.</a> peur de prendre la parole.<br> <a href="#entry-vacana" class="skt-link">vacana</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vacanajyaayas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vacanajye_s_tha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vacanajyeṣṭha</i> [<a href="#entry-jye_s_tha" class="skt-link">jyeṣṭha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vacanajye_s_tha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vacanajye_s_tha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vacanajye_s_thaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vacanajyeṣṭhā</i> le plus éloquent, le meilleur en paroles.
  </div>
</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vacanavyakti</i> [<a href="#entry-vyakti" class="skt-link">vyakti</a>] <a href="#entry-vacanavyakti" class="skt-link">f.</a> gram. dénotation spécifique d'une énonciation.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vacaniiya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वचनीय</span> <i>vacanīya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] <a href="#entry-vac" class="skt-link">vac</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vacaniiya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vacaniiya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vacaniiyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vacanīyā</i> à dire; dont il faut parler <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> dont il y a à redire, blâmable — <a href="#entry-vacaniiya" class="skt-link">n.</a> blâme, reproche; censure.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vacas">

</div>

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vadati)</i> pr. md. <i>(vadate)</i> fut. <i>(</i><i>vadiṣyati</i><i>)</i> imp. <i>(vada)</i> impft. <i>(avadat)</i> opt. <i>(vadet)</i> pft. <i>(uvāda)</i> aor. [<span class="skt-grammar">5</span>] <i>(avādīt)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>udita_2</i>, <i>vadita</i><i>)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>udya</i>, <i>vadya</i><i>)</i> abs. <i>(</i><i>-udya</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>anu</i>, <i>apa</i>, <i>abhi</i>, <i>pari</i>, <i>pra</i>, <i>vi</i>, <i>sam</i><i>)</i> parler; dire qqc. à qqn ⟨2 acc.⟩; appeler <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> énoncer, expliquer — ca. <i>(vādayati)</i> ps. <i>(vādyate)</i> faire parler, faire dire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> jouer d'un instrument de musique ⟨i.⟩ — ps. <i>(udyate)</i> être parlé, être dit — int. <i>(vāvadīti)</i> parler fort; bavarder, trop parler <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>vates</i>; fr. vaticiner.<br> <i>satyaṃ</i> <i>vad</i> dire la vérité.<br> <i>saṃskṛtena</i> <i>vad</i> parler en sanskrit.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वद</span> <i>vada</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vad" class="skt-link">vad</a>] ifc. a. <a href="#entry-vada" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vada" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vadaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vadā</i> qui dit.
  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vadana">

  </div>

    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">वध्</span> <i>vadh</i> aor. [<span class="skt-grammar">5</span>] <i>(avadhīt)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>vadhya</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>ā</i><i>)</i> frapper, tuer (substitut de <a href="#entry-han_1" class="skt-link">han_1</a> pour l'aor.) — ps. <i>(vadhyate)</i> être tué, abattu, vaincu.

</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vadha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">

</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vadhin">

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vadhri">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vadhuu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वधू</span> <i>vadhū</i> [<a href="#entry-vah_1" class="skt-link">vah_1</a>] <a href="#entry-vadhuu" class="skt-link">f.</a> fiancée, jeune mariée; femme, épouse; femelle <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> animal femelle (not. vache et jument).

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vadhuusaraa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vadhūsarā</i> [<a href="#entry-saraa" class="skt-link">sarā</a>] <a href="#entry-vadhuusaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> myth. np. de la rivière Vadhūsarā «Issue de la belle», formée des larmes de <a href="#entry-Upulomaa_2" class="skt-link">Pulomā_2</a> pleurant la perte de <a href="#entry-Ucyavana" class="skt-link">Cyavana</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vadhuu" class="skt-link">vadhū</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vadhya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वध्य</span> <i>vadhya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-vadh" class="skt-link">vadh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vadhya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vadhya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vadhyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vadhyā</i> qui doit être frappé; qui doit être puni <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui doit ou qui va être tué, qui mérite la mort; condamné; qui doit être détruit — <a href="#entry-vadhya" class="skt-link">m.</a> ennemi — <a href="#entry-vadhyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vadhyā</i> ifc. meurtre, mise à mort de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vadhyamaalaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vadhyamālā</i> [<a href="#entry-maalaa" class="skt-link">mālā</a>] <a href="#entry-vadhyamaalaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> soc. guirlande de laurier-rose [<a href="#entry-karaviira" class="skt-link">karavīra</a>] qu'un condamné portait au cou.<br> <a href="#entry-vadhya" class="skt-link">vadhya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vadhyataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vadhyatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-vadhyataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> fait de devoir être tué.<br> <i>vadhyatāṃ</i> <i>gam</i> mériter la mort.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vadi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वदि</span> <i>vadi</i> adv. pendant la quinzaine sombre (d'un mois lunaire); opp. <a href="#entry-zudi" class="skt-link">śudi</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>badi</i> id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vadit_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वदितृ</span> <i>vaditṛ</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vad" class="skt-link">vad</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vadit_r" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vadit_r" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaditrii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaditrī</i> qui dit; qui parle, qui raconte ⟨acc.⟩ — <a href="#entry-vadit_r" class="skt-link">m.</a> orateur.<br> <i>viruddhaṃ</i> <i>vaditā</i> qui est enclin à dire des choses contradictoires.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vadya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वद्य</span> <i>vadya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-vad" class="skt-link">vad</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vadya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vadya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vadyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vadyā</i> qui peut ou doit être dit <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> dont on doit parler; qui mérite l'éloge, louable — <a href="#entry-vadya" class="skt-link">n.</a> ce qui est dit, ce qu'on raconte; ce qui peut ou doit être dit.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vafga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वङ्ग</span> <i>vaṅga</i> <a href="#entry-vafga" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. du roi Vaṅga, fils de <a href="#entry-Udiirghatamaa" class="skt-link">Dīrghatamā</a> et <a href="#entry-Usude_s_naa" class="skt-link">Sudeṣṇā</a>; on le dit ancêtre des bengalis <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> géo. son royaume, l'un des cinq pays de l'Inde du Nord [<a href="#entry-pa_ncagau_da" class="skt-link">pañcagauḍa</a>]; mod. Bengale de l'Est <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>vaṅgās</i> le pays du Bengale et son peuple <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> var. <i>vaṅgana</i> natu. bot. <i>Solanum melongena</i>, aubergine <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bengali bafga; fr. Bengale.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vafgana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वङ्गन</span> <i>vaṅgana</i> [<a href="#entry-vafga" class="skt-link">vaṅga</a><a href="#entry--na" class="skt-link">-na</a>] <a href="#entry-vafgana" class="skt-link">m.</a> natu. bot. <i>Solanum melongena</i>, aubergine; syn. <a href="#entry-vaarttaaka" class="skt-link">vārttāka</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> perse baadenjaan; fr. aubergine; hi. <i>baiṃgan</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vafgasenaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vaṅgasenā</i> [<a href="#entry-senaa" class="skt-link">senā</a>] <a href="#entry-vafgasenaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> armée du Bengale.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vafgasenaaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vaṅgasenāka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] <a href="#entry-vafgasenaaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> natu. bot. <i>Sesbania grandiflora</i> ou arbre Agati, légumineuse pouvant atteindre 10 m de haut, aux fleurs écarlates.<br> <a href="#entry-vafgasenaa" class="skt-link">vaṅgasenā</a> <br> <a href="#entry-vafga" class="skt-link">vaṅga</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vafka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वङ्क</span> <i>vaṅka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-va_nc" class="skt-link">vañc</a>] <a href="#entry-vafka" class="skt-link">m.</a> vagabond <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> méandre (d'une rivière) — <a href="#entry-vafkaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaṅkā</i> pommeau de selle.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vafku">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वङ्कु</span> <i>vaṅku</i> [<a href="#entry-va_nc" class="skt-link">vañc</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vafku" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vafku" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vafku" class="skt-link">f.</a> véd. qui va par des moyens détournés; qui se hâte; impulsif.<br> <i>vaṅkuḥ</i> <i>kaviḥ</i> myth. «Obscure poète», épith. de <a href="#entry-Urudra" class="skt-link">Rudra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vagaaha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वगाह</span> <i>vagāha</i> [<a href="#entry-avagaaha" class="skt-link">avagāha</a>] <a href="#entry-vagaaha" class="skt-link">m.</a> bain, ablution; immersion.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vagaahya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वगाह्य</span> <i>vagāhya</i> [<a href="#entry-avagaah" class="skt-link">avagāh</a>] ind. s'étant plongé dans.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vagalaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वगला</span> <i>vagalā</i> <a href="#entry-vagalaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> phil. [tantr.] np. de Vagalā ou Vagalāmukhī, l'une des 10 puissances [<a href="#entry-mahaavidyaa" class="skt-link">mahāvidyā</a>] de la Déesse [<a href="#entry-Uzakti" class="skt-link">Śakti</a>], plus tard appelée Bagalā ou Bagalāmukhī; elle est aussi <a href="#entry-Upiitaambaraa" class="skt-link">Pītāmbarā</a> «vêtue de jaune»; elle tient un gourdin en main dont elle frappe les hommes pour détruire leur ignorance; son regard est hypnotique; elle transcende les contraires et son savoir détruit les dualités.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vah_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">वह्</span> <i>vah_1</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vahati)</i> pft. <i>(uvāha)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>ūḍha</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>ā</i>, <i>ut</i>, <i>upa</i>, <i>ni</i>, <i>nis</i>, <i>pari</i>, <i>pra</i>, <i>vi</i>, <i>sam</i><i>)</i> porter <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> apporter, emmener; conduire, mener, transporter <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> traîner, tirer (se dit du cheval attelé à un char, d'une bête de trait attelée à un chariot) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> avancer, aller, couler, souffler <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> porter sur soi, avoir — ps. <i>(uhyate)</i> être porté, être emmené, être transporté — ca. <i>(vāhayati)</i> conduire, diriger, se servir d'un véhicule <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> faire porter <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>veho</i>; all. Wagen; ang. wagon; fr. véhicule.<br> <i>aśvena</i> <i>vah</i> aller à cheval.<br> <i>plavena</i> <i>vah</i> aller en bateau.<br> <i>bhṛtyo</i> <i>bharaṃ</i> <i>vahati</i> le serviteur porte le fardeau.<br> <i>nadī</i> <i>vahati</i> la rivière coule.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vah_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वह्</span> <i>vah_2</i> [<a href="#entry-vah_1" class="skt-link">vah_1</a>] ifc. a. <a href="#entry-vah_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vah_2" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vah_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> qui va (à cheval, etc.).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वह</span> <i>vaha</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vah_1" class="skt-link">vah_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vahaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vahā</i> ifc. qui conduit, qui porte, qui charrie; chargé de, pourvu de <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui porte le nom de — <a href="#entry-vaha" class="skt-link">m.</a> véhicule; char; bateau <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> vent, courant <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. l'un des 7 Vents du Ciel [<a href="#entry-marut" class="skt-link">marut</a>]; le <a href="#entry-Udeviipuraa_na" class="skt-link">Devīpurāṇa</a> liste: <a href="#entry-Uparaavaha" class="skt-link">Parāvaha</a>, <a href="#entry-Univaha" class="skt-link">Nivaha</a>, <a href="#entry-Uudvaha" class="skt-link">Udvaha</a>, <a href="#entry-Usa_mvaha" class="skt-link">Saṃvaha</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvivaha" class="skt-link">Vivaha</a>, <a href="#entry-Upravaha" class="skt-link">Pravaha</a>, et <a href="#entry-Uparivaha" class="skt-link">Parivaha</a>; ils sont associés aux 7 langues d'<a href="#entry-Uagni" class="skt-link">Agni</a> [<a href="#entry-saptajihva" class="skt-link">saptajihva</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> porteur; animal de transport; épaule — <a href="#entry-vaha" class="skt-link">n.</a> collier d'un animal de trait — <a href="#entry-vahaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vahā</i> cours d'eau, rivière <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>via</i>; fr. vague, voie.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vahana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वहन</span> <i>vahana</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vah_1" class="skt-link">vah_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vahana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vahana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vahanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vahanā</i> ifc. qui va, qui conduit, qui porte — <a href="#entry-vahana" class="skt-link">n.</a> conduite (en voiture, etc.); véhicule.<br> <i>vahanīkṛ</i> utiliser comme véhicule.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vahat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वहत्</span> <i>vahat</i> [ppr. <a href="#entry-vah_1" class="skt-link">vah_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vahat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vahat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vahantii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vahantī</i> qui coule.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vahatu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वहतु</span> <i>vahatu</i> [<a href="#entry-vaha" class="skt-link">vaha</a><a href="#entry--tu" class="skt-link">-tu</a>] <a href="#entry-vahatu" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. procession de mariage; mariage.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vahin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वहिन्</span> <i>vahin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vah_1" class="skt-link">vah_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vahin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vahin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vahinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vahinī</i> qui tire — <a href="#entry-vahin" class="skt-link">m.</a> animal de trait.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vahni">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वह्नि</span> <i>vahni</i> [<a href="#entry-vah_1" class="skt-link">vah_1</a><a href="#entry--ni" class="skt-link">-ni</a>] <a href="#entry-vahni" class="skt-link">m.</a> animal de trait <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> feu [«qui porte les offrandes»] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Vahni, épith. d'<a href="#entry-Uagni" class="skt-link">Agni</a> gardien [<a href="#entry-dikpaala" class="skt-link">dikpāla</a>] du Sud-Est <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. principe divin masculin, opp. <a href="#entry-zakti" class="skt-link">śakti</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. feu mystique — <a href="#entry-vahni" class="skt-link">n.</a> [<i>vahnipurāṇa</i>] lit. np. du Vahni_1 <a href="#entry-puraa_na" class="skt-link">purāṇa</a>.<br> <i>vahnitrikoṇa</i> n. phil. [tantr.] triangle igné, la pointe en haut, symbolisant le principe mâle dans les diagrammes [<a href="#entry-yantra" class="skt-link">yantra</a>] géométriques.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vahnimat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vahnimat</i> [<a href="#entry--mat" class="skt-link">-mat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vahnimat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vahnimat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vahnimatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vahnimatī</i> qui contient du feu.<br> <i>parvato</i> <i>vahnimān</i> <i>dhūmavattvāt</i> var. <i>parvato</i> <i>vahnimān</i> <i>dhūmāt</i> [<a href="#entry-Utarkasafgraha" class="skt-link">Tarkasaṃgraha</a>] Le mont contient du feu, du fait qu'il porte de la fumée.<br> <a href="#entry-vahni" class="skt-link">vahni</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vahnitva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vahnitva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-vahnitva" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. nature du feu.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vai">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वै</span> <i>vai</i> conj. cl. certes, en vérité, en effet, précisément.<br> <i>yadi</i> <i>...</i> <i>vai</i> <i>...</i> si ... au contraire ...
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vai_daala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैडाल</span> <i>vaiḍāla</i> var. <i>baiḍāla</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vi_daala" class="skt-link">viḍāla</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vai_daala" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vai_daala" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vai_daalii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaiḍālī</i> relatif au chat, propre au chat; félin <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hypocrite, imposteur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vai_duurya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैडूर्य</span> <i>vaiḍūrya</i> cf. <a href="#entry-vaiduurya" class="skt-link">vaidūrya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vai_s_nava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैष्णव</span> <i>vaiṣṇava</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vi_s_nu" class="skt-link">viṣṇu</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vai_s_nava" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vai_s_nava" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vai_s_navii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaiṣṇavī</i> relatif, consacré, adressé à <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a> — <a href="#entry-vai_s_nava" class="skt-link">m.</a> vishnouite, adepte de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] nom d'un missile [<a href="#entry-astra" class="skt-link">astra</a>] que <a href="#entry-Ubhagadatta" class="skt-link">Bhagadatta</a> utilisa contre <a href="#entry-Uarjuna" class="skt-link">Arjuna</a> — <a href="#entry-vai_s_navii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaiṣṇavī</i> myth. np. de Vaiṣṇavī, <a href="#entry-zakti" class="skt-link">śakti</a> de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>, une <a href="#entry-saptamaat_rkaa" class="skt-link">saptamātṛkā</a>; elle est adorée dans la grotte de Vaiṣṇo <a href="#entry-Udevii" class="skt-link">Devī</a> dans le district de Jammu, à 12 km au dessus de Katra; cf. <a href="#entry-Utrikuu_ta" class="skt-link">Trikūṭa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vai_s_navacaapa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vaiṣṇavacāpa</i> [<a href="#entry-caapa" class="skt-link">cāpa</a>] <a href="#entry-vai_s_navacaapa" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de l'arc Vaiṣṇavacāpa que <a href="#entry-Uvizvakarmaa" class="skt-link">Viśvakarmā</a> fabriqua pour <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>; après son duel victorieux avec <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a> le donna à <a href="#entry-U_rciika" class="skt-link">Ṛcīka</a>, qui en fit don à <a href="#entry-Ujamadagni" class="skt-link">Jamadagni</a>, qui le donna à son fils <a href="#entry-Uparazuraama" class="skt-link">Paraśurāma</a>, qui l'utilisa pour affronter <a href="#entry-Uraama" class="skt-link">Rāma</a> au retour du <a href="#entry-svaya_mvara" class="skt-link">svayaṃvara</a> de <a href="#entry-Usiitaa" class="skt-link">Sītā</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Uz_rfga" class="skt-link">Śṛṅga</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vai_s_nava" class="skt-link">vaiṣṇava</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaibhaa_sika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैभाषिक</span> <i>vaibhāṣika</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vibhaa_saa" class="skt-link">vibhāṣā</a><a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaibhaa_sika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaibhaa_sika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaibhaa_sikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaibhāṣikā</i> optionnel <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bd. adepte d'une doctrine optionnelle; on en reconnaît 4 variétés; cf. <a href="#entry-sarvaastivaada" class="skt-link">sarvāstivāda</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaicitrya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैचित्र्य</span> <i>vaicitrya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vicitra" class="skt-link">vicitra</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-vaicitrya" class="skt-link">n.</a> diversité, variété; multiplicité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaidarbha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैदर्भ</span> <i>vaidarbha</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vidarbha" class="skt-link">vidarbha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaidarbha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaidarbha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaidarbhii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaidarbhī</i> relatif au <a href="#entry-Uvidarbha" class="skt-link">Vidarbha</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. style poétique [<a href="#entry-riiti" class="skt-link">rīti</a>] du <a href="#entry-Uvidarbha" class="skt-link">Vidarbha</a>; opp. <a href="#entry-gau_da" class="skt-link">gauḍa</a> — <a href="#entry-vaidarbha" class="skt-link">m.</a> homme ou prince du <a href="#entry-Uvidarbha" class="skt-link">Vidarbha</a> — <a href="#entry-vaidarbhii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaidarbhī</i> princesse du <a href="#entry-Uvidarbha" class="skt-link">Vidarbha</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Vaidarbhī, épith. de <a href="#entry-Ulopaamudraa" class="skt-link">Lopāmudrā</a>, de <a href="#entry-Udamayantii" class="skt-link">Damayantī</a>, de <a href="#entry-Urukmi_nii" class="skt-link">Rukmiṇī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaidarbhariiti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vaidarbharīti</i> [<a href="#entry-riiti" class="skt-link">rīti</a>] <a href="#entry-vaidarbhariiti" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. style de composition poétique du <a href="#entry-Uvidarbha" class="skt-link">Vidarbha</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vaidarbha" class="skt-link">vaidarbha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaideha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैदेह</span> <i>vaideha</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-videha" class="skt-link">videha</a>] <a href="#entry-vaideha" class="skt-link">m.</a> homme ou prince du <a href="#entry-Uvideha" class="skt-link">Videha</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> homme de caste mixte (not. de père <a href="#entry-vaizya" class="skt-link">vaiśya</a> et de mère <a href="#entry-braahma_nii" class="skt-link">brāhmaṇī</a>) — <a href="#entry-vaidehii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaidehī</i> femme du <a href="#entry-Uvideha" class="skt-link">Videha</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] np. de Vaidehī, épith. de <a href="#entry-Usiitaa" class="skt-link">Sītā</a> «princesse du <a href="#entry-Uvideha" class="skt-link">Videha</a>».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaidezika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैदेशिक</span> <i>vaideśika</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-videza" class="skt-link">videśa</a><a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaidezika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaidezika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaidezikii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaideśikī</i> non autochtone — <a href="#entry-vaidezika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaidezikii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaideśikī</i> étranger.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaidhaatra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैधात्र</span> <i>vaidhātra</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vidhaat_r" class="skt-link">vidhātṛ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaidhaatra" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaidhaatra" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaidhaatrii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaidhātrī</i> issu de <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. se dit des 4 (ou 7) sages [<a href="#entry-_r_si" class="skt-link">ṛṣi</a>] issus de l'esprit de <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a> [<a href="#entry-vaidhaatra" class="skt-link">vaidhātra</a>] pour peupler le Monde; cf. <a href="#entry-Usana" class="skt-link">Sana</a>, <a href="#entry-Usanaka" class="skt-link">Sanaka</a>, <a href="#entry-Usanatkumaara" class="skt-link">Sanatkumāra</a>, <a href="#entry-Usanandana" class="skt-link">Sanandana</a>; ils habitent le ciel [<a href="#entry-loka" class="skt-link">loka</a>] <a href="#entry-Ujanar" class="skt-link">Janar</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaidharmya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैधर्म्य</span> <i>vaidharmya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vidharma" class="skt-link">vidharma</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-vaidharmya" class="skt-link">n.</a> illégalité; injustice.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaidika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैदिक</span> <i>vaidika</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-veda" class="skt-link">veda</a><a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaidika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaidika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaidikii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaidikī</i> védique; conforme au <a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a>, prescrit par le <a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> connaissant le <a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a> — <a href="#entry-vaidika" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. brâhmane versé dans le <a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a> — <a href="#entry-vaidika" class="skt-link">n.</a> injonction védique; extrait du <a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaiduurya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैदूर्य</span> <i>vaidūrya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-viduura" class="skt-link">vidūra</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-vaiduurya" class="skt-link">n.</a> béryl bleu, aigue-marine; astr. c'est le joyau associé à <a href="#entry-Uketu" class="skt-link">Ketu</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pierre semi-précieuse (œil de chat, lapis lazuli, etc.) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> var. <i>vaiḍūrya</i> id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaidya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैद्य</span> <i>vaidya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vidyaa" class="skt-link">vidyā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaidya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaidya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaidyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaidyā</i> lettré, érudit — <a href="#entry-vaidya" class="skt-link">m.</a> savant, expert; médecin — <a href="#entry-vaidyii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaidyī</i> femme de médecin.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaidyaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैद्यक</span> <i>vaidyaka</i> [<a href="#entry-vaidya" class="skt-link">vaidya</a><a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaidyaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaidyaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaidyakaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaidyakā</i> médical — <a href="#entry-vaidyaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> médecin — <a href="#entry-vaidyaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> médecine, science médicale.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaidyanaatha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vaidyanātha</i> [<a href="#entry-naatha" class="skt-link">nātha</a>] <a href="#entry-vaidyanaatha" class="skt-link">m.</a> géo. np. de Vaidyanātha, l'un des 12 signes radieux de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> [<a href="#entry-jyotirlifga" class="skt-link">jyotirliṅga</a>], établi à Devagarh (mod. Deogarh au <a href="#entry-Ubihaara" class="skt-link">Bihāra</a>/Jharkhand); c'est aussi l'un des 51 lieux de la Déesse [<a href="#entry-zaktipii_tha" class="skt-link">śaktipīṭha</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaidyaraaj">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vaidyarāj</i> [<a href="#entry-raaj_2" class="skt-link">rāj_2</a>] <a href="#entry-vaidyaraaj" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Vaidyarāj «Roi des médecins», épith. de <a href="#entry-Udhanvantari" class="skt-link">Dhanvantari</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> var. <i>vaidyarāja</i> id.<br> <i>vaidyarāja</i> <i>namastubhyam</i> <i>yamarājasahodaraḥ</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>yamastu</i> <i>harati</i> <i>prāṇān</i> <i>tvaṃ</i> <i>tu</i> <i>prāṇān</i> <i>dhanāni</i> <i>api</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> Je te salue, ô médecin, tu es le frère de <a href="#entry-Uyama" class="skt-link">Yama</a>; alors que <a href="#entry-Uyama" class="skt-link">Yama</a> nous prend la vie, tu nous prends et la vie et l'argent.<br> <a href="#entry-vaidya" class="skt-link">vaidya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaijayanta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैजयन्त</span> <i>vaijayanta</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vijayanta" class="skt-link">vijayanta</a>] <a href="#entry-vaijayanta" class="skt-link">m.</a> drapeau, bannière; oriflamme; not. bannière d'<a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a> — <a href="#entry-vaijayantii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaijayantī</i> bannière ou guirlande de victoire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. not. parure de cou de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> géo. np. de la ville de Vaijayantī «Victorieuse», épith. de <a href="#entry-Uvanavaasii" class="skt-link">Vanavāsī</a>, très ancienne ville du <a href="#entry-Ukar_naa_ta" class="skt-link">Karṇāṭa</a>, capitale secondaire des <a href="#entry-Usaatavaahanaas" class="skt-link">Sātavāhanās</a>, puis capitale de la dynastie <a href="#entry-Ukadamba" class="skt-link">Kadamba</a> au 4⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. np. du lexique de <a href="#entry-Uyaadavaprakaaza" class="skt-link">Yādavaprakāśa</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Uvaijayantiikoza" class="skt-link">Vaijayantīkośa</a> — <a href="#entry-vaijayanta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <i>vaijayanta</i> np. de la ville de Vaijayanta; cf. <a href="#entry-Uvaijayantii" class="skt-link">Vaijayantī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaijayantii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैजयन्ती</span> <i>vaijayantī</i> iic. f. de <a href="#entry-vaijayanta" class="skt-link">vaijayanta</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaijayantiikoza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vaijayantīkośa</i> [<a href="#entry-koza" class="skt-link">kośa</a>] <a href="#entry-vaijayantiikoza" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du Vaijayantīkośa, lexique dû à <a href="#entry-Uyaadavaprakaaza" class="skt-link">Yādavaprakāśa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaijayantiimaalaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vaijayantīmālā</i> [<a href="#entry-maalaa" class="skt-link">mālā</a>] <a href="#entry-vaijayantiimaalaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> myth. guirlande magique protégeant des blessures, donnée par <a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a> au roi <a href="#entry-Uuparicara" class="skt-link">Uparicara</a> <a href="#entry-Uvasu_2" class="skt-link">Vasu_2</a>; éternellement fraîche, elle ne se fane pas.<br> <a href="#entry-vaijayantii" class="skt-link">vaijayantī</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaijayika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैजयिक</span> <i>vaijayika</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vijaya" class="skt-link">vijaya</a><a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaijayika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaijayika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaijayikii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaijayikī</i> qui confère ou qui prédit la victoire — <a href="#entry-vaijayikii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaijayikī</i> la stratégie, l'un des 64 arts [<a href="#entry-kalaa" class="skt-link">kalā</a>].<br> <i>vaijayikīnāṃ</i> <i>vidyānāṃ</i> <i>jñānam</i> le savoir des connaissances qui apportent la victoire.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaij_naanika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैज्ञानिक</span> <i>vaijñānika</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vij_naana" class="skt-link">vijñāna</a><a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaij_naanika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaij_naanika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaij_naanikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaijñānikā</i> savant, érudit; scientifique.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaikartana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैकर्तन</span> <i>vaikartana</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vikartana" class="skt-link">vikartana</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaikartana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaikartana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaikartanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaikartanā</i> relatif au Soleil — <a href="#entry-vaikartana" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Vaikartana «l'Écorché», épith. de <a href="#entry-Ukar_na" class="skt-link">Karṇa</a> après qu'il se soit arraché la cuirasse d'or avec laquelle il était né.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaikhaanasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
