    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैखानस</span> <i>vaikhānasa</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vikhaanasa" class="skt-link">vikhānasa</a>] <a href="#entry-vaikhaanasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaikhaanasii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaikhānasī</i> soc. anachorète selon la règle de l'ermite [<a href="#entry-muni" class="skt-link">muni</a>] <a href="#entry-Uvikhanas" class="skt-link">Vikhanas</a>; c'est une forme extrême d'ermite [<a href="#entry-vaanaprastha" class="skt-link">vānaprastha</a>]; il ne doit manger que des racines et des baies sauvages <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. caste héréditaire de prêtres vishnouites de l'Inde du Sud [<a href="#entry-arcaka" class="skt-link">arcaka</a>] issue de ces ascètes; ils ont remplacé le sacrifice védique par les rites du temple; ils portent une marque au fer rouge à l'épaule; on devient <a href="#entry-vaikhaanasa" class="skt-link">vaikhānasa</a> par le rite prénatal <a href="#entry-vi_s_nubali" class="skt-link">viṣṇubali</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. np. de Vaikhānasa, <a href="#entry-viduu_saka" class="skt-link">vidūṣaka</a> du <a href="#entry-Ukaumudiimahotsava" class="skt-link">Kaumudīmahotsava</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaikhaanasamantrapaa_tha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vaikhānasamantrapāṭha</i> [<a href="#entry-mantrapaa_tha" class="skt-link">mantrapāṭha</a>] <a href="#entry-vaikhaanasamantrapaa_tha" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du Vaikhānasamantrapāṭha, recueil d'hymnes vishnouites.<br> <a href="#entry-vaikhaanasa" class="skt-link">vaikhānasa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaikharii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैखरी</span> <i>vaikharī</i> <a href="#entry-vaikharii" class="skt-link">f.</a> discours articulé, parole compréhensible <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> faculté de parole <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-Ubhart_rhari" class="skt-link">Bhartṛhari</a>] son au 4⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ stade de la manifestation.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaiku_n_tha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैकुण्ठ</span> <i>vaikuṇṭha</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-viku_n_tha" class="skt-link">vikuṇṭha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaiku_n_tha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaiku_n_tha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaiku_n_thaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaikuṇṭhā</i> myth. relatif à <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a> «l'Immanent» — <a href="#entry-vaiku_n_tha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaiku_n_tha" class="skt-link">n.</a> myth. np. du Vaikuṇṭha «(Ciel) de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>»; cf. <a href="#entry-vaiku_n_thasvarga" class="skt-link">vaikuṇṭhasvarga</a> — <a href="#entry-vaiku_n_tha" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [«du ciel de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>»] épith. de divers dieux, not. <a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a> et <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>-<a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaiku_n_thacaturdazii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vaikuṇṭhacaturdaśī</i> [<a href="#entry-caturdazii" class="skt-link">caturdaśī</a>] <a href="#entry-vaiku_n_thacaturdazii" class="skt-link">f.</a> soc. quatorzième jour de la quinzaine claire du mois <a href="#entry-kaarttika" class="skt-link">kārttika</a>, sacré à <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>, aussi appelé <a href="#entry-narakacaturdazii" class="skt-link">narakacaturdaśī</a>; il débute le festival de <a href="#entry-Udiipaavali" class="skt-link">Dīpāvali</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaiku_n_thacaturmuurti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vaikuṇṭhacaturmūrti</i> [<a href="#entry-catur" class="skt-link">catur</a>-<a href="#entry-muurti" class="skt-link">mūrti</a>] <a href="#entry-vaiku_n_thacaturmuurti" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. forme de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a> à 4 visages, représentant <a href="#entry-Uvaraaha" class="skt-link">Varāha</a>, <a href="#entry-Unarasi_mha" class="skt-link">Narasiṃha</a>, <a href="#entry-Uraama" class="skt-link">Rāma</a> et <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-caturaanana" class="skt-link">caturānana</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaiku_n_thaikaadazii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vaikuṇṭhaikādaśī</i> [<a href="#entry-ekaadazii" class="skt-link">ekādaśī</a>] <a href="#entry-vaiku_n_thaikaadazii" class="skt-link">f.</a> soc. onzième jour de la quinzaine sombre du mois <a href="#entry-pau_sa" class="skt-link">pauṣa</a>; il est sacré à <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>, et jeûné [<a href="#entry-vrata" class="skt-link">vrata</a>]; c'est une fête importante en Inde du Sud.<br> <a href="#entry-vaiku_n_tha" class="skt-link">vaikuṇṭha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaiku_n_thasvarga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vaikuṇṭhasvarga</i> [<a href="#entry-svarga" class="skt-link">svarga</a>] <a href="#entry-vaiku_n_thasvarga" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. Ciel de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>; ni la peur ni les obstacles n'y existent; il est symbolisé par une ombrelle, dont l'axe est le Mont <a href="#entry-Umeru" class="skt-link">Meru</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaila">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैल</span> <i>vaila</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vila" class="skt-link">vila</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaila" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaila" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vailii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vailī</i> rupestre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vailasthaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vailasthāna</i> [<a href="#entry-sthaana" class="skt-link">sthāna</a>] <a href="#entry-vailasthaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> habitat rupestre, caverne; ruines, cimetière.<br> <a href="#entry-vaila" class="skt-link">vaila</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaimaanika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैमानिक</span> <i>vaimānika</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vimaana_1" class="skt-link">vimāna_1</a><a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaimaanika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaimaanika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaimaanikii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaimānikī</i> myth. né dans un chariot céleste — <a href="#entry-vaimaanika" class="skt-link">m.</a> jn. être céleste; on distingue ceux du présent [<a href="#entry-kalpabhava" class="skt-link">kalpabhava</a>] et ceux du passé [<a href="#entry-kalpaatita" class="skt-link">kalpātita</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaimaatra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैमात्र</span> <i>vaimātra</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vimaat_r" class="skt-link">vimātṛ</a>] <a href="#entry-vaimaatra" class="skt-link">m.</a> demi-frère; syn. <a href="#entry-vimaat_rja" class="skt-link">vimātṛja</a> — <a href="#entry-vaimaatrii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaimātrī</i> var. <i>vaimātṛkā</i> demi-sœur.<br> <i>vaimātra</i> <i>bhrātṛ</i> demi-frère; beau-frère.<br> <i>vaimātṛkā</i> <i>bhaginī</i> demi-sœur; belle-sœur (opp. <a href="#entry-svakasvakaa" class="skt-link">svakasvakā</a> <a href="#entry-bhaginii" class="skt-link">bhaginī</a>).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaimala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैमल</span> <i>vaimala</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vimala" class="skt-link">vimala</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaimala" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaimala" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaimalaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaimalā</i> lit. se dit de textes sacrés <a href="#entry-zaiva" class="skt-link">śaiva</a>, de la tradition <a href="#entry-atimaarga" class="skt-link">atimārga</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaimalya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैमल्य</span> <i>vaimalya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vimala" class="skt-link">vimala</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-vaimalya" class="skt-link">n.</a> pureté; propreté.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaimanasya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैमनस्य</span> <i>vaimanasya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vimanas" class="skt-link">vimanas</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-vaimanasya" class="skt-link">n.</a> tristesse, découragement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vainateya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैनतेय</span> <i>vainateya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vinataa" class="skt-link">vinatā</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-vainateya" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Vainateya, épith. de <a href="#entry-Ugaru_da" class="skt-link">Garuḍa</a> «fils de <a href="#entry-Uvinataa" class="skt-link">Vinatā</a>».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vainayika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैनयिक</span> <i>vainayika</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vinaya" class="skt-link">vinaya</a><a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vainayika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vainayika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vainayikii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vainayikī</i> relatif à la discipline ou à la bonne conduite <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> la discipline militaire, l'un des 64 arts [<a href="#entry-kalaa" class="skt-link">kalā</a>].<br> <i>vainayikīnāṃ</i> <i>vidyānāṃ</i> <i>jñānam</i> soc. l'aptitude au commandement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaiphalya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैफल्य</span> <i>vaiphalya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-viphala" class="skt-link">viphala</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-vaiphalya" class="skt-link">n.</a> inutilité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaira">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैर</span> <i>vaira</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-viira" class="skt-link">vīra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaira" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaira" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vairaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vairā</i> hostile, inamical — <a href="#entry-vaira" class="skt-link">n.</a> hostilité, inimitié; querelle; hostilité envers ⟨i.⟩ — <a href="#entry-vairaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vairā</i> ifc. hostilité envers — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. md. <i>(vairāyate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vairāyita</i><i>)</i> faire un acte hostile, commencer les hostilités, s'attaquer à ⟨<a href="#entry-prati" class="skt-link">prati</a>-acc. i.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vairaaga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैराग</span> <i>vairāga</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-viraaga" class="skt-link">virāga</a>] <a href="#entry-vairaaga" class="skt-link">n.</a> absence de passion, libération des désirs.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vairaagin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vairāgin</i> [<a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vairaagin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vairaagin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vairaagi_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vairāgiṇī</i> qui s'est libéré de toute passion et de tout désir — <a href="#entry-vairaagin" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. ascète, not. <a href="#entry-vai_s_nava" class="skt-link">vaiṣṇava</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vairaaga" class="skt-link">vairāga</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vairaagya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैराग्य</span> <i>vairāgya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-viraaga" class="skt-link">virāga</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-vairaagya" class="skt-link">n.</a> renoncement au monde, cessation des passions; abnégation.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vairaagyaprakara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vairāgyaprakaraṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-prakara_na" class="skt-link">prakaraṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-vairaagyaprakara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Vairāgyaprakaraṇa, 2⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ section du <a href="#entry-Umok_sopaaya" class="skt-link">Mokṣopāya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vairaagyazataka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vairāgyaśataka</i> [<a href="#entry-zataka" class="skt-link">śataka</a>] <a href="#entry-vairaagyazataka" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Vairāgyaśataka, recueil de 100 poèmes sur le renoncement dû à <a href="#entry-Ubhart_rhari_1" class="skt-link">Bhartṛhari_1</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vairaagya" class="skt-link">vairāgya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vairayaatanaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vairayātanā</i> [<a href="#entry-yaatanaa" class="skt-link">yātanā</a>] <a href="#entry-vairayaatanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> vengeance.<br> <a href="#entry-vaira" class="skt-link">vaira</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vairezvari">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैरेश्वरि</span> <i>vaireśvari</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-viirezvara" class="skt-link">vīreśvara</a>] <a href="#entry-vairezvari" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. de Vaireśvari «fils de <a href="#entry-Uviirezvara" class="skt-link">Vīreśvara</a>», patr. de <a href="#entry-Uhari_1" class="skt-link">Hari_1</a> <a href="#entry-Udiik_sita" class="skt-link">Dīkṣita</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vairi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैरि</span> <i>vairi</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-vairin" class="skt-link">vairin</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vairin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैरिन्</span> <i>vairin</i> [<a href="#entry-vaira" class="skt-link">vaira</a><a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vairin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vairin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vairi_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vairiṇī</i> hostile, inamical — <a href="#entry-vairin" class="skt-link">m.</a> ennemi <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> héros.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vairisi_mha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vairisiṃha</i> [<a href="#entry-si_mha" class="skt-link">siṃha</a>] <a href="#entry-vairisi_mha" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. du roi Vairisiṃha «Lion parmi les héros», de la dynastie <a href="#entry-Uparamaara" class="skt-link">Paramāra</a>; il régnait au <a href="#entry-Umaalava" class="skt-link">Mālava</a> au 9⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle; il transféra sa capitale d'<a href="#entry-Uujjayinii" class="skt-link">Ujjayinī</a> à <a href="#entry-Udhaaraa" class="skt-link">Dhārā</a>; il est ancêtre de <a href="#entry-Ubhojadeva" class="skt-link">Bhojadeva</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vairi" class="skt-link">vairi</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vairocana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैरोचन</span> <i>vairocana</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-virocana" class="skt-link">virocana</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vairocana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vairocana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vairocanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vairocanā</i> solaire — <a href="#entry-vairocana" class="skt-link">m.</a> bd. np. de Vairocana «le Lumi­neux», <a href="#entry-dhyaanibuddha" class="skt-link">dhyānibuddha</a> du Centre dans le panthéon du <a href="#entry-mahaayaana" class="skt-link">mahāyāna</a>, représenté en gén. en <a href="#entry-dharmacakra" class="skt-link">dharmacakra</a> <a href="#entry-mudraa" class="skt-link">mudrā</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Vairocana_1, patr. de <a href="#entry-Ubali" class="skt-link">Bali</a> «Fils de <a href="#entry-Uvirocana" class="skt-link">Virocana</a>».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vairudhya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैरुध्य</span> <i>vairudhya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-virudh" class="skt-link">virudh</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-vairudhya" class="skt-link">m.</a> hostilité, obstruction, opposition.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vairudhyavaada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vairudhyavāda</i> [<a href="#entry-vaada" class="skt-link">vāda</a>] <a href="#entry-vairudhyavaada" class="skt-link">m.</a> dialectique.<br> <a href="#entry-vairudhya" class="skt-link">vairudhya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vairuupa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैरूप</span> <i>vairūpa</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-viruupa" class="skt-link">virūpa</a>] <a href="#entry-vairuupa" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. descendant de <a href="#entry-Uviruupa" class="skt-link">Virūpa</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>vairūpās</i> myth. syn. <a href="#entry-afgirasas" class="skt-link">aṅgirasas</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vairuupya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैरूप्य</span> <i>vairūpya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-viruupa" class="skt-link">virūpa</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-vairuupya" class="skt-link">n.</a> multiplicité de formes, diversité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> difformité, laideur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vairuupyataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vairūpyatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-vairuupyataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> condition de difformité.<br> <a href="#entry-vairuupya" class="skt-link">vairūpya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaita_n_dika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैतण्डिक</span> <i>vaitaṇḍika</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vita_n_daa" class="skt-link">vitaṇḍā</a><a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaita_n_dika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaita_n_dika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaita_n_dikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaitaṇḍikā</i> phil. champion d'arguties; qui soutient une thèse arbitraire pour le simple plaisir de remporter le débat — <a href="#entry-vaita_n_dika" class="skt-link">m.</a> sophiste.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaitaalika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैतालिक</span> <i>vaitālika</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vitaala" class="skt-link">vitāla</a><a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] <a href="#entry-vaitaalika" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. hérault-poète de cour; il proclame l'heure poétiquement, en incluant un panégyrique du roi.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaitanika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैतनिक</span> <i>vaitanika</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vetana" class="skt-link">vetana</a><a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaitanika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaitanika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaitanikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaitanikā</i> qui vit de ses gages; salarié — <a href="#entry-vaitanika" class="skt-link">m.</a> travailleur, journalier.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaitara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैतरण</span> <i>vaitaraṇa</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vitara_na" class="skt-link">vitaraṇa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaitara_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaitara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaitara_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaitaraṇī</i> qui veut traverser (la rivière) — <a href="#entry-vaitara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. transport des âmes sur le rivière menant aux régions infernales — <a href="#entry-vaitara_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaitaraṇī</i> myth. np. de la rivière souterraine Vaitaraṇī, menant les morts vers le royaume de <a href="#entry-Uyama" class="skt-link">Yama</a>; elle est le Styx indien; les <a href="#entry-paa_n_davaas" class="skt-link">pāṇḍavās</a> s'y baignèrent lors de leur exil, sur le chemin du mont <a href="#entry-Umahendra" class="skt-link">Mahendra</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> géo. rivière du <a href="#entry-Ukalifga" class="skt-link">Kaliṅga</a> (mod. Baitaraṇī, qui passe à Jajpur en Orissa).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaitathya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैतथ्य</span> <i>vaitathya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vitathya" class="skt-link">vitathya</a>] <a href="#entry-vaitathya" class="skt-link">n.</a> fausseté, erreur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaivarta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैवर्त</span> <i>vaivarta</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vivarta" class="skt-link">vivarta</a>] <a href="#entry-vaivarta" class="skt-link">n.</a> cf. <a href="#entry-brahmavaivartapuraa_na" class="skt-link">brahmavaivartapurāṇa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaivasvata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैवस्वत</span> <i>vaivasvata</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vivasvat" class="skt-link">vivasvat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaivasvata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaivasvata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaivasvatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaivasvatī</i> relatif à <a href="#entry-Uvivasvaan" class="skt-link">Vivasvān</a>; de la lignée solaire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Vaivasvata, patr. de <a href="#entry-Usatyavrata" class="skt-link">Satyavrata</a> fils de <a href="#entry-Uvivasvaan" class="skt-link">Vivasvān</a>, 7⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ <a href="#entry-manu" class="skt-link">manu</a> du <a href="#entry-kalpa" class="skt-link">kalpa</a>; c'est le <a href="#entry-Umanu" class="skt-link">Manu</a>-<a href="#entry-Uyama" class="skt-link">Yama</a> de l'ère actuelle; il fut sauvé du déluge par un poisson géant, à la corne duquel il accrocha son bateau; cf. <a href="#entry-Usatyavrata" class="skt-link">Satyavrata</a> — <a href="#entry-vaivasvatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaivasvatī</i> myth. np. de Vaivasvatī, patr. de <a href="#entry-Uyamii" class="skt-link">Yamī</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pkt. <i>Vaiśvata</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaiyaaghra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैयाघ्र</span> <i>vaiyāghra</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vyaaghra" class="skt-link">vyāghra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaiyaaghra" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaiyaaghra" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaiyaaghraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaiyāghrā</i> relatif au tigre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> couvert d'une peau de tigre — <a href="#entry-vaiyaaghra" class="skt-link">n.</a> peau de tigre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaiyaaghrapadya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैयाघ्रपद्य</span> <i>vaiyāghrapadya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vyaaghrapad" class="skt-link">vyāghrapad</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaiyaaghrapadya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaiyaaghrapadya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaiyaaghrapadyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaiyāghrapadyā</i> composé par <a href="#entry-Uvyaaghrapaad" class="skt-link">Vyāghrapād</a> — <a href="#entry-vaiyaaghrapadya" class="skt-link">m.</a> patr. du <a href="#entry-muni" class="skt-link">muni</a> Vaiyāghrapadya; nom de <a href="#entry-gotra" class="skt-link">gotra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaiyaakara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैयाकरण</span> <i>vaiyākaraṇa</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vyaakara_na" class="skt-link">vyākaraṇa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaiyaakara_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaiyaakara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaiyaakara_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaiyākaraṇī</i> relatif à la grammaire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui connaît la grammaire — <a href="#entry-vaiyaakara_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> grammairien.<br> <i>prathame</i> <i>hi</i> <i>vidvāṃso</i> <i>vaikyākaraṇaḥ</i> [<a href="#entry-Udhvanyaaloka" class="skt-link">Dhvanyāloka</a>] Les grammairiens sont premiers parmi les savants.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaiyaakara_nabhuu_sa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vaiyākaraṇabhūṣaṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-bhuu_sa_na" class="skt-link">bhūṣaṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-vaiyaakara_nabhuu_sa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Vaiyākaraṇabhūṣaṇa «Ornementation de la grammaire», copieux traité de philosophie du langage dû à <a href="#entry-Ukau_n_da" class="skt-link">Kauṇḍa</a> <a href="#entry-Ubha_t_ta" class="skt-link">Bhaṭṭa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaiyaakara_nabhuu_sa_nasaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vaiyākaraṇabhūṣaṇasāra</i> [<a href="#entry-saara" class="skt-link">sāra</a>] <a href="#entry-vaiyaakara_nabhuu_sa_nasaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du Vaiyākaraṇabhūṣaṇasāra «Quintessence linguistique», résumé du précédent.<br> <a href="#entry-vaiyaakara_nabhuu_sa_na" class="skt-link">vaiyākaraṇabhūṣaṇa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaiyaakara_nasiddhaanta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vaiyākaraṇasiddhānta</i> [<a href="#entry-siddhaanta" class="skt-link">siddhānta</a>] <a href="#entry-vaiyaakara_nasiddhaanta" class="skt-link">m.</a> traité de grammaire.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaiyaakara_nasiddhaantama_njuu_saa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vaiyākaraṇasiddhāntamañjūṣā</i> [<a href="#entry-ma_njuu_saa" class="skt-link">mañjūṣā</a>] <a href="#entry-vaiyaakara_nasiddhaantama_njuu_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de la Vaiyākaraṇasiddhāntamañjūṣā «Trésor de savoir grammatical», traité linguistique de <a href="#entry-Unaageza" class="skt-link">Nāgeśa</a> <a href="#entry-Ubha_t_ta" class="skt-link">Bhaṭṭa</a>; il fut résumé dans la Vaiyākaraṇasiddhāntalaghumañjūṣā, et condensé encore plus dans la Vaiyākaraṇasiddhāntaparamalaghumañjūṣā; <a href="#entry-Udurbalaacaarya" class="skt-link">Durbalācārya</a> en fit un commentaire <a href="#entry-Uku_ncikaa" class="skt-link">Kuñcikā</a>, <a href="#entry-Ubaalambha_t_ta" class="skt-link">Bālambhaṭṭa</a> en fit un commentaire <a href="#entry-Ukalaa" class="skt-link">Kalā</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vaiyaakara_nasiddhaanta" class="skt-link">vaiyākaraṇasiddhānta</a> <br> <a href="#entry-vaiyaakara_na" class="skt-link">vaiyākaraṇa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaiyadhikara_nya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैयधिकरण्य</span> <i>vaiyadhikaraṇya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vyadhikara_na" class="skt-link">vyadhikaraṇa</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-vaiyadhikara_nya" class="skt-link">n.</a> gram. non agrément en cas <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> en relation avec des sujets différents.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaiyarthya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैयर्थ्य</span> <i>vaiyarthya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vyartha" class="skt-link">vyartha</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-vaiyarthya" class="skt-link">n.</a> inutilité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaizaakha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैशाख</span> <i>vaiśākha</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vizaakha" class="skt-link">viśākha</a>] <a href="#entry-vaizaakha" class="skt-link">m.</a> mois de <a href="#entry-Uvizaakhe" class="skt-link">Viśākhe</a> (avril-mai), 2⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ mois lunaire, et 1⟨sup⟩er⟨/sup⟩ mois solaire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. festival de Vaiśākha, fêtant l'anniversaire du <a href="#entry-Ubuddha" class="skt-link">Buddha</a> [<a href="#entry-buddhajayantii" class="skt-link">buddhajayantī</a>] — <a href="#entry-vaizaakhii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaiśākhī</i> sa pleine lune [<a href="#entry-puur_nimaa" class="skt-link">pūrṇimā</a>]; cf. <a href="#entry-buddhapuur_nimaa" class="skt-link">buddhapūrṇimā</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> singhalais vesak; pali <i>vesākha</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaizaalii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैशाली</span> <i>vaiśālī</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vizaala" class="skt-link">viśāla</a>] <a href="#entry-vaizaalii" class="skt-link">f.</a> myth. np. de Vaiśālī (ou Vaiśalī), une épouse de <a href="#entry-Uvasudeva" class="skt-link">Vasudeva</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> géo. np. de la ville de Vaiśālī_1 au <a href="#entry-Ubihaara" class="skt-link">Bihāra</a> (mod. Basarh, Muśaṅṅarpur district, 50 km au nord de Paṭnā); c'était la capitale du clan <a href="#entry-Ulicchavi" class="skt-link">Licchavi</a> et de la confédération républicaine <a href="#entry-Uv_rji" class="skt-link">Vṛji</a>, au 5⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle ant.; son régent <a href="#entry-Ucetaka" class="skt-link">Cetaka</a> combattit <a href="#entry-Uajaatazatru_1" class="skt-link">Ajātaśatru_1</a>; <a href="#entry-Umahaaviira" class="skt-link">Mahāvīra</a> y naquit, <a href="#entry-Ubuddha" class="skt-link">Buddha</a> y fit son dernier sermon, <a href="#entry-Uvimalakiirti" class="skt-link">Vimalakīrti</a> y vécut, <a href="#entry-Uzizunaaga" class="skt-link">Śiśunāga</a> y régna.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaizaarada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैशारद</span> <i>vaiśārada</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vizaarada" class="skt-link">viśārada</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaizaarada" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaizaarada" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaizaaradii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaiśāradī</i> érudit, expert; infaillible — <a href="#entry-vaizaarada" class="skt-link">n.</a> érudition, expertise.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaizaaradya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैशारद्य</span> <i>vaiśāradya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vizaarada" class="skt-link">viśārada</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-vaizaaradya" class="skt-link">n.</a> grande expérience, sagesse; expertise (en ⟨loc.⟩); infaillibilité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bd. not. sûreté de jugement de <a href="#entry-Ubuddha" class="skt-link">Buddha</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaizalii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैशली</span> <i>vaiśalī</i> cf. <a href="#entry-vaizaalii" class="skt-link">vaiśālī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaizampaayana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैशम्पायन</span> <i>vaiśampāyana</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vizampa" class="skt-link">viśampa</a>-<a href="#entry-aayana" class="skt-link">āyana</a>] <a href="#entry-vaizampaayana" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] patr. de Vaiśampāyana «fils de <a href="#entry-Uvizampa" class="skt-link">Viśampa</a>», disciple de <a href="#entry-Uvyaasa" class="skt-link">Vyāsa</a>; à sa demande il récita le <a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a> à <a href="#entry-Ujanamejaya" class="skt-link">Janamejaya</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. [<a href="#entry-Ukaadambarii" class="skt-link">Kādambarī</a>] np. de Vaiśampāyana_1, fils de <a href="#entry-Uzukanaasa" class="skt-link">Śukanāsa</a> et <a href="#entry-Umanoramaa_1" class="skt-link">Manoramā_1</a>, compagnon du prince <a href="#entry-Ucandraapii_da" class="skt-link">Candrāpīḍa</a>; il est l'incarnation du héros <a href="#entry-Upu_n_dariika_2" class="skt-link">Puṇḍarīka_2</a>; envoyé par <a href="#entry-Ucandraapii_da_1" class="skt-link">Candrāpīḍa_1</a> pour dire son amour à <a href="#entry-Ukaadambarii" class="skt-link">Kādambarī</a>, il tombe amoureux de <a href="#entry-Umahaazvetaa" class="skt-link">Mahāśvetā</a>, mais celle-ci le maudit de renaître comme le perroquet narrateur à la cour du roi <a href="#entry-Uzuudraka_1" class="skt-link">Śūdraka_1</a>; il meurt, ce qui fera (apparemment) mourir de chagrin <a href="#entry-Ucandraapii_da" class="skt-link">Candrāpīḍa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaizasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैशस</span> <i>vaiśasa</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vizasa" class="skt-link">viśasa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaizasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaizasa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaizasaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaiśasā</i> destructeur — <a href="#entry-vaizasa" class="skt-link">n.</a> destruction, mise en pièces, massacre; calamité, guerre, boucherie — <a href="#entry-vaizasaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaiśasā</i> ifc. destruction de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaize_sika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैशेषिक</span> <i>vaiśeṣika</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vize_sa" class="skt-link">viśeṣa</a><a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaize_sika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaize_sika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaize_sikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaiśeṣikā</i> particulier, spécifique; distingué, excellent — <a href="#entry-vaize_sika" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. le discernement, doctrine philosophique discriminative remontant au 1⟨sup⟩er⟨/sup⟩ siècle, traditionnellement attribuée à <a href="#entry-Uka_naada" class="skt-link">Kaṇāda</a>; elle s'occupe de discerner les différences charactéristiques [<a href="#entry-vize_sa" class="skt-link">viśeṣa</a>] entre les choses; c'est l'un des 6 points de vue [<a href="#entry-_sa_ddarzana" class="skt-link">ṣaḍdarśana</a>] de l'Hindouisme orthodoxe, de préoccupation ontologique et systématique; on y classifie les concepts en 6 catégories ontologiques [<a href="#entry-padaartha" class="skt-link">padārtha</a>]: les substances [<a href="#entry-dravya_1" class="skt-link">dravya_1</a>], les propriétés [<a href="#entry-gu_na" class="skt-link">guṇa</a>], les activités [<a href="#entry-karman" class="skt-link">karman</a>], les universaux ou substrats génériques [<a href="#entry-saamaanya" class="skt-link">sāmānya</a>] ou discriminatifs [<a href="#entry-vize_sa" class="skt-link">viśeṣa</a>], et les inhérences [<a href="#entry-samavaaya" class="skt-link">samavāya</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaize_sikasuutra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vaiśeṣikasūtra</i> [<a href="#entry-suutra" class="skt-link">sūtra</a>] <a href="#entry-vaize_sikasuutra" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Vaiśeṣikasūtra, exposé de la doctrine discriminative [<a href="#entry-vaize_sika" class="skt-link">vaiśeṣika</a>] en dix livres [<a href="#entry-adhyaaya" class="skt-link">adhyāya</a>], attribué à <a href="#entry-Uka_naada" class="skt-link">Kaṇāda</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaize_sikasuutrav_rtti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vaiśeṣikasūtravṛtti</i> [<a href="#entry-v_rtti" class="skt-link">vṛtti</a>] <a href="#entry-vaize_sikasuutrav_rtti" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de la Vaiśeṣikasūtravṛtti, glose du <a href="#entry-Uvaize_sikasuutra" class="skt-link">Vaiśeṣikasūtra</a> due à <a href="#entry-Ucandraananda" class="skt-link">Candrānanda</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vaize_sikasuutra" class="skt-link">vaiśeṣikasūtra</a> <br> <a href="#entry-vaize_sika" class="skt-link">vaiśeṣika</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaizi_s_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैशिष्ट</span> <i>vaiśiṣṭa</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vizi_s_ta" class="skt-link">viśiṣṭa</a>] <a href="#entry-vaizi_s_ta" class="skt-link">n.</a> distinction; différence.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaizi_s_tya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैशिष्ट्य</span> <i>vaiśiṣṭya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vizi_s_ta" class="skt-link">viśiṣṭa</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-vaizi_s_tya" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. possession d'une propriété distinctive; distinction; singularité; différence <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> prééminence, excellence, supériorité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaizrava_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैश्रवण</span> <i>vaiśravaṇa</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vizravas" class="skt-link">viśravas</a>] <a href="#entry-vaizrava_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Vaiśravaṇa «Descendant de <a href="#entry-Uvizravaa" class="skt-link">Viśravā</a>», patr. de <a href="#entry-Ukubera" class="skt-link">Kubera</a>, mais aussi de <a href="#entry-Uraava_na" class="skt-link">Rāvaṇa</a> et ses frères <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bd. roi du Nord (aussi appelé <a href="#entry-Ujambhala" class="skt-link">Jambhala</a> au Tibet); il est souvent représenté avec une mangouste [<a href="#entry-nakula" class="skt-link">nakula</a>] crachant des joyaux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaizvaanara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैश्वानर</span> <i>vaiśvānara</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vizvaanara" class="skt-link">viśvānara</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaizvaanara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaizvaanara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaizvaanarii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaiśvānarī</i> commun à tous les hommes, universel, général; s'appliquant à tous <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> vénéré par tous — <a href="#entry-vaizvaanara" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Vaiśvānara, invocation d'<a href="#entry-Uagni" class="skt-link">Agni</a> «Qui appartient à tous les hommes», sous son aspect du Soleil, de la lumière ou du feu <a href="#entry-aahavaniiya" class="skt-link">āhavanīya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaizvadeva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैश्वदेव</span> <i>vaiśvadeva</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vizvedeva" class="skt-link">viśvedeva</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaizvadeva" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaizvadeva" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaizvadevii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaiśvadevī</i> relatif à tous les dieux [<a href="#entry-Uvizvedevaas" class="skt-link">Viśvedevās</a>]; sacré à tous les dieux — <a href="#entry-vaizvadeva" class="skt-link">n.</a> soc. 1⟨sup⟩er⟨/sup⟩ rite de <a href="#entry-caaturmaasya" class="skt-link">cāturmāsya</a> à la pleine lune du mois <a href="#entry-maagha" class="skt-link">māgha</a>, où l'on sacrifie à tous les dieux, et not. à <a href="#entry-Uagni" class="skt-link">Agni</a> qui leur porte les offrandes — <a href="#entry-vaizvadevii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaiśvadevī</i> soc. variété de brique d'autel du feu <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. 8⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ jour de la quinzaine sombre du mois <a href="#entry-maagha" class="skt-link">māgha</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaizvadevabali">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vaiśvadevabali</i> [<a href="#entry-bali" class="skt-link">bali</a>] <a href="#entry-vaizvadevabali" class="skt-link">m.</a> offrande (lancée) à tous les dieux.<br> <a href="#entry-vaizvadeva" class="skt-link">vaiśvadeva</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaizya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वैश्य</span> <i>vaiśya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-viz_2" class="skt-link">viś_2</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-vaizya" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. membre de la 3⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ classe, qui vit de son travail; cultivateur, éleveur, marchand, artisan, banquier <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>vaiśyās</i> soc. la classe des travailleurs — <a href="#entry-vaizyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaiśyā</i> soc. femme de cette classe — <a href="#entry-vaizya" class="skt-link">n.</a> subordination, dépendance.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaj">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">वज्</span> <i>vaj</i> v. être fort <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>vigeo</i>; fr. vigueur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vajra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वज्र</span> <i>vajra</i> [<a href="#entry-vaj" class="skt-link">vaj</a><a href="#entry--ra" class="skt-link">-ra</a>] <a href="#entry-vajra" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vajra" class="skt-link">n.</a> foudre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> diamant <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> [<i>vajrayuddha</i>] myth. le missile-foudre, arme d'<a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a> (représenté par un trident à trois pointes, puis quatre pointes recourbées aux deux extrémités d'un sceptre); syn. <a href="#entry-kuliza" class="skt-link">kuliśa</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Vajra «Diamant», fils d'<a href="#entry-Uaniruddha" class="skt-link">Aniruddha</a> et d'<a href="#entry-Uu_saa_1" class="skt-link">Uṣā_1</a>; il fut le dernier des <a href="#entry-yaadavaas" class="skt-link">yādavās</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vajraasana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vajrāsana</i> [<a href="#entry-aasana" class="skt-link">āsana</a>] <a href="#entry-vajraasana" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>] posture avec les jambes croisées en lotus, la plante des pieds tournée vers le haut.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vajraayana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vajrāyana</i> [<a href="#entry-aayana" class="skt-link">āyana</a>] <a href="#entry-vajraayana" class="skt-link">m.</a> bd. np. du Vajrāyana «Voie du diamant», forme tantrique du <a href="#entry-Umahaayaana" class="skt-link">Mahāyāna</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vajrabhaa_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vajrabhāṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-bhaa_saa" class="skt-link">bhāṣā</a>] <a href="#entry-vajrabhaa_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> bd. [<a href="#entry-Umahaayaana" class="skt-link">Mahāyāna</a>] np. du <a href="#entry-vajrabodhisattva" class="skt-link">vajrabodhisattva</a> Vajrabhāṣa «À la parole adamantine».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vajrabodhisattva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vajrabodhisattva</i> [<a href="#entry-bodhisattva" class="skt-link">bodhisattva</a>] <a href="#entry-vajrabodhisattva" class="skt-link">m.</a> bd. [<a href="#entry-Umahaayaana" class="skt-link">Mahāyāna</a>] l'un de 16 accomplis [<a href="#entry-bodhisattva" class="skt-link">bodhisattva</a>] associés 4 par 4 aux <a href="#entry-jina" class="skt-link">jina</a> gardiens <a href="#entry-Uak_sobhya" class="skt-link">Akṣobhya</a>, <a href="#entry-Uamitaabha" class="skt-link">Amitābha</a>, <a href="#entry-Uamoghasiddhi" class="skt-link">Amoghasiddhi</a> et <a href="#entry-Uratnasambhava" class="skt-link">Ratnasaṃbhava</a>; ils s'appellent <a href="#entry-Uvajrasattva" class="skt-link">Vajrasattva</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvajraraaja" class="skt-link">Vajrarāja</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvajraraaga" class="skt-link">Vajrarāga</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvajrasaadhu" class="skt-link">Vajrasādhu</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvajraratna" class="skt-link">Vajraratna</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvajratejas" class="skt-link">Vajratejas</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvajraketu" class="skt-link">Vajraketu</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvajrahaasa" class="skt-link">Vajrahāsa</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvajradharma" class="skt-link">Vajradharma</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvajratiik_s_na" class="skt-link">Vajratīkṣṇa</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvajrahetu" class="skt-link">Vajrahetu</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvajrabhaa_sa" class="skt-link">Vajrabhāṣa</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvajrakarma" class="skt-link">Vajrakarma</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvajrarak_sa" class="skt-link">Vajrarakṣa</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvajrayak_sa" class="skt-link">Vajrayakṣa</a>, et <a href="#entry-Uvajrasandhi" class="skt-link">Vajrasandhi</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vajracchedaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vajracchedaka</i> [<a href="#entry-chedaka" class="skt-link">chedaka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vajracchedaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vajracchedaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vajracchedikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vajracchedikā</i> qui coupe le diamant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vajracchedakapraj_naapaaramitaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vajracchedakaprajñāpāramitā</i> [<a href="#entry-praj_naapaaramitaa" class="skt-link">prajñāpāramitā</a>] <a href="#entry-vajracchedakapraj_naapaaramitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> bd. np. de la Vajracchedakaprajñāpāramitā ou Vajracchedikā «Sūtra du diamant», ouvrage fondateur du bouddhisme <a href="#entry-Umahaayaana" class="skt-link">Mahāyāna</a>, sous la forme d'un dialogue entre <a href="#entry-Ubuddha" class="skt-link">Buddha</a> et son disciple <a href="#entry-Usubhuuti" class="skt-link">Subhūti</a> sur la vacuité et l'impermanence du monde; il fut traduit en chinois par <a href="#entry-Ukumaarajiiva" class="skt-link">Kumārajīva</a> en 401, on en connaît une version imprimée de 868.<br> <a href="#entry-vajracchedaka" class="skt-link">vajracchedaka</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vajracuur_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vajracūrṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-cuur_na" class="skt-link">cūrṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-vajracuur_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> mod. ciment.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vajradhara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vajradhara</i> [<a href="#entry-dhara" class="skt-link">dhara</a>] <a href="#entry-vajradhara" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. épith. d'<a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a> «Tenant le foudre» <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bd. [Vajrayāna] np. de l'accompli [<a href="#entry-bodhisattva" class="skt-link">bodhisattva</a>] Vajradhara «Portant le foudre adamantin», aussi appelé <a href="#entry-Uvajrapaa_ni" class="skt-link">Vajrapāṇi</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vajradharma">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vajradharma</i> [<a href="#entry-dharma" class="skt-link">dharma</a>] <a href="#entry-vajradharma" class="skt-link">m.</a> bd. [<a href="#entry-Umahaayaana" class="skt-link">Mahāyāna</a>] np. du <a href="#entry-vajrabodhisattva" class="skt-link">vajrabodhisattva</a> Vajradharma, «Loi adamantine», aspect d'<a href="#entry-Uavalokitezvara" class="skt-link">Avalokiteśvara</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vajrahaasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vajrahāsa</i> [<a href="#entry-haasa" class="skt-link">hāsa</a>] <a href="#entry-vajrahaasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> bd. [<a href="#entry-Umahaayaana" class="skt-link">Mahāyāna</a>] np. du <a href="#entry-vajrabodhisattva" class="skt-link">vajrabodhisattva</a> Vajrahāsa «Rire adamantin».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vajrahetu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vajrahetu</i> [<a href="#entry-hetu" class="skt-link">hetu</a>] <a href="#entry-vajrahetu" class="skt-link">m.</a> bd. [<a href="#entry-Umahaayaana" class="skt-link">Mahāyāna</a>] np. du <a href="#entry-vajrabodhisattva" class="skt-link">vajrabodhisattva</a> Vajrahetu «Agent adamantin», aspect de <a href="#entry-Umaitreya" class="skt-link">Maitreya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vajrakaaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vajrakāya</i> [<a href="#entry-kaaya" class="skt-link">kāya</a>] <a href="#entry-vajrakaaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> bd. le «corps essentiel» [«de diamant»], symbolisant l'Être absolu présent dans la nature spirituelle de tout homme; syn. <a href="#entry-dharmakaaya" class="skt-link">dharmakāya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vajrakandara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vajrakandara</i> [<a href="#entry-kandara" class="skt-link">kandara</a>] <a href="#entry-vajrakandara" class="skt-link">n.</a> canal uro-génital.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vajrakarma">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vajrakarma</i> [<a href="#entry-karma" class="skt-link">karma</a>] <a href="#entry-vajrakarma" class="skt-link">m.</a> bd. [<a href="#entry-Umahaayaana" class="skt-link">Mahāyāna</a>] np. du <a href="#entry-vajrabodhisattva" class="skt-link">vajrabodhisattva</a> Vajrakarma «au destin adamantin».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vajraketu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vajraketu</i> [<a href="#entry-ketu" class="skt-link">ketu</a>] <a href="#entry-vajraketu" class="skt-link">m.</a> bd. [<a href="#entry-Umahaayaana" class="skt-link">Mahāyāna</a>] np. du <a href="#entry-vajrabodhisattva" class="skt-link">vajrabodhisattva</a> Vajraketu «Météore adamantin».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vajralepa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vajralepa</i> [<a href="#entry-lepa" class="skt-link">lepa</a>] <a href="#entry-vajralepa" class="skt-link">m.</a> mortier; enduit <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> colle forte; not. colle de peau de buffle utilisée pour les enduits.<br> <i>dharmakṣetre</i> <i>kṛtam</i> <i>pāpaṃ</i> <i>vajralepam</i> <i>bhaviṣyati</i> En ce temps de justice, que le péché commis soit mis au pilori.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vajrama_ni">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vajramaṇi</i> [<a href="#entry-ma_ni" class="skt-link">maṇi</a>] <a href="#entry-vajrama_ni" class="skt-link">m.</a> diamant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vajranaabha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vajranābha</i> [<a href="#entry-naabhi" class="skt-link">nābhi</a>] <a href="#entry-vajranaabha" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Vajranābha, épith. de <a href="#entry-Usudarzana" class="skt-link">Sudarśana</a>, <a href="#entry-cakra" class="skt-link">cakra</a> de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a> «au moyeu de diamant»; <a href="#entry-Uagni" class="skt-link">Agni</a> le donna à <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vajrapaa_ni">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vajrapāṇi</i> [<a href="#entry-paa_ni" class="skt-link">pāṇi</a>] <a href="#entry-vajrapaa_ni" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Vajrapāṇi, épith. d'<a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a> farouche «Avec le foudre en main» <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bd. [Vajrayāna] épith. d'un accompli [<a href="#entry-bodhisattva" class="skt-link">bodhisattva</a>] incorporant <a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a> dans le panthéon du <a href="#entry-Umahaayaana" class="skt-link">Mahāyāna</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Uvajradhara" class="skt-link">Vajradhara</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vajraraaga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vajrarāga</i> [<a href="#entry-raaga" class="skt-link">rāga</a>] <a href="#entry-vajraraaga" class="skt-link">m.</a> bd. [<a href="#entry-Umahaayaana" class="skt-link">Mahāyāna</a>] np. du <a href="#entry-vajrabodhisattva" class="skt-link">vajrabodhisattva</a> Vajrarāga «Goût adamantin».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vajraraaja">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vajrarāja</i> [<a href="#entry-raaja" class="skt-link">rāja</a>] <a href="#entry-vajraraaja" class="skt-link">m.</a> bd. [<a href="#entry-Umahaayaana" class="skt-link">Mahāyāna</a>] np. du <a href="#entry-vajrabodhisattva" class="skt-link">vajrabodhisattva</a> Vajrarāja «Roi adamantin».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vajrarak_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vajrarakṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-rak_sa" class="skt-link">rakṣa</a>] <a href="#entry-vajrarak_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> bd. [<a href="#entry-Umahaayaana" class="skt-link">Mahāyāna</a>] np. du <a href="#entry-vajrabodhisattva" class="skt-link">vajrabodhisattva</a> Vajrarakṣa «Protecteur adamantin».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vajraratna">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vajraratna</i> [<a href="#entry-ratna" class="skt-link">ratna</a>] <a href="#entry-vajraratna" class="skt-link">m.</a> bd. [<a href="#entry-Umahaayaana" class="skt-link">Mahāyāna</a>] np. du <a href="#entry-vajrabodhisattva" class="skt-link">vajrabodhisattva</a> Vajraratna «Joyau adamantin».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vajrasaadhu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vajrasādhu</i> [<a href="#entry-saadhu" class="skt-link">sādhu</a>] <a href="#entry-vajrasaadhu" class="skt-link">m.</a> bd. [<a href="#entry-Umahaayaana" class="skt-link">Mahāyāna</a>] np. du <a href="#entry-vajrabodhisattva" class="skt-link">vajrabodhisattva</a> Vajrasādhu «Bienfait adamantin».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vajrasandhi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vajrasandhi</i> [<a href="#entry-sandhi" class="skt-link">sandhi</a>] <a href="#entry-vajrasandhi" class="skt-link">m.</a> bd. [<a href="#entry-Umahaayaana" class="skt-link">Mahāyāna</a>] np. du <a href="#entry-vajrabodhisattva" class="skt-link">vajrabodhisattva</a> Vajrasandhi «Crépuscule adamantin».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vajrasattva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vajrasattva</i> var. <i>vajrasatva</i> [<a href="#entry-sattva" class="skt-link">sattva</a>] <a href="#entry-vajrasattva" class="skt-link">m.</a> bd. [<a href="#entry-Umahaayaana" class="skt-link">Mahāyāna</a>] np. du <a href="#entry-vajrabodhisattva" class="skt-link">vajrabodhisattva</a> Vajrasattva «Être adamantin» <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bd. [tantr.] épith. de <a href="#entry-Uhevajra" class="skt-link">Hevajra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vajrasuucii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vajrasūcī</i> [<a href="#entry-suucii" class="skt-link">sūcī</a>] <a href="#entry-vajrasuucii" class="skt-link">f.</a> bd. np. de la Vajrasūcī «Pointe du diamant», texte en vers attribué à <a href="#entry-Uazvagho_sa" class="skt-link">Aśvaghoṣa</a>, sans doute plus tardif (6⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle); c'est une satire des idéaux brahmaniques.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vajratejas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vajratejas</i> [<a href="#entry-tejas" class="skt-link">tejas</a>] <a href="#entry-vajratejas" class="skt-link">m.</a> bd. [<a href="#entry-Umahaayaana" class="skt-link">Mahāyāna</a>] np. du <a href="#entry-vajrabodhisattva" class="skt-link">vajrabodhisattva</a> Vajratejas «Puissance adamantine».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vajratiik_s_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vajratīkṣṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-tiik_s_na" class="skt-link">tīkṣṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-vajratiik_s_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> bd. [<a href="#entry-Umahaayaana" class="skt-link">Mahāyāna</a>] np. du <a href="#entry-vajrabodhisattva" class="skt-link">vajrabodhisattva</a> Vajratīkṣṇa aspect de <a href="#entry-Uma_njuzrii" class="skt-link">Mañjuśrī</a> «au glaive adamantin».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vajrayaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vajrayāna</i> [<a href="#entry-yaana" class="skt-link">yāna</a>] <a href="#entry-vajrayaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> bd. «véhicule de diamant», bouddhisme tantrique.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vajrayak_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vajrayakṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-yak_sa" class="skt-link">yakṣa</a>] <a href="#entry-vajrayak_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> bd. [<a href="#entry-Umahaayaana" class="skt-link">Mahāyāna</a>] np. du <a href="#entry-vajrabodhisattva" class="skt-link">vajrabodhisattva</a> Vajrayakṣa «Génie adamantin».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vajrayoginii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vajrayoginī</i> [<a href="#entry-yoginii" class="skt-link">yoginī</a>] <a href="#entry-vajrayoginii" class="skt-link">f.</a> myth. np. de Vajrayoginī, <a href="#entry-yoginii" class="skt-link">yoginī</a> «au foudre»; cf. <a href="#entry-Uvajrezvarii" class="skt-link">Vajreśvarī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vajrayuddha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vajrayuddha</i> [<a href="#entry-yuddha" class="skt-link">yuddha</a>] <a href="#entry-vajrayuddha" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. arme diamant-foudre d'<a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vajrezvarii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vajreśvarī</i> [<a href="#entry-iizvarii" class="skt-link">īśvarī</a>] <a href="#entry-vajrezvarii" class="skt-link">f.</a> bd. np. de la déesse bd. Vajreśvarī <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. forme de <a href="#entry-Udurgaa" class="skt-link">Durgā</a> «au foudre»; son temple principal se trouve à mod. Kangra (Himachal Pradesh); il était très riche, fut pillé par Mahmud de Gazni en 1009 et par Tughluk Shah en 1360, et détruit par un tremblement de terre en 1905; un autre temple se trouve à <a href="#entry-Uvajrezvarii" class="skt-link">Vajreśvarī</a>, sur les bords de la Tansā au <a href="#entry-Umahaaraa_s_tra" class="skt-link">Mahārāṣṭra</a>; c'est un <a href="#entry-zaktipii_tha" class="skt-link">śaktipīṭha</a>, le <a href="#entry-pii_thasthaana" class="skt-link">pīṭhasthāna</a> d'un sein de <a href="#entry-Usatii" class="skt-link">Satī</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vajra" class="skt-link">vajra</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vajrolii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वज्रोली</span> <i>vajrolī</i> [relié à <a href="#entry-vajra" class="skt-link">vajra</a>] <a href="#entry-vajrolii" class="skt-link">f.</a> cf. <a href="#entry-vajroliimudraa" class="skt-link">vajrolīmudrā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vajroliimudraa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vajrolīmudrā</i> [<a href="#entry-mudraa" class="skt-link">mudrā</a>] <a href="#entry-vajroliimudraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-tantra" class="skt-link">tantra</a>] réaspiration du sperme par le pénis.<br> <a href="#entry-vajrolii" class="skt-link">vajrolī</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vak_s">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">वक्ष्</span> <i>vakṣ</i> [relié à <a href="#entry-uk_s" class="skt-link">ukṣ</a>] pft. <i>(vavakṣa)</i> croître, grandir; être fort — ca. <i>(vakṣayati)</i> faire croître, affermir, revigorer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> ang. wax.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vak_sa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वक्षण</span> <i>vakṣaṇa</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vak_s" class="skt-link">vakṣ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vak_sa_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vak_sa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vak_sa_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vakṣaṇī</i> qui revigore, qui rafraîchit — <a href="#entry-vak_sa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> revigorant <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> poitrine; sein — <a href="#entry-vak_sa_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vakṣaṇā</i> estomac; ventre; terrain fertile.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vak_sas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वक्षस्</span> <i>vakṣas</i> [<a href="#entry-vak_s" class="skt-link">vakṣ</a>] <a href="#entry-vak_sas" class="skt-link">n.</a> (sg. et pl.) poitrine, cage thoracique; sein — <a href="#entry-vak_sas" class="skt-link">m.</a> bœuf.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vak_soja">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vakṣoja</i> [<a href="#entry-ja" class="skt-link">ja</a>] <a href="#entry-vak_soja" class="skt-link">m.</a> sein [«né de la poitrine»].<br> <i>vakṣojapānakṛt</i> <i>kāṇa</i> [«petit borgne qui tête encore le sein de sa mère»] insulte du logicien <a href="#entry-Upak_sadhara" class="skt-link">Pakṣadhara</a> envers son élève insolent <a href="#entry-Uraghunaatha_1" class="skt-link">Raghunātha_1</a> <a href="#entry-Uziroma_ni" class="skt-link">Śiromaṇi</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vak_sas" class="skt-link">vakṣas</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vak_su">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वक्षु</span> <i>vakṣu</i> <a href="#entry-vak_su" class="skt-link">m.</a> géo. np. du fleuve Vakṣu (Oxus), qui descend du Pamir à la mer d'Aral; mod. Amou-Daria.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वक</span> <i>vaka</i> cf. <a href="#entry-baka" class="skt-link">baka</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vakaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वकार</span> <i>vakāra</i> [<i>(va)</i>-<a href="#entry-kaara" class="skt-link">kāra</a>] <a href="#entry-vakaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> le son ou la lettre ‘<i>va</i>’.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vakra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वक्र</span> <i>vakra</i> [<a href="#entry-va_nc" class="skt-link">vañc</a><a href="#entry--ra" class="skt-link">-ra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vakra" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vakra" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vakraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vakrā</i> courbe, sinueux, tortueux, tordu; oblique <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> ambigu, déloyal, faux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vakrarekhaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vakrarekhā</i> [<a href="#entry-rekhaa" class="skt-link">rekhā</a>] <a href="#entry-vakrarekhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> math. courbe.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vakrataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vakratā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-vakrataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> curvature; fait d'être tordu ou tortueux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> ambiguité; perversité; fausseté <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. qualité oblique de la poésie, critère esthétique de <a href="#entry-Ukuntaka" class="skt-link">Kuntaka</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vakratu_n_da">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vakratuṇḍa</i> [<a href="#entry-tu_n_da" class="skt-link">tuṇḍa</a>] <a href="#entry-vakratu_n_da" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Vakratuṇḍa, épith. de <a href="#entry-Uga_neza" class="skt-link">Gaṇeśa</a> «à la trompe recourbée».<br> <i>vakratuṇḍa</i> <i>mahākāya</i> <i>sūrya</i> <i>koṭi</i> <i>sama</i> <i>prabhā</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>nirvighnam</i> <i>kuru</i> <i>me</i> <i>deva</i> <i>sarva</i> <i>kāryeṣu</i> <i>sarvadā</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> (invocation à <a href="#entry-Uga_neza" class="skt-link">Gaṇeśa</a> pour le succès d'une entreprise) Seigneur à la trompe recourbée, au corps puissant et à l'éclat de millions de soleils, puisses-tu écarter les obstacles de toutes les actions que j'entreprenne.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vakrokti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vakrokti</i> [<a href="#entry-ukti" class="skt-link">ukti</a>] <a href="#entry-vakrokti" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. [«parole oblique»] langage voilé, métaphorique ou à double entendre, genre poétique [<a href="#entry-kaavya" class="skt-link">kāvya</a>] cryptique <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> charade, rébus, jeux de mot.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vakroktijiivita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vakroktijīvita</i> [<a href="#entry-jiivita" class="skt-link">jīvita</a>] <a href="#entry-vakroktijiivita" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du Vakroktijīvita, ouvrage de poétique de <a href="#entry-Ukuntaka" class="skt-link">Kuntaka</a> cherchant à établir que le genre oblique [<a href="#entry-vakrokti" class="skt-link">vakrokti</a>] est l'essence de la poésie.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vakroktipa_ncaazikaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vakroktipañcāśikā</i> [<a href="#entry-pa_ncaazaka" class="skt-link">pañcāśaka</a>] <a href="#entry-vakroktipa_ncaazikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de la Vakroktipañcāśikā, poème de 50 vers-rébus de <a href="#entry-raajaanaka" class="skt-link">rājānaka</a> <a href="#entry-Uratnaakara_1" class="skt-link">Ratnākara_1</a> formant un dialogue amoureux entre <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> et <a href="#entry-Upaarvatii" class="skt-link">Pārvatī</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vakrokti" class="skt-link">vakrokti</a> <br> <a href="#entry-vakra" class="skt-link">vakra</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vakrolaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वक्रोलक</span> <i>vakrolaka</i> <a href="#entry-vakrolaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de la ville de Vakrolaka, capitale du roi Sūryaprabha.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vakt_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वक्तृ</span> <i>vaktṛ</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vac" class="skt-link">vac</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vakt_r" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vakt_r" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaktrii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaktrī</i> qui parle, qui dit, qui proclame ⟨g.⟩; orateur; éloquent <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> sage; honnête; sincère <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> loquace; bavard — <a href="#entry-vakt_r" class="skt-link">m.</a> orateur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pali <i>vattā</i>.<br> <i>saṃskṛtavaktāraḥ</i> les locuteurs du sanskrit.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaktavya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वक्तव्य</span> <i>vaktavya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">3</span>] <a href="#entry-vac" class="skt-link">vac</a>] <a href="#entry-vaktavya" class="skt-link">n.</a> ce qui doit être dit, ce qu'on a à dire.<br> <i>sarvaiḥ</i> <i>satyaṃ</i> <i>vaktavyam</i> la vérité doit être dite par tous.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vakti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वक्ति</span> <i>vakti</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vac" class="skt-link">vac</a>] <a href="#entry-vakti" class="skt-link">f.</a> parole.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaktra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वक्त्र</span> <i>vaktra</i> [instr. <a href="#entry-vac" class="skt-link">vac</a>] <a href="#entry-vaktra" class="skt-link">n.</a> bouche; visage.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaktraagama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vaktrāgama</i> [<a href="#entry-aagama" class="skt-link">āgama</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaktraagama" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaktraagama" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaktraagamaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaktrāgamā</i> transmis oralement.<br> <i>śivavaktrāgamodita</i> réputé provenir de la bouche même de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vaktra" class="skt-link">vaktra</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaktu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वक्तु</span> <i>vaktu</i> [inf. <a href="#entry-vac" class="skt-link">vac</a>] iic. le dire, la parole.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaktukaama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vaktukāma</i> [<a href="#entry-kaama" class="skt-link">kāma</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaktukaama" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaktukaama" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaktukaamaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaktukāmā</i> qui veut dire, qui veut parler.<br> <a href="#entry-vaktu" class="skt-link">vaktu</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-val">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">वल्</span> <i>val</i> [relié à <a href="#entry-v_r_1" class="skt-link">vṛ_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(valate)</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(valati)</i> pft. <i>(vavale)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>valita</i><i>)</i> se tourner vers, se pencher; être attaché à ⟨loc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> revenir, retourner <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> se manifester <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> recouvrir; être recouvert de — ca. <i>(valayati)</i> faire tourner.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वल</span> <i>vala</i> [<a href="#entry-val" class="skt-link">val</a>] <a href="#entry-vala" class="skt-link">m.</a> cave, caverne <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> véd. [RV.] np. de la caverne Vala, qu'<a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a>, aidé des lumineux [<a href="#entry-afgirasas" class="skt-link">aṅgirasas</a>] et des souffles [<a href="#entry-marutas" class="skt-link">marutas</a>], ouvrit pour libérer l'Aube [<a href="#entry-Uu_saa" class="skt-link">Uṣā</a>] au premier matin du Monde; ses rayons nourriciers étaient confisqués par les démons avares [<a href="#entry-pa_ni" class="skt-link">paṇi</a>] comme leur bétail; cette caverne, découverte par la chienne <a href="#entry-Usaramaa" class="skt-link">Saramā</a>, se trouvait sur une île de la rivière céleste <a href="#entry-Urasaa" class="skt-link">Rasā</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> véd. np. de l'<a href="#entry-asura" class="skt-link">asura</a> <a href="#entry-Uvala" class="skt-link">Vala</a> «Puissant», frère de <a href="#entry-Uv_rtra" class="skt-link">Vṛtra</a>, tué par <a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a> (plus tard appelé <a href="#entry-Ubala" class="skt-link">Bala</a>) — ifc. fort en; cf. <a href="#entry-bala" class="skt-link">bala</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hi. <i>vala</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-valaahaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वलाहक</span> <i>valāhaka</i> cf. <a href="#entry-balaahaka" class="skt-link">balāhaka</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-valaaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वलाक</span> <i>valāka</i> var. <i>balāka</i> <a href="#entry-valaaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> natu. zoo. sorte de héron.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-valava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वलव</span> <i>valava</i> cf. <a href="#entry-balava" class="skt-link">balava</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-valaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वलय</span> <i>valaya</i> [<a href="#entry-vala" class="skt-link">vala</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-valaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> bracelet; cercle.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-valg">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">वल्ग्</span> <i>valg</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(valgati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>valgita</i><i>)</i> remuer les membres, s'agiter; sauter, bondir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-valgaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वल्गा</span> <i>valgā</i> [<a href="#entry-valg" class="skt-link">valg</a>] <a href="#entry-valgaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> bride; rêne.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-valgaafka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>valgāṅka</i> [<a href="#entry-afka" class="skt-link">aṅka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-valgaafka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-valgaafka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-valgaafkaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>valgāṅkā</i> qui tient la bride.<br> <a href="#entry-valgaa" class="skt-link">valgā</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-valgu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वल्गु</span> <i>valgu</i> [<a href="#entry-valg" class="skt-link">valg</a><a href="#entry--u" class="skt-link">-u</a>] a. <a href="#entry-valgu" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-valgu" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-valgu" class="skt-link">f.</a> joli, gracieux; beau, charmant, attirant — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. <i>(valgūyati)</i> devenir gracieux ou gentil; honorer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-valguka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>valguka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-valguka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-valguka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-valgukaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>valgukā</i> joli; agréable — <a href="#entry-valguka" class="skt-link">m.</a> santal — <a href="#entry-valguka" class="skt-link">n.</a> bois de santal.<br> <a href="#entry-valgu" class="skt-link">valgu</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vali">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वलि</span> <i>vali</i> <a href="#entry-vali" class="skt-link">f.</a> pli, ride <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> boucle (de cheveux) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> vague <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> var. <i>valī</i> id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-valii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वली</span> <i>valī</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-vali" class="skt-link">vali</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-valiimukha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>valīmukha</i> [<a href="#entry-mukha" class="skt-link">mukha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-valiimukha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-valiimukha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-valiimukhii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>valīmukhī</i> [«à la face ridée»] singe <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> var. <i>valimukha</i> id.<br> <a href="#entry-valii" class="skt-link">valī</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-valita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वलित</span> <i>valita</i> [<a href="#entry-vali" class="skt-link">vali</a><a href="#entry--ta" class="skt-link">-ta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-valita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-valita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-valitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>valitā</i> plissé, ridé; courbé; bouclé — ifc. connecté avec; accompagné de — <a href="#entry-valita" class="skt-link">n.</a> poivre noir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-valka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वल्क</span> <i>valka</i> <a href="#entry-valka" class="skt-link">m.</a> écorce d'arbre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-valkala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वल्कल</span> <i>valkala</i> [<a href="#entry-valka" class="skt-link">valka</a><a href="#entry--la" class="skt-link">-la</a>] <a href="#entry-valkala" class="skt-link">n.</a> écorce <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> vêtement fait de fibres d'écorce (à l'usage des ascètes).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-valla">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वल्ल</span> <i>valla</i> <a href="#entry-valla" class="skt-link">m.</a> variété de blé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> sa graine, unité de poids (entre 2 et 4 grains [<a href="#entry-yava" class="skt-link">yava</a>]).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vallaala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वल्लाल</span> <i>vallāla</i> <a href="#entry-vallaala" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. de Vallāla, poète de la fin du 16⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle, auteur du <a href="#entry-Ubhojaprabandha" class="skt-link">Bhojaprabandha</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vallaalacarita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vallālacarita</i> [<a href="#entry-carita" class="skt-link">carita</a>] <a href="#entry-vallaalacarita" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Vallālacarita «Vie du roi <a href="#entry-Uvallaalasena" class="skt-link">Vallālasena</a>» d'<a href="#entry-Uaanandabha_t_ta" class="skt-link">Ānandabhaṭṭa</a> (16⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vallaalasena">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vallālasena</i> [<a href="#entry-sena" class="skt-link">sena</a>] <a href="#entry-vallaalasena" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. du roi du Bengale Vallālasena ou Ballālasena, fils de <a href="#entry-Uvijayasena" class="skt-link">Vijayasena</a>; il régna de 1158 à 1178; il institua le système <a href="#entry-kuliina" class="skt-link">kulīna</a> des castes et persécuta le bouddhisme; son fils <a href="#entry-Ulak_sma_nasena" class="skt-link">Lakṣmaṇasena</a> lui succéda; sa vie fut contée dans le <a href="#entry-Uvallaalacarita" class="skt-link">Vallālacarita</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vallaala" class="skt-link">vallāla</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vallabha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वल्लभ</span> <i>vallabha</i> a. <a href="#entry-vallabha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vallabha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vallabhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vallabhā</i> aimé, désiré, préféré; cher à ⟨g. loc. iic.⟩; préféré à ⟨abl.⟩ — <a href="#entry-vallabha" class="skt-link">m.</a> bien-aimé, époux, favori; suprême <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Vallabha, épith. de <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a> «Bien-aimé» <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. de Vallabha_1, fondateur d'une secte vishnouite; cf. <a href="#entry-Uvallabhaacaarya" class="skt-link">Vallabhācārya</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. du logicien Vallabha_2, auteur de la <a href="#entry-Unyaayaliilaavatii" class="skt-link">Nyāyalīlāvatī</a> — <a href="#entry-vallabhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vallabhā</i> épouse, bien-aimée, favorite; maîtresse — <a href="#entry-vallabhii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vallabhī</i> géo. np. de la ville de Vallabhī au Gujarāt.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vallabhaacaarya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vallabhācārya</i> [<a href="#entry-aacaarya" class="skt-link">ācārya</a>] <a href="#entry-vallabhaacaarya" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. de Vallabhācārya «Maître bien-aimé», brâhmane telugu (1479–1531) né à Bénarès; avec <a href="#entry-Ucaitanya" class="skt-link">Caitanya</a> il prêcha la dévotion [<a href="#entry-bhakti" class="skt-link">bhakti</a>] envers <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a> et créa la doctrine du pur monisme [<a href="#entry-zuddhaadvaita" class="skt-link">śuddhādvaita</a>] réalisée par la voie du bien-être [<a href="#entry-pu_s_timaarga" class="skt-link">puṣṭimārga</a>]; il écrivit l'<a href="#entry-Uanubhaa_sya" class="skt-link">Anubhāṣya</a>, commentaire sur le <a href="#entry-Ubrahmasuutra" class="skt-link">Brahmasūtra</a>, et le poème dévotionnel <a href="#entry-Umadhuraa_s_taka" class="skt-link">Madhurāṣṭaka</a>; on le dit réincarnation d'<a href="#entry-Uagni" class="skt-link">Agni</a>; on le célèbre à <a href="#entry-gurudvaadazii" class="skt-link">gurudvādaśī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vallabhadeva">
