  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vastrapuuta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vastrapūta</i> [<a href="#entry-puuta_1" class="skt-link">pūta_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vastrapuuta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vastrapuuta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vastrapuutaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vastrapūtā</i> filtré par un linge.<br> <i>vastrapūtaṃ</i> <i>jalam</i> eau purifiée.<br> <a href="#entry-vastra" class="skt-link">vastra</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vastu_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वस्तु</span> <i>vastu_1</i> [<a href="#entry-vas_1" class="skt-link">vas_1</a><a href="#entry--tu" class="skt-link">-tu</a>] <a href="#entry-vastu_1" class="skt-link">n.</a> biens, richesses <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> chose; matière, substance <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. réalité concrète; fait <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> (au fig.) propriété, nature, caractère <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. sens propre (opp. <a href="#entry-alafkaara" class="skt-link">alaṅkāra</a> sens figuré) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> ce dont il est question; thème; sujet; affaire; contenu factuel <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. intrigue d'un récit; scenario; composition musicale <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> substance, essence de qqc.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vastu_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वस्तु</span> <i>vastu_2</i> [<a href="#entry-vas_4" class="skt-link">vas_4</a><a href="#entry--tu" class="skt-link">-tu</a>] <a href="#entry-vastu_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> aube; matin.<br> <i>vastoḥ</i> le matin.<br> <i>vastor</i> <i>vastoḥ</i> adv. tous les matins.<br> <i>vastor</i> <i>asyāḥ</i> adv. ce matin.<br> <i>prati</i> <i>vastoḥ</i> adv. vers le matin.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vastubheda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vastubheda</i> [<a href="#entry-bheda" class="skt-link">bheda</a>] <a href="#entry-vastubheda" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. changement de thème; rupture d'évènement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vastudharma">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vastudharma</i> [<a href="#entry-dharma" class="skt-link">dharma</a>] <a href="#entry-vastudharma" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. la vraie nature des choses <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. id..
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vastudharmin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vastudharmin</i> [<a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vastudharmin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vastudharmin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vastudharmi_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vastudharmiṇī</i> phil. qui dépend de la nature d'une chose; objectif.<br> <a href="#entry-vastudharma" class="skt-link">vastudharma</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vastudhvani">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vastudhvani</i> [<a href="#entry-dhvani" class="skt-link">dhvani</a>] <a href="#entry-vastudhvani" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. suggestion d'un fait.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vastutas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vastutas</i> [<a href="#entry--tas" class="skt-link">-tas</a>] adv. conformément à la nature des choses <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> en substance, en réalité; en fait; essentiellement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vastuv_rtta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vastuvṛtta</i> [<a href="#entry-v_rtta" class="skt-link">vṛtta</a>] <a href="#entry-vastuv_rtta" class="skt-link">n.</a> les faits (substance de ce qui s'est produit).<br> <a href="#entry-vastu_1" class="skt-link">vastu_1</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vastuvakrataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vastuvakratā</i> [<a href="#entry-vakrataa" class="skt-link">vakratā</a>] <a href="#entry-vastuvakrataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. [<a href="#entry-Ukuntaka" class="skt-link">Kuntaka</a>] qualité oblique des sujets abordés.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vasu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वसु</span> <i>vasu</i> [<a href="#entry-vas_4" class="skt-link">vas_4</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vasu" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vasu" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vasu" class="skt-link">f.</a> bon, excellent [«qui brille»] — <a href="#entry-vasu" class="skt-link">n.</a> bien, richesse, argent, trésor <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> or, joyau, pierrerie <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> objet excellent, bénéfique — <a href="#entry-vasu" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Vasu «le Riche», épith. d'<a href="#entry-Uagni" class="skt-link">Agni</a>; le feu; le Soleil; diverses divinités <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Vasu_1, 3⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ fils de <a href="#entry-Ujamadagni" class="skt-link">Jamadagni</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. de Vasu_2 «l'Excellent» roi du pays <a href="#entry-Ucedi" class="skt-link">Cedi</a>, fils de <a href="#entry-Uk_rtii" class="skt-link">Kṛtī</a>, père de <a href="#entry-Usatyavatii" class="skt-link">Satyavatī</a> et <a href="#entry-Ub_rhadratha" class="skt-link">Bṛhadratha</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Uuparicara" class="skt-link">Uparicara</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] np. du roi Vasu_3, fils de <a href="#entry-Ukuza_1" class="skt-link">Kuśa_1</a>; il fonda la ville de <a href="#entry-Ugirivraja" class="skt-link">Girivraja</a>-<a href="#entry-Uraajag_rha" class="skt-link">Rājagṛha</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>vasavas</i> myth. [<a href="#entry-a_s_tavasu" class="skt-link">aṣṭavasu</a>] le groupe des 8 Trésors naturels, classe de divinités védiques assistant <a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a> dans le ciel des 33 dieux [<a href="#entry-trayastri_mza" class="skt-link">trayastriṃśa</a>]; ils comprennent [BU.]: <a href="#entry-Uagni" class="skt-link">Agni</a> le Feu, <a href="#entry-Up_rthivii" class="skt-link">Pṛthivī</a> la Terre, <a href="#entry-Uvaayu" class="skt-link">Vāyu</a> le Vent, <a href="#entry-Uantarik_sa" class="skt-link">Antarikṣa</a> l'Espace, <a href="#entry-Uaaditya" class="skt-link">Āditya</a> le Soleil, <a href="#entry-Udyau" class="skt-link">Dyau</a> le Ciel-Lumière, <a href="#entry-Ucandra" class="skt-link">Candra</a> le dieu Lune, et <a href="#entry-nak_satraa_ni" class="skt-link">nakṣatrāṇi</a> l'ensemble des constellations ou maisons lunaires; ou bien [VP.]: <a href="#entry-Uaapa" class="skt-link">Āpa</a> l'Eau (ou <a href="#entry-Uahar" class="skt-link">Ahar</a> le Jour), <a href="#entry-Udhruva" class="skt-link">Dhruva</a> le Fixe (Étoile polaire) ou l'Espace, <a href="#entry-Usoma" class="skt-link">Soma</a> le dieu Lune, <a href="#entry-Udhara" class="skt-link">Dhara</a> le sol de la Terre (ou <a href="#entry-Up_rthu" class="skt-link">Pṛthu</a>), <a href="#entry-Uanila" class="skt-link">Anila</a> le Vent, <a href="#entry-Uanala" class="skt-link">Anala</a> le Feu, <a href="#entry-Upratyuu_sa" class="skt-link">Pratyūṣa</a> le Soleil et <a href="#entry-Uprabhaasa" class="skt-link">Prabhāsa</a> la Lumière; ils sont nés de <a href="#entry-Ukazyapa" class="skt-link">Kaśyapa</a> et d'<a href="#entry-Uaditi" class="skt-link">Aditi</a> [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] ou de <a href="#entry-Uprajaapati" class="skt-link">Prajāpati</a> [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>]; les trésors représentent les formes visibles des lois naturelles; astr. ils président le <a href="#entry-nak_satra" class="skt-link">nakṣatra</a> <a href="#entry-Uzravi_s_thaa" class="skt-link">Śraviṣṭhā</a> (β du Dauphin); plus tardivement, ils forment une classe du <a href="#entry-ga_na" class="skt-link">gaṇa</a>; [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] ils visitèrent l'ermitage de <a href="#entry-Uvasi_s_tha" class="skt-link">Vasiṣṭha</a> avec leurs épouses; <a href="#entry-Up_rthivii" class="skt-link">Pṛthivī</a> s'éprit de la vache <a href="#entry-Unandinii" class="skt-link">Nandinī</a>, et demanda à <a href="#entry-Udyau" class="skt-link">Dyau</a> de la voler; <a href="#entry-Uvasi_s_tha" class="skt-link">Vasiṣṭha</a> en retour maudit les <a href="#entry-vasavas" class="skt-link">vasavas</a> de se réincarner en hommes; devant leurs supplications, il leur accorda de ne renaître que très brièvement, sauf celui qui avait volé <a href="#entry-Unandinii" class="skt-link">Nandinī</a>, condamné à une très longue existence; ils se réincarnèrent comme fils de <a href="#entry-Ugafgaadevii" class="skt-link">Gaṅgādevī</a> et du roi <a href="#entry-Uzaantanu" class="skt-link">Śāntanu</a>, tous noyés à leur naissance sauf <a href="#entry-Udevavrata" class="skt-link">Devavrata</a>/<a href="#entry-Ubhii_sma" class="skt-link">Bhīṣma</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> math. symb. le nombre 8.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vasubandhu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vasubandhu</i> [<a href="#entry-bandhu" class="skt-link">bandhu</a>] <a href="#entry-vasubandhu" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. de Vasubandhu, lettré bouddhiste du 5⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle, né d'un père brâhmane de <a href="#entry-Upuru_sapura" class="skt-link">Puruṣapura</a>, de <a href="#entry-gotra" class="skt-link">gotra</a> <a href="#entry-Ukauzika" class="skt-link">Kauśika</a>; il est l'auteur de nombreux ouvrages philosophiques, dont l'<a href="#entry-Uabhidharmakoza" class="skt-link">Abhidharmakośa</a> <a href="#entry-bhaa_sya" class="skt-link">bhāṣya</a>, somme de la doctrine <a href="#entry-Utheravaada" class="skt-link">Theravāda</a>; on lui doit aussi l'ouvrage de grammaire <a href="#entry-Uvyaakhyaayukti" class="skt-link">Vyākhyāyukti</a>; son frère <a href="#entry-Uasafga" class="skt-link">Asaṅga</a> le convertit au bd. <a href="#entry-Umahaayaana" class="skt-link">Mahāyāna</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vasudeva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vasudeva</i> [<a href="#entry-deva" class="skt-link">deva</a>] <a href="#entry-vasudeva" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. de Vasudeva «Divin prolifique», roi de <a href="#entry-Umathuraa" class="skt-link">Mathurā</a> de la lignée lunaire <a href="#entry-yaadava" class="skt-link">yādava</a>, fils de <a href="#entry-Uzuura" class="skt-link">Śūra</a>, frère de <a href="#entry-Ukuntii" class="skt-link">Kuntī</a>; sa naissance fut saluée par un roulement de tambour céleste [<a href="#entry-Uaanakadundubhi" class="skt-link">Ānakadundubhi</a>]; il incarne <a href="#entry-Ukazyapa" class="skt-link">Kaśyapa</a> revenu sur Terre par une malédiction de <a href="#entry-Uvaru_na" class="skt-link">Varuṇa</a>; emprisonné par le tyran <a href="#entry-Uka_msa" class="skt-link">Kaṃsa</a>, il eut 8 fils de sa femme <a href="#entry-Udevakii" class="skt-link">Devakī</a>, dont <a href="#entry-Ubalaraama" class="skt-link">Balarāma</a> et <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a>, les précédents ayant été tués à leur naissance sur l'ordre de <a href="#entry-Uka_msa" class="skt-link">Kaṃsa</a>; ses autres épouses sont <a href="#entry-Urohi_nii_3" class="skt-link">Rohiṇī_3</a> et <a href="#entry-Uvaizalii" class="skt-link">Vaiśalī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vasudhaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vasudhā</i> [<a href="#entry-dhaa_3" class="skt-link">dhā_3</a>] <a href="#entry-vasudhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> la Terre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> la terre, le sol; le royaume.<br> <i>vasudhaiva</i> <i>kuṭumbakam</i> [<a href="#entry-Uhitopadeza" class="skt-link">Hitopadeśa</a>] La Terre est notre foyer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vasudharaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vasudharā</i> [<a href="#entry-dharaa" class="skt-link">dharā</a>] <a href="#entry-vasudharaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> bd. np. de la déesse Vasudharā «qui apporte la richesse».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vasugupta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vasugupta</i> [<a href="#entry-gupta" class="skt-link">gupta</a>] <a href="#entry-vasugupta" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. du phil. <a href="#entry-trika" class="skt-link">trika</a> Vasugupta (<a href="#entry-Ukazmiira" class="skt-link">Kaśmīra</a>, fin du 8⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle); il reçut de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> en rêve la révélation du <a href="#entry-Uzivasuutra" class="skt-link">Śivasūtra</a>; son élève <a href="#entry-Ukalla_ta" class="skt-link">Kallaṭa</a> en écrivit les <a href="#entry-Uspandakaarikaas" class="skt-link">Spandakārikās</a>, qui exposent la doctrine <a href="#entry-pratyabhij_naadarzana" class="skt-link">pratyabhijñādarśana</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vasum">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वसुम्</span> <i>vasum</i> [acc. <a href="#entry-vasu" class="skt-link">vasu</a>] iic.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vasumanas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vasumanas</i> [<a href="#entry-manas" class="skt-link">manas</a>] <a href="#entry-vasumanas" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Vasumanā, roi d'<a href="#entry-Uayodhyaa" class="skt-link">Ayodhyā</a> de la lignée solaire, fils de <a href="#entry-Uharyazva" class="skt-link">Haryaśva</a> et de <a href="#entry-Umaadhavii" class="skt-link">Mādhavī</a>; il est père de <a href="#entry-Utridhanvaa" class="skt-link">Tridhanvā</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vasu" class="skt-link">vasu</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vasumatii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vasumatī</i> [<a href="#entry--mat" class="skt-link">-mat</a>] <a href="#entry-vasumatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. [DKC.] np. de Vasumatī «Riche comme la Terre», épouse du roi <a href="#entry-Uraajaha_msa" class="skt-link">Rājahaṃsa</a>; elle recueillit <a href="#entry-Uarthapaala" class="skt-link">Arthapāla</a> pour servir de camarade à son fils <a href="#entry-Uraajavaahana" class="skt-link">Rājavāhana</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vasundhara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vasuṃdhara</i> [<a href="#entry-dhara" class="skt-link">dhara</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vasu_mdhara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vasu_mdhara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vasu_mdharaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vasuṃdharā</i> généreux, prolifique — <a href="#entry-vasu_mdharaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vasuṃdharā</i> la Terre [«qui porte des trésors»] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> la terre, le sol; le royaume.<br> <a href="#entry-vasum" class="skt-link">vasum</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vasunemi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vasunemi</i> [<a href="#entry-nemi" class="skt-link">nemi</a>] <a href="#entry-vasunemi" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. du <a href="#entry-naaga" class="skt-link">nāga</a> Vasunemi «Roue de la fortune»; sauvé d'un chasseur par le roi <a href="#entry-Uudayana" class="skt-link">Udayana</a>, il lui fit visiter la cité sous-marine <a href="#entry-Ubhogavatii" class="skt-link">Bhogavatī</a>, et lui donna la <a href="#entry-vii_naa" class="skt-link">vīṇā</a> magique <a href="#entry-Ugho_savatii" class="skt-link">Ghoṣavatī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vasupuujya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vasupūjya</i> [<a href="#entry-puujya" class="skt-link">pūjya</a>] <a href="#entry-vasupuujya" class="skt-link">m.</a> jn. np. du roi mythique Vasupūjya «Joyau vénérable».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vatsa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वत्स</span> <i>vatsa</i> <a href="#entry-vatsa" class="skt-link">m.</a> veau, jeune animal <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> [<i>vatsabhūmi</i>] nom du pays Vatsa, dans la vallée inférieure de la <a href="#entry-Uyamunaa" class="skt-link">Yamunā</a>, de capitale <a href="#entry-Ukauzaambii" class="skt-link">Kauśāmbī</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Vatsa_1, fils du roi <a href="#entry-Upratardana" class="skt-link">Pratardana</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>vatsās</i> les habitants du pays <a href="#entry-Uvatsa" class="skt-link">Vatsa</a>; ses princes — voc. adr. mon enfant, mon fils, mon chéri — <a href="#entry-vatsaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vatsā</i> génisse, jeune femelle <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> chère — voc. <i>vatse</i> adr. ma fille, ma chérie.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vatsaasura">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vatsāsura</i> [<a href="#entry-asura" class="skt-link">asura</a>] <a href="#entry-vatsaasura" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. du démon-veau Vatsāsura; il s'était glissé, déguisé en veau par ruse, dans le troupeau que <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a> et <a href="#entry-Ubalaraama" class="skt-link">Balarāma</a> enfants gardaient à <a href="#entry-Uv_rndaavana" class="skt-link">Vṛndāvana</a>; <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a> le remarqua et le tua; pour expier ce crime de <a href="#entry-goghaata" class="skt-link">goghāta</a>, il se purifia dans les eaux du <a href="#entry-Umanasigafgaaku_n_da" class="skt-link">Manasigaṅgākuṇḍa</a>, où il convoqua le Gange par la pensée.<br> <a href="#entry-vatsa" class="skt-link">vatsa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vatsabhuumi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vatsabhūmi</i> [<a href="#entry-bhuumi" class="skt-link">bhūmi</a>] <a href="#entry-vatsabhuumi" class="skt-link">f.</a> géo. pays des <a href="#entry-vatsaas" class="skt-link">vatsās</a>, de capitale <a href="#entry-Ukauzaambii" class="skt-link">Kauśāmbī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vatsala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वत्सल</span> <i>vatsala</i> [<a href="#entry-vatsa" class="skt-link">vatsa</a><a href="#entry--la" class="skt-link">-la</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vatsala" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vatsala" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vatsalaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vatsalā</i> tendre envers ses enfants, affectueux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vatsara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वत्सर</span> <i>vatsara</i> [<a href="#entry-vatsa" class="skt-link">vatsa</a><a href="#entry--ra" class="skt-link">-ra</a>] <a href="#entry-vatsara" class="skt-link">m.</a> année d'un cycle de 5 ans; année en gén.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vatsatara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vatsatara</i> [<a href="#entry--tara" class="skt-link">-tara</a>] <a href="#entry-vatsatara" class="skt-link">m.</a> jeune bovin — <a href="#entry-vatsatarii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vatsatarī</i> jeune vache.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vatuula">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वतूल</span> <i>vatūla</i> cf. <a href="#entry-vaatula" class="skt-link">vātula</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वव</span> <i>vava</i> cf. <a href="#entry-bava" class="skt-link">bava</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vayam">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वयम्</span> <i>vayam</i> [nom. pl. <a href="#entry-aham" class="skt-link">aham</a>] ind. nous.<br> <i>vayaṃvayam</i> [red.] nous-même.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vayas_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वयस्</span> <i>vayas_1</i> [<a href="#entry-vii_1" class="skt-link">vī_1</a>] <a href="#entry-vayas_1" class="skt-link">n.</a> vigueur, jeunesse <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> âge.<br> <i>prathamavayasi</i> adv. dans l'enfance.<br> <i>tasmin</i> <i>vayasi</i> adv. à cet âge.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vayas_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वयस्</span> <i>vayas_2</i> [<a href="#entry-vi_1" class="skt-link">vi_1</a>] <a href="#entry-vayas_2" class="skt-link">n.</a> gent ailée; nuée d'oiseaux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vayasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वयस</span> <i>vayasa</i> [<a href="#entry-vayas_2" class="skt-link">vayas_2</a>] <a href="#entry-vayasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> oiseau.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vayasya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वयस्य</span> <i>vayasya</i> [<a href="#entry-vayas_1" class="skt-link">vayas_1</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-vayasya" class="skt-link">m.</a> compagnon, camarade, ami (d'enfance ou du même âge) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Vayasya «Copain», fils d'<a href="#entry-Uafgiraa" class="skt-link">Aṅgirā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vayov_rddha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vayovṛddha</i> [<a href="#entry-v_rddha" class="skt-link">vṛddha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vayov_rddha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vayov_rddha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vayov_rddhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vayovṛddhā</i> avancé en âge, âgé; vieux.<br> <a href="#entry-vayas_1" class="skt-link">vayas_1</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vayuna">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वयुन</span> <i>vayuna</i> [<a href="#entry-vii_1" class="skt-link">vī_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vayuna" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vayuna" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vayunaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vayunā</i> rapide, mobile, vif; agité, houleux — <a href="#entry-vayuna" class="skt-link">m.</a> chemin; règle, ordonnance; agencement rituel — <a href="#entry-vayunaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vayunā</i> marque; but; connaissance, sagesse.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaz">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">वश्</span> <i>vaś</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(vaṣṭi)</i> être favorable à; désirer, vouloir, souhaiter <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> imposer sa volonté, commander; affirmer, statuer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gr. εκων; ang. to wish.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वश</span> <i>vaśa</i> [<a href="#entry-vaz" class="skt-link">vaś</a>] <a href="#entry-vaza" class="skt-link">m.</a> volonté, désir <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> ordre, autorité, pouvoir, empire — a. <a href="#entry-vaza" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaza" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vazaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaśā</i> soumis, obéissant; dépendant de, sous le pouvoir de ⟨g. iic.⟩.<br> <i>vaśāt</i> par la volonté, par l'effet de.<br> <i>vaśīkṛ</i> soumettre à sa volonté, subjuguer.<br> <i>vaśe</i> <i>kṛ</i> id.<br> <i>vaśaṃ</i> <i>nī</i> id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vazaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वशा</span> <i>vaśā</i> [<a href="#entry-vaaz" class="skt-link">vāś</a>] <a href="#entry-vazaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> vache (stérile ou n'ayant pas encore vêlé) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> femelle d'animal; femme <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> fr. vache.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vazaga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वशग</span> <i>vaśaga</i> [<a href="#entry-vaza" class="skt-link">vaśa</a>-<a href="#entry-ga_1" class="skt-link">ga_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vazaga" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vazaga" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vazagaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaśagā</i> soumis à la volonté de, dépendant de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vazi_s_tha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वशिष्ठ</span> <i>vaśiṣṭha</i> cf. <a href="#entry-vasi_s_tha" class="skt-link">vasiṣṭha</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vazi_s_thii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वशिष्ठी</span> <i>vaśiṣṭhī</i> [f. <a href="#entry-vazi_s_tha" class="skt-link">vaśiṣṭha</a>] <a href="#entry-vazi_s_thii" class="skt-link">f.</a> nom de femme <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. not. np. d'une épouse de l'empereur <a href="#entry-Uzaalivaahana" class="skt-link">Śālivāhana</a>, mère des princes Śrīpulamāvi et <a href="#entry-Uzaatakar_nii" class="skt-link">Śātakarṇī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vazi_s_thiiputra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vaśiṣṭhīputra</i> [<a href="#entry-putra" class="skt-link">putra</a>] <a href="#entry-vazi_s_thiiputra" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. matr. de Vasiṣṭhīputra_1 Śrīpulamāvi, fils de l'empereur <a href="#entry-Uzaalivaahana" class="skt-link">Śālivāhana</a>, auquel il succéda en 102 comme roi de la lignée des <a href="#entry-Usaatavaahanaas" class="skt-link">Sātavāhanās</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. son frère cadet Vasiṣṭhīputra_2 <a href="#entry-Uzaatakar_nii" class="skt-link">Śātakarṇī</a>, qui lui succéda en 130.<br> <a href="#entry-vazi_s_thii" class="skt-link">vaśiṣṭhī</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vazii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वशी</span> <i>vaśī</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-vaza" class="skt-link">vaśa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaziik_rta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vaśīkṛta</i> [<a href="#entry-k_rta" class="skt-link">kṛta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vaziik_rta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vaziik_rta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vaziik_rtaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaśīkṛtā</i> dépendant; sous l'influence de — <a href="#entry-vaziik_rtaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaśīkṛtā</i> soumission, dépendance; fait d'être sous l'emprise ou le pouvoir de; envoûtement.<br> <a href="#entry-vazii" class="skt-link">vaśī</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaziikaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vaśīkāra</i> [<a href="#entry-kaara" class="skt-link">kāra</a>] <a href="#entry-vaziikaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vaziikara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vaśīkaraṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-kara_na" class="skt-link">karaṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-vaziikara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. [tantr.] subjugation (par <a href="#entry-mantra" class="skt-link">mantra</a> ou <a href="#entry-yantra" class="skt-link">yantra</a>).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vazin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वशिन्</span> <i>vaśin</i> [<a href="#entry-vaza" class="skt-link">vaśa</a><a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vazin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vazin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vazinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaśinī</i> maître de soi.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vazitaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वशिता</span> <i>vaśitā</i> [<a href="#entry-vaz" class="skt-link">vaś</a><a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-vazitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>] la volonté irrésistible, ou pouvoir d'imposer sa volonté à autrui, un <a href="#entry-a_s_tasiddhi" class="skt-link">aṣṭasiddhi</a>; ce pouvoir permet de dompter les bêtes sauvages, mais aussi de soumettre à sa volonté le ciel ou l'eau.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vazitva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वशित्व</span> <i>vaśitva</i> [<a href="#entry-vaz" class="skt-link">vaś</a><a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-vazitva" class="skt-link">n.</a> la maîtrise de soi <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> le pouvoir de subjuguer autrui; cf. <a href="#entry-vazitaa" class="skt-link">vaśitā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vazya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वश्य</span> <i>vaśya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-vaz" class="skt-link">vaś</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vazya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vazya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vazyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaśyā</i> qui doit être subjugué, à dompter <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soumis, docile; au pouvoir de, au service de ⟨g. iic.⟩ — <a href="#entry-vazya" class="skt-link">m.</a> serviteur; esclave — <a href="#entry-vazyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vaśyā</i> épouse, femme docile <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. pouvoir magique de soumettre à sa volonté; rite de subjugation.<br> <i>yam</i> <i>brāhmaṇam</i> <i>devī</i> <i>vāg</i> <i>vaśyaiva</i> <i>anuvartate</i> [<a href="#entry-Ubhavabhuuti" class="skt-link">Bhavabhūti</a>] Ce brâhmane que la déesse de la parole suit partout comme une servante.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-va_nc">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">वञ्च्</span> <i>vañc</i> [relié à <a href="#entry-a_nc" class="skt-link">añc</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vañcati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vañcita</i><i>)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>vaṅkya</i>, <i>vañcya</i><i>)</i> marcher de travers; chanceler, tituber — ca. <i>(vañcayati)</i> tromper <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>vacillo</i>; fr. vaciller.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-va_ncana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वञ्चन</span> <i>vañcana</i> [act. <a href="#entry-va_nc" class="skt-link">vañc</a>] <a href="#entry-va_ncana" class="skt-link">n.</a> tromperie, déception <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> illusion, hallucination — <a href="#entry-va_ncanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vañcanā</i> id.<br> <i>vañcanāṃ</i> <i>kṛ</i> tricher, tromper.<br> <i>vañcanāṃ</i> <i>labh</i> être abusé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-va_ncita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वञ्चित</span> <i>vañcita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-va_nc" class="skt-link">vañc</a>] a. <a href="#entry-va_ncita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-va_ncita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-va_ncitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vañcitā</i> trompé, déçu; qui manque (le but ⟨i.⟩).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ve_ni">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेणि</span> <i>veṇi</i> <a href="#entry-ve_ni" class="skt-link">f.</a> tresse, natte <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. not. natte de la veuve <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> confluence de deux rivières <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> var. <i>veṇī</i> tresse, chevelure en nattes <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> courant, ruisseau.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ve_niisa_mhaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>veṇīsaṃhāra</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_mhaara" class="skt-link">saṃhāra</a>] <a href="#entry-ve_niisa_mhaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du Veṇīsaṃhāra, drame de <a href="#entry-Ubha_t_tanaaraaya_na" class="skt-link">Bhaṭṭanārāyaṇa</a>, qui évoque l'épisode du <a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a> où <a href="#entry-Udu_hzaasana" class="skt-link">Duḥśāsana</a> insulte <a href="#entry-Udraupadii" class="skt-link">Draupadī</a> en défaisant ses nattes [<a href="#entry-ve_niisa_mhaara" class="skt-link">veṇīsaṃhāra</a>] et en la traînant par ses cheveux défaits, incitant <a href="#entry-Ubhiima" class="skt-link">Bhīma</a> à jurer de la venger en buvant son sang.<br> <a href="#entry-ve_ni" class="skt-link">veṇi</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ve_nu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेणु</span> <i>veṇu</i> [relié à <a href="#entry-vetra" class="skt-link">vetra</a>] <a href="#entry-ve_nu" class="skt-link">m.</a> roseau, bambou; pipeau, flûte traversière.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ve_nuda_n_da">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>veṇudaṇḍa</i> [<a href="#entry-da_n_da" class="skt-link">daṇḍa</a>] <a href="#entry-ve_nuda_n_da" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. bâton de bambou, planté en terre pour célébrer le festival d'<a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a> [<a href="#entry-indrotsava" class="skt-link">indrotsava</a>], institué par le roi <a href="#entry-Uuparicara" class="skt-link">Uparicara</a> <a href="#entry-Uvasu_2" class="skt-link">Vasu_2</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-ve_nu" class="skt-link">veṇu</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ve_nugopaala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>veṇugopāla</i> [<a href="#entry-gopaala" class="skt-link">gopāla</a>] <a href="#entry-ve_nugopaala" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a> adolescent jouant de la flûte (pour ravir les bouvières [<a href="#entry-gopii" class="skt-link">gopī</a>]).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ve_s_t">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेष्ट्</span> <i>veṣṭ</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(veṣṭate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>veṣṭita</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>pari</i><i>)</i> enrouler; muer (serpent) — ca. <i>(veṣṭayati)</i> envelopper, entourer, couvrir; enrouler (not. turban).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ve_s_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेष्ट</span> <i>veṣṭa</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-ve_s_t" class="skt-link">veṣṭ</a>] <a href="#entry-ve_s_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> enclos, enveloppe <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> nœud coulant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ve_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेष</span> <i>veṣa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vi_s_1" class="skt-link">viṣ_1</a>] <a href="#entry-ve_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> travail, activité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> costume, tenue; aspect.<br> <i>veṣaṃ</i> <i>kṛ</i> revêtir un costume; not. prendre l'habit (orange) d'un renonçant [<a href="#entry-sannyaasin" class="skt-link">sannyāsin</a>].<br> <i>veṣaṃ</i> <i>dhā</i> se déguiser, prendre l'air de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ve_sa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेषण</span> <i>veṣaṇa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vi_s_1" class="skt-link">viṣ_1</a>] <a href="#entry-ve_sa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> service, fonction — <a href="#entry-ve_sa_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>veṣaṇā</i> id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ve_sya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेष्य</span> <i>veṣya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-vi_s_1" class="skt-link">viṣ_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ve_sya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ve_sya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-ve_syaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>veṣyā</i> costumé, déguisé; grimé (not. comme un acteur).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ve_t">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेट्</span> <i>veṭ</i> [<a href="#entry-vaa_1" class="skt-link">vā_1</a>-<a href="#entry-i_t" class="skt-link">iṭ</a>] nota. gram. se dit des racines admettant un ‘<i>i</i>’ intercalaire optionnel.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ved">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेद्</span> <i>ved</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-vid_1" class="skt-link">vid_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(vedayati)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>vedayitavya</i><i>)</i> informer qqn. ⟨dat.⟩ de ⟨acc.⟩; faire savoir, proclamer; montrer, communiquer ⟨acc.⟩ (à qqc. ⟨dat.⟩); apprendre qqc. à qqn. ⟨2 acc.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-veda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेद</span> <i>veda</i> [obj. <a href="#entry-vid_1" class="skt-link">vid_1</a>] <a href="#entry-veda" class="skt-link">m.</a> connaissance, science; parole sacrée, connaissance révélée <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. le Veda ou «Savoir», ensemble de textes sacrés comprenant le <a href="#entry-U_rgveda" class="skt-link">Ṛgveda</a>, le <a href="#entry-Usaamaveda" class="skt-link">Sāmaveda</a>, les deux <a href="#entry-Uyajurveda" class="skt-link">Yajurveda</a> et l'<a href="#entry-Uatharvaveda" class="skt-link">Atharvaveda</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> math. symb. le nombre quatre — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. <i>(vedāpayati)</i> faire connaître.<br> <i>trayo</i> <i>vedā</i> <i>etaiva</i> <i>vāg</i> <i>evargvedaḥ</i> <i>mano</i> <i>yajurvedaḥ</i> <i>prāṇaḥ</i> <i>sāmavedaḥ</i> [BU.] Il y a trois Védas: le <a href="#entry-U_rgveda" class="skt-link">Ṛgveda</a> est parole, le <a href="#entry-Uyajurveda" class="skt-link">Yajurveda</a> est esprit et le <a href="#entry-Usaamaveda" class="skt-link">Sāmaveda</a> est souffle.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-veda_sa_dafga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vedaṣaḍaṅga</i> [<a href="#entry-_sa_dafga" class="skt-link">ṣaḍaṅga</a>] <a href="#entry-veda_sa_dafga" class="skt-link">n.</a> cf. <a href="#entry-vedaafga" class="skt-link">vedāṅga</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vedaadhikaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vedādhikāra</i> [<a href="#entry-adhikaara" class="skt-link">adhikāra</a>] <a href="#entry-vedaadhikaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> autorité du <a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vedaadhyaapaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vedādhyāpaka</i> [<a href="#entry-adhyaapaka" class="skt-link">adhyāpaka</a>] <a href="#entry-vedaadhyaapaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. enseignant du <a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vedaadhyaapana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vedādhyāpana</i> [<a href="#entry-adhyaapana" class="skt-link">adhyāpana</a>] <a href="#entry-vedaadhyaapana" class="skt-link">n.</a> soc. enseignement du <a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a>, l'un des 6 devoirs d'un brâhmane [<a href="#entry-_sa_tkarmaani" class="skt-link">ṣaṭkarmāni</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vedaadhyaaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vedādhyāya</i> [<a href="#entry-adhyaaya" class="skt-link">adhyāya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vedaadhyaaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vedaadhyaaya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vedaadhyaayii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vedādhyāyī</i> qui récite le <a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a>; récitant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vedaadhyayana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vedādhyayana</i> [<a href="#entry-adhyayana" class="skt-link">adhyayana</a>] <a href="#entry-vedaadhyayana" class="skt-link">n.</a> soc. lecture, étude personnelle du <a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a>, l'un des 6 devoirs d'un brâhmane [<a href="#entry-_sa_tkarmaani" class="skt-link">ṣaṭkarmāni</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vedaafga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vedāṅga</i> [<a href="#entry-afga_1" class="skt-link">aṅga_1</a>] <a href="#entry-vedaafga" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. [«appendice du <a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a>»] discipline annexe du <a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a>; on en compte 6 [<a href="#entry-veda_sa_dafga" class="skt-link">vedaṣaḍaṅga</a>]: la phonétique [<a href="#entry-zik_saa" class="skt-link">śikṣā</a>], le rituel [<a href="#entry-kalpa" class="skt-link">kalpa</a>], la grammaire [<a href="#entry-vyaakara_na" class="skt-link">vyākaraṇa</a>], l'herméneutique [<a href="#entry-nirukta" class="skt-link">nirukta</a>], la métri­que-prosodie des hymnes [<a href="#entry-chandas" class="skt-link">chandas</a>] et l'astronomie-astrologie [<a href="#entry-jyoti_sa" class="skt-link">jyotiṣa</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vedaafgajyoti_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vedāṅgajyotiṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-jyoti_sa" class="skt-link">jyotiṣa</a>] <a href="#entry-vedaafgajyoti_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> astr. np. du Vedāṅgajyotiṣa, très ancien traité astronomique, dû à <a href="#entry-Ulagadha" class="skt-link">Lagadha</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vedaafga" class="skt-link">vedāṅga</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vedaanta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vedānta</i> [<a href="#entry-anta" class="skt-link">anta</a>] <a href="#entry-vedaanta" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. «culmination du <a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a>», l'un des 6 points de vue [<a href="#entry-_sa_ddarzana" class="skt-link">ṣaḍdarśana</a>] de l'Hindouisme orthodoxe, doctrine attribuée à <a href="#entry-Uvyaasa" class="skt-link">Vyāsa</a>, développée dans les leçons [<a href="#entry-upani_sad" class="skt-link">upaniṣad</a>] et par <a href="#entry-Uzafkaraacaarya" class="skt-link">Śaṅkarācārya</a>; il traite de la métaphysique de non-dualité [<a href="#entry-advaita" class="skt-link">advaita</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vedaantadezika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vedāntadeśika</i> [<a href="#entry-dezika" class="skt-link">deśika</a>] <a href="#entry-vedaantadezika" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du poète et philosophe <a href="#entry-vai_s_nava" class="skt-link">vaiṣṇava</a> Vedāntadeśika (13⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle); successeur de <a href="#entry-Uraamaanuja" class="skt-link">Rāmānuja</a>, il vécut à <a href="#entry-Uzriirafga" class="skt-link">Śrīraṅga</a>; on lui doit deux œuvres philosophiques sur la tradition <a href="#entry-pa_ncaraatra" class="skt-link">pañcarātra</a>: la Pañcarātrarakṣā et la Saccaritrarakṣā; sa Tattvaṭīkā est un commentaire du Śrībhāṣya de <a href="#entry-Uraamaanuja" class="skt-link">Rāmānuja</a>, sa <a href="#entry-Utaatparyacandrikaa" class="skt-link">Tātparyacandrikā</a> est un commentaire de la <a href="#entry-Ugiitaa" class="skt-link">Gītā</a>; sa Seśvaramīmāṃsā unifie le point de vue <a href="#entry-miimaa_msaa" class="skt-link">mīmāṃsā</a>; on lui doit de nombreuses autres œuvres, comme le Haṃsasaṃdeśa et le <a href="#entry-Unyaayasiddhaantajana" class="skt-link">Nyāyasiddhāntajana</a>; il composa un poème en 64 syllabes dont les 32 dernières, lues suivant le parcours d'un cavalier aux échecs, reproduisent les 32 premières; on l'appelle aussi <a href="#entry-Uvefka_tanaatha" class="skt-link">Veṅkaṭanātha</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vedaantadiipa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vedāntadīpa</i> [<a href="#entry-diipa" class="skt-link">dīpa</a>] <a href="#entry-vedaantadiipa" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du Vedāntadīpa de <a href="#entry-Uraamaanujaacaarya" class="skt-link">Rāmānujācārya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vedaantaparibhaa_saa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vedāntaparibhāṣā</i> [<a href="#entry-paribhaa_saa" class="skt-link">paribhāṣā</a>] <a href="#entry-vedaantaparibhaa_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de la Vedāntaparibhāṣā.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vedaantasaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vedāntasāra</i> [<a href="#entry-saara" class="skt-link">sāra</a>] <a href="#entry-vedaantasaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du Vedāntasāra_1 «Essence du <a href="#entry-vedaanta" class="skt-link">vedānta</a>», ouvrage de <a href="#entry-Uraamaanuja" class="skt-link">Rāmānuja</a> expliquant la doctrine <a href="#entry-vizi_s_taadvaita" class="skt-link">viśiṣṭādvaita</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. np. du Vedāntasāra_2, ouvrage de <a href="#entry-Usadaananda" class="skt-link">Sadānanda</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vedaantasuutra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vedāntasūtra</i> [<a href="#entry-suutra" class="skt-link">sūtra</a>] <a href="#entry-vedaantasuutra" class="skt-link">n.</a> pl. lit. np. des recueils de Vedāntasūtra; cf. <a href="#entry-Ubrahmasuutra" class="skt-link">Brahmasūtra</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vedaanta" class="skt-link">vedānta</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vedaantin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेदान्तिन्</span> <i>vedāntin</i> [<a href="#entry-vedaanta" class="skt-link">vedānta</a><a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>] <a href="#entry-vedaantin" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. adepte du <a href="#entry-vedaanta" class="skt-link">vedānta</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vedaartha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vedārtha</i> [<a href="#entry-artha" class="skt-link">artha</a>] <a href="#entry-vedaartha" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. signification du <a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vedaarthaprakaaza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vedārthaprakāśa</i> [<a href="#entry-prakaaza" class="skt-link">prakāśa</a>] <a href="#entry-vedaarthaprakaaza" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du Vedārthaprakāśa «Explication du sens du <a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a>», commentaire de <a href="#entry-Usaaya_na" class="skt-link">Sāyaṇa</a> sur le <a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vedaarthasafgraha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vedārthasaṃgraha</i> [<a href="#entry-safgraha" class="skt-link">saṃgraha</a>] <a href="#entry-vedaarthasa_mgraha" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du Vedārthasaṃgraha de <a href="#entry-Uraamaanuja" class="skt-link">Rāmānuja</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vedaartha" class="skt-link">vedārtha</a> <br> <a href="#entry-veda" class="skt-link">veda</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vedaarthavid">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vedārthavid</i> [<a href="#entry-vid_1" class="skt-link">vid_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vedaarthavid" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vedaarthavid" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vedaarthavid" class="skt-link">f.</a> qui connaît le sens du <a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vedabaahya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vedabāhya</i> [<a href="#entry-baahya" class="skt-link">bāhya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vedabaahya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vedabaahya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vedabaahyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vedabāhyā</i> soc. hors de la tradition védique; non orthodoxe, hérétique.<br> <i>vedabāhyavrataliṅgadhārin</i> qui porte les signes extérieurs d'un hérétique.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vedabaahyatara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vedabāhyatara</i> [<a href="#entry--tara" class="skt-link">-tara</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vedabaahyatara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vedabaahyatara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vedabaahyataraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vedabāhyatarā</i> compar. soc. exclu de l'orthodoxie brâhmanique.<br> <a href="#entry-vedabaahya" class="skt-link">vedabāhya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vedadiipa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vedadīpa</i> [<a href="#entry-diipa" class="skt-link">dīpa</a>] <a href="#entry-vedadiipa" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du Vedadīpa de Mahīdhara.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vedaj_naana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vedajñāna</i> [<a href="#entry-j_naana" class="skt-link">jñāna</a>] <a href="#entry-vedaj_naana" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. de Vedajñāna, théologien shivaïte du 16⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle, auteur du <a href="#entry-Udiik_saadarza" class="skt-link">Dīkṣādarśa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vedaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेदक</span> <i>vedaka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vid_1" class="skt-link">vid_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vedaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vedaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vedikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vedikā</i> qui annonce, qui proclame.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vedana_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेदन</span> <i>vedana_1</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vid_1" class="skt-link">vid_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vedana_1" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vedana_1" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vedanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vedanā</i> qui annonce, qui proclame — <a href="#entry-vedana_1" class="skt-link">n.</a> perception, connaissance <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> proclamation — f. cf. <a href="#entry-vedanaa" class="skt-link">vedanā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vedana_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेदन</span> <i>vedana_2</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vid_2" class="skt-link">vid_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vedana_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vedana_2" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vedanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vedanā</i> qui trouve; qui se procure — <a href="#entry-vedana_2" class="skt-link">n.</a> fait de trouver, découverte; rencontre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. mariage (not. d'une femme de classe <a href="#entry-zuudra" class="skt-link">śūdra</a> avec un homme de classe <a href="#entry-dvija" class="skt-link">dvija</a>).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vedanaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेदना</span> <i>vedanā</i> [f. <a href="#entry-vedana_1" class="skt-link">vedana_1</a>] <a href="#entry-vedanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> douleur; torture; agonie <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Vedanā, la Douleur personnifiée, fille d'<a href="#entry-Uan_rta" class="skt-link">Anṛta</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bd. la sensation, un des 5 agrégats [<a href="#entry-skandha" class="skt-link">skandha</a>] de l'ego; c'est la 7⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ cause de souffrance [<a href="#entry-pratiityasamutpaada" class="skt-link">pratītyasamutpāda</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vedaniiya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेदनीय</span> <i>vedanīya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] <a href="#entry-vid_1" class="skt-link">vid_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vedaniiya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vedaniiya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vedaniiyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vedanīyā</i> ifc. qui doit être compris comme; qui doit être exprimé par; qui doit être ressenti comme <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> à connaître; à faire connaître.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vedapriya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vedapriya</i> [<a href="#entry-priya" class="skt-link">priya</a>] <a href="#entry-vedapriya" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. du pieux brâhmane Vedapriya, qui vivait avec ses 4 fils à l'ermitage de <a href="#entry-Usaandiipani" class="skt-link">Sāndīpani</a>; ils étaient persécutés par l'<a href="#entry-asura" class="skt-link">asura</a> <a href="#entry-Uduu_sa_na_1" class="skt-link">Dūṣaṇa_1</a>; ils établirent un <a href="#entry-lifga" class="skt-link">liṅga</a> de terre [<a href="#entry-paarthiva" class="skt-link">pārthiva</a>]; <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>-<a href="#entry-Umahaakaala" class="skt-link">Mahākāla</a> en surgit pour tuer le démon; cf. <a href="#entry-Umahaakaalezvara" class="skt-link">Mahākāleśvara</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vedas_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेदस्</span> <i>vedas_1</i> [obj. <a href="#entry-vid_1" class="skt-link">vid_1</a>] <a href="#entry-vedas_1" class="skt-link">n.</a> véd. science, connaissance.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vedas_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेदस्</span> <i>vedas_2</i> [obj. <a href="#entry-vid_2" class="skt-link">vid_2</a>] <a href="#entry-vedas_2" class="skt-link">n.</a> véd. possessions, richesses.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vedavaadin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vedavādin</i> [<a href="#entry-vaadin" class="skt-link">vādin</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vedavaadin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vedavaadin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vedavaadinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vedavādinī</i> qui célèbre le <a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vedavat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vedavat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vedavat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vedavat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vedavatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vedavatī</i> qui est familier avec le <a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Ubhavi_syapuraa_na" class="skt-link">Bhaviṣyapurāṇa</a>] np. du roi Vedavān, fils de Pradyota_1 — <a href="#entry-vedavatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vedavatī</i> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] np. de la belle Vedavatī, incarnation de <a href="#entry-Uvaak" class="skt-link">Vāk</a>, fille de <a href="#entry-Ukuzadhvaja" class="skt-link">Kuśadhvaja</a>, qui ne voulut pas la marier à quiconque excepté <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>; elle vivait en ascète dans les bois, où <a href="#entry-Uraava_na" class="skt-link">Rāvaṇa</a> la rencontra et lui manqua de respect; elle se jeta dans le feu en le maudissant, et en faisant le vœu de renaître hors de toute matrice, pieuse fille d'un homme juste; au <a href="#entry-tretaayuga" class="skt-link">tretāyuga</a> elle renaquit comme <a href="#entry-Usiitaa" class="skt-link">Sītā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vedavid">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vedavid</i> [<a href="#entry-vid_3" class="skt-link">vid_3</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vedavid" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vedavid" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vedavid" class="skt-link">f.</a> versé dans le <a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vedavidyaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vedavidyā</i> [<a href="#entry-vidyaa" class="skt-link">vidyā</a>] <a href="#entry-vedavidyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> connaissance du <a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vedavyaasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vedavyāsa</i> [<a href="#entry-vyaasa" class="skt-link">vyāsa</a>] <a href="#entry-vedavyaasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. de Vedavyāsa «Compositeur du <a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a>», épith. de <a href="#entry-Uvyaasa" class="skt-link">Vyāsa</a> ou de <a href="#entry-Ubaadaraaya_na" class="skt-link">Bādarāyaṇa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vedaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेदय</span> <i>vedaya</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-ved" class="skt-link">ved</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vedaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vedaya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vedayaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vedayā</i> qui informe.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vedayitavya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेदयितव्य</span> <i>vedayitavya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">3</span>] <a href="#entry-ved" class="skt-link">ved</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vedayitavya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vedayitavya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vedayitavyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vedayitavyā</i> que l'on doit faire savoir, dont on doit informer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vedha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेध</span> <i>vedha</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vyadh" class="skt-link">vyadh</a>] <a href="#entry-vedha" class="skt-link">m.</a> action de percer, de blesser; pénétration, perforation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> blessure <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> profondeur (d'une excavation, etc.) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> (alchimie) transmutation.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vedhaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेधक</span> <i>vedhaka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vyadh" class="skt-link">vyadh</a>] <a href="#entry-vedhaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> perforateur (not. de gemmes) — <a href="#entry-vedhaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> coriandre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> grain non vanné.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vedhana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेधन</span> <i>vedhana</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vyadh" class="skt-link">vyadh</a>] <a href="#entry-vedhana" class="skt-link">n.</a> fait de percer, d'atteindre avec une flèche <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pénétration, perforation — <a href="#entry-vedhanii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vedhanī</i> perforateur; vrille, foret <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> not. perforateur d'oreilles d'éléphant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vedhaniiya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेधनीय</span> <i>vedhanīya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] <a href="#entry-vyadh" class="skt-link">vyadh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vedhaniiya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vedhaniiya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vedhaniiyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vedhanīyā</i> propre à être percé; pénétrable, vulnérable.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vedhas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेधस्</span> <i>vedhas</i> [<a href="#entry-vidh_1" class="skt-link">vidh_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vedhas" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vedhas" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vedhas" class="skt-link">f.</a> pieux, vertueux, brave — <a href="#entry-vedhas" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. dieu créateur ou ordonnateur; épith. de <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a>, <a href="#entry-Uprajaapati" class="skt-link">Prajāpati</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>, <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>, <a href="#entry-Udak_sa" class="skt-link">Dakṣa</a>, etc.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vedi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेदि</span> <i>vedi</i> [<a href="#entry-vid_1" class="skt-link">vid_1</a>] <a href="#entry-vedi" class="skt-link">f.</a> espace sacrificiel, autel; banc, terrasse <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. aire du sacrifice véd. <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> var. <i>vedī</i> id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vedikaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vedikā</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] <a href="#entry-vedikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> arch. barrière (not. balustrade entourant un <a href="#entry-stuupa" class="skt-link">stūpa</a>).<br> <a href="#entry-vedi" class="skt-link">vedi</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vedin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेदिन्</span> <i>vedin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vid_1" class="skt-link">vid_1</a>] ifc. a. <a href="#entry-vedin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vedin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vedinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vedinī</i> qui connaît, qui est familier avec.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-veditavya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेदितव्य</span> <i>veditavya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">3</span>] <a href="#entry-vid_1" class="skt-link">vid_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-veditavya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-veditavya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-veditavyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>veditavyā</i> à savoir, qui mérite d'être su, qui doit être appris.<br> <i>anantaśāstram</i> <i>bahuveditavyam</i> <i>alpaśca</i> <i>kālo</i> <i>bahavaśca</i> <i>vighnāḥ</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>yatsārabhūtaṃ</i> <i>tadupāsitavyaṃ</i> <i>haṃso</i> <i>yathā</i> <i>kṣīramivāmbumiśram</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> [<a href="#entry-Uuttaragiitaa" class="skt-link">Uttaragītā</a>] Les ouvrages qui méritent d'être étudiés sont innombrables, la vie est courte et les obstacles sont nombreux; ce qui est important de savoir, c'est de discerner la vérité de l'erreur, à l'instar du <a href="#entry-ha_msa" class="skt-link">haṃsa</a> qui sait séparer le lait de l'eau.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vedya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेद्य</span> <i>vedya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-vid_1" class="skt-link">vid_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vedya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vedya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vedyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vedyā</i> qui doit être connu <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> célèbre, illustre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vefgii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेङ्गी</span> <i>veṅgī</i> <a href="#entry-vefgii" class="skt-link">f.</a> géo. np. de la ville de Veṅgī ou Veṅgi, capitale des <a href="#entry-Uzaalafkaayanaas" class="skt-link">Śālaṅkāyanās</a>, puis des <a href="#entry-Ucaalukyaas" class="skt-link">Cālukyās</a> de l'Est; elle était proche de la mod. Eluru en <a href="#entry-Uandhra" class="skt-link">Andhra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vefka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेङ्क</span> <i>veṅka</i> <a href="#entry-vefka" class="skt-link">m.</a> pl. nom d'un peuple de l'Inde du Sud.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vefka_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेङ्कट</span> <i>veṅkaṭa</i> [pkt. <a href="#entry-vyafka_ta" class="skt-link">vyaṅkaṭa</a>] <a href="#entry-vefka_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> géo. nom de la colline sacrée de Veṅkaṭa, à Tirumala, au sud de l'<a href="#entry-Uandhra" class="skt-link">Andhra</a> Pradesh, important lieu de pélerinage <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> var. <i>vyaṅkaṭa</i> id. (forme non corrompue).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vefka_taadhvarin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>veṅkaṭādhvarin</i> [<a href="#entry-adhvarin" class="skt-link">adhvarin</a>] <a href="#entry-vefka_taadhvarin" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. de Veṅkaṭādhvarī, poète de style <a href="#entry-campuu" class="skt-link">campū</a> (Inde du Sud, 17⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle), auteur du Viśvaguṇādarśa.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vefka_tanaatha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>veṅkaṭanātha</i> [<a href="#entry-naatha" class="skt-link">nātha</a>] <a href="#entry-vefka_tanaatha" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. de Veṅkaṭanātha «Maître de <a href="#entry-Uvefka_ta" class="skt-link">Veṅkaṭa</a>», épith. du phil. <a href="#entry-vai_s_nava" class="skt-link">vaiṣṇava</a> <a href="#entry-Uvedaantadezika" class="skt-link">Vedāntadeśika</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vefka_teza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>veṅkaṭeśa</i> [<a href="#entry-iiza" class="skt-link">īśa</a>] <a href="#entry-vefka_teza" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Veṅkaṭeśa le «Seigneur de <a href="#entry-Uvefka_ta" class="skt-link">Veṅkaṭa</a>», épith. de <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a> ou <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Uvefka_tezvara" class="skt-link">Veṅkaṭeśvara</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vefka_tezaananda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>veṅkaṭeśānanda</i> [<a href="#entry-aananda" class="skt-link">ānanda</a>] <a href="#entry-vefka_tezaananda" class="skt-link">m.</a> mod. np. du <a href="#entry-Usvaamii" class="skt-link">Svāmī</a> Veṅkaṭeśānanda (1921–1982), disciple de <a href="#entry-Uzivaananda" class="skt-link">Śivānanda</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vefka_teza" class="skt-link">veṅkaṭeśa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vefka_tezvara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>veṅkaṭeśvara</i> [<a href="#entry-iizvara" class="skt-link">īśvara</a>] <a href="#entry-vefka_tezvara" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Veṅkaṭeśvara, le «Seigneur de <a href="#entry-Uvefka_ta" class="skt-link">Veṅkaṭa</a>», idole de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a> du temple de <a href="#entry-Uvefka_ta" class="skt-link">Veṅkaṭa</a>; il a les yeux cachés (car son regard brûlerait l'univers), et est souvent couvert de guirlandes de fleurs qui ne laissent voir que ses pieds; on l'appelle aussi Balaji «Puissant Seigneur».<br> <a href="#entry-vefka_ta" class="skt-link">veṅkaṭa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vega">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेग</span> <i>vega</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vij" class="skt-link">vij</a>] <a href="#entry-vega" class="skt-link">m.</a> courant d'eau; torrent; au fig. torrent de larmes <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> rapidité, élan, impulsion, essor <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> véhémence, impétuosité; effet violent (not. poison); paroxisme.<br> <i>vegāt</i> adv. impétueusement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vegavat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vegavat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vegavat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vegavat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vegavatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vegavatī</i> agité (not. océan); impétueux; véhément, violent; rapide (not. torrent) — <a href="#entry-vegavatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vegavatī</i> lit. [<a href="#entry-Ukathaasaritsaagara" class="skt-link">Kathāsaritsāgara</a>] np. de la <a href="#entry-vidyaadharii" class="skt-link">vidyādharī</a> Vegavatī, sœur de <a href="#entry-Umaanasavega" class="skt-link">Mānasavega</a>; elle aida le prince <a href="#entry-Unaravaahanadatta" class="skt-link">Naravāhanadatta</a> dont elle devint amante.<br> <a href="#entry-vega" class="skt-link">vega</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vegin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेगिन्</span> <i>vegin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vij" class="skt-link">vij</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vegin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vegin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-veginii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>veginī</i> rapide, véloce; impétueux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vegita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेगित</span> <i>vegita</i> [<a href="#entry-vega" class="skt-link">vega</a><a href="#entry--ita" class="skt-link">-ita</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vegita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vegita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vegitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vegitā</i> agité de vagues, houleux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> rapide, véloce; impétueux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vej">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेज्</span> <i>vej</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-vij" class="skt-link">vij</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(vejayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vejita</i><i>)</i> accélérer, intensifier <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> inquiéter, alarmer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vejita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेजित</span> <i>vejita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vej" class="skt-link">vej</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vejita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vejita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vejitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vejitā</i> effrayé, terrifié <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> accru, intensifié.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-velaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेला</span> <i>velā</i> <a href="#entry-velaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> frontière, limite, bord; rive, rivage <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> époque, heure, temps; dernière heure.<br> <i>kā</i> <i>velā</i> <i>vartate</i> quelle heure est-il?
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ven">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेन्</span> <i>ven</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(venati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>venita</i><i>)</i> désirer, attendre impatiemment, avoir la nostalgie de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vena">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेन</span> <i>vena</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-ven" class="skt-link">ven</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vena" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vena" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-venii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>venī</i> anxieux, désireux — <a href="#entry-vena" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. du sage [<a href="#entry-_r_si" class="skt-link">ṛṣi</a>] Vena «Désir», fils d'<a href="#entry-Uafga_1" class="skt-link">Aṅga_1</a> et de <a href="#entry-Usuniithaa" class="skt-link">Sunīthā</a>; sous la mauvaise influence de sa mère, il commit des sacrilèges qui provoquèrent sa perte; les brâhmanes barattèrent son corps, pour en extraire le Mal sous la forme de la race <a href="#entry-ni_saada" class="skt-link">niṣāda</a>, puis créérent <a href="#entry-Up_rthu" class="skt-link">Pṛthu</a>-<a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a> à partir du Bien.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vep">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेप्</span> <i>vep</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-vip" class="skt-link">vip</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(vepayati)</i> faire trembler, agiter.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vepa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेप</span> <i>vepa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vip" class="skt-link">vip</a>] <a href="#entry-vepa" class="skt-link">m.</a> tremblement, frisson.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vepathu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेपथु</span> <i>vepathu</i> [<a href="#entry-vep" class="skt-link">vep</a><a href="#entry--athu" class="skt-link">-athu</a>] <a href="#entry-vepathu" class="skt-link">m.</a> tremblement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vepita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेपित</span> <i>vepita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vip" class="skt-link">vip</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vepita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vepita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vepitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vepitā</i> tremblant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vera">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेर</span> <i>vera</i> <a href="#entry-vera" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vera" class="skt-link">n.</a> corps <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>cadaver</i>; fr. cadavre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vesara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेसर</span> <i>vesara</i> <a href="#entry-vesara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vesarii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vesarī</i> natu. zoo. mulet <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> géo. désigne le pays au sud de la <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_naa_1" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇā_1</a> jusqu'au cap Comorin.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vetaala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेताल</span> <i>vetāla</i> <a href="#entry-vetaala" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. démon qui s'empare des cadavres, vampire, fantôme, revenant, mort-vivant; syn. <a href="#entry-puutana" class="skt-link">pūtana</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vetaalabha_t_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vetālabhaṭṭa</i> [<a href="#entry-bha_t_ta" class="skt-link">bhaṭṭa</a>] <a href="#entry-vetaalabha_t_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. de Vetālabhaṭṭa, l'un des neuf joyaux [<a href="#entry-navaratna" class="skt-link">navaratna</a>] de la cour du roi <a href="#entry-Uvikramaaditya" class="skt-link">Vikramāditya</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vetaala" class="skt-link">vetāla</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vetaalapa_ncavi_mzatikaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vetālapañcaviṃśatikā</i> [<a href="#entry-pa_ncavi_mzati" class="skt-link">pañcaviṃśati</a><a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] <a href="#entry-vetaalapa_ncavi_mzatikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. du recueil de fables Vetālapañcaviṃśatikā «25 contes du mort-vivant» (VeP.); il en existe quatre versions; not. il forme une partie du <a href="#entry-Ukathaasaritsaagara" class="skt-link">Kathāsaritsāgara</a> (fixé au 11⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle); le roi <a href="#entry-Utrivikramasena" class="skt-link">Trivikramasena</a> porte sur son épaule un cadavre qui lui raconte des histoires, terminées par des énigmes.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vetana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेतन</span> <i>vetana</i> <a href="#entry-vetana" class="skt-link">n.</a> gages, rétributions; salaire.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vetasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेतस</span> <i>vetasa</i> [relié à <a href="#entry-vetra" class="skt-link">vetra</a>] <a href="#entry-vetasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> natu. bot. <i>Calamus rotang</i>, sorte de roseau, rotin; baguette — <a href="#entry-vetasa" class="skt-link">n.</a> lancette — <a href="#entry-vetasii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vetasī</i> roseau, rotin.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vetasvat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेतस्वत्</span> <i>vetasvat</i> [<a href="#entry-vetasa" class="skt-link">vetasa</a><a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vetasvat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vetasvat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vetasvatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vetasvatī</i> couvert de roseaux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vetra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वेत्र</span> <i>vetra</i> [relié à <a href="#entry-vetasa" class="skt-link">vetasa</a>] <a href="#entry-vetra" class="skt-link">m.</a> natu. bot. <i>Calamus fasciculatus</i>, sorte de bambou; canne, bâton; cf. <a href="#entry-ve_nu" class="skt-link">veṇu</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>vīmen</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vetravat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vetravat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] <a href="#entry-vetravatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vetravatī</i> géo. np. de la rivière Vetravatī «Couverte de bambous»; mod. Betvā, affluent de la <a href="#entry-Uyamunaa" class="skt-link">Yamunā</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Uviraa_tanagara" class="skt-link">Virāṭanagara</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. np. de Vetravatī_1 «Qui porte la canne», femme-huissier du palais de <a href="#entry-Udu_syanta" class="skt-link">Duṣyanta</a> dans le drame de <a href="#entry-Ukaalidaasa" class="skt-link">Kālidāsa</a> «<a href="#entry-abhij_naanazakuntalaa" class="skt-link">abhijñānaśakuntalā</a>».<br> <a href="#entry-vetra" class="skt-link">vetra</a>
  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_dambita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विडम्बित</span> <i>viḍambita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vi_damb" class="skt-link">viḍamb</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vi_dambita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vi_dambita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vi_dambitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viḍambitā</i> imité, copié; déguisé, déformé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> trompé; frustré, mortifié <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> inférieur; abject — <a href="#entry-vi_dambita" class="skt-link">n.</a> objet de ridicule ou de raillerie; objet de mépris.

  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_mzatisaahasra">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_mzatitama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_mzatizata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viṃśatiśata</i> [<a href="#entry-zata" class="skt-link">śata</a>] num. <a href="#entry-vi_mzatizata" class="skt-link">n.</a> 120.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_s_nu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विष्णु</span> <i>viṣṇu</i> [<a href="#entry-vi_s_1" class="skt-link">viṣ_1</a><a href="#entry--nu" class="skt-link">-nu</a>] <a href="#entry-vi_s_nu" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. véd. aspect du soleil, radieux fils cadet d'<a href="#entry-Uaditi" class="skt-link">Aditi</a> [<a href="#entry-aaditya" class="skt-link">āditya</a>]; plus tard, np. du dieu suprême Viṣṇu «l'Immanent»; ses 10 manifestations [<a href="#entry-dazaavataaraas" class="skt-link">daśāvatārās</a>] sont traditionnellement <a href="#entry-Umatsya" class="skt-link">Matsya</a> le Poisson, <a href="#entry-Ukuurma" class="skt-link">Kūrma</a> la Tortue, <a href="#entry-Uvaraaha" class="skt-link">Varāha</a> le Sanglier, <a href="#entry-Unarasi_mha" class="skt-link">Narasiṃha</a> l'Homme-lion, <a href="#entry-Uvaamana" class="skt-link">Vāmana</a>-<a href="#entry-Utrivikrama" class="skt-link">Trivikrama</a> le Nain, <a href="#entry-Uparazuraama" class="skt-link">Paraśurāma</a> à la Hache, <a href="#entry-Uraama" class="skt-link">Rāma</a> le Roi, <a href="#entry-Ubalaraama" class="skt-link">Balarāma</a> le Fort, <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a> le Noir Sauveur, et <a href="#entry-Ukalkii" class="skt-link">Kalkī</a> le Cavalier de l'Apocalypse; parfois <a href="#entry-Ubuddha" class="skt-link">Buddha</a> est inclus dans la liste; <a href="#entry-Ugaru_da" class="skt-link">Garuḍa</a> est sa monture, <a href="#entry-Ulak_smii" class="skt-link">Lakṣmī</a> son épouse; il demeure au Ciel <a href="#entry-Uvaiku_n_tha" class="skt-link">Vaikuṇṭha</a>; astr. il régente le <a href="#entry-nak_satra" class="skt-link">nakṣatra</a> <a href="#entry-Uzrava_naa" class="skt-link">Śravaṇā</a> (Altaïr);
