ses 24 aspects sont <a href="#entry-Ukezava" class="skt-link">Keśava</a>, <a href="#entry-Unarottama" class="skt-link">Narottama</a>, <a href="#entry-Unaaraaya_na" class="skt-link">Nārāyaṇa</a>, <a href="#entry-Umaadhava" class="skt-link">Mādhava</a>, <a href="#entry-Ugovinda" class="skt-link">Govinda</a>, <a href="#entry-Umok_sada" class="skt-link">Mokṣada</a>, <a href="#entry-Umadhusuudana" class="skt-link">Madhusūdana</a>, <a href="#entry-Utrivikrama" class="skt-link">Trivikrama</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvaamana" class="skt-link">Vāmana</a>, <a href="#entry-Uzriidhara" class="skt-link">Śrīdhara</a>, <a href="#entry-Uh_r_siikeza" class="skt-link">Hṛṣīkeśa</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvarada" class="skt-link">Varada</a>, <a href="#entry-Udaamodara" class="skt-link">Dāmodara</a>, <a href="#entry-Usafkar_sa_na" class="skt-link">Saṃkarṣaṇa</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvaasudeva" class="skt-link">Vāsudeva</a>, <a href="#entry-Upradyumna" class="skt-link">Pradyumna</a>, <a href="#entry-Uaniruddha" class="skt-link">Aniruddha</a>, <a href="#entry-Upuru_sottama" class="skt-link">Puruṣottama</a>, <a href="#entry-Uadhok_saja" class="skt-link">Adhokṣaja</a>, <a href="#entry-Unarasi_mha" class="skt-link">Narasiṃha</a>, <a href="#entry-Uacyuta" class="skt-link">Acyuta</a>, <a href="#entry-Uupendra" class="skt-link">Upendra</a> <a href="#entry-baalaruupin" class="skt-link">bālarūpin</a>, <a href="#entry-Ujanaardana" class="skt-link">Janārdana</a>, <a href="#entry-Uhari" class="skt-link">Hari</a> et <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a>; ils portent avec leurs 4 bras les 24 permutations de 4 attributs: le disque de feu [<a href="#entry-cakra" class="skt-link">cakra</a>], la conque [<a href="#entry-zafkha" class="skt-link">śaṅkha</a>], la massue [<a href="#entry-gadaa" class="skt-link">gadā</a>] et le lotus [<a href="#entry-padma" class="skt-link">padma</a>]; cf. <a href="#entry-Ucakrapaa_ni" class="skt-link">Cakrapāṇi</a>, <a href="#entry-Ujagannaatha" class="skt-link">Jagannātha</a>, <a href="#entry-Upadmanaabha" class="skt-link">Padmanābha</a>, <a href="#entry-Upiitavaasas" class="skt-link">Pītavāsas</a>, <a href="#entry-Upiitaambara" class="skt-link">Pītāmbara</a>, <a href="#entry-Uprajaagara" class="skt-link">Prajāgara</a>, <a href="#entry-Upratardana" class="skt-link">Pratardana</a>, <a href="#entry-Ubhagavaan" class="skt-link">Bhagavān</a>, <a href="#entry-Umohinii" class="skt-link">Mohinī</a>, <a href="#entry-Uviku_n_tha" class="skt-link">Vikuṇṭha</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvibhu" class="skt-link">Vibhu</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvizvaruupa_1" class="skt-link">Viśvarūpa_1</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvefka_tezvara" class="skt-link">Veṅkaṭeśvara</a>, <a href="#entry-Uzriinivaasa" class="skt-link">Śrīnivāsa</a>; [BhP.] sa manifestation est blanche au <a href="#entry-k_rtayuga" class="skt-link">kṛtayuga</a>, rouge au <a href="#entry-tretaayuga" class="skt-link">tretāyuga</a>, jaune au <a href="#entry-dvaaparayuga" class="skt-link">dvāparayuga</a> et noire au <a href="#entry-kaliyuga" class="skt-link">kaliyuga</a>; ses attributs sont le joyau <a href="#entry-Ukaustubha" class="skt-link">Kaustubha</a>, la massue-sceptre <a href="#entry-Ukaumodakii" class="skt-link">Kaumodakī</a>, le disque <a href="#entry-Usudarzana" class="skt-link">Sudarśana</a>, la conque <a href="#entry-Upaa_ncajanya" class="skt-link">Pāñcajanya</a>, l'arc <a href="#entry-Uz_rfga" class="skt-link">Śṛṅga</a>, l'épée <a href="#entry-Unandaka" class="skt-link">Nandaka</a>, la boucle de poils <a href="#entry-Uzriivatsa" class="skt-link">Śrīvatsa</a>; le basilic sacré [<a href="#entry-tulasii" class="skt-link">tulasī</a>] lui est consacré, ainsi que l'ammonite [<a href="#entry-zaalagraama" class="skt-link">śālagrāma</a>]; représenté en empereur, il porte la tiare de gloire [<a href="#entry-kiirtimuku_ta" class="skt-link">kīrtimukuṭa</a>]; phil. [<a href="#entry-saafkhya" class="skt-link">sāṃkhya</a>] il est le régent [<a href="#entry-niyant_r" class="skt-link">niyantṛ</a>] de la faculté de marche [<a href="#entry-paada" class="skt-link">pāda</a>]; <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a> émerveille le Monde par le jeu [<a href="#entry-liilaa" class="skt-link">līlā</a>] de sa Magie [<a href="#entry-Umaayaa" class="skt-link">Māyā</a>]; il obtint de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> d'incarner <a href="#entry-Uzakti" class="skt-link">Śakti</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-tejolifga" class="skt-link">tejoliṅga</a>.<br> <i>viṣṇūyate</i> <i>dvijam</i> il traite le brâhmane à l'instar de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_s_nubali">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viṣṇubali</i> [<a href="#entry-bali" class="skt-link">bali</a>] <a href="#entry-vi_s_nubali" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. «sacrifice à <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>», rite effectué au 8⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ mois de la grossesse, permettant la naissance de l'enfant en tant que <a href="#entry-vaikhaanasa" class="skt-link">vaikhānasa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_s_nudharma">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viṣṇudharma</i> [<a href="#entry-dharma" class="skt-link">dharma</a>] <a href="#entry-vi_s_nudharma" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. rite de <a href="#entry-zraaddha" class="skt-link">śrāddha</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. np. du Viṣṇudharma; cf. <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nudharmottara" class="skt-link">Viṣṇudharmottara</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_s_nudharmottara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viṣṇudharmottara</i> [<a href="#entry-uttara_1" class="skt-link">uttara_1</a>] <a href="#entry-vi_s_nudharmottara" class="skt-link">n.</a> [<i>viṣṇudharmottarapurāṇa</i>] lit. np. du Viṣṇudharmottara, un <a href="#entry-upapuraa_na" class="skt-link">upapurāṇa</a>; il discute des sciences et des arts, et donne not. les règles de célébration des fêtes hindoues; il contient un chapitre sur la poétique [<a href="#entry-alafkaara" class="skt-link">alaṃkāra</a>]; il fut compilé entre 450 et 650.<br> <a href="#entry-vi_s_nudharma" class="skt-link">viṣṇudharma</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_s_nuduuta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viṣṇudūta</i> [<a href="#entry-duuta" class="skt-link">dūta</a>] <a href="#entry-vi_s_nuduuta" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. émissaire de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>, classe d'êtres au service de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_s_nugupta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viṣṇugupta</i> [<a href="#entry-gupta" class="skt-link">gupta</a>] <a href="#entry-vi_s_nugupta" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. de Viṣṇugupta, ministre de <a href="#entry-Ucandragupta" class="skt-link">Candragupta</a> <a href="#entry-Umaurya" class="skt-link">Maurya</a>; il est souvent identifié à <a href="#entry-Ukau_tilya" class="skt-link">Kauṭilya</a> <a href="#entry-Ucaa_nakya" class="skt-link">Cāṇakya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_s_nukha_n_da">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viṣṇukhaṇḍa</i> [<a href="#entry-kha_n_da" class="skt-link">khaṇḍa</a>] <a href="#entry-vi_s_nukha_n_da" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vi_s_nukha_n_da" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Viṣṇukhaṇḍa, section du <a href="#entry-Uskandapuraa_na" class="skt-link">Skandapurāṇa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_s_numahaapuraa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viṣṇumahāpurāṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-mahaapuraa_na" class="skt-link">mahāpurāṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-vi_s_numahaapuraa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> cf. <a href="#entry-vi_s_nupuraa_na" class="skt-link">viṣṇupurāṇa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_s_nupada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viṣṇupada</i> [<a href="#entry-pada" class="skt-link">pada</a>] <a href="#entry-vi_s_nupada" class="skt-link">n.</a> géo. np. du temple de Viṣṇupada à <a href="#entry-Ugayaa" class="skt-link">Gayā</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Ugayaasura" class="skt-link">Gayāsura</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_s_nupura">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viṣṇupura</i> [<a href="#entry-pura" class="skt-link">pura</a>] <a href="#entry-vi_s_nupura" class="skt-link">n.</a> géo. np. de Viṣṇupura «Cité de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>» — <a href="#entry-vi_s_nupurii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viṣṇupurī</i> géo. np. de Viṣṇupurī, tiers du site d'<a href="#entry-Uofkaarezvara" class="skt-link">Oṃkāreśvara</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_s_nupuraa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viṣṇupurāṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-puraa_na" class="skt-link">purāṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-vi_s_nupuraa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Viṣṇupurāṇa [VP.], recueil mythologique d'obédience <a href="#entry-vai_s_nava" class="skt-link">vaiṣṇava</a>, l'un des six livres vertueux [<a href="#entry-saattvika" class="skt-link">sāttvika</a>]; conforme au modèle <a href="#entry-pa_ncalak_sa_na" class="skt-link">pañcalakṣaṇa</a>, il comprend 6 parties: création de l'univers, généalogies royales, <a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a> et devoirs des castes, chroniques des dynasties, vie de <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a>, et dissolution des mondes.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_s_nusahasranaaman">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viṣṇusahasranāman</i> [<a href="#entry-sahasranaaman" class="skt-link">sahasranāman</a>] <a href="#entry-vi_s_nusahasranaaman" class="skt-link">n.</a> les mille noms de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a> — iic. <i>viṣṇusahasranāma</i> des mille noms de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_s_nusahasranaamastotra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viṣṇusahasranāmastotra</i> [<a href="#entry-stotra" class="skt-link">stotra</a>] <a href="#entry-vi_s_nusahasranaamastotra" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Viṣṇusahasranāmastotra ou litanie des mille noms de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>; not. section [13-135] du <a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a><br> <a href="#entry-vi_s_nusahasranaaman" class="skt-link">viṣṇusahasranāman</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_s_nusm_rti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viṣṇusmṛti</i> [<a href="#entry-sm_rti" class="skt-link">smṛti</a>] <a href="#entry-vi_s_nusm_rti" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de la Viṣṇusmṛti, recueil de lois [<a href="#entry-dharmazaastra" class="skt-link">dharmaśāstra</a>] vishnouite.<br> <a href="#entry-vi_s_nu" class="skt-link">viṣṇu</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_s_nuvardhana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viṣṇuvardhana</i> [<a href="#entry-vardhana" class="skt-link">vardhana</a>] <a href="#entry-vi_s_nuvardhana" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. du roi <a href="#entry-Uhoysala" class="skt-link">Hoysala</a> Viṣṇuvardhana (12⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle); il régna de 1108 à 1152, combattit l'empire <a href="#entry-Ucaalukya" class="skt-link">Cālukya</a> de l'Ouest et s'en affranchit en créant l'empire <a href="#entry-Uhoysala" class="skt-link">Hoysala</a>; d'origine <a href="#entry-jaina" class="skt-link">jaina</a>, il se convertit au culte de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a> sous l'influence de <a href="#entry-Uraamaanujaacaarya" class="skt-link">Rāmānujācārya</a> et commissionna de nombreux temples à Belur, Halebidu, Melukoṭe et <a href="#entry-Upa_n_dharpur" class="skt-link">Paṇḍharpur</a>; son fils <a href="#entry-Unarasi_mha_1" class="skt-link">Narasiṃha_1</a> lui succéda.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_s_nuzarman">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viṣṇuśarman</i> [<a href="#entry-zarman" class="skt-link">śarman</a>] <a href="#entry-vi_s_nuzarman" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. du brâhmane Viṣṇuśarmā «Dans la joie de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>», narrateur et auteur présumé du <a href="#entry-Upa_ncatantra" class="skt-link">Pañcatantra</a> (6⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_s_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विष्ट</span> <i>viṣṭa</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-viz_1" class="skt-link">viś_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vi_s_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vi_s_ta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vi_s_taa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viṣṭā</i> entré dans, contenu dans ⟨acc. loc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> rempli ou accompagné de ⟨i.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_s_tabdha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विष्टब्ध</span> <i>viṣṭabdha</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vi_s_tambh" class="skt-link">viṣṭambh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vi_s_tabdha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vi_s_tabdha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vi_s_tabdhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viṣṭabdhā</i> fixe, rigide.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_s_tambh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विष्टम्भ्</span> <i>viṣṭambh</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-stambh" class="skt-link">stambh</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">9</span>] pr. <i>(viṣṭabhnāti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>viṣṭabdha</i><i>)</i> consolider, affermir, fortifier; raidir <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bourrer qqc. ⟨acc.⟩ de ⟨i.⟩ — ca. <i>(viṣṭambhayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>viṣṭambhita</i><i>)</i> arrêter, immobiliser, fixer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_s_tambhita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विष्टम्भित</span> <i>viṣṭambhita</i> [ca. pp. <a href="#entry-vi_s_tambh" class="skt-link">viṣṭambh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vi_s_tambhita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vi_s_tambhita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vi_s_tambhitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viṣṭambhitā</i> arrêté, immobilisé, fixé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_s_tapa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विष्टप</span> <i>viṣṭapa</i> [<a href="#entry-vi_s_tambh" class="skt-link">viṣṭambh</a>] <a href="#entry-vi_s_tapa" class="skt-link">n.</a> sommet; monde, ciel.<br> <i>viṣṭape</i> au ciel.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_s_thaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विष्ठा</span> <i>viṣṭhā</i> var. <i>viṣṭā</i> [<a href="#entry-vi_s_1" class="skt-link">viṣ_1</a>] <a href="#entry-vi_s_thaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> excréments, ordures.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_s_ti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विष्टि</span> <i>viṣṭi</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vi_s_1" class="skt-link">viṣ_1</a>] <a href="#entry-vi_s_ti" class="skt-link">f.</a> service, travail; travail forcé, esclavage <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> (collectif) classe des serviteurs, des esclaves <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> astr. septième demi-jour lunaire [<a href="#entry-kara_na" class="skt-link">karaṇa</a>] (mobile).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_s_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">विष्</span> <i>viṣ_1</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">3</span>] pr. <i>(viveṣṭi)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>pari</i><i>)</i> être actif, agir; faire, accomplir — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(veṣati)</i> être rapide, filer; couler (eau) — ca. <i>(veṣayati)</i> servir — int. <i>(veveṣṭi)</i> imprégner.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_s_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विष्</span> <i>viṣ_2</i> <a href="#entry-vi_s_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> excréments, ordures.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विष</span> <i>viṣa</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vi_s_1" class="skt-link">viṣ_1</a>] <a href="#entry-vi_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> serviteur — <a href="#entry-vi_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> [«ce qui agit vite»] poison, venin — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. md. <i>(viṣāyate)</i> agir comme un poison <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gr. ιος; lat. <i>virus</i>.<br> <i>viṣībhūta</i> empoisonné (not. nourriture).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_sa_n_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विषण्ण</span> <i>viṣaṇṇa</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vi_sad" class="skt-link">viṣad</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vi_sa_n_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vi_sa_n_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vi_sa_n_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viṣaṇṇā</i> triste, abattu, déprimé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_sa_n_nataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viṣaṇṇatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-vi_sa_n_nataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> lassitude, tristesse, dépression.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_sa_n_natva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viṣaṇṇatva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-vi_sa_n_natva" class="skt-link">n.</a> cf. <a href="#entry-vi_sa_n_nataa" class="skt-link">viṣaṇṇatā</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vi_sa_n_na" class="skt-link">viṣaṇṇa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_saa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विषाण</span> <i>viṣāṇa</i> <a href="#entry-vi_saa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> corne; défense (de l'éléphant); pinces (de crabe) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> sommet, pic (d'une montagne) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> téton <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> meilleur de sa classe — <a href="#entry-vi_saa_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viṣāṇā</i> ifc. corne de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_saada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विषाद</span> <i>viṣāda</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vi_sad" class="skt-link">viṣad</a>] <a href="#entry-vi_saada" class="skt-link">m.</a> abattement, lassitude, dépression; désolation, désespoir; dégoût, aversion.<br> <i>viṣāda</i> <i>kṛ</i> témoigner de l'aversion.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_saadana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विषादन</span> <i>viṣādana</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vi_sad" class="skt-link">viṣad</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vi_saadana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vi_saadana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vi_saadanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viṣādanā</i> déprimant, désolant — <a href="#entry-vi_saadana" class="skt-link">n.</a> désolation, désespoir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_saadazalya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viṣādaśalya</i> [<a href="#entry-zalya" class="skt-link">śalya</a>] <a href="#entry-vi_saadazalya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vi_saadazalya" class="skt-link">n.</a> épine du désespoir.<br> <i>uddhṛtaviṣādaśalya</i> a. m. n. ayant arraché l'épine du désespoir.<br> <a href="#entry-vi_saadana" class="skt-link">viṣādana</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_saanna">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viṣānna</i> [<a href="#entry-anna" class="skt-link">anna</a>] <a href="#entry-vi_saanna" class="skt-link">n.</a> flèche empoisonnée.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_saapaha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viṣāpaha</i> [<a href="#entry-apaha" class="skt-link">apaha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vi_saapaha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vi_saapaha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vi_saapahaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viṣāpahā</i> qui guérit du poison — <a href="#entry-vi_saapaha" class="skt-link">m.</a> antidote <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. épith. de <a href="#entry-Ugaru_da" class="skt-link">Garuḍa</a>.<br> <i>mantrair</i> <i>viṣāpahaiḥ</i> par les charmes antidotes.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_saapahaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viṣāpahāra</i> [<a href="#entry-apahaara" class="skt-link">apahāra</a>] <a href="#entry-vi_saapahaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> antidote — <a href="#entry-vi_saapahaaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viṣāpahārā</i> <a href="#entry-vi_saapahaarii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viṣāpahārī</i> myth. épith. de <a href="#entry-Umanasaa" class="skt-link">Manasā</a> «qui protège du poison».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_saapahaarada_n_da">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viṣāpahāradaṇḍa</i> [<a href="#entry-da_n_da" class="skt-link">daṇḍa</a>] <a href="#entry-vi_saapahaarada_n_da" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. baguette magique pour détruire le poison.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_saapahaarastotra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viṣāpahārastotra</i> [<a href="#entry-stotra" class="skt-link">stotra</a>] <a href="#entry-vi_saapahaarastotra" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du poème dévotionnel Viṣāpahārastotra jaïne de <a href="#entry-Udhana_njaya_1" class="skt-link">Dhanañjaya_1</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vi_saapahaara" class="skt-link">viṣāpahāra</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_saastra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viṣāstra</i> [<a href="#entry-astra" class="skt-link">astra</a>] <a href="#entry-vi_saastra" class="skt-link">n.</a> nourriture empoisonnée.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_sad">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विषद्</span> <i>viṣad</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-sad_1" class="skt-link">sad_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(viṣīdati)</i> pft. <i>(viṣasāda)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>viṣaṇṇa</i><i>)</i> être épuisé, être abattu; déprimer — ca. <i>(viṣādayati)</i> abattre, désespérer.<br> <i>viṣīdantam</i> adv. abattu, déprimé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_saghna">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viṣaghna</i> [<a href="#entry-ghna" class="skt-link">ghna</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vi_saghna" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vi_saghna" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vi_saghnaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viṣaghnā</i> qui combat le poison; antidote.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_sahiina">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viṣahīna</i> [<a href="#entry-hiina" class="skt-link">hīna</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vi_sahiina" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vi_sahiina" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vi_sahiinaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viṣahīnā</i> non venimeux (not. serpent).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_sak_rta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viṣakṛta</i> [<a href="#entry-k_rta" class="skt-link">kṛta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vi_sak_rta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vi_sak_rta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vi_sak_rtaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viṣakṛtā</i> empoisonné.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_sakanyaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viṣakanyā</i> [<a href="#entry-kanyaa" class="skt-link">kanyā</a>] <a href="#entry-vi_sakanyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> soc. fille-appât, causant la mort de qui succombe à ses charmes.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_sama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विषम</span> <i>viṣama</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-sama" class="skt-link">sama</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vi_sama" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vi_sama" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vi_samaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viṣamā</i> rugueux, rude; inégal, irrégulier; brut, âpre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> différent; inconstant <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> difficile, malaisé, pénible; incongru; bizarre; désagréable, mauvais; douloureux; dangereux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> math. impair <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui ne se divise pas (comme un animal vivant) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> adverse; inadéquat, incompréhensible, erroné; partial, malhonnête — <a href="#entry-vi_sama" class="skt-link">n.</a> rugosité; irrégularité; difficulté, infortune; situation difficile; mauvaise voie, danger.<br> <i>viṣameṇa</i> adv. inégalement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_samaafka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viṣamāṅka</i> [<a href="#entry-afka" class="skt-link">aṅka</a>] <a href="#entry-vi_samaafka" class="skt-link">m.</a> math. nombre impair; opp. <a href="#entry-samaafka" class="skt-link">samāṅka</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vi_sama" class="skt-link">viṣama</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_samaak_sara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viṣamākṣara</i> [<a href="#entry-ak_sara" class="skt-link">akṣara</a>] <a href="#entry-vi_samaak_sara" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. se dit d'une forme de <a href="#entry-vilomakaavya" class="skt-link">vilomakāvya</a> dans laquelle le vers et son image-miroir sont différents; opp. <a href="#entry-samaak_sara" class="skt-link">samākṣara</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_samastha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viṣamastha</i> [<a href="#entry-stha" class="skt-link">stha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vi_samastha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vi_samastha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vi_samasthaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viṣamasthā</i> [«qui vit dans des conditions difficiles»] malheureux; opp. <a href="#entry-samastha" class="skt-link">samastha</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_savaidya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viṣavaidya</i> [<a href="#entry-vaidya" class="skt-link">vaidya</a>] <a href="#entry-vi_savaidya" class="skt-link">m.</a> guérisseur de morsures de serpents; vendeur d'antidote de poison; syn. <a href="#entry-jaafghulika" class="skt-link">jāṅghulika</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. ouvrage de traitement des poisons.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_savat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viṣavat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vi_savat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vi_savat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vi_savatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viṣavatī</i> vénéneux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_saya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विषय</span> <i>viṣaya</i> [<a href="#entry-vi_s_1" class="skt-link">viṣ_1</a>] <a href="#entry-vi_saya" class="skt-link">m.</a> domaine, territoire, espace; champ de perception, sphère d'influence; portée <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> objet, but, affaire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> ce qui est accessible aux sens; jouissance, volupté <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. rhét. objet matériel tangible opposé à sa représentation figurée; objet opposé au sujet; not. l'un des cinq objets des sens: <a href="#entry-zabda" class="skt-link">śabda</a> le son, <a href="#entry-sparza" class="skt-link">sparśa</a> la sensation tactile, <a href="#entry-ruupa" class="skt-link">rūpa</a> la forme, <a href="#entry-rasa" class="skt-link">rasa</a> le goût et <a href="#entry-gandha" class="skt-link">gandha</a> l'odeur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. sujet d'une comparaison; opp. <a href="#entry-vi_sayin" class="skt-link">viṣayin</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-navyanyaaya" class="skt-link">navyanyāya</a>] perçu — <a href="#entry-vi_sayaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viṣayā</i> ifc. qui concerne, qui relève de.<br> <i>viṣayīkṛ</i> s'emparer de ⟨acc.⟩.<br> <i>viṣayībhū</i> devenir le domaine de ⟨g.⟩.<br> <i>yathā</i> <i>ayam</i> <i>ghaṭaḥ</i> <i>iti</i> <i>jñāne</i> <i>ghaṭatvam</i> <i>viṣayaḥ</i> Ainsi, pour un pot, son perçu consiste en la connaissance qu'on a de sa qualité de pot.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_sayataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viṣayatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-vi_sayataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> phil. rhét. rapport entre un objet et la connaissance qu'on a de lui <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-navyanyaaya" class="skt-link">navyanyāya</a>] état du perçu, sémantique; fait d'être compris.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_sayataavaada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viṣayatāvāda</i> [<a href="#entry-vaada" class="skt-link">vāda</a>] <a href="#entry-vi_sayataavaada" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] np. du Viṣayatāvāda, traité de cognitique dû à <a href="#entry-Uhariraama" class="skt-link">Harirāma</a> <a href="#entry-Utarkaalafkaara" class="skt-link">Tarkālaṅkāra</a>, philosophe du 16⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle.<br> <a href="#entry-vi_sayataa" class="skt-link">viṣayatā</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_sayi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विषयि</span> <i>viṣayi</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-vi_sayin" class="skt-link">viṣayin</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_sayin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viṣayin</i> [<a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vi_sayin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vi_sayin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vi_sayi_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viṣayiṇī</i> (homme) sensuel [«attaché aux plaisirs des sens»]; matérialiste <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. sens figuré; objet d'une comparaison; opp. <a href="#entry-vi_saya" class="skt-link">viṣaya</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-navyanyaaya" class="skt-link">navyanyāya</a>] réceptacle de cognition, sujet cognitif.<br> <a href="#entry-vi_saya" class="skt-link">viṣaya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_sayitaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viṣayitā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-vi_sayitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> phil. [navyanyaaya] état cognitif, fait de percevoir.<br> <a href="#entry-vi_sayi" class="skt-link">viṣayi</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_sin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viṣin</i> [<a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vi_sin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vi_sin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vi_si_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viṣiṇī</i> empoisonné.<br> <a href="#entry-vi_sa" class="skt-link">viṣa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_su">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विषु</span> <i>viṣu</i> [<a href="#entry-vizva" class="skt-link">viśva</a>] iic. des deux côtés, dans toutes les directions; également, en parts égales.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_suucii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विषूची</span> <i>viṣūcī</i> iic. f. de <a href="#entry-vi_svac" class="skt-link">viṣvac</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_suuciikaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viṣūcīkā</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] <a href="#entry-vi_suuciikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> choléra <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. sa personnification Viṣūcīkā; cf. <a href="#entry-Ukarka_tii" class="skt-link">Karkaṭī</a>.<br> <i>oṃ</i> <i>hrāṃ</i> <i>hrīṃ</i> <i>śrīṃ</i> <i>śāṃ</i> <i>viṣṇuśaktaye</i> <i>namaḥ</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>bhagavati</i> <i>viṣṇuśakti</i> <i>ehi</i> <i>enāṃ</i> <i>hara</i> <i>hara</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>dehe</i> <i>hana</i> <i>hana</i> <i>paca</i> <i>paca</i> <i>matha</i> <i>matha</i> <i>utsādaya</i> <i>utsādaya</i> <i>dūre</i> <i>kuru</i> <i>kuru</i> <i>svāhā</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>viṣūcīke</i> <i>tvaṃ</i> <i>himavantaṃ</i> <i>gaccha</i> <i>jīvasaraḥ</i> <i>candramaṇḍalaṃ</i> <i>gatāsi</i> <i>svāhā</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <a href="#entry-mantra" class="skt-link">mantra</a> de guérison du choléra.<br> <a href="#entry-vi_suucii" class="skt-link">viṣūcī</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_suvat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viṣuvat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vi_suvat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vi_suvat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vi_suvatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viṣuvatī</i> qui partage, médian, central — <a href="#entry-vi_suvat" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. jour central d'un grand sacrifice [<a href="#entry-sattra" class="skt-link">sattra</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> équinoxe <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> var. <i>viṣuva</i> f. id.<br> <a href="#entry-vi_su" class="skt-link">viṣu</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_svac">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विष्वच्</span> <i>viṣvac</i> var. <i>viṣvañc</i> [<a href="#entry-vi_su" class="skt-link">viṣu</a>-<a href="#entry-ac" class="skt-link">ac</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vi_svac" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vi_svac" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vi_suucii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viṣūcī</i> tourné de tous (ou des deux) côtés; qui va en tous sens.<br> <i>viṣvak</i> adv. de tous côtés, partout.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_svak">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विष्वक्</span> <i>viṣvak</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-vi_svac" class="skt-link">viṣvac</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_svaksena">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viṣvaksena</i> [<a href="#entry-senaa" class="skt-link">senā</a>] <a href="#entry-vi_svaksena" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Viṣvaksena, épith. de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a> ou <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a> «qui fait sentir ses pouvoirs partout» <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Viṣvaksena_1, garde du palais de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>; <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> le tua avec son trident après avoir coupé une tête à <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a>, pour rencontrer <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a> aux fins de lui demander pardon.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_svaksenasa_mhitaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viṣvaksenasaṃhitā</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_mhitaa" class="skt-link">saṃhitā</a>] <a href="#entry-vi_svaksenasa_mhitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de la Viṣvaksenasaṃhitā, œuvre de la doctrine <a href="#entry-paa_ncaraatra" class="skt-link">pāñcarātra</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vi_svaksena" class="skt-link">viṣvaksena</a> <br> <a href="#entry-vi_svak" class="skt-link">viṣvak</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_t_thala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विट्ठल</span> <i>viṭṭhala</i> <a href="#entry-vi_t_thala" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Viṭṭhala ou Viṭhobā «Brique», aspect de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>-<a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a>; en visitant la ville de <a href="#entry-Upa_n_dharpur" class="skt-link">Paṇḍharpur</a> il insuffla son essence en un jeune brâhmane nommé <a href="#entry-Upu_n_dariika" class="skt-link">Puṇḍarīka</a> (ou <a href="#entry-Upu_n_daliika" class="skt-link">Puṇḍalīka</a> ou <a href="#entry-Upu_n_darafga" class="skt-link">Puṇḍaraṅga</a>) qui était renommé pour sa piété filiale; on le représente comme un adolescent blanc debout sur une brique, les poings sur les hanches, attendant le retour de <a href="#entry-Upu_n_dariika" class="skt-link">Puṇḍarīka</a> parti s'occuper de ses parents; son culte a donné naissance à la secte <a href="#entry-Uharidaasa" class="skt-link">Haridāsa</a> au 13⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle; son pélerinage est célébré à <a href="#entry-Upa_n_dharpur" class="skt-link">Paṇḍharpur</a>, not. à <a href="#entry-aa_saa_dha" class="skt-link">āṣāḍha</a> <a href="#entry-ekaadazii" class="skt-link">ekādaśī</a>; le saint <a href="#entry-Unaamadeva" class="skt-link">Nāmadeva</a> le célébra; un grand temple de <a href="#entry-Uvi_t_thala" class="skt-link">Viṭṭhala</a> se trouve à <a href="#entry-Uvijayanagara" class="skt-link">Vijayanagara</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. du grammairien Viṭṭhala_1, commentateur de <a href="#entry-Uraamacandra_2" class="skt-link">Rāmacandra_2</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विट</span> <i>viṭa</i> <a href="#entry-vi_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> épicurien, bon vivant, libertin, débauché; amant <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> entremetteur; souteneur; mignon, giton <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. (théâtre) compagnon de débauche d'un prince, courtisan.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_tapa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विटप</span> <i>viṭapa</i> <a href="#entry-vi_tapa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vi_tapa" class="skt-link">n.</a> branche, rameau; buisson.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_thafka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विठङ्क</span> <i>viṭhaṅka</i> a. <a href="#entry-vi_thafka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vi_thafka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vi_thafkaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viṭhaṅkā</i> dissolu; débauché, fréquentant les prostituées.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_thobaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विठोबा</span> <i>viṭhobā</i> cf. <a href="#entry-vi_t_thala" class="skt-link">viṭṭhala</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vi_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वि</span> <i>vi_1</i> <a href="#entry-vi_1" class="skt-link">m.</a> oiseau <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> être véloce (not. cheval, flèche, vent) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>avis</i>; fr. avicole.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibaddha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विबद्ध</span> <i>vibaddha</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vibandh" class="skt-link">vibandh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vibaddha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vibaddha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vibaddhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vibaddhā</i> lié fermement; tendu.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibandh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विबन्ध्</span> <i>vibandh</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-bandh" class="skt-link">bandh</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">9</span>] pr. <i>(vibadhnāti)</i> pr. md. <i>(vibadhnīte)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vibaddha</i><i>)</i> lier fermement, attacher; tendre (not. tambour).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibhaa_n_daka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विभाण्डक</span> <i>vibhāṇḍaka</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-bhaa_n_daka" class="skt-link">bhāṇḍaka</a>] <a href="#entry-vibhaa_n_daka" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] np. du <a href="#entry-_r_si" class="skt-link">ṛṣi</a> Vibhāṇḍaka, fils de <a href="#entry-Ukaazyapa" class="skt-link">Kāśyapa</a>; <a href="#entry-U_rzyaz_rfga" class="skt-link">Ṛśyaśṛṅga</a> est son fils, né d'une antilope ayant bu l'eau de la rivière où sa semence avait coulé à la vue de l'<a href="#entry-apsaras" class="skt-link">apsaras</a> <a href="#entry-Uurvazii" class="skt-link">Urvaśī</a>; l'antilope était une fille des dieux à laquelle <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a> avait promis de retrouver forme humaine si elle donnait naissance, en tant qu'antilope, à un grand saint; un fils lui naquit avec une corne au front [<a href="#entry-U_rzyaz_rfga" class="skt-link">Ṛśyaśṛṅga</a>]; <a href="#entry-Uvibhaa_n_daka" class="skt-link">Vibhāṇḍaka</a> l'éleva en ignorance des femmes; à l'âge adulte, il fut enlevé par des courtisanes envoyées par le roi <a href="#entry-Ulomapaada" class="skt-link">Lomapāda</a> pour lui faire épouser sa fille et faire cesser la sécheresse de son pays; <a href="#entry-Uvibhaa_n_daka" class="skt-link">Vibhāṇḍaka</a> y consentit, pourvu que son fils revienne à l'ermitage après avoir eu lui-même un fils.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibhaa_s">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विभाष्</span> <i>vibhāṣ</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-bhaa_s" class="skt-link">bhāṣ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(vibhāṣate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vibhāṣita</i><i>)</i> médire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. admettre une alternative; être optionnel.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibhaa_saa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विभाषा</span> <i>vibhāṣā</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vibhaa_s" class="skt-link">vibhāṣ</a>] <a href="#entry-vibhaa_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> alternative, option <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. (sens de la construction ‘<i>na</i> <i>vā</i>’) option d'une règle grammaticale; on distingue: <i>prāptavibhāṣā</i> option appropriée et <i>aprāptavibhāṣā</i> option inappropriée; l'option ainsi notée est non préférable, au contraire de ‘<i>vā</i>’ option préférable ou ‘<i>anyatarasyām</i>’ option indifférente <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. [<a href="#entry-suutra" class="skt-link">sūtra</a>] indique que les règles qui suivent sont optionnelles.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibhaa_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विभा</span> <i>vibhā_1</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-bhaa_1" class="skt-link">bhā_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(vibhāti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vibhāta</i><i>)</i> briller.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibhaa_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विभा</span> <i>vibhā_2</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vibhaa_1" class="skt-link">vibhā_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vibhaa_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vibhaa_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> brillant — <a href="#entry-vibhaa_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> splendeur, éclat, lumière; beauté.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibhaaga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विभाग</span> <i>vibhāga</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vibhaj" class="skt-link">vibhaj</a>] <a href="#entry-vibhaaga" class="skt-link">m.</a> distribution, répartition, attribution, partage (not. d'un héritage) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> part, partie, portion <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> division, séparation, différence; opp. <a href="#entry-sa_myoga" class="skt-link">saṃyoga</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-vaize_sika" class="skt-link">vaiśeṣika</a>] la propriété [<a href="#entry-gu_na" class="skt-link">guṇa</a>] de séparation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] disjonction <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. analyse <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> math. numérateur (d'une fraction).<br> <i>vibhāgena</i> adv. séparément, au détail.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibhaagazas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vibhāgaśas</i> [<a href="#entry--zas" class="skt-link">-śas</a>] adv. proportionnellement; en juste partage — ifc. selon.<br> <a href="#entry-vibhaaga" class="skt-link">vibhāga</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibhaaj_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विभाज्</span> <i>vibhāj_1</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-vibhaj" class="skt-link">vibhaj</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(vibhājayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vibhājita</i><i>)</i> séparer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibhaaj_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विभाज्</span> <i>vibhāj_2</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vibhaj" class="skt-link">vibhaj</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vibhaaj_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vibhaaj_2" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vibhaaj_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> qui sépare, qui divise.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibhaajita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विभाजित</span> <i>vibhājita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vibhaaj_1" class="skt-link">vibhāj_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vibhaajita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vibhaajita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vibhaajitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vibhājitā</i> divisé, partitionné.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibhaav">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विभाव्</span> <i>vibhāv</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-vibhuu_1" class="skt-link">vibhū_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(vibhāvayati)</i> produire, faire se manifester, causer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibhaava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विभाव</span> <i>vibhāva</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vibhuu_1" class="skt-link">vibhū_1</a>] <a href="#entry-vibhaava" class="skt-link">m.</a> état, condition, circonstance <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. situation dramatique.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibhaavaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विभावक</span> <i>vibhāvaka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vibhuu_1" class="skt-link">vibhū_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vibhaavaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vibhaavaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vibhaavikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vibhāvikā</i> qui provoque l'apparition.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibhaavana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विभावन</span> <i>vibhāvana</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vibhuu_1" class="skt-link">vibhū_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vibhaavana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vibhaavana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vibhaavanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vibhāvanā</i> qui fait apparaître; qui développe, qui manifeste — <a href="#entry-vibhaavanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vibhāvanā</i> lit. procédé rhétorique [<a href="#entry-alafkaara" class="skt-link">alaṃkāra</a>] de description des effets de causes non explicitées — <a href="#entry-vibhaavana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <i>vibhāvana</i> développement, manifestation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. production d'une émotion artistique.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibhafga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विभङ्ग</span> <i>vibhaṅga</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vibha_nj" class="skt-link">vibhañj</a>] <a href="#entry-vibhafga" class="skt-link">m.</a> destruction, anéantissement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibhaj">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विभज्</span> <i>vibhaj</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-bhaj" class="skt-link">bhaj</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vibhajati)</i> pr. md. <i>(vibhajate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vibhakta</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>sam</i><i>)</i> diviser, partager, répartir, distribuer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> séparer, discerner.<br> <i>ardhaṃ</i> <i>vibhaj</i> diviser en deux.<br> <i>samaṃ</i> <i>vibhaj</i> diviser en parties égales.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibhakta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विभक्त</span> <i>vibhakta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vibhaj" class="skt-link">vibhaj</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vibhakta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vibhakta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vibhaktaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vibhaktā</i> divisé, distribué parmi ⟨i.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui a reçu sa part; qui a fait la division <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> isolé, séparé de ⟨i.⟩; distinct, différent; varié <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> divisé en parts égales; harmonieux, équilibré — <a href="#entry-vibhakta" class="skt-link">n.</a> isolation; solitude.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibhakti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विभक्ति</span> <i>vibhakti</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vibhaj" class="skt-link">vibhaj</a>] <a href="#entry-vibhakti" class="skt-link">f.</a> séparation, distinction <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. désinence, flexion nominale ou verbale; on distingue le cas où la flexion est gouvernée par le rôle [<a href="#entry-kaaraka" class="skt-link">kāraka</a>] verbal du cas où elle gouvernée par la co-occurrence d'un autre mot [<a href="#entry-upapada" class="skt-link">upapada</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibhava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विभव</span> <i>vibhava</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vibhuu_1" class="skt-link">vibhū_1</a>] <a href="#entry-vibhava" class="skt-link">m.</a> dignité, grandeur, richesse <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> astr. np. de Vibhava «Succès», fils de <a href="#entry-Unaaradii" class="skt-link">Nāradī</a> personnifiant l'an 2 d'un cycle de vie.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibhavatas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vibhavatas</i> [<a href="#entry--tas" class="skt-link">-tas</a>] adv. (chacun placé) selon son rang.<br> <a href="#entry-vibhava" class="skt-link">vibhava</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibha_nj">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विभञ्ज्</span> <i>vibhañj</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-bha_nj" class="skt-link">bhañj</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">7</span>] pr. <i>(vibhanakti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vibhagna</i><i>)</i> briser en morceaux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibhid">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विभिद्</span> <i>vibhid</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-bhid_1" class="skt-link">bhid_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">7</span>] pr. <i>(vibhinatti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vibhinna</i><i>)</i> fendre en deux, briser en morceaux; casser, briser <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> enfreindre, transgresser, violer; ouvrir <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> éparpiller, disperser; détruire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> altérer, changer (not. d'avis, d'humeur).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibhii_s">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विभीष्</span> <i>vibhīṣ</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-vibhii_1" class="skt-link">vibhī_1</a>] ca. <i>(vibhīṣayati)</i> ca. md. <i>(vibhīṣayate)</i> faire peur, effrayer, terrifier.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibhii_sa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विभीषण</span> <i>vibhīṣaṇa</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vibhii_s" class="skt-link">vibhīṣ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vibhii_sa_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vibhii_sa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vibhii_sa_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vibhīṣaṇā</i> effrayant — <a href="#entry-vibhii_sa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> action d'effrayer — <a href="#entry-vibhii_sa_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> fausse couche, avortement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] np. de l'ogre-vampire [<a href="#entry-raak_sasa" class="skt-link">rākṣasa</a>] Vibhīṣaṇa l'«Effrayant», fils de <a href="#entry-Uvizravaa" class="skt-link">Viśravā</a> et <a href="#entry-Ukezinii_2" class="skt-link">Keśinī_2</a>, frère de <a href="#entry-Uraava_na" class="skt-link">Rāvaṇa</a>; <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a> le récompensa de son ascèse en lui accordant un vœu; il choisit de ne jamais s'abaisser à commettre une mauvaise action; s'opposant à son frère <a href="#entry-Uraava_na" class="skt-link">Rāvaṇa</a> qui avait bafoué le <a href="#entry-dharma" class="skt-link">dharma</a>, il fut banni de <a href="#entry-Ulafkaa" class="skt-link">Laṅkā</a>; après avoir vaincu <a href="#entry-Uraava_na" class="skt-link">Rāvaṇa</a>, <a href="#entry-Uraama" class="skt-link">Rāma</a> le fit roi de <a href="#entry-Ulafkaa" class="skt-link">Laṅkā</a>; c'est l'un des 7 immortels [<a href="#entry-cira_njiivin" class="skt-link">ciraṃjīvin</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibhii_saka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विभीषक</span> <i>vibhīṣaka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vibhii_s" class="skt-link">vibhīṣ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vibhii_saka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vibhii_saka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vibhii_sikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vibhīṣikā</i> qui effraye, qui terrifie — <a href="#entry-vibhii_sikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vibhīṣikā</i> acte d'effrayer; terreur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibhii_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विभी</span> <i>vibhī_1</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-bhii_1" class="skt-link">bhī_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">3</span>] pr. <i>(vibibheti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vibhīta</i><i>)</i> craindre ⟨abl. g.⟩; être effrayé — ca. <i>(vibhīṣayati)</i> ca. md. <i>(vibhīṣayate)</i> faire peur; effrayer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibhii_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विभी</span> <i>vibhī_2</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-bhii_2" class="skt-link">bhī_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vibhii_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vibhii_2" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vibhii_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> sans peur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibhiita_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विभीत</span> <i>vibhīta_1</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vibhii_1" class="skt-link">vibhī_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vibhiita_1" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vibhiita_1" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vibhiitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vibhītā</i> effrayé; intimidé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibhiita_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विभीत</span> <i>vibhīta_2</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-bhiita" class="skt-link">bhīta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vibhiita_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vibhiita_2" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vibhiitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vibhītā</i> sans peur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibhiitaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vibhītaka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] <a href="#entry-vibhiitaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vibhiitakii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vibhītakī</i> natu. bot. <i>Terminalia bellirica</i>, arbre Beleric ou faux myrobolan, une combretacée de 20 à 30 m; son écorce brun-gris est fissurée, ses fruits sont des drupes à 5 angles; on tire au sort par reste modulo 4 d'une poignée de ses noix <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. jeu de dés joué avec ses noix — <a href="#entry-vibhiitaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <i>vibhītaka</i> son fruit; méd. on l'utilise not. pour traiter le phlegme [<a href="#entry-kapha" class="skt-link">kapha</a>]; cf. <a href="#entry-triphalaa" class="skt-link">triphalā</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vibhiita_1" class="skt-link">vibhīta_1</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibhinna">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विभिन्न</span> <i>vibhinna</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vibhid" class="skt-link">vibhid</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vibhinna" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vibhinna" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vibhinnaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vibhinnā</i> fendu en deux, cassé, brisé; détruit <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> altéré; aliéné; séparé, divisé; désuni; déçu — <a href="#entry-vibhinna" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. épith. de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> destructeur.<br> <i>vibhinnīkṛ</i> séparer, diviser.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibhraaj">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विभ्राज्</span> <i>vibhrāj</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-bhraaj" class="skt-link">bhrāj</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(vibhrājate)</i> resplendir, étinceler.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibhram">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विभ्रम्</span> <i>vibhram</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-bhram" class="skt-link">bhram</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vibhramati)</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. <i>(vibhrāmyati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vibhrānta</i><i>)</i> errer, circuler, se remuer dans tous les sens, devenir confus <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> disperser, remuer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibhrama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विभ्रम</span> <i>vibhrama</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vibhram" class="skt-link">vibhram</a>] <a href="#entry-vibhrama" class="skt-link">m.</a> agitation, véhémence, confusion; trouble, illusion, apparence <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> charme, beauté, coquetterie féminine; jeu érotique, art de la courtisane.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibhu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विभु</span> <i>vibhu</i> cf. <a href="#entry-vibhuu_2" class="skt-link">vibhū_2</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibhuja">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विभुज</span> <i>vibhuja</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-bhuja" class="skt-link">bhuja</a>] ifc. a. <a href="#entry-vibhuja" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vibhuja" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vibhujaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vibhujā</i> qui courbe ⟨iic.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibhuu_s">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विभूष्</span> <i>vibhūṣ</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-bhuu_s" class="skt-link">bhūṣ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(vibhūṣayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vibhūṣita</i><i>)</i> orner, décorer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibhuu_sa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विभूषण</span> <i>vibhūṣaṇa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vibhuu_s" class="skt-link">vibhūṣ</a>] <a href="#entry-vibhuu_sa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> ornement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibhuu_sita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विभूषित</span> <i>vibhūṣita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vibhuu_s" class="skt-link">vibhūṣ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vibhuu_sita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vibhuu_sita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vibhuu_sitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vibhūṣitā</i> orné, décoré.<br> <i>muṇḍamālāvibhūṣitā</i> ornée de la guirlande de crânes (dit de <a href="#entry-Ukaalii" class="skt-link">Kālī</a>).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibhuu_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विभू</span> <i>vibhū_1</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-bhuu_1" class="skt-link">bhū_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vibhavati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vibhūta</i><i>)</i> se produire, se manifester; se développer — ca. <i>(vibhāvayati)</i> produire, faire se manifester, causer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibhuu_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विभू</span> <i>vibhū_2</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vibhuu_1" class="skt-link">vibhū_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vibhuu_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vibhuu_2" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vibhvii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vibhvī</i> qui imprègne tout, qui pénètre partout; omniprésent <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> puissant, efficace <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> var. <i>vibhu</i> id. — <a href="#entry-vibhuu_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. np. de Vibhu «le Tout-Puissant», épith. de <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a>, <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> ou <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibhuuti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विभूति</span> <i>vibhūti</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vibhuu_1" class="skt-link">vibhū_1</a>] <a href="#entry-vibhuuti" class="skt-link">f.</a> manifestation de force, déploiement d'énergie, puissance; pouvoir surhumain (cf. <a href="#entry-siddhi" class="skt-link">siddhi</a>) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> abondance, richesse; succès, splendeur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. manifestation divine; être divinement inspiré <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. cendres (de bouse de vache) dont s'enduisent les ascètes, not. <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibhuutipaada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vibhūtipāda</i> [<a href="#entry-paada" class="skt-link">pāda</a>] <a href="#entry-vibhuutipaada" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>] np. du Vibhūtipāda, section du <a href="#entry-Uyogasuutra" class="skt-link">Yogasūtra</a> traitant de la Voie du pouvoir.<br> <a href="#entry-vibhuuti" class="skt-link">vibhūti</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibhuutipa_njara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vibhūtipañjara</i> [<a href="#entry-pa_njara" class="skt-link">pañjara</a>] <a href="#entry-vibhuutipa_njara" class="skt-link">n.</a> soc. [«cage de manifestations divines»] récitation des 100 syllabes de 10 séries d'invocations du <a href="#entry-dazaak_saramantra" class="skt-link">daśākṣaramantra</a>, suivie de son installation [<i>vibhūtipañjaranyāsa</i>], successivement à 100 endroits du corps.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibhvan">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विभ्वन्</span> <i>vibhvan</i> [<a href="#entry-vibhuu_2" class="skt-link">vibhū_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vibhvan" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vibhvan" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vibhvanii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vibhvanī</i> pénétrant, qui imprègne — <a href="#entry-vibhvan" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. du <a href="#entry-_rbhu" class="skt-link">ṛbhu</a> Vibhvā «Pénétrant».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibodha_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विबोध</span> <i>vibodha_1</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-bodha" class="skt-link">bodha</a>] <a href="#entry-vibodha_1" class="skt-link">m.</a> inattention; fait d'être étourdi.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibodha_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विबोध</span> <i>vibodha_2</i> [<a href="#entry-vibudh" class="skt-link">vibudh</a>] <a href="#entry-vibodha_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> éveil; perception, intelligence.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibruu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विब्रू</span> <i>vibrū</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-bruu" class="skt-link">brū</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(vibravīti)</i> pr. md. <i>(vibrūte)</i> expliquer, déclarer, se prononcer sur ⟨acc.⟩; contredire.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibuddha_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विबुद्ध</span> <i>vibuddha_1</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vibudh" class="skt-link">vibudh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vibuddha_1" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vibuddha_1" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vibuddhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vibuddhā</i> éveillé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibuddha_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विबुद्ध</span> <i>vibuddha_2</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-buddha" class="skt-link">buddha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vibuddha_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vibuddha_2" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vibuddhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vibuddhā</i> inconscient.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibuddhi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विबुद्धि</span> <i>vibuddhi</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-buddhi" class="skt-link">buddhi</a>] <a href="#entry-vibuddhi" class="skt-link">f.</a> déraisonnable.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibudh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विबुध्</span> <i>vibudh</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-budh_1" class="skt-link">budh_1</a>] pr. md. <i>(vibudhyate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vibuddha_1</i><i>)</i> s'éveiller; percevoir, apprendre — ca. <i>(vibodhyati)</i> éveiller.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibudha_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विबुध</span> <i>vibudha_1</i> [<a href="#entry-vibudh" class="skt-link">vibudh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vibudha_1" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vibudha_1" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vibudhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vibudhā</i> d'une grande sagesse, très instruit — <a href="#entry-vibudha_1" class="skt-link">m.</a> érudit; syn. <a href="#entry-pa_n_dita" class="skt-link">paṇḍita</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] np. du roi Vibudha <a href="#entry-Ujanaka" class="skt-link">Janaka</a> «Grand sage», fils de <a href="#entry-Udevamii_dha" class="skt-link">Devamīḍha</a>, père de <a href="#entry-Umahiidhraka" class="skt-link">Mahīdhraka</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vibudha_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विबुध</span> <i>vibudha_2</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-budha" class="skt-link">budha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vibudha_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vibudha_2" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vibudhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vibudhā</i> sans sage.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vic">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">विच्</span> <i>vic</i> [relié à <a href="#entry-vij" class="skt-link">vij</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">7</span>] pr. <i>(vinakti)</i> pr. md. <i>(viṅkte)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vikta</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>vi</i><i>)</i> discriminer, discerner; séparer; not. le grain de la balle, vanner <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> priver de ⟨i.⟩ — ca. <i>(vecayati)</i> cf. <a href="#entry-vivic" class="skt-link">vivic</a> — dés. <i>(vivikṣati)</i> souhaiter séparer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vicaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विचार</span> <i>vicāra</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vicar" class="skt-link">vicar</a>] <a href="#entry-vicaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> procédure; délibération, réflexion; introspection, investigation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> doute, hésitation; prudence <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> conjecture probable <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> débat; controverse; dispute <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. opinion comme critère de jugement moral; opp. <a href="#entry-aacaara" class="skt-link">ācāra</a>.<br> <i>vicāraṃ</i> <i>kṛ</i> hésiter, tergiverser.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vicaara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विचारण</span> <i>vicāraṇa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vicar" class="skt-link">vicar</a>] <a href="#entry-vicaara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> considération, réflexion; délibération, discussion; doute, hésitation — <a href="#entry-vicaara_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vicāraṇā</i> id. <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [YV.] l'introspection, 2⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ niveau de connaissance [<a href="#entry-j_naanabhuumikaa" class="skt-link">jñānabhūmikā</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vicaara_niiya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विचारणीय</span> <i>vicāraṇīya</i> [ca. pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] <a href="#entry-vicar" class="skt-link">vicar</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vicaara_niiya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vicaara_niiya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vicaara_niiyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vicāraṇīyā</i> qui mérite réflexion.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vicaarasaagara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vicārasāgara</i> [<a href="#entry-saagara" class="skt-link">sāgara</a>] <a href="#entry-vicaarasaagara" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Vicārasāgara, texte de <a href="#entry-vedaanta" class="skt-link">vedānta</a> en hindi dû à Niścaladāsa <a href="#entry-muni" class="skt-link">muni</a> (1844), traduit en sanskrit par <a href="#entry-zrii" class="skt-link">śrī</a> Vāsudeva Brahmendra <a href="#entry-Usarasvatii_2" class="skt-link">Sarasvatī_2</a> <a href="#entry-Usvaamii" class="skt-link">Svāmī</a> (1964).<br> <a href="#entry-vicaara" class="skt-link">vicāra</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vicaarin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विचारिन्</span> <i>vicārin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vicar" class="skt-link">vicar</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vicaarin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vicaarin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vicaari_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vicāriṇī</i> qui se déplace; qui erre — ifc. qui considère, qui discute, qui juge.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vicaarita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विचारित</span> <i>vicārita</i> [ca. pp. <a href="#entry-vicar" class="skt-link">vicar</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vicaarita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vicaarita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vicaaritaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vicāritā</i> considéré, discuté, évalué <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> douteux, incertain <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> décidé, établi — <a href="#entry-vicaarita" class="skt-link">n.</a> doute, hésitation; délibération, discussion.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vicaarya_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विचार्य</span> <i>vicārya_1</i> [ca. pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-vicar" class="skt-link">vicar</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vicaarya_1" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vicaarya_1" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vicaaryaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vicāryā</i> discutable; dont on doit débattre; douteux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vicaarya_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विचार्य</span> <i>vicārya_2</i> [abs. <a href="#entry-vicar" class="skt-link">vicar</a>] ind. ayant discuté, ayant délibéré.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vicak_s">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विचक्ष्</span> <i>vicakṣ</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-cak_s" class="skt-link">cakṣ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. md. <i>(vicaṣṭe)</i> voir clairement; discerner, percevoir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vicak_sa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विचक्षण</span> <i>vicakṣaṇa</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vicak_s" class="skt-link">vicakṣ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vicak_sa_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vicak_sa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vicak_sa_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vicakṣaṇā</i> perceptible; visible, évident; radiant, splendide <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> intelligent, clairvoyant, perspicace; rusé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> sage, prudent, avisé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> expert, versé dans ⟨loc. iic.⟩ — <a href="#entry-vicak_sa_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vicakṣaṇā</i> myth. np. de Vicakṣaṇā «Clairvoyance», trône de <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vical">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विचल्</span> <i>vical</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-cal" class="skt-link">cal</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vicalati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vicalita</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>pra</i><i>)</i> bouger, s'agiter, être agité; partir, dévier, se désister de ⟨abl.⟩ — ca. <i>(vicālayati)</i> faire bouger; agiter, secouer, remuer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> détourner de ⟨abl.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vicalita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विचलित</span> <i>vicalita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vical" class="skt-link">vical</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vicalita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vicalita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vicalitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vicalitā</i> parti; dévié de ⟨abl.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> troublé, obscurci, aveuglé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vicar">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विचर्</span> <i>vicar</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-car" class="skt-link">car</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vicarati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vicarita</i><i>)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>vicārya</i><i>)</i> circuler, errer, parcourir; se diffuser; vivre; pratiquer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> commettre une erreur, s'écarter de la règle — ca. <i>(vicārayati)</i> faire errer, induire en erreur; séduire — ca. md. <i>(vicārayate)</i> [«retourner en tous sens»] réfléchir, hésiter, avoir des doutes sur ⟨loc.⟩.<br> <i>kiṃ</i> <i>vicārayate</i> à quoi bon tergiverser?
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vicar_sa_ni">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विचर्षणि</span> <i>vicarṣaṇi</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-car_sa_ni" class="skt-link">carṣaṇi</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vicar_sa_ni" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vicar_sa_ni" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vicar_sa_ni" class="skt-link">f.</a> très actif; talentueux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> var. <i>vicarṣaṇa</i> f. id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vicaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विचय</span> <i>vicaya</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vici" class="skt-link">vici</a>] <a href="#entry-vicaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> collection, énumération <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> investigation, recherche, examen.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viccheda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विच्छेद</span> <i>viccheda</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vicchid" class="skt-link">vicchid</a>] <a href="#entry-viccheda" class="skt-link">m.</a> fracture, interruption, séparation; destruction, cessation; différence, distinction <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. segmentation.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vicchid">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विच्छिद्</span> <i>vicchid</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-chid_1" class="skt-link">chid_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">7</span>] pr. <i>(vicchinatti)</i> pr. md. <i>(vicchintte)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vicchinna</i><i>)</i> abs. <i>(</i><i>vicchidya</i><i>)</i> fendre, détruire; séparer, interrompre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vicchidya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विच्छिद्य</span> <i>vicchidya</i> [abs. <a href="#entry-vicchid" class="skt-link">vicchid</a>] ind. ayant séparé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> séparément de ⟨abl.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vicchindat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विच्छिन्दत्</span> <i>vicchindat</i> [ppr. <a href="#entry-vicchid" class="skt-link">vicchid</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vicchindat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vicchindat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vicchindatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vicchindatī</i> séparant, interrompant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vicchinna">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विच्छिन्न</span> <i>vicchinna</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vicchid" class="skt-link">vicchid</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vicchinna" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vicchinna" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vicchinnaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vicchinnā</i> fendu, séparé, interrompu.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vice_s_t">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विचेष्ट्</span> <i>viceṣṭ</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-ce_s_t" class="skt-link">ceṣṭ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(viceṣṭati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>viceṣṭita</i><i>)</i> gesticuler, s'agiter; se débattre; être en convulsions <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> agir, s'employer à, se donner de la peine.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vice_s_tita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विचेष्टित</span> <i>viceṣṭita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vice_s_t" class="skt-link">viceṣṭ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vice_s_tita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vice_s_tita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vice_s_titaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viceṣṭitā</i> effectué — <a href="#entry-vice_s_tita" class="skt-link">n.</a> action, comportement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vici">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विचि</span> <i>vici</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-ci" class="skt-link">ci</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">5</span>] pr. <i>(vicinoti)</i> pr. md. <i>(vicinute)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vicita</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>pra</i><i>)</i> séparer par la pensée, distinguer; sélectionner <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> diviser (not. cheveux); enlever, disperser <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> investiguer; examiner avec soin <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> rechercher.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vicint">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विचिन्त्</span> <i>vicint</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-cint" class="skt-link">cint</a>] v.
