[<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(vicintayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vicintita</i><i>)</i> abs. <i>(</i><i>vicintya</i><i>)</i> considérer, examiner; réfléchir sur, se préoccuper de ⟨acc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> inventer, imaginer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vicit">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विचित्</span> <i>vicit</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-cit_1" class="skt-link">cit_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vicetati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vicitta</i><i>)</i> percevoir, discerner, comprendre — pr. md. <i>(vicetate)</i> apparaître.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vicitra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विचित्र</span> <i>vicitra</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-citra" class="skt-link">citra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vicitra" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vicitra" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vicitraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vicitrā</i> varié; multicolore, bariolé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> étonnant, singulier, surprenant; étrange, merveilleux; rare <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> plaisant, amusant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vicitraviirya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vicitravīrya</i> [<a href="#entry-viirya" class="skt-link">vīrya</a>] <a href="#entry-vicitraviirya" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. du roi Vicitravīrya «Merveilleux Héros», de la lignée lunaire <a href="#entry-kaurava" class="skt-link">kaurava</a>; fils cadet du roi <a href="#entry-Uzaantanu" class="skt-link">Śāṃtanu</a> et de sa femme <a href="#entry-Usatyavatii" class="skt-link">Satyavatī</a>, il est demi-frère de <a href="#entry-Ubhii_sma" class="skt-link">Bhīṣma</a>; après la mort de son aîné <a href="#entry-Ucitraafgada" class="skt-link">Citrāṅgada</a> il devint l'héritier du trône; pour assurer sa descendance, <a href="#entry-Ubhii_sma" class="skt-link">Bhīṣma</a> enleva <a href="#entry-Uambikaa_1" class="skt-link">Ambikā_1</a> et <a href="#entry-Uambaalikaa_1" class="skt-link">Ambālikā_1</a> pour lui servir d'épouses; lorsqu'il mourut de phtisie sans héritier, <a href="#entry-Usatyavatii" class="skt-link">Satyavatī</a> demanda à son fils secret <a href="#entry-Uvyaasa" class="skt-link">Vyāsa</a>, qu'elle avait eu de sa rencontre avec l'ascète <a href="#entry-Uparaazara" class="skt-link">Parāśara</a>, de revenir de son ermitage pour épouser ses deux veuves, <a href="#entry-Uambikaa_1" class="skt-link">Ambikā_1</a> dont il engendra <a href="#entry-Udh_rtaraa_s_tra" class="skt-link">Dhṛtarāṣṭra</a>, et <a href="#entry-Uambaalikaa_1" class="skt-link">Ambālikā_1</a> dont il engendra <a href="#entry-Upaa_n_du" class="skt-link">Pāṇḍu</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vicitrazaakayuu_sabhak_sya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vicitraśākayūṣabhakṣya</i> [<a href="#entry-zaaka_1" class="skt-link">śāka_1</a>-<a href="#entry-yuu_sa" class="skt-link">yūṣa</a>-<a href="#entry-bhak_sya" class="skt-link">bhakṣya</a>] <a href="#entry-vicitrazaakayuu_sabhak_sya" class="skt-link">n.</a> variété de plats végétariens.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vicitrazaakayuu_sabhak_syavikaarakriyaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vicitraśākayūṣabhakṣyavikārakriyā</i> [<a href="#entry-vikaara" class="skt-link">vikāra</a>-<a href="#entry-kriyaa" class="skt-link">kriyā</a>] <a href="#entry-vicitrazaakayuu_sabhak_syavikaarakriyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> soc. l'art d'accommoder les mets, l'un des 64 arts [<a href="#entry-kalaa" class="skt-link">kalā</a>].<br> <a href="#entry-vicitrazaakayuu_sabhak_sya" class="skt-link">vicitraśākayūṣabhakṣya</a> <br> <a href="#entry-vicitra" class="skt-link">vicitra</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vicitrita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विचित्रित</span> <i>vicitrita</i> [<a href="#entry-vicitra" class="skt-link">vicitra</a><a href="#entry--ita" class="skt-link">-ita</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vicitrita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vicitrita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vicitritaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vicitritā</i> peint, décoré, orné, paré.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vicitta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विचित्त</span> <i>vicitta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vicit" class="skt-link">vicit</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vicitta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vicitta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vicittaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vicittā</i> perçu, observé; manifeste.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vid_rr">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विदॄ</span> <i>vidṝ</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-d_rr" class="skt-link">dṝ</a>] ca. <i>(vidārayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vidīrṇa</i><i>)</i> fendre, déchirer, lacérer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vid_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">विद्</span> <i>vid_1</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(vetti)</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">6</span>] pr. <i>(vidati)</i> pft. <i>(veda)</i> aor. [<span class="skt-grammar">5</span>] <i>(avedīt)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vidita</i><i>)</i> ppft. <i>(vidvas)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>veditavya</i>, <i>vedya</i><i>)</i> abs. <i>(</i><i>viditvā</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>ni</i>, <i>prati</i>, <i>sam</i><i>)</i> savoir, connaître; connaître comme ⟨2 acc.⟩; comprendre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> éprouver, ressentir, avoir conscience de; voir — ps. <i>(vidyate)</i> être su, être connu — ca. <i>(vedayati)</i> ps. <i>(vedyate)</i> informer qqn. ⟨dat.⟩; faire savoir, montrer, communiquer qqc. ⟨acc.⟩; apprendre qqc. à qqn. ⟨2 acc.⟩ — dés. <i>(vividiṣati)</i> vouloir connaître, désirer savoir; investiguer — dés. <i>(vivitsati)</i> id. — int. <i>(vevidīti)</i> bien savoir — int. md. <i>(vevidyate)</i> id. <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>video</i>; all. wissen, weise; ang. wit, wise.<br> <i>vidyāt</i> on doit comprendre que; il faut savoir que.<br> <i>viddhi</i> <i>yathā</i> sache ceci.<br> <i>ya</i> <i>evaṃ</i> <i>veda</i> qui sait cela (emploi du parfait au présent).<br> <i>taṃ</i> <i>sthaviraṃ</i> <i>viduḥ</i> ils le considèrent âgé.<br> <i>rājarṣir</i> <i>iti</i> <i>māṃ</i> <i>viduḥ</i> ils me prennent pour un <a href="#entry-raajar_si" class="skt-link">rājarṣi</a>.<br> <i>tad</i> <i>idaṃ</i> <i>sarvam</i> <i>āpnoti</i> <i>ya</i> <i>evaṃ</i> <i>veda</i> [CU.] Il obtient tout ce qu'il désire, celui qui sait cela.<br> <i>vetti</i> <i>sarvāṇi</i> <i>śāstrāṇi</i> <i>garvo</i> <i>yasya</i> <i>na</i> <i>vidyate</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>vintte</i> <i>dharmaṃ</i> <i>sadā</i> <i>sadbhis</i> <i>teṣu</i> <i>pūjāṃ</i> <i>ca</i> <i>vindati</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> [<a href="#entry-Ukavirahasya" class="skt-link">Kavirahasya</a>] Il connaît toutes les écritures et pourtant n'en tire pas vanité; il discute de la loi avec les sages et acquiert la gloire parmi eux (illustre l'usage des racines <a href="#entry-vid_1" class="skt-link">vid_1</a> et <a href="#entry-vid_2" class="skt-link">vid_2</a>).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vid_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">विद्</span> <i>vid_2</i> [relié à <a href="#entry-vid_1" class="skt-link">vid_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">6</span>] pr. <i>(vindati)</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. md. <i>(vitte)</i> pft. <i>(viveda)</i> aor. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] <i>(avidat)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vitta</i>, <i>vinna</i><i>)</i> ppr. ps. <i>(vidyamāna)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>nis</i><i>)</i> trouver, découvrir, acquérir, obtenir <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> procurer à qqn. ⟨dat.⟩ — pr. md. <i>(vindate)</i> obtenir en mariage, épouser — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">7</span>] pr. md. <i>(vintte)</i> discuter, considérer — ps. <i>(vidyate)</i> se trouver, exister, être.<br> <i>vidyate</i> il y a (un) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> (avec <a href="#entry-na" class="skt-link">na</a>) il n'y a pas.<br> <i>vidyante</i> il y a (des).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vid_3">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विद्</span> <i>vid_3</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vid_1" class="skt-link">vid_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vid_3" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vid_3" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vid_3" class="skt-link">f.</a> ifc. qui sait, qui connaît; sachant, connaisseur de — <a href="#entry-vid_3" class="skt-link">m.</a> celui qui sait; savant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विदार</span> <i>vidāra</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vid_rr" class="skt-link">vidṝ</a>] <a href="#entry-vidaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> action de fendre, de déchirer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> guerre; catastrophe — <a href="#entry-vidaarii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vidārī</i> natu. bot. <i>Ipomoea digitata</i>, patate douce.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidaara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विदारण</span> <i>vidāraṇa</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vid_rr" class="skt-link">vidṝ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vidaara_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vidaara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vidaara_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vidāraṇā</i> fendant, brisant; qui fait éclater — <a href="#entry-vidaara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> fait de fendre, de perforer, d'ouvrir (not. la bouche).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidagdha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विदग्ध</span> <i>vidagdha</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vidah" class="skt-link">vidah</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vidagdha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vidagdha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vidagdhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vidagdhā</i> brûlé, enflammé; consumé, digéré <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gâté, corrompu, aigre; arrivé à maturité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> subtil, intelligent, instruit, savant; habile, rusé — <a href="#entry-vidagdha" class="skt-link">m.</a> lettré, érudit; syn. <a href="#entry-pa_n_dita" class="skt-link">paṇḍita</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> intriguant <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. np. de Vidagdha, titre de <a href="#entry-Uzaakalya" class="skt-link">Śākalya</a> «Habile lettré», éminent linguiste auteur du <a href="#entry-Upadapaa_tha" class="skt-link">Padapāṭha</a> — <a href="#entry-vidagdhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vidagdhā</i> soc. femme instruite.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidagdhataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vidagdhatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-vidagdhataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> intelligence, érudition; habileté en ⟨loc.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidagdhatva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vidagdhatva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-vidagdhatva" class="skt-link">n.</a> intelligence, érudition; habileté en ⟨loc.⟩.<br> <a href="#entry-vidagdha" class="skt-link">vidagdha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidah">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विदह्</span> <i>vidah</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-dah_1" class="skt-link">dah_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vidahati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vidagdha</i><i>)</i> brûler, détruire par le feu.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidarbha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विदर्भ</span> <i>vidarbha</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-darbha" class="skt-link">darbha</a>] <a href="#entry-vidarbha" class="skt-link">m.</a> géo. np. du pays Vidarbha «dépourvu d'herbe <a href="#entry-kuza" class="skt-link">kuśa</a>», au sud des monts <a href="#entry-Uvindhya" class="skt-link">Vindhya</a> (mod. Berar, au nord-est du <a href="#entry-Umahaaraa_s_tra" class="skt-link">Mahārāṣṭra</a>); sa capitale était <a href="#entry-Uku_n_dina_1" class="skt-link">Kuṇḍina_1</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Udamayantii" class="skt-link">Damayantī</a>, <a href="#entry-Ubhii_smaka" class="skt-link">Bhīṣmaka</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>vidarbhās</i> son peuple, les Vidarbhās <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hi. <i>Berar</i>.<br> <i>vidarbheṣu</i> loc. adv. au Berar.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विदस्</span> <i>vidas</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-das" class="skt-link">das</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. <i>(vidasyati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vidasta</i><i>)</i> manquer, s'épuiser; être épuisé, s'achever.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viddha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विद्ध</span> <i>viddha</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vyadh" class="skt-link">vyadh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-viddha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-viddha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-viddhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viddhā</i> perçé; frappé, battu; blessé — ifc. empli de, affecté par, transformé par.<br> <i>śūlāyāṃ</i> <i>viddha</i> empalé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-videha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विदेह</span> <i>videha</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-deha" class="skt-link">deha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-videha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-videha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-videhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>videhā</i> incorporel; mort [«privé de corps»] — <a href="#entry-videha" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. absence de conscience de son corps dans l'expérience de l'identité avec l'Absolu [<a href="#entry-brahman" class="skt-link">brahman</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Videha, épith. du roi <a href="#entry-Umithi" class="skt-link">Mithi</a> <a href="#entry-Ujanaka" class="skt-link">Janaka</a>, né du corps sans vie de <a href="#entry-Unimi" class="skt-link">Nimi</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> géo. par ext., pays du nord du Gange, royaume de la dynastie <a href="#entry-Ujanaka" class="skt-link">Janaka</a>; sa capitale était <a href="#entry-Umithilaa" class="skt-link">Mithilā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-videhamukta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>videhamukta</i> [<a href="#entry-mukta" class="skt-link">mukta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-videhamukta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-videhamukta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-videhamuktaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>videhamuktā</i> phil. [<a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>] qui se libère de la conscience de son corps.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-videhamukti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>videhamukti</i> [<a href="#entry-mukti" class="skt-link">mukti</a>] <a href="#entry-videhamukti" class="skt-link">f.</a> phil. libération par absence de conscience de son corps.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-videhin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>videhin</i> [<a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>] a. <a href="#entry-videhin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-videhin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-videhinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>videhinī</i> phil. être accompli [<a href="#entry-siddha_1" class="skt-link">siddha_1</a>] réduit à son corps causal [<a href="#entry-kaara_nazariira" class="skt-link">kāraṇaśarīra</a>], en état d'<a href="#entry-asampraj_naata" class="skt-link">asaṃprajñāta</a> <a href="#entry-samaadhi" class="skt-link">samādhi</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-videha" class="skt-link">videha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-videza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विदेश</span> <i>videśa</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-deza" class="skt-link">deśa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-videza" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-videza" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-videzii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>videśī</i> étranger; exotique — <a href="#entry-videza" class="skt-link">m.</a> pays étranger — <a href="#entry-videzii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>videśī</i> langue étrangère <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hi. <i>videś</i>.<br> <i>videśagata</i> parti à l'étranger.<br> <i>videśagamana</i> départ à l'étranger.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-videzin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विदेशिन्</span> <i>videśin</i> [<a href="#entry-videza" class="skt-link">videśa</a><a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>] a. <a href="#entry-videzin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-videzin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-videzinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>videśinī</i> étranger <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hi. <i>videśī</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-videzya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विदेश्य</span> <i>videśya</i> [<a href="#entry-videza" class="skt-link">videśa</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-videzya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-videzya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-videzyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>videśyā</i> étranger; opp. <a href="#entry-sandezya" class="skt-link">saṃdeśya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidh_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">विध्</span> <i>vidh_1</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">6</span>] pr. <i>(vidhati)</i> adorer, honorer un dieu ⟨dat. loc. acc.⟩ (avec ⟨i.⟩) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> offrir, dédier.<br> <i>kasmai</i> <i>devāya</i> <i>haviṣā</i> <i>vidhema</i> [RV.] A quel dieu devons nous offrir l'oblation?.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidh_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विध्</span> <i>vidh_2</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vyadh" class="skt-link">vyadh</a>] ifc. a. <a href="#entry-vidh_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vidh_2" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vidh_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> qui pique.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विध</span> <i>vidha</i> cf. <a href="#entry-vidhaa_2" class="skt-link">vidhā_2</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidhaa_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विधा</span> <i>vidhā_1</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-dhaa_1" class="skt-link">dhā_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">3</span>] pr. <i>(vidadhāti)</i> pr. md. <i>(vidhatte)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vihita</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>abhi</i>, <i>prati</i>, <i>sam</i><i>)</i> faire, produire, effectuer; déterminer, assigner; enjoindre; établir, fixer, statuer; régler, répartir <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> installer, placer, disposer, mettre; fixer sur, diriger vers ⟨dat. loc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> montrer en soi — ps. <i>(vidhīyate)</i> être destiné à, être considéré comme [nom.] — dés. <i>(vidhitsati)</i> chercher à se procurer.<br> <i>yo</i> <i>vidhīyate</i> gram. ce qui est enjoint.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidhaa_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विधा</span> <i>vidhā_2</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vidhaa_1" class="skt-link">vidhā_1</a>] <a href="#entry-vidhaa_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> manière d'être, comportement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> espèce — <a href="#entry-vidha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vidha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <i>vidha</i> ifc. semblable à <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> ⟨num.⟩ se produisant tant de fois.<br> <i>evaṃvidha</i> a. m. n. tel [«dont l'espèce est ainsi»].<br> <i>tathāvidha</i> conj. tel ... (que).<br> <i>yathāvidha</i> [corrél. <a href="#entry-tathaavidha" class="skt-link">tathāvidha</a>] conj. (tel) ... que.<br> <i>bahuvidha</i> a. m. n. divers [«de beaucoup d'espèces»].<br> <i>bhavad</i> <i>vidha</i> pareil à vous.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidhaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विधान</span> <i>vidhāna</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vidhaa_1" class="skt-link">vidhā_1</a>] <a href="#entry-vidhaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> arrangement, ordre; disposition (not. des feux sacrés) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> prescription, règle; fait d'enjoindre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> ce qui est prescrit, ce qui doit s'accomplir <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> application des règles, exécution; moyen, façon <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> mod. constitution.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidhaanatas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vidhānatas</i> [<a href="#entry--tas" class="skt-link">-tas</a>] adv. selon les règles, conformément aux prescriptions.<br> <a href="#entry-vidhaana" class="skt-link">vidhāna</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidhaat_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विधातृ</span> <i>vidhātṛ</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vidhaa_1" class="skt-link">vidhā_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vidhaat_r" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vidhaat_r" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vidhaatrii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vidhātrī</i> ordonnateur, dispensateur; créateur de ⟨g. iic.⟩ — <a href="#entry-vidhaat_r" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Vidhātā «Dispensateur», épith. de <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a> «l'Ordonnateur du Monde», personnifiant la Destinée <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. fils de <a href="#entry-Ubh_rgu" class="skt-link">Bhṛgu</a> par <a href="#entry-Ukyaati" class="skt-link">Kyāti</a>, associé à son frère <a href="#entry-Udhaataa" class="skt-link">Dhātā</a> comme maîtres du destin.<br> <i>bhāgya</i> <i>vidhātṛ</i> destin sauveur (not. de l'Inde).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidhama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विधम</span> <i>vidhama</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-dhama" class="skt-link">dhama</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vidhama" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vidhama" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vidhamaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vidhamā</i> qui souffle ou bat contre ⟨iic.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidharma">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विधर्म</span> <i>vidharma</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-dharma" class="skt-link">dharma</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vidharma" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vidharma" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vidharmaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vidharmā</i> mal, injuste; illégal, illicite; contraire au devoir — <a href="#entry-vidharma" class="skt-link">m.</a> illégalité, injustice.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidhavaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विधवा</span> <i>vidhavā</i> <a href="#entry-vidhavaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> veuve <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> ang. widow.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidhavaataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vidhavātā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-vidhavaataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> état de veuvage.<br> <a href="#entry-vidhavaa" class="skt-link">vidhavā</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidhaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विधय</span> <i>vidhaya</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-dhaya" class="skt-link">dhaya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vidhaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vidhaya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vidhayaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vidhayā</i> qui se tient mal en buvant; qui se soûle.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidheya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विधेय</span> <i>vidheya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-vidhaa_1" class="skt-link">vidhā_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vidheya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vidheya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vidheyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vidheyā</i> obéissant, soumis, docile <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> prescrit <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. prédicat (opp. sujet [<a href="#entry-uddezya" class="skt-link">uddeśya</a>]).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidheyaavimarza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vidheyāvimarśa</i> [<a href="#entry-avimarza" class="skt-link">avimarśa</a>] <a href="#entry-vidheyaavimarza" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. faute de syntaxe, un défault esthétique de la poésie.<br> <a href="#entry-vidheya" class="skt-link">vidheya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidheyavize_sa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vidheyaviśeṣaṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-vize_sa_na" class="skt-link">viśeṣaṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-vidheyavize_sa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> gram. adjectif prédicatif; épithète.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidhi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विधि</span> <i>vidhi</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vidhaa_1" class="skt-link">vidhā_1</a>] <a href="#entry-vidhi" class="skt-link">m.</a> règle, ordonnance, précepte, loi, autorité; injonction; exhortation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> rite, cérémonie; manière d'agir, conduite <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-miimaa_msaa" class="skt-link">mīmāṃsā</a>] injonction rituelle; syn. <a href="#entry-codanaa" class="skt-link">codanā</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-utpattividhi" class="skt-link">utpattividhi</a>, <a href="#entry-viniyogavidhi" class="skt-link">viniyogavidhi</a>, <a href="#entry-prayogavidhi" class="skt-link">prayogavidhi</a>, <a href="#entry-adhikaaravidhi" class="skt-link">adhikāravidhi</a>, <a href="#entry-niyamavidhi" class="skt-link">niyamavidhi</a>, <a href="#entry-parisafkhyaavidhi" class="skt-link">parisaṃkhyāvidhi</a>, <a href="#entry-phalavidhi" class="skt-link">phalavidhi</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. texte d'instruction du rituel dans la littérature <a href="#entry-braahma_na" class="skt-link">brāhmaṇa</a>; opp. <a href="#entry-arthavaada" class="skt-link">arthavāda</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. règle prescriptive d'une opération <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. prescription d'un temps/aspect pour conjuguer un verbe; cf. <a href="#entry-lakaara" class="skt-link">lakāra</a>; not. impératif, cf. <a href="#entry-lo_t" class="skt-link">loṭ</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> créateur, ordonnateur; destin <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Vidhi le Régulateur, épith. de <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidhii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विधी</span> <i>vidhī</i> cf. <a href="#entry-vidhaa_1" class="skt-link">vidhā_1</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidhiiyamaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vidhīyamāna</i> gram. ce qui est posé.<br> <i>kāmān</i> <i>vidhā</i> exhaucer les vœux.<br> <i>pūjaṃ</i> <i>vidhā</i> faire ses dévotions.<br> <i>maitryaṃ</i> <i>vidhā</i> lier amitié.<br> <i>mano</i> <i>vidhā</i> penser à, méditer sur ⟨loc. dat. <a href="#entry-prati" class="skt-link">prati</a>-inf.⟩.<br> <i>mantraṃ</i> <i>vidhā</i> tenir conseil.<br> <i>veṣaṃ</i> <i>vidhā</i> mettre un vêtement; prendre l'apparence de.<br> <i>upāyaṃ</i> <i>vidhā</i> concevoir un moyen.<br> <i>lajjaṃ</i> <i>vidhā</i> être timide; faire preuve de pudeur.<br> <i>rājyaṃ</i> <i>vidhā</i> gouverner.<br> <i>siṃhatvaṃ</i> <i>vidhā</i> se changer en lion.<br> <i>saṃdhiṃ</i> <i>vidhā</i> faire la paix.<br> <i>kalahaṃ</i> <i>vidhā</i> chercher querelle.<br> <i>vairaṃ</i> <i>vidhā</i> déclarer la guerre.<br> <i>kolāhalaṃ</i> <i>vidhā</i> faire du tumulte.<br> <i>cumbanaṃ</i> <i>vidhā</i> donner un baiser.<br> <a href="#entry-vidhaa_1" class="skt-link">vidhā_1</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidhisuutra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vidhisūtra</i> [<a href="#entry-suutra" class="skt-link">sūtra</a>] <a href="#entry-vidhisuutra" class="skt-link">n.</a> gram. règle prescrivant une opération dans l'<a href="#entry-Ua_s_taadhyaayii" class="skt-link">Aṣṭādhyāyī</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vidhi" class="skt-link">vidhi</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidhivat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vidhivat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] adv. selon la règle, comme il convient.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidhiviveka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vidhiviveka</i> [<a href="#entry-viveka" class="skt-link">viveka</a>] <a href="#entry-vidhiviveka" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du Vidhiviveka, œuvre de <a href="#entry-miimaa_msaa" class="skt-link">mīmāṃsā</a> de <a href="#entry-Uma_n_dana" class="skt-link">Maṇḍana</a> <a href="#entry-Umizra" class="skt-link">Miśra</a>; <a href="#entry-Uvaacaspati_1" class="skt-link">Vācaspati_1</a> <a href="#entry-Umizra" class="skt-link">Miśra</a> en fit un commentaire.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidhu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विधु</span> <i>vidhu</i> <a href="#entry-vidhu" class="skt-link">m.</a> la Lune.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidhura">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विधुर</span> <i>vidhura</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-dhura" class="skt-link">dhura</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vidhura" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vidhura" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vidhuraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vidhurā</i> [«sans brancards»] endommagé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> séparé (de l'objet aimé); triste, déprimé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> antipathique — ifc. dépourvu de, à qui il manque; plein de désir pour.<br> <i>saṃskṛtagandhavidhura</i> dépourvu du parfum du sanskrit.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidhuu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विधू</span> <i>vidhū</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-dhuu_1" class="skt-link">dhū_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">5</span>] pr. <i>(vidhunoti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vidhūta</i><i>)</i> secouer, agiter <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> chasser, disperser.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidhuuta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विधूत</span> <i>vidhūta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vidhuu" class="skt-link">vidhū</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vidhuuta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vidhuuta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vidhuutaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vidhūtā</i> secoué, agité — ifc. délivré de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विदित</span> <i>vidita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vid_1" class="skt-link">vid_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vidita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vidita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-viditaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viditā</i> connu, reconnu; appris, compris.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidiz">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विदिश्</span> <i>vidiś</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-diz_2" class="skt-link">diś_2</a>] <a href="#entry-vidiz" class="skt-link">f.</a> point intermédiaire du compas (comme Nord-Est).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidizaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विदिशा</span> <i>vidiśā</i> [<a href="#entry-vidiz" class="skt-link">vidiś</a>] <a href="#entry-vidizaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> région du Nord-Est <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> géo. np. de la ville [<a href="#entry-naagara" class="skt-link">nāgara</a>] de Vidiśā, au confluent des rivières Betwa et Bes, à 10 km de <a href="#entry-Usaa_ncii" class="skt-link">Sāñcī</a>, au Madhya Pradesh; elle fut un important centre de commerce et de culte aux 6⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ et 5⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècles ant.; elle fut abandonnée au 6⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle, détruite puis reconstruite comme Bhilsa (mod. Besnagar) au 9⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle; on y trouve le pilier d'Heliodorus et les caves d'<a href="#entry-Uudayagiri_3" class="skt-link">Udayagiri_3</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Upifgalaa_2" class="skt-link">Piṅgalā_2</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidru">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विद्रु</span> <i>vidru</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-dru_1" class="skt-link">dru_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vidravati)</i> courir ça et là, s'enfuir, fuir — ca. <i>(vidrāvayati)</i> pourchasser, mettre en fuite.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidruma">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विद्रुम</span> <i>vidruma</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-druma" class="skt-link">druma</a>] <a href="#entry-vidruma" class="skt-link">n.</a> corail.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidrumamaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vidrumamaya</i> [<a href="#entry-maya" class="skt-link">maya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vidrumamaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vidrumamaya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vidrumamayii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vidrumamayī</i> en corail.<br> <a href="#entry-vidruma" class="skt-link">vidruma</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidu_s">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विदुष्</span> <i>viduṣ</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-du_s" class="skt-link">duṣ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. <i>(viduṣyati)</i> pécher, commettre une faute, transgresser — ca. <i>(vidūṣayati)</i> cf. <a href="#entry-viduu_s" class="skt-link">vidūṣ</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidu_sii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विदुषी</span> <i>viduṣī</i> cf. <a href="#entry-vidvas" class="skt-link">vidvas</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidura">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विदुर</span> <i>vidura</i> [<a href="#entry-vid_1" class="skt-link">vid_1</a><a href="#entry--ra" class="skt-link">-ra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vidura" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vidura" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-viduraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vidurā</i> intelligent, malin; connaisseur, spécialiste — <a href="#entry-vidura" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. de Vidura «l'Intelligent», né (du regard) de <a href="#entry-Uvyaasa" class="skt-link">Vyāsa</a> sur une servante déguisée par <a href="#entry-Uambikaa_1" class="skt-link">Ambikā_1</a>; il naquit intelligent car sa mère comprit le regard fécondant de Vyaasa; il incarne <a href="#entry-Udharma" class="skt-link">Dharma</a> maudit par <a href="#entry-Umaa_n_davya" class="skt-link">Māṇḍavya</a>; demi-frère de <a href="#entry-Udh_rtaraa_s_tra" class="skt-link">Dhṛtarāṣṭra</a> et de <a href="#entry-Upaa_n_du" class="skt-link">Pāṇḍu</a>, il est le sage conseiller des <a href="#entry-paa_n_davaas" class="skt-link">pāṇḍavās</a>; à la fin de la guerre il devient ascète errant, cessa de se nourrir, et mourut en s'unissant à <a href="#entry-Uyudhi_s_thira" class="skt-link">Yudhiṣṭhira</a> par le regard.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viduraniiti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viduranīti</i> [<a href="#entry-niiti" class="skt-link">nīti</a>] <a href="#entry-viduraniiti" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] épisode du livre 5, où <a href="#entry-Uvidura" class="skt-link">Vidura</a> procura en vain ses conseils à <a href="#entry-Udh_rtaraa_s_tra" class="skt-link">Dhṛtarāṣṭra</a> pour tenter d'éviter la guerre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viduraprajaagara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viduraprajāgara</i> [<a href="#entry-prajaagara" class="skt-link">prajāgara</a>] <a href="#entry-viduraprajaagara" class="skt-link">m.</a> cf. <a href="#entry-viduraniiti" class="skt-link">viduranīti</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vidura" class="skt-link">vidura</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viduu_s">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विदूष्</span> <i>vidūṣ</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-vidu_s" class="skt-link">viduṣ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(vidūṣayati)</i> souiller, corrompre, déshonorer.<br> <i>upahāsaiḥ</i> <i>vidūṣ</i> ridiculiser, tourner en dérision.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viduu_sa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विदूषण</span> <i>vidūṣaṇa</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-viduu_s" class="skt-link">vidūṣ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-viduu_sa_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-viduu_sa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-viduu_sa_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vidūṣaṇā</i> qui souille, qui salit; vil, corrupteur — <a href="#entry-viduu_sa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> satire; injure; diffamation.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viduu_saka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विदूषक</span> <i>vidūṣaka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-viduu_s" class="skt-link">vidūṣ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-viduu_saka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-viduu_saka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-viduu_sikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vidūṣikā</i> ifc. qui déshonore, qui tourne en ridicule — <a href="#entry-viduu_saka" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. bouffon, rôle de théâtre burlesque de compagnon d'enfance du prince-héros; il joue les corrupteurs, et sert de bouc émissaire; il doit être brâhmane, ou d'une caste supérieure au prince, et parle sanskrit; il porte un bâton tordu [<a href="#entry-ku_tilaka" class="skt-link">kuṭilaka</a>], et lui-même est estropié et chauve; il est associé symboliquement à <a href="#entry-Uvaru_na" class="skt-link">Varuṇa</a> et à <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Umaitreya_1" class="skt-link">Maitreya_1</a>, <a href="#entry-Umaadhavya" class="skt-link">Mādhavya</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvasantaka" class="skt-link">Vasantaka</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvaikhaanasa" class="skt-link">Vaikhānasa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viduu_sita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विदूषित</span> <i>vidūṣita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-viduu_s" class="skt-link">vidūṣ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-viduu_sita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-viduu_sita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-viduu_sitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vidūṣitā</i> souillé; calomnié, outragé, insulté — <a href="#entry-viduu_sita" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. rhét. calomnie, insulte; attaque <i>ad</i> <i>hominem</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viduura">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विदूर</span> <i>vidūra</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-duura" class="skt-link">dūra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-viduura" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-viduura" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-viduuraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vidūrā</i> distant, très éloigné <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qu'on ne peut atteindre par ⟨g.⟩.<br> <i>vidūrāt</i> var. <i>vidūratas</i> adv. de loin; au loin.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viduuraja">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vidūraja</i> var. <i>viḍūraja</i> [<a href="#entry-ja" class="skt-link">ja</a>] <a href="#entry-viduuraja" class="skt-link">n.</a> béryl bleu, aigue-marine <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pierre précieuse (œil de chat, lapis lazuli, etc.).<br> <a href="#entry-viduura" class="skt-link">vidūra</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidvadgo_s_thii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vidvadgoṣṭhī</i> [<a href="#entry-go_s_thii" class="skt-link">goṣṭhī</a>] <a href="#entry-vidvadgo_s_thii" class="skt-link">f.</a> débat scholastique entre lettrés.<br> <a href="#entry-vidvat" class="skt-link">vidvat</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidvas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विद्वस्</span> <i>vidvas</i> [ppft. <a href="#entry-vid_1" class="skt-link">vid_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vidvas" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vidvas" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vidu_sii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viduṣī</i> savant, sage, érudit; intelligent; expert, versé dans ⟨acc. loc. iic.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidvat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विद्वत्</span> <i>vidvat</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-vidvas" class="skt-link">vidvas</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidvatsabhaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vidvatsabhā</i> [<a href="#entry-sabhaa" class="skt-link">sabhā</a>] <a href="#entry-vidvatsabhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> assemblée de savants; colloque scientifique.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidvattaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vidvattā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-vidvattaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> science; expertise, connaissance, érudition.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidvattva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vidvattva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-vidvattva" class="skt-link">n.</a> science; expertise, connaissance, érudition.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidve_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विद्वेष</span> <i>vidveṣa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vidvi_s_1" class="skt-link">vidviṣ_1</a>] <a href="#entry-vidve_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> haine, hostilité; aversion envers ⟨loc.⟩.<br> <i>vidveṣaṃ</i> <i>kṛ</i> être hostile envers ⟨loc.⟩.<br> <i>vidveṣaṃ</i> <i>gam</i> être odieux à l'égard de ⟨loc.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidvi_s_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विद्विष्ट</span> <i>vidviṣṭa</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vidvi_s_1" class="skt-link">vidviṣ_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vidvi_s_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vidvi_s_ta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vidvi_s_taa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vidviṣṭā</i> haï, détesté, odieux; hostile à ⟨loc.⟩ — ifc. contraire à.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidvi_s_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विद्विष्</span> <i>vidviṣ_1</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-dvi_s_1" class="skt-link">dviṣ_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(vidveṣṭi)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vidviṣṭa</i><i>)</i> ppr. <i>(vidviṣat)</i> haïr, détester — pr. md. <i>(vidveṣṭe)</i> se détester mutuellement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidvi_s_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विद्विष्</span> <i>vidviṣ_2</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vidvi_s_1" class="skt-link">vidviṣ_1</a>] <a href="#entry-vidvi_s_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> ennemi.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidvi_sat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विद्विषत्</span> <i>vidviṣat</i> [ppr. <a href="#entry-vidvi_s_1" class="skt-link">vidviṣ_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vidvi_sat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vidvi_sat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vidvi_santii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vidviṣantī</i> ennemi — <a href="#entry-vidvi_sat" class="skt-link">m.</a> id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidyaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विद्या</span> <i>vidyā</i> [<a href="#entry-vid_1" class="skt-link">vid_1</a>-<a href="#entry-yaa_3" class="skt-link">yā_3</a>] <a href="#entry-vidyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> science, connaissance, savoir, sagesse <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> tradition sacrée; le <a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a>, connaissance révélée <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. formule magique <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-zaivasiddhaanta" class="skt-link">śaivasiddhānta</a>] aspect du <a href="#entry-bindu" class="skt-link">bindu</a> associé à <a href="#entry-Usadaaziva" class="skt-link">Sadāśiva</a>-<a href="#entry-Uaghora" class="skt-link">Aghora</a>.<br> <i>vidyāṃ</i> <i>prapad</i> accéder à la connaissance.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidyaa_sa_dak_sarii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vidyāṣaḍakṣarī</i> [<a href="#entry-_sa_d" class="skt-link">ṣaḍ</a>-<a href="#entry-ak_sara" class="skt-link">akṣara</a>] <a href="#entry-vidyaa_sa_dak_sarii" class="skt-link">f.</a> bd. formule en 6 syllabes; cf. <a href="#entry-om" class="skt-link">om</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidyaabhuu_sa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vidyābhūṣaṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-bhuu_sa_na" class="skt-link">bhūṣaṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-vidyaabhuu_sa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> soc. np. de Vidyābhūṣaṇa, titre de lettré.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidyaadaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vidyādāna</i> [<a href="#entry-daana" class="skt-link">dāna</a>] <a href="#entry-vidyaadaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> instruction; enseignement du savoir sacré.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidyaadhara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vidyādhara</i> [<a href="#entry-dhara" class="skt-link">dhara</a>] <a href="#entry-vidyaadhara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vidyaadharii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vidyādharī</i> myth. [«porteur de sagesse»] classe de génies aériens, magiciens de la suite de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>, considérés comme des demi-dieux [<a href="#entry-upadeva" class="skt-link">upadeva</a>]; éternellement jeunes, de grande beauté, ils changent d'apparence à volonté [<a href="#entry-kaamaruupin" class="skt-link">kāmarūpin</a>]; on les représente portant des guirlandes dans le ciel; cf. <a href="#entry-Ukandarpaketu" class="skt-link">Kandarpaketu</a>, <a href="#entry-Ujiimuutavaahana" class="skt-link">Jīmūtavāhana</a>, <a href="#entry-Umaanasavega" class="skt-link">Mānasavega</a>, <a href="#entry-Usudarzana_1" class="skt-link">Sudarśana_1</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. myth. np. des génies Vidyādharās; [<a href="#entry-Ub_rhatkathaa" class="skt-link">Bṛhatkathā</a>] <a href="#entry-Unaravaahanadatta" class="skt-link">Naravāhanadatta</a> devint leur roi <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bd. titre de lamas tibétains.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidyaadhikaarin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vidyādhikārin</i> [<a href="#entry-adhikaarin" class="skt-link">adhikārin</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vidyaadhikaarin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vidyaadhikaarin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vidyaadhikaari_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vidyādhikāriṇī</i> soc. en charge du savoir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidyaakara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vidyākara</i> [<a href="#entry-kara_1" class="skt-link">kara_1</a>] <a href="#entry-vidyaakara" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. du poète bengali bouddhiste Vidyākara (début 12⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle); il est le compilateur du <a href="#entry-Usubhaa_sitaratnakoza" class="skt-link">Subhāṣitaratnakośa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidyaalaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vidyālaya</i> [<a href="#entry-aalaya" class="skt-link">ālaya</a>] <a href="#entry-vidyaalaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> école, collège.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidyaanaatha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vidyānātha</i> [<a href="#entry-naatha" class="skt-link">nātha</a>] <a href="#entry-vidyaanaatha" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. du lettré Vidyānātha, auteur du <a href="#entry-Uprataaparudriiya" class="skt-link">Pratāparudrīya</a> (début du 14⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidyaanipu_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vidyānipuṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-nipu_na" class="skt-link">nipuṇa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vidyaanipu_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vidyaanipu_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vidyaanipu_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vidyānipuṇā</i> qui réussit dans ses études.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidyaapati">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vidyāpati</i> [<a href="#entry-pati" class="skt-link">pati</a>] <a href="#entry-vidyaapati" class="skt-link">m.</a> «maître du savoir», titre de lettré [<a href="#entry-pa_n_dita" class="skt-link">paṇḍita</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Vidyāpati, ministre du roi <a href="#entry-Uindradyumna" class="skt-link">Indradyumna</a>, envoyé en éclaireur au <a href="#entry-Upuru_sottamak_setra" class="skt-link">Puruṣottamakṣetra</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. du poète Vidyāpati_1 de <a href="#entry-Umithilaa" class="skt-link">Mithilā</a>, auteur de poèmes dévotionnels <a href="#entry-vai_s_nava" class="skt-link">vaiṣṇava</a> (début du 15⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidyaapii_tha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vidyāpīṭha</i> [<a href="#entry-pii_tha" class="skt-link">pīṭha</a>] <a href="#entry-vidyaapii_tha" class="skt-link">n.</a> [«siège de savoir»] école, collège, université <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. trône de présentation d'un manuscrit shivaïte [<a href="#entry-aagama" class="skt-link">āgama</a>] à consacrer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidyaara_nya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vidyāraṇya</i> [<a href="#entry-ra_nya" class="skt-link">raṇya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vidyaara_nya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vidyaara_nya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vidyaara_nyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vidyāraṇyā</i> qui prend plaisir au savoir — <a href="#entry-vidyaara_nya" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. de Vidyāraṇya, nom d'ascète de <a href="#entry-Umaadhavaacaarya" class="skt-link">Mādhavācārya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidyaarambha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vidyārambha</i> [<a href="#entry-rambha" class="skt-link">rambha</a>] <a href="#entry-vidyaarambha" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. cérémonie de début des études primaires d'un garçon, vers l'âge de cinq ans; le maître remet un bâton de craie [<a href="#entry-kha_dii" class="skt-link">khaḍī</a>] à l'élève et commence à lui apprendre à écrire.<br> <i>sarasvatī</i> <i>namastubhyam</i> <i>varade</i> <i>kāmarūpiṇī</i> <i>vidyārambham</i> <i>kariṣyāmi</i> <i>siddhirbhavatu</i> <i>me</i> <i>sadā</i> Ô déesse <a href="#entry-Usarasvatii" class="skt-link">Sarasvatī</a> à l'aspect enchanteur, je te vénère; alors que je commence mes études, accorde moi toujours la connaissance.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidyaarthin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vidyārthin</i> var. <i>vidyarthin</i> [<a href="#entry-arthin" class="skt-link">arthin</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vidyaarthin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vidyaarthin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vidyaarthinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vidyārthinī</i> qui désire apprendre — <a href="#entry-vidyaarthin" class="skt-link">m.</a> étudiant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidyaasaagara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vidyāsāgara</i> [<a href="#entry-saagara" class="skt-link">sāgara</a>] <a href="#entry-vidyaasaagara" class="skt-link">m.</a> «Océan de savoir», titre d'érudit en sanskrit.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidyaasthaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vidyāsthāna</i> [<a href="#entry-sthaana" class="skt-link">sthāna</a>] <a href="#entry-vidyaasthaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. [«siège du savoir»] branche de la connaissance; la tradition en distingue 14: les 4 Savoirs [<a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a>], les 6 disciplines annexes [<a href="#entry-vedaafga" class="skt-link">vedāṅga</a>], et les 4 disciplines secondaires [<a href="#entry-upaafga" class="skt-link">upāṅga</a>]: la logique [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>], l'exégèse [<a href="#entry-miimaa_msaa" class="skt-link">mīmāṃsā</a>], le droit [<a href="#entry-dharmazaastra" class="skt-link">dharmaśāstra</a>] et les récits d'antan [<a href="#entry-puraa_na" class="skt-link">purāṇa</a>].<br> <a href="#entry-vidyaa" class="skt-link">vidyā</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidyaav_rddha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vidyāvṛddha</i> [<a href="#entry-v_rddha" class="skt-link">vṛddha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vidyaav_rddha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vidyaav_rddha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vidyaav_rddhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vidyāvṛddhā</i> supérieur par la science; avancé en connaissances.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidyaavaaridhi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vidyāvāridhi</i> [<a href="#entry-vaaridhi" class="skt-link">vāridhi</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vidyaavaaridhi" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vidyaavaaridhi" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vidyaavaaridhi" class="skt-link">f.</a> soc. [«océan de science»] titulaire d'un doctorat.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidyaavat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vidyāvat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vidyaavat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vidyaavat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vidyaavatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vidyāvatī</i> qui possède la connaissance; savant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidyamaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विद्यमान</span> <i>vidyamāna</i> [ppr. ps. <a href="#entry-vid_2" class="skt-link">vid_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vidyamaana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vidyamaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vidyamaanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vidyamānā</i> qui se trouve, qui existe; existant, réel.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidyota">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विद्योत</span> <i>vidyota</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vidyut_1" class="skt-link">vidyut_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vidyota" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vidyota" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vidyotaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vidyotā</i> étincelant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidyudduuta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vidyuddūta</i> [<a href="#entry-duuta" class="skt-link">dūta</a>] <a href="#entry-vidyudduuta" class="skt-link">m.</a> mod. message électronique.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidyudvallii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vidyudvallī</i> [<a href="#entry-vallii" class="skt-link">vallī</a>] <a href="#entry-vidyudvallii" class="skt-link">f.</a> éclair.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidyunmaalin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vidyunmālin</i> [<a href="#entry-maalin" class="skt-link">mālin</a>] <a href="#entry-vidyunmaalin" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de l'<a href="#entry-asura" class="skt-link">asura</a> Vidyunmālī «Couronné d'éclairs», fils de <a href="#entry-Utaaraka" class="skt-link">Tāraka</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Utripura" class="skt-link">Tripura</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vidyut_2" class="skt-link">vidyut_2</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidyunmat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vidyunmat</i> [<a href="#entry-mat" class="skt-link">mat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vidyunmat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vidyunmat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vidyunmatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vidyunmatī</i> accompagné d'éclairs.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidyut_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विद्युत्</span> <i>vidyut_1</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-dyut_1" class="skt-link">dyut_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(vidyotate)</i> briller (comme l'éclair) — ca. <i>(vidyotayati)</i> illuminer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidyut_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विद्युत्</span> <i>vidyut_2</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vidyut_1" class="skt-link">vidyut_1</a>] <a href="#entry-vidyut_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> éclair; foudre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [ChU.] np. de Vidyut, l'Éclair personnifié comme quart [<a href="#entry-kalaa" class="skt-link">kalā</a>] de l'aspect radiant [<a href="#entry-jyoti_smat" class="skt-link">jyotiṣmat</a>] du <a href="#entry-brahman" class="skt-link">brahman</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> mod. électricité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pali <i>vijju</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidyutkanda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vidyutkanda</i> [<a href="#entry-kanda" class="skt-link">kanda</a>] <a href="#entry-vidyutkanda" class="skt-link">m.</a> mod. ampoule électrique.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vidyutvat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vidyutvat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vidyutvat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vidyutvat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vidyutvatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vidyutvatī</i> muni de l'éclair.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vig_rhya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विगृह्य</span> <i>vigṛhya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-vigrah" class="skt-link">vigrah</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vig_rhya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vig_rhya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vig_rhyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vigṛhyā</i> qui doit être séparé ou isolé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. indépendant (<a href="#entry-padapaa_tha" class="skt-link">padapāṭha</a>) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hostile, agressif, inamical — ind. ayant séparé; s'étant querellé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vig_rhyagamana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vigṛhyagamana</i> [<a href="#entry-gamana" class="skt-link">gamana</a>] <a href="#entry-vig_rhyagamana" class="skt-link">n.</a> mouvement hostile.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vig_rhyasambhaa_saa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vigṛhyasambhāṣā</i> [<a href="#entry-sambhaa_saa" class="skt-link">sambhāṣā</a>] <a href="#entry-vig_rhyasambhaa_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> dispute; opp. <a href="#entry-sandhaayasambhaa_saa" class="skt-link">saṃdhāyasambhāṣā</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vig_rhya" class="skt-link">vigṛhya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vig_rhyavaada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vigṛhyavāda</i> [<a href="#entry-vaada" class="skt-link">vāda</a>] <a href="#entry-vig_rhyavaada" class="skt-link">m.</a> dispute.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vigaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विगा</span> <i>vigā</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-gaa_2" class="skt-link">gā_2</a>] pp. <i>(</i><i>vigīta</i><i>)</i> ps. <i>(gīyate)</i> être blâmé, être contredit.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vigaa_dha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विगाढ</span> <i>vigāḍha</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vigaah" class="skt-link">vigāh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vigaa_dha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vigaa_dha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vigaa_dhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vigāḍhā</i> plongé, immergé, absorbé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> où l'on plonge, où l'on a pénétré; dont on s'est emparé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vigaah">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विगाह्</span> <i>vigāh</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-gaah" class="skt-link">gāh</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(vigāhate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vigāḍha</i><i>)</i> se plonger dans, baigner, être immergé dans ⟨loc. acc.⟩; pénétrer, s'absorber dans.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vigal">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विगल्</span> <i>vigal</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-gal" class="skt-link">gal</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vigalati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vigalita</i><i>)</i> tomber, s'écouler; s'évanouir, disparaître.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vigalita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vigacchati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vigata</i><i>)</i> s'en aller, partir, disparaître; mourir; passer (temps).

</div>

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(vighaṭṭate)</i> casser, détruire — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(vighaṭṭayati)</i> enfoncer (porte); disperser; agiter, frotter.
  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vighaata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

[<span class="skt-grammar">9</span>] pr. <i>(vigṛhṇāti)</i> pr. md. <i>(vigṛhṇīte)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vigṛhīta</i><i>)</i> saisir, agripper; combattre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> reconnaître, séparer, isoler.<br> <i>keśe</i> <i>vigrah</i> saisir par les cheveux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vigraha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>
