<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vihiinataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vihīnatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-vihiinataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> privation; manque de ⟨iic.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vihiinayoni">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vihīnayoni</i> [<a href="#entry-yoni" class="skt-link">yoni</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vihiinayoni" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vihiinayoni" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vihiinayoni" class="skt-link">f.</a> de vile origine, de race inférieure.<br> <a href="#entry-vihiina" class="skt-link">vihīna</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vihita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विहित</span> <i>vihita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vidhaa_1" class="skt-link">vidhā_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vihita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vihita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vihitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vihitā</i> attribué, prescrit, institué, ordonné, fixé; destiné <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> accompli, effectué; muni, pourvu de ⟨i. iic.⟩ — <a href="#entry-vihita" class="skt-link">n.</a> prescription, ordonnance, attribution.<br> <i>vihitāñjali</i> a. m. n. f. qui fait l'<a href="#entry-a_njali" class="skt-link">añjali</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vihitatva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vihitatva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-vihitatva" class="skt-link">n.</a> prescription.<br> <a href="#entry-vihita" class="skt-link">vihita</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vihuu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विहू</span> <i>vihū</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-huu" class="skt-link">hū</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(vihvayate)</i> invoquer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vihval">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विह्वल्</span> <i>vihval</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-hval" class="skt-link">hval</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vihvalati)</i> pr. md. <i>(vihvalate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vihvalita</i><i>)</i> trébucher, chanceler <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> (au fig.) être troublé, douter.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vihvala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विह्वल</span> <i>vihvala</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vihval" class="skt-link">vihval</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vihvala" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vihvala" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vihvalaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vihvalā</i> troublé; qui n'est pas maître de soi.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vihvalita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विह्वलित</span> <i>vihvalita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vihval" class="skt-link">vihval</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vihvalita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vihvalita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vihvalitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vihvalitā</i> qui trébuche, qui chancelle <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> troublé, perplexe.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vii_naa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वीणा</span> <i>vīṇā</i> <a href="#entry-vii_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> mus. sorte de luth en bois de jacquier, à 2 caisses et 7 cordes (4 dessus pour la mélodie, 3 sur les côtés pour le rythme); on en joue à plat, posé sur les genoux, jambes en tailleur; on trouve les variantes <a href="#entry-rudravii_naa" class="skt-link">rudravīṇā</a> (Inde du Nord), <a href="#entry-sarasvatiivii_naa" class="skt-link">sarasvatīvīṇā</a> (Inde du Sud).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vii_naa_damaruvaadya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vīṇāḍamaruvādya</i> [<a href="#entry-_damaru" class="skt-link">ḍamaru</a>-<a href="#entry-vaadya" class="skt-link">vādya</a>] <a href="#entry-vii_naa_damaruvaadya" class="skt-link">n.</a> pl. <i>vīṇāḍamaruvādyāni</i> les performances de luth et de tambourin, l'un des 64 arts [<a href="#entry-kalaa" class="skt-link">kalā</a>].<br> <a href="#entry-vii_naa" class="skt-link">vīṇā</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vii_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वीट</span> <i>vīṭa</i> <a href="#entry-vii_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vii_taa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vīṭā</i> morceau de bois porté dans la bouche par les ascètes comme pénitence.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vii_tamukha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vīṭamukha</i> [<a href="#entry-mukha" class="skt-link">mukha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vii_tamukha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vii_tamukha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vii_tamukhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vīṭamukhā</i> qui a le <a href="#entry-vii_ta" class="skt-link">vīṭa</a> en bouche.<br> <a href="#entry-vii_ta" class="skt-link">vīṭa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vii_tii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वीटी</span> <i>vīṭī</i> <a href="#entry-vii_tii" class="skt-link">f.</a> natu. bot. <i>Piper betel</i>, bétel.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vii_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">वी</span> <i>vī_1</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(veti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vīta_1</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>pra</i><i>)</i> se mouvoir; approcher; accepter; saisir, profiter de <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> attaquer, s'emparer de; punir <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> amorcer, inciter.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vii_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वी</span> <i>vī_2</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vii_1" class="skt-link">vī_1</a>] ifc. a. <a href="#entry-vii_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vii_2" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vii_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> incliné à, désireux de, prêt à ⟨g.⟩ — ifc. propulsé par — <a href="#entry-vii_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> fait d'aller, mouvement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vii_3">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वी</span> <i>vī_3</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-i" class="skt-link">i</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(vyeti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vīta_2</i><i>)</i> ppr. <i>(viyat)</i> se séparer, se disperser; se répandre dans; se dissiper, disparaître, cesser.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viici">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वीचि</span> <i>vīci</i> <a href="#entry-viici" class="skt-link">m.</a> vague, onde, houle.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viij">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">वीज्</span> <i>vīj</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vījati)</i> éventer, refroidir en soufflant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viija">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वीज</span> <i>vīja</i> cf. <a href="#entry-biija" class="skt-link">bīja</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viik_s">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वीक्ष्</span> <i>vīkṣ</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-iik_s" class="skt-link">īkṣ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(vīkṣate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vīkṣita</i><i>)</i> abs. <i>(</i><i>vīkṣya</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>abhi</i>, <i>ut</i><i>)</i> voir, regarder, observer, considérer, contempler <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> apercevoir, distinguer, reconnaître.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viik_sa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वीक्षण</span> <i>vīkṣaṇa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-viik_s" class="skt-link">vīkṣ</a>] <a href="#entry-viik_sa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> observation, considération, contemplation; examen, enquête, investigation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>] méditation; cf. <a href="#entry-a_s_taafgayoga" class="skt-link">aṣṭāṅgayoga</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viik_sita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वीक्षित</span> <i>vīkṣita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-viik_s" class="skt-link">vīkṣ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-viik_sita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-viik_sita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-viik_sitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vīkṣitā</i> contemplé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viips">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वीप्स्</span> <i>vīps</i> [dés. <a href="#entry-vyaap" class="skt-link">vyāp</a>] v. pr. <i>(vīpsati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vīpsita</i><i>)</i> désirer se répandre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viipsaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वीप्सा</span> <i>vīpsā</i> [act. <a href="#entry-viips" class="skt-link">vīps</a>] <a href="#entry-viipsaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> distribution, répétition, succession <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. not. répétition de mots pour signifier la répétition ou la continuité d'une action.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viira">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वीर</span> <i>vīra</i> <a href="#entry-viira" class="skt-link">m.</a> mâle, guerrier, héros, chef; époux, fils <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [esthétique] l'héroïsme, un des 9 modes artistiques [<a href="#entry-rasa" class="skt-link">rasa</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. de l'<a href="#entry-asura" class="skt-link">asura</a> Vīra «Héros», fils de <a href="#entry-Udanaayu" class="skt-link">Danāyu</a> et <a href="#entry-Ukazyapa" class="skt-link">Kaśyapa</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. de Vīra_1 <a href="#entry-Unarasi_mha_6" class="skt-link">Narasiṃha_6</a>, fils de Narasa <a href="#entry-Unaayaka" class="skt-link">Nāyaka</a>, régent de <a href="#entry-Uvijayanagara" class="skt-link">Vijayanagara</a>; à la mort de son père en 1503 il continua la régence; le dauphin légitime Immadi ayant été assassiné en 1505, <a href="#entry-Uviira_1" class="skt-link">Vīra_1</a> <a href="#entry-Unarasi_mha_6" class="skt-link">Narasiṃha_6</a> devint roi, créant la dynastie Tuluva; en 1509 son frère <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_nadeva" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇadeva</a> <a href="#entry-Uraaya" class="skt-link">Rāya</a> lui succéda <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>vir</i>; fr. viril.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viiraasana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vīrāsana</i> [<a href="#entry-aasana" class="skt-link">āsana</a>] <a href="#entry-viiraasana" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>] posture assise avec un pied sur une cuisse, l'autre pied étant ramené sous cette cuisse.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viirabhadra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vīrabhadra</i> [<a href="#entry-bhadra" class="skt-link">bhadra</a>] <a href="#entry-viirabhadra" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Vīrabhadra, aspect terrible de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> «Prêt à la guerre», qu'il prit pour détruire le sacrifice de <a href="#entry-Udak_sa" class="skt-link">Dakṣa</a>; il a 1000 têtes, 1000 yeux, 1000 bras portant une massue et 1000 jambes; il porte un <a href="#entry-lifga" class="skt-link">liṅga</a> dans les cheveux; il est souvent représenté avec le bras droit tenant une épée dressée, le bras gauche portant la tête tranchée de <a href="#entry-Udak_sa" class="skt-link">Dakṣa</a>, et derrière lui un loup attendant la tête à ronger; il se transforma en <a href="#entry-zarabha" class="skt-link">śarabha</a> pour mettre fin à l'incarnation de <a href="#entry-Unarasi_mha" class="skt-link">Narasiṃha</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. du prince <a href="#entry-Ucaalukya" class="skt-link">Cālukya</a> de l'Est Vīrabhadra_1; il épousa la reine <a href="#entry-Urudramadevii" class="skt-link">Rudramadevī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viiraka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vīraka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] <a href="#entry-viiraka" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uharacaritacintaama_ni" class="skt-link">Haracaritacintāmaṇi</a>] np. de Vīraka «Petit héros», épith. de <a href="#entry-Unandii" class="skt-link">Nandī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viiramelaapa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vīramelāpa</i> [<a href="#entry-melaapa" class="skt-link">melāpa</a>] <a href="#entry-viiramelaapa" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. [«réunion virile»] rituel <a href="#entry-krama" class="skt-link">krama</a> secret d'orgie collective; syn. <a href="#entry-cakramelaka" class="skt-link">cakramelaka</a>, <a href="#entry-cakrakrii_daa" class="skt-link">cakrakrīḍā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viiramitrodaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vīramitrodaya</i> [<a href="#entry-mitrodaya" class="skt-link">mitrodaya</a>] <a href="#entry-viiramitrodaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du Vīramitrodaya de <a href="#entry-Umitra_1" class="skt-link">Mitra_1</a> <a href="#entry-Umizra" class="skt-link">Miśra</a>, vaste recueil de <a href="#entry-dharmazaastra" class="skt-link">dharmaśāstra</a> (1610–1640).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viirapatnii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vīrapatnī</i> [<a href="#entry-patnii" class="skt-link">patnī</a>] <a href="#entry-viirapatnii" class="skt-link">f.</a> épouse d'un héros.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viirarasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vīrarasa</i> [<a href="#entry-rasa" class="skt-link">rasa</a>] <a href="#entry-viirarasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. le sentiment héroïque, un des 9 modes artistiques [<a href="#entry-rasa" class="skt-link">rasa</a>]; on lui associe la couleur orange clair et la divinité <a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viirasena">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vīrasena</i> [<a href="#entry-senaa" class="skt-link">senā</a>] <a href="#entry-viirasena" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. de Vīrasena «à l'armée de héros», roi des <a href="#entry-Uni_sadhaas" class="skt-link">Niṣadhās</a>, père de <a href="#entry-Unala" class="skt-link">Nala</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. du maître <a href="#entry-aacaarya" class="skt-link">ācārya</a> Vīrasena_1, mathématicien, géomètre et poète jaïne du 9⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle; <a href="#entry-Ujinasena" class="skt-link">Jinasena</a> fut son disciple.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viirastambha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vīrastambha</i> [<a href="#entry-stambha" class="skt-link">stambha</a>] <a href="#entry-viirastambha" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. stèle commémorant les prouesses d'un héros; on en trouve dans le Deccan et au Bengale <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> kannara viirakkal.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viirazaiva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vīraśaiva</i> [<a href="#entry-zaiva" class="skt-link">śaiva</a>] <a href="#entry-viirazaiva" class="skt-link">m.</a> pl. nom d'une secte <a href="#entry-zaiva" class="skt-link">śaiva</a> du <a href="#entry-Ukar_naa_ta" class="skt-link">Karṇāṭa</a> dont les membres portent autour du cou un petit <a href="#entry-lifga" class="skt-link">liṅga</a>; leurs morts sont enterrés plutôt que brûlés; cf. <a href="#entry-lifgaayat" class="skt-link">liṅgāyat</a>, <a href="#entry-jafgama" class="skt-link">jaṅgama</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viirezvara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vīreśvara</i> [<a href="#entry-iizvara" class="skt-link">īśvara</a>] <a href="#entry-viirezvara" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. de Vīreśvara, fils de <a href="#entry-Ubha_t_toji" class="skt-link">Bhaṭṭoji</a> <a href="#entry-Udiik_sita" class="skt-link">Dīkṣita</a>, père de <a href="#entry-Uhari_1" class="skt-link">Hari_1</a> <a href="#entry-Udiik_sita" class="skt-link">Dīkṣita</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-viira" class="skt-link">vīra</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viirudh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वीरुध्</span> <i>vīrudh</i> <a href="#entry-viirudh" class="skt-link">f.</a> plante, herbe; not. liane ou buisson.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viirya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वीर्य</span> <i>vīrya</i> [<a href="#entry-viira" class="skt-link">vīra</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-viirya" class="skt-link">n.</a> valeur, héroïsme; prouesse <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> énergie, vigueur, virilité, force <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bd. la vigueur, une des 6 perfections [<a href="#entry-paaramitaa" class="skt-link">pāramitā</a>] d'un accompli [<a href="#entry-bodhisattva" class="skt-link">bodhisattva</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> sperme.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viiryavat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viitihotra">

    <i>vītihotra</i> [<a href="#entry-hotra" class="skt-link">hotra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-viitihotra" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-viitihotra" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-viitihotraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vītihotrā</i> qui invite au festin <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. invité au festin (des dieux); épith. d'<a href="#entry-Uagni" class="skt-link">Agni</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Vītihotra, ainé des 100 fils du roi <a href="#entry-Utaalajafgha" class="skt-link">Tālajaṅgha</a>; lorsque son père fut vaincu par <a href="#entry-Uparazuraama" class="skt-link">Paraśurāma</a>, il se réfugia dans l'<a href="#entry-Uhimaalaya" class="skt-link">Himālaya</a>, dont il redescendit lorsque celui-ci partit comme ermite au Mont <a href="#entry-Umahendra_1" class="skt-link">Mahendra_1</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. myth. np. des Vītihotrās, ses descendants.<br> <a href="#entry-viiti" class="skt-link">vīti</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vij">

</div>

    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विजन</span> <i>vijana</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-jana" class="skt-link">jana</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vijana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vijana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vijanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vijanā</i> sans hommes, solitaire.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vijaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विजय</span> <i>vijaya</i> [act. <a href="#entry-viji" class="skt-link">viji</a>] <a href="#entry-vijaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> victoire, conquête sur ⟨g. iic.⟩; triomphe; succès <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> butin <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. de Vijaya «le Victorieux», nom d'exil d'<a href="#entry-Uarjuna" class="skt-link">Arjuna</a> au royaume de <a href="#entry-Uviraa_ta" class="skt-link">Virāṭa</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Vijaya_1, l'un des deux <a href="#entry-dvaarapaala" class="skt-link">dvārapāla</a> de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. de Vijaya_2, prince fondateur cinghalais, vers 500 ant.; cf. <a href="#entry-Uanuraadha" class="skt-link">Anurādha</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> véd. np. de Vijaya_3 «Victoire», javelot de <a href="#entry-Urudra" class="skt-link">Rudra</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] arc Vijaya_4 que <a href="#entry-Uvizvakarmaa" class="skt-link">Viśvakarmā</a> avait fait pour <a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a>, et que <a href="#entry-Ujaamadagnya" class="skt-link">Jāmadagnya</a> donna à <a href="#entry-Ukar_na" class="skt-link">Karṇa</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-bhaargava" class="skt-link">bhārgava</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> géo. np. de la principauté de Vijaya_5 du royaume hindouïsé du <a href="#entry-Ucampaa_1" class="skt-link">Campā_1</a> au Sud-Vietnam <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> astr. np. de Vijaya_5 «Victorieux», personnifiant l'an 27 d'un cycle de vie [<a href="#entry-sa_mvatsara" class="skt-link">saṃvatsara</a>] — <a href="#entry-vijaya" class="skt-link">n.</a> tente royale — a. <a href="#entry-vijaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vijaya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vijayaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vijayā</i> qui mène à la victoire; victorieux — <a href="#entry-vijayaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vijayā</i> soc. [<a href="#entry-tantra" class="skt-link">tantra</a>] boisson de chanvre broyé [<a href="#entry-bhafgaa" class="skt-link">bhaṅgā</a>] bue lors des rituels.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vijayabha_t_taarikaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vijayabhaṭṭārikā</i> [<a href="#entry-bha_t_taarikaa" class="skt-link">bhaṭṭārikā</a>] <a href="#entry-vijayabha_t_taarikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> hist. np. de la reine Vijayabhaṭṭārikā, qui assura la régence du trône <a href="#entry-Ucaalukya" class="skt-link">Cālukya</a> de <a href="#entry-Uvaataapi" class="skt-link">Vātāpi</a> (mod. Badāmi) entre 649 et 655; <a href="#entry-Uvikramaaditya_1" class="skt-link">Vikramāditya_1</a> lui succéda, à la mort de son fils mineur; elle était lettrée, et composa le poème <a href="#entry-Ukaumudiimahotsava" class="skt-link">Kaumudīmahotsava</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vijayadazamii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vijayadaśamī</i> [<a href="#entry-dazamii" class="skt-link">daśamī</a>] <a href="#entry-vijayadazamii" class="skt-link">f.</a> soc. 10⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ jour du festival de <a href="#entry-durgaapuujaa" class="skt-link">durgāpūjā</a>, juste après <a href="#entry-navaraatra" class="skt-link">navarātra</a>; il coïncide avec la fête de <a href="#entry-dazaaha" class="skt-link">daśāha</a>, le 10⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ jour de la quinzaine claire du mois <a href="#entry-aazvina" class="skt-link">āśvina</a>; mod. Dassera.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vijayanagara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vijayanagara</i> [<a href="#entry-nagara" class="skt-link">nagara</a>] <a href="#entry-vijayanagara" class="skt-link">n.</a> géo. np. de Vijayanagara «Cité de la Victoire», capitale de l'empire du <a href="#entry-Ukar_naa_ta" class="skt-link">Karṇāṭa</a>, sur la rive Sud de la <a href="#entry-Utufgabhadraa" class="skt-link">Tuṅgabhadrā</a> (mod. Hampi, près de Hospet); ses origines mythiques sont associées à <a href="#entry-Uki_skindhaa" class="skt-link">Kiṣkindhā</a>; lors de la conquête de Warangal par Malik Kafur en 1323, les frères <a href="#entry-Uharihara_1" class="skt-link">Harihara_1</a> et <a href="#entry-Ubukka_1" class="skt-link">Bukka_1</a>, ministres du roi <a href="#entry-Uprataaparudra_1" class="skt-link">Pratāparudra_1</a>, s'enfuirent à <a href="#entry-Ukampili" class="skt-link">Kampili</a>; lors de son invasion en 1327 par l'armée du Sultan Tughluk de Delhi, ils furent faits prisonniers, convertis, et renvoyés là-bas comme gouverneurs; ils fondèrent alors la ville de <a href="#entry-Uvijayanagara" class="skt-link">Vijayanagara</a>, et <a href="#entry-Uharihara_1" class="skt-link">Harihara_1</a> devint son premier empereur en 1336, inaugurant la dynastie <a href="#entry-Usafgama" class="skt-link">Saṅgama</a>; elle fut mise à sac et détruite après la bataille de Tālīkota en 1565; l'empire s'éteindra en 1678 <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> géo. np. de Vijayanagara_1, ville de l'empire <a href="#entry-Ugajapati" class="skt-link">Gajapati</a> au sud du Kalifga, sur la côte Est du Deccan; mod. Viśyanagaram, au nord du pays <a href="#entry-Uandhra" class="skt-link">Andhra</a> [Uttarāndhra].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vijayanta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विजयन्त</span> <i>vijayanta</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-jayanta" class="skt-link">jayanta</a>] <a href="#entry-vijayanta" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Vijayanta «le Victorieux», épith. d'<a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vijayapura">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vijayapura</i> [<a href="#entry-pura" class="skt-link">pura</a>] <a href="#entry-vijayapura" class="skt-link">n.</a> géo. np. de Vijayapura «Ville de la Victoire», capitale du royaume <a href="#entry-Ucaalukya" class="skt-link">Cālukya</a>; mod. Bījāpur au <a href="#entry-Ukar_naa_ta" class="skt-link">Karṇāṭa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vijayasena">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vijayasena</i> [<a href="#entry-sena" class="skt-link">sena</a>] <a href="#entry-vijayasena" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. du roi Vijayasena, fils de <a href="#entry-Uhemantasena" class="skt-link">Hemantasena</a>; il régna sur le Bengale de 1096 à 1159; son fils <a href="#entry-Uvallaalasena" class="skt-link">Vallālasena</a> lui succéda.<br> <a href="#entry-vijaya" class="skt-link">vijaya</a>
  </div>
</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विजिघ्र</span> <i>vijighra</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-jighra" class="skt-link">jighra</a>] ifc. a. <a href="#entry-vijighra" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vijighra" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vijighraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vijighrā</i> qui renifle.

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vijigii_s">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विजिगीष्</span> <i>vijigīṣ</i> [dés. <a href="#entry-vij" class="skt-link">vij</a>] v. pr. <i>(vijigīṣati)</i> v. pr. md. <i>(vijigīṣate)</i> vouloir vaincre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vijigii_su">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विजिगीषु</span> <i>vijigīṣu</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vijigii_s" class="skt-link">vijigīṣ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vijigii_su" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vijigii_su" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vijigii_su" class="skt-link">f.</a> qui veut gagner; ambitieux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. «Ambitieux de conquête», titre royal; <a href="#entry-Ukau_tilya" class="skt-link">Kauṭilya</a> en pare le prince <a href="#entry-Ubindusaara" class="skt-link">Bindusāra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vijita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विजित</span> <i>vijita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-viji" class="skt-link">viji</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vijita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vijita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vijitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vijitā</i> conquis; battu, dominé, vaincu — <a href="#entry-vijita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vijita" class="skt-link">n.</a> pays conquis; conquête, victoire.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vij_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विज्ञ</span> <i>vijña</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vij_naa_1" class="skt-link">vijñā_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vij_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vij_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vij_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vijñā</i> instruit, érudit — <a href="#entry-vij_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> érudit, savant, sage.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vij_naa_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विज्ञा</span> <i>vijñā_1</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-j_naa_1" class="skt-link">jñā_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">9</span>] pr. <i>(vijānāti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vijñāta</i><i>)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>vijñeya</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>sam</i><i>)</i> reconnaître, percevoir, distinguer, comprendre; reconnaître qqc. ⟨acc.⟩ comme qqc. ⟨acc.⟩; se reconnaître dans ⟨loc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> apprendre qqc. ⟨acc.⟩ de qqn. ⟨g.⟩; s'informer, se cultiver — ca. <i>(vijñapayati)</i> ca. <i>(vijñāpayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vijñapta</i><i>)</i> faire connaître, informer; porter à la connaissance ou au jugement d'un supérieur — ps. <i>(vijñāyate)</i> être connu; être compris <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> (impers.) on sait que, étant entendu que; il est prescrit que.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vij_naa_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विज्ञा</span> <i>vijñā_2</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vij_naa_1" class="skt-link">vijñā_1</a>] <a href="#entry-vij_naa_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> connaissance, savoir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vij_naana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विज्ञान</span> <i>vijñāna</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vij_naa_1" class="skt-link">vijñā_1</a>] <a href="#entry-vij_naana" class="skt-link">n.</a> connaissance, savoir, discernement, compréhension, intellect; science <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. connaissance sacrée, science infuse <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bd. la connaissance discriminante, un des 5 agrégats [<a href="#entry-skandha" class="skt-link">skandha</a>] de l'ego; c'est la 3⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ cause de souffrance [<a href="#entry-pratiityasamutpaada" class="skt-link">pratītyasamutpāda</a>] — ifc. connaissance de, compréhension de <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pali <i>viññāṇa</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vij_naanaam_rta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vijñānāmṛta</i> [<a href="#entry-am_rta" class="skt-link">amṛta</a>] <a href="#entry-vij_naanaam_rta" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Vijñānāmṛta, œuvre phil. de <a href="#entry-Uvij_naanabhik_su" class="skt-link">Vijñānabhikṣu</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vij_naana" class="skt-link">vijñāna</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vij_naanabhairava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vijñānabhairava</i> [<a href="#entry-bhairava" class="skt-link">bhairava</a>] <a href="#entry-vij_naanabhairava" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du Vijñānabhairava <a href="#entry-zaiva" class="skt-link">śaiva</a> <a href="#entry-tantra" class="skt-link">tantra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vij_naanabhairava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vijñānabhairava</i> [<a href="#entry-bhairava" class="skt-link">bhairava</a>] <a href="#entry-vij_naanabhairava" class="skt-link">n.</a> [<i>vijñānabhairavatantra</i>] lit. np. du Vijñānabhairava <a href="#entry-tantra" class="skt-link">tantra</a>, ancien texte ésotérique du shivaïsme du <a href="#entry-Ukazmiira" class="skt-link">Kaśmīra</a>; c'est un chapitre du <a href="#entry-Urudrayaamala" class="skt-link">Rudrayāmala</a> <a href="#entry-tantra" class="skt-link">tantra</a>; il décrit 112 techniques spirituelles de libération.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vij_naanabhik_su">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vijñānabhikṣu</i> [<a href="#entry-bhik_su" class="skt-link">bhikṣu</a>] <a href="#entry-vij_naanabhik_su" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. du philosophe Vijñānabhikṣu (16⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle); il combattit l'interprétation moniste [<a href="#entry-advaita" class="skt-link">advaita</a>] du <a href="#entry-vedaanta" class="skt-link">vedānta</a> et s'efforça d'en réconcilier une interprétation théiste avec le <a href="#entry-saafkhya" class="skt-link">sāṃkhya</a>; il réinterpréta le <a href="#entry-Uyogasuutra" class="skt-link">Yogasūtra</a> de <a href="#entry-Upata_njali_2" class="skt-link">Patañjali_2</a> pour le resituer dans le point de vue du <a href="#entry-vedaanta" class="skt-link">vedānta</a>; on lui doit not. le <a href="#entry-Uyogavaarttika" class="skt-link">Yogavārttika</a>, le <a href="#entry-Uyogasaarasafgraha" class="skt-link">Yogasārasaṃgraha</a>, le <a href="#entry-Usaafkhyapravacanabhaa_sya" class="skt-link">Sāṃkhyapravacanabhāṣya</a>, le <a href="#entry-Usaafkhyasaara" class="skt-link">Sāṃkhyasāra</a> et le <a href="#entry-Uvij_naanaam_rta" class="skt-link">Vijñānāmṛta</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vij_naanamaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vijñānamaya</i> [<a href="#entry-maya" class="skt-link">maya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vij_naanamaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vij_naanamaya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vij_naanamayii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vijñānamayī</i> phil. fait de pur intellect, de la nature du savoir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vij_naanamayakoza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vijñānamayakośa</i> [<a href="#entry-koza" class="skt-link">kośa</a>] <a href="#entry-vij_naanamayakoza" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-vedaanta" class="skt-link">vedānta</a>] l'enveloppe de discernement, formant avec <a href="#entry-manomayakoza" class="skt-link">manomayakośa</a> le corps subtil ou intellectuel [<a href="#entry-suuk_smazariira" class="skt-link">sūkṣmaśarīra</a>].<br> <a href="#entry-vij_naanamaya" class="skt-link">vijñānamaya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vij_naananidhi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vijñānanidhi</i> [<a href="#entry-nidhi" class="skt-link">nidhi</a>] <a href="#entry-vij_naananidhi" class="skt-link">m.</a> mod. trésor culturel (not. manuscrits anciens).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vij_naanavaada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vijñānavāda</i> [<a href="#entry-vaada" class="skt-link">vāda</a>] <a href="#entry-vij_naanavaada" class="skt-link">m.</a> bd. [«voie de la connaissance»] doctrine idéaliste de l'école bouddhiste <a href="#entry-yogaacaara" class="skt-link">yogācāra</a>; opp. <a href="#entry-zuunyavaada" class="skt-link">śūnyavāda</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Uasafga" class="skt-link">Asaṅga</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvasubandhu" class="skt-link">Vasubandhu</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vij_naanavaadin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vijñānavādin</i> [<a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vij_naanavaadin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vij_naanavaadin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vij_naanavaadinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vijñānavādinī</i> tenant de la voie de la connaissance, idéaliste; il affirme que le monde phénoménal n'est constitué que de représentations psychiques.<br> <a href="#entry-vij_naanavaada" class="skt-link">vijñānavāda</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vij_naanin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विज्ञानिन्</span> <i>vijñānin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vij_naa_1" class="skt-link">vijñā_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vij_naanin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vij_naanin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vij_naaninii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vijñāninī</i> érudit; spécialiste.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vij_naap">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विज्ञाप्</span> <i>vijñāp</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-vij_naa_1" class="skt-link">vijñā_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(vijñāpayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vijñāpita</i><i>)</i> faire connaître, informer; porter à la connaissance ou au jugement d'un supérieur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vij_naapana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विज्ञापन</span> <i>vijñāpana</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vij_naap" class="skt-link">vijñāp</a>] <a href="#entry-vij_naapana" class="skt-link">n.</a> information, communication; requête — <a href="#entry-vij_naapanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vijñāpanā</i> id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vij_naata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विज्ञात</span> <i>vijñāta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vij_naa_1" class="skt-link">vijñā_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vij_naata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vij_naata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vij_naanataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vijñānatā</i> discerné, compris, connu <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> fameux; célèbre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vij_naaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विज्ञाय</span> <i>vijñāya</i> [abs. <a href="#entry-vij_naa_1" class="skt-link">vijñā_1</a>] ind. ayant reconnu, ayant discerné.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vij_nap">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विज्ञप्</span> <i>vijñap</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-vij_naa_1" class="skt-link">vijñā_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(jñapayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vijñapta</i><i>)</i> faire connaître, informer; porter à la connaissance ou au jugement d'un supérieur — pr. md. <i>(vijñapayate)</i> s'informer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vij_napta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विज्ञप्त</span> <i>vijñapta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vij_nap" class="skt-link">vijñap</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vij_napta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vij_napta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vij_naptaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vijñaptā</i> diffusé, publié; informé
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vij_napti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विज्ञप्ति</span> <i>vijñapti</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vij_nap" class="skt-link">vijñap</a>] <a href="#entry-vij_napti" class="skt-link">f.</a> information; rapport (à un supérieur) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> requête (à propos de ⟨g.⟩).<br> <i>vijñaptikṛ</i> faire son rapport (à un supérieur) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soumettre une requête (à propos de ⟨g.⟩).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vij_neya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विज्ञेय</span> <i>vijñeya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-vij_naa_1" class="skt-link">vijñā_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vij_neya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vij_neya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vij_neyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vijñeyā</i> reconnaissable, discernable, perceptible <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> à connaître; à considérer comme ⟨nom.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vik_lp">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विकॢप्</span> <i>vikḷp</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-k_lp" class="skt-link">kḷp</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(vikalpate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vikḷpta</i><i>)</i> être indécis, hésiter; être douteux ou facultatif — ca. <i>(vikalpayati)</i> poser un dilemme; présenter un choix <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> conjecturer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vik_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विकृ</span> <i>vikṛ</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-k_r_1" class="skt-link">kṛ_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">8</span>] pr. <i>(vikaroti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vikṛta</i><i>)</i> changer, altérer, déformer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> ruiner; agir en traître, être infidèle à ⟨g. loc.⟩ — pr. md. <i>(vikurute)</i> se déformer, subir un changement — ps. <i>(vikriyate)</i> changer d'humeur, éprouver une joie ou peur subite; changer de forme — ca. <i>(vikārayati)</i> transformer; faire changer (not. d'humeur).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vik_r_s">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विकृष्</span> <i>vikṛṣ</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-k_r_s" class="skt-link">kṛṣ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vikarṣati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vikṛṣṭa</i><i>)</i> tendre (not. l'arc); tirer, traîner.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vik_rr">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विकॄ</span> <i>vikṝ</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-k_rr" class="skt-link">kṝ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">6</span>] pr. <i>(vikirati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vikīrṇa</i><i>)</i> lancer, jeter; répandre, disperser, éparpiller; joncher, couvrir de ⟨i.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vik_rt">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विकृत्</span> <i>vikṛt</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-k_rt_1" class="skt-link">kṛt_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">6</span>] pr. <i>(vikṛntati)</i> couper, trancher, découper, déchirer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vik_rta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विकृत</span> <i>vikṛta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vik_r" class="skt-link">vikṛ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vik_rta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vik_rta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vik_rtaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vikṛtā</i> changé, transformé; orné; déformé, altéré; défiguré, mutilé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> étrange, laid; incongru; difforme; malade <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> non accompli, incomplet, avorté <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> décoré, embelli; orné de, incrusté de ⟨iic.⟩ — <a href="#entry-vik_rta" class="skt-link">m.</a> astr. np. de Vikṛta «Transformé», fils de <a href="#entry-Unaaradii" class="skt-link">Nāradī</a> personnifiant l'an 24 d'un cycle de vie [<a href="#entry-sa_mvatsara" class="skt-link">saṃvatsara</a>] — <a href="#entry-vik_rta" class="skt-link">n.</a> altération; dégoût, aversion <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. silence de gène <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> avorton, monstre — <a href="#entry-vik_rtaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vikṛtā</i> myth. np. de la <a href="#entry-yoginii" class="skt-link">yoginī</a> Vikṛtā <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> prakrit vika.ta.<br> <i>vikṛtavadha</i> m. soc. exécution capitale avec mutilation.<br> <i>vikṛtā</i> <i>vāc</i> f. langage incongru ou ordurier.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vik_rti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विकृति</span> <i>vikṛti</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vik_r" class="skt-link">vikṛ</a>] <a href="#entry-vik_rti" class="skt-link">f.</a> changement, transformation; dégradation, déchéance; incongruité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> changement d'humeur, émotion; perturbation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> aliénation; hostilité; défection <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> spectre, fantôme <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. dérivé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-saafkhya" class="skt-link">sāṃkhya</a>] la dégradation par transformation du monde phénoménal (opp. <a href="#entry-prak_rti" class="skt-link">prakṛti</a> la Nature Originelle) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-miimaa_msaa" class="skt-link">mīmāṃsā</a>] injonction adaptée au contexte; opp. <a href="#entry-prak_rti" class="skt-link">prakṛti</a>.<br> <i>maraṇamprakṛtiḥ</i> <i>vikṛtirjīvitamucyate</i> On dit que la mort est naturelle, et que la vie est accidentelle.<br> <i>prakṛtivad</i> <i>vikṛtiḥ</i> <i>kartavya</i> [<a href="#entry-miimaa_msaa" class="skt-link">mīmāṃsā</a>] L'injonction doit être faite selon le <a href="#entry-mantra" class="skt-link">mantra</a> d'origine.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vik_rtipaa_tha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vikṛtipāṭha</i> [<a href="#entry-paa_tha" class="skt-link">pāṭha</a>] <a href="#entry-vik_rtipaa_tha" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. récitation particulière du <a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-krama" class="skt-link">krama</a>, <a href="#entry-ghana" class="skt-link">ghana</a>, <a href="#entry-ja_taa" class="skt-link">jaṭā</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vik_rti" class="skt-link">vikṛti</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vik_sar">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विक्षर्</span> <i>vikṣar</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-k_sar" class="skt-link">kṣar</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vikṣarati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vikṣarita</i><i>)</i> s'écouler, se répandre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vik_sara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विक्षर</span> <i>vikṣara</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vik_sar" class="skt-link">vikṣar</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vik_sara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vik_sara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vik_saraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vikṣarā</i> qui s'écoule — <a href="#entry-vik_sara" class="skt-link">m.</a> émanation, effluence <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Vikṣara, épith. de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a> «Imprégnant l'Univers» <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de l'<a href="#entry-asura" class="skt-link">asura</a> Vikṣara_1, fils de <a href="#entry-Udanaayu" class="skt-link">Danāyu</a> et <a href="#entry-Ukazyapa" class="skt-link">Kaśyapa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vik_sip">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विक्षिप्</span> <i>vikṣip</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-k_sip" class="skt-link">kṣip</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">6</span>] pr. <i>(vikṣipati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vikṣipta</i><i>)</i> jeter, disperser; éliminer (douleur) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> étendre, tirer, tendre (not. l'arc); traîner, tirer hors de, retenir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vik_sipa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विक्षिप</span> <i>vikṣipa</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vik_sip" class="skt-link">vikṣip</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vik_sipa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vik_sipa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vik_sipii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vikṣipī</i> qui agite; qui fait des ennuis; agitateur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vik_sipta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विक्षिप्त</span> <i>vikṣipta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vik_sip" class="skt-link">vikṣip</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vik_sipta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vik_sipta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vik_siptaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vikṣiptā</i> jeté, dispersé; réfuté <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> agité; distrait — <a href="#entry-vik_sipta" class="skt-link">n.</a> dispersion.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vik_siptacitta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vikṣiptacitta</i> [<a href="#entry-citta" class="skt-link">citta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vik_siptacitta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vik_siptacitta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vik_siptacittaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vikṣiptacittā</i> à l'esprit distrait.<br> <a href="#entry-vik_sipta" class="skt-link">vikṣipta</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vik_sobha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विक्षोभ</span> <i>vikṣobha</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vik_subh" class="skt-link">vikṣubh</a>] <a href="#entry-vik_sobha" class="skt-link">m.</a> agitation, fébrilité; trouble, inquiétude; trouble mental.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vik_sobhita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विक्षोभित</span> <i>vikṣobhita</i> [ca. pp. <a href="#entry-vik_subh" class="skt-link">vikṣubh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vik_sobhita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vik_sobhita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vik_sobhitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vikṣobhitā</i> agité, inquiet, troublé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vik_subh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विक्षुभ्</span> <i>vikṣubh</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-k_subh" class="skt-link">kṣubh</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. md. <i>(vikṣubhyate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vikṣubdha</i><i>)</i> être bouleversé, être agité — ca. <i>(vikṣobhayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vikṣobhita</i><i>)</i> agiter, troubler; mettre en déroute.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vika_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विकट</span> <i>vikaṭa</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-k_rta" class="skt-link">kṛta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vika_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vika_ta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vika_taa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vikaṭā</i> <a href="#entry-vika_tii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vikaṭī</i> démesuré, immense, énorme <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> extraordinaire, monstrueux; hideux, horrible — <a href="#entry-vika_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Vikaṭa, épith. de <a href="#entry-Uga_neza" class="skt-link">Gaṇeśa</a> «Énorme».<br> <i>vikaṭīkṛ</i> élargir; étendre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikaar">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विकार्</span> <i>vikār</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-vik_r" class="skt-link">vikṛ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(vikārayati)</i> faire changer (not. d'humeur).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विकार</span> <i>vikāra</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vik_r" class="skt-link">vikṛ</a>] <a href="#entry-vikaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> transformation, changement; déformation, altération, perversion <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> préparation culinaire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> jeu de physionomie, grimace; trouble du corps, maladie <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. application du <a href="#entry-sandhi" class="skt-link">sandhi</a> pour passer de la forme isolée [<a href="#entry-padapaa_tha" class="skt-link">padapāṭha</a>] à la forme continue [<a href="#entry-sa_mhitaapaa_tha" class="skt-link">saṃhitāpāṭha</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikaara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विकारण</span> <i>vikāraṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-kaara_na" class="skt-link">kāraṇa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vikaara_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vikaara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vikaara_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vikāraṇā</i> sans cause.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikaarin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विकारिन्</span> <i>vikārin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vik_r" class="skt-link">vikṛ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vikaarin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vikaarin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vikaari_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vikāriṇī</i> sujet au changement; inconstant, infidèle — <a href="#entry-vikaarin" class="skt-link">m.</a> astr. np. de Vikārī «Inconstant», personnifation de l'an 33 d'un cycle de vie [<a href="#entry-sa_mvatsara" class="skt-link">saṃvatsara</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikaarya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विकार्य</span> <i>vikārya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-vikaar" class="skt-link">vikār</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vikaarya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vikaarya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vikaaryaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vikāryā</i> à transformer; destiné à changer, variable <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. qualifie un objet [<a href="#entry-karman" class="skt-link">karman</a>] transformé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikaasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विकास</span> <i>vikāsa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vikas" class="skt-link">vikas</a>] <a href="#entry-vikaasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> éclosion, épanouissement; floraison <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-trika" class="skt-link">trika</a>] phase descendante de réalisation spirituelle où le disciple réintègre le monde phénoménal, et transgresse les interdits pour atteindre la conscience suprême [<a href="#entry-anuttara" class="skt-link">anuttara</a>]; elle succède à la phase de rétraction [<a href="#entry-safkoca" class="skt-link">saṃkoca</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikaasin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विकासिन्</span> <i>vikāsin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vikas" class="skt-link">vikas</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vikaasin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vikaasin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vikaasinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vikāsinī</i> épanoui, fleuri; développé, étendu.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikaasita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विकासित</span> <i>vikāsita</i> [ca. pp. <a href="#entry-vikas" class="skt-link">vikas</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vikaasita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vikaasita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vikaasitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vikāsitā</i> épanoui.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikaaz">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विकाश्</span> <i>vikāś</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-kaaz" class="skt-link">kāś</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(vikāśate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vikāśita</i><i>)</i> paraître, devenir visible <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> briller, resplendir — ca. <i>(vikāśayati)</i> faire apparaître; rendre brillant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikaaza_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विकाश</span> <i>vikāśa_1</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-kaaza" class="skt-link">kāśa</a>] <a href="#entry-vikaaza_1" class="skt-link">m.</a> absence de manifestation; solitude.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikaaza_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विकाश</span> <i>vikāśa_2</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vikaaz" class="skt-link">vikāś</a>] <a href="#entry-vikaaza_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> éclat, splendeur; manifestation.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikalp">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विकल्प्</span> <i>vikalp</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-vik_lp" class="skt-link">vikḷp</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(vikalpayati)</i> poser un dilemme; présenter un choix <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> conjecturer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikalpa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विकल्प</span> <i>vikalpa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vik_lp" class="skt-link">vikḷp</a>] <a href="#entry-vikalpa" class="skt-link">m.</a> option, alternative, choix; distinction, discrimination <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hésitation, indécision, doute; imagination, illusion <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> image mentale; état mental <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. l'abstention d'action; opp. <a href="#entry-safkalpa" class="skt-link">saṃkalpa</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>] la conceptualisation, un <a href="#entry-cittav_rtti" class="skt-link">cittavṛtti</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] analyse logique d'un concept, classification <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-miimaa_msaa" class="skt-link">mīmāṃsā</a>] ensemble d'instructions alternatives, à exécuter au choix; opp. <a href="#entry-samuccaya" class="skt-link">samuccaya</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> math. combinatoire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. alternative d'une règle de grammaire, option <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. rhét. antithèse.<br> <i>vikalpena</i> adv. optionnellement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikalpaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विकल्पक</span> <i>vikalpaka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vik_lp" class="skt-link">vikḷp</a>] <a href="#entry-vikalpaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> distributeur; répartiteur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> compositeur; transformateur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikalpana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विकल्पन</span> <i>vikalpana</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vik_lp" class="skt-link">vikḷp</a>] <a href="#entry-vikalpana" class="skt-link">m.</a> arrangeur; compositeur — <a href="#entry-vikalpana" class="skt-link">n.</a> alternative; distinction <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> diversité d'opinion; confusion; imagination; indécision.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikamp">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विकम्प्</span> <i>vikamp</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-kamp" class="skt-link">kamp</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(vikampate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vikampita</i><i>)</i> trembler violemment <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> être effrayé; hésiter.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikar_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विकर्ण</span> <i>vikarṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-kar_na" class="skt-link">karṇa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vikar_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vikar_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vikar_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vikarṇī</i> sans oreilles — <a href="#entry-vikar_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. de Vikarṇa, l'un des fils de <a href="#entry-Udh_rtaraa_s_tra" class="skt-link">Dhṛtarāṣṭra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikara_na_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विकरण</span> <i>vikaraṇa_1</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-kara_na" class="skt-link">karaṇa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vikara_na_1" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vikara_na_1" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vikara_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vikaraṇā</i> privé de sensations — <a href="#entry-vikara_na_1" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. abandon des actes; privation des sensations.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikara_na_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विकरण</span> <i>vikaraṇa_2</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vik_r" class="skt-link">vikṛ</a>] <a href="#entry-vikara_na_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> gram. [«qui déclenche une transformation»] marqueur utilisé en suffixe d'une racine pour former un thème de conjugaison; leur liste est <i>śap</i>, <i>śapoluk</i>, <i>ślu</i>, <i>śyan</i>, <i>śnu</i>, <i>śa</i>, <i>śnam</i>, <i>u</i>, <i>śnā</i>, <i>yak</i>, <i>cli</i>, <i>tāsi</i>, <i>sya</i>, et <i>sip</i>; aussi <i>luk</i> pour les racines de 2⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ <a href="#entry-ga_na" class="skt-link">gaṇa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikarman">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विकर्मन्</span> <i>vikarman</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-karman" class="skt-link">karman</a>] <a href="#entry-vikarman" class="skt-link">n.</a> mauvaise action.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikartana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विकर्तन</span> <i>vikartana</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vik_rt" class="skt-link">vikṛt</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vikartana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vikartana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vikartanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vikartanā</i> qui sépare, qui déchire — <a href="#entry-vikartana" class="skt-link">m.</a> le Soleil (qui sépare les nuages).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विकस्</span> <i>vikas</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-kas" class="skt-link">kas</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vikasati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vikasita</i><i>)</i> s'ouvrir, s'épanouir; fleurir <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> se réjouir <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> s'étendre, croître, augmenter — ca. <i>(vikāsayati)</i> faire s'épanouir; faire croître.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikasita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विकसित</span> <i>vikasita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vikas" class="skt-link">vikas</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vikasita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vikasita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vikasitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vikasitā</i> épanoui.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikatth">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विकत्थ्</span> <i>vikatth</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-katth" class="skt-link">katth</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(vikatthate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vikatthita</i><i>)</i> abs. <i>(</i><i>vikatthya</i><i>)</i> se vanter (de ⟨i.⟩); fanfaronner — ca. <i>(vikatthayati)</i> se moquer de, humilier.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikatthaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विकत्था</span> <i>vikatthā</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vikatth" class="skt-link">vikatth</a>] <a href="#entry-vikatthaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> vantardise.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikhaanasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विखानस</span> <i>vikhānasa</i> [<a href="#entry-vikhan" class="skt-link">vikhan</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vikhaanasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vikhaanasa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vikhaanasaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vikhānasā</i> qui déterre (des racines) — <a href="#entry-vikhaanasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. de l'ermite [<a href="#entry-muni" class="skt-link">muni</a>] Vikhānasa ou Vikhanas, qui établit la règle des anachorètes [<a href="#entry-vaikhaanasa" class="skt-link">vaikhānasa</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikhan">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विखन्</span> <i>vikhan</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-khan" class="skt-link">khan</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vikhanati)</i> déterrer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikira">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विकिर</span> <i>vikira</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vik_rr" class="skt-link">vikṝ</a>] <a href="#entry-vikira" class="skt-link">m.</a> dispersion <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. portion de riz éparpillée pour conjurer les êtres hostiles à l'oblation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> eau qui goutte; eau filtrée goutte à goutte; not. eau obtenue en creusant un trou dans la berge sablonneuse d'une rivière.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विक्क</span> <i>vikka</i> <a href="#entry-vikka" class="skt-link">m.</a> jeune éléphant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viklav">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विक्लव्</span> <i>viklav</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-klav" class="skt-link">klav</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(viklavate)</i> se troubler, devenir confus; être agité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viklava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विक्लव</span> <i>viklava</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-viklav" class="skt-link">viklav</a>] a. <a href="#entry-viklava" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-viklava" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-viklavaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viklavā</i> troublé, confus, perplexe; hésitant, indécis, incertain <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bouleversé, apeuré, intimidé; découragé, défaillant — ifc. dégoûté de — <a href="#entry-viklava" class="skt-link">n.</a> agitation, trouble; découragement.<br> <i>viklava</i> <i>kṛ</i> décourager.<br> <i>viklava</i> <i>bhū</i> se troubler, se décourager.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viklid">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विक्लिद्</span> <i>viklid</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-klid" class="skt-link">klid</a>] [inusité sans pf.].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viklitti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विक्लित्ति</span> <i>viklitti</i> [act. <a href="#entry-viklid" class="skt-link">viklid</a>] <a href="#entry-viklitti" class="skt-link">f.</a> humidification; ramollissement (not. du riz dans l'eau).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikraanta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विक्रान्त</span> <i>vikrānta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vikram" class="skt-link">vikram</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vikraanta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vikraanta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vikraantaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vikrāntā</i> vaillant, preux, puissant — <a href="#entry-vikraanta" class="skt-link">n.</a> démarche, allure; vaillance, hardiesse.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikram">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विक्रम्</span> <i>vikram</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-kram" class="skt-link">kram</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vikrāmati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vikrānta</i><i>)</i> marcher, s'avancer, enjamber <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> s'élever à ⟨acc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> montrer du courage; attaquer, combattre, soumettre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikrama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विक्रम</span> <i>vikrama</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vikram" class="skt-link">vikram</a>] <a href="#entry-vikrama" class="skt-link">m.</a> marche, démarche; pas, enjambée <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> allure (not. majestueuse); vaillance, courage, héroïsme; puissance <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Vikrama «Héros», épith. du roi <a href="#entry-Upuruuravaa" class="skt-link">Purūravā</a>; il personnifie l'an 14 d'un cycle de vie [<a href="#entry-sa_mvatsara" class="skt-link">saṃvatsara</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. de l'ère [<a href="#entry-sa_mvat" class="skt-link">saṃvat</a>] <a href="#entry-Uvikrama" class="skt-link">Vikrama</a>, débutant en 57 ant. <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> astr. calendrier utilisé en Inde du Nord; la fête de <a href="#entry-Udiipaavali" class="skt-link">Dīpāvali</a> marque son dernier jour.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikrama_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विक्रमण</span> <i>vikramaṇa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vikram" class="skt-link">vikram</a>] <a href="#entry-vikrama_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> enjambée, pas; not. enjambée cosmique de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> héroïsme, bravoure; puissance <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> [<a href="#entry-paazupata" class="skt-link">pāśupata</a>] pouvoir surnaturel <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. récitation pas à pas selon les règles du <a href="#entry-kramapaa_tha" class="skt-link">kramapāṭha</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikramaaditya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vikramāditya</i> [<a href="#entry-aaditya" class="skt-link">āditya</a>] <a href="#entry-vikramaaditya" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. du roi Vikramāditya «Soleil d'héroïsme», épith. de <a href="#entry-Ucandragupta_2" class="skt-link">Candragupta_2</a> (380–415), qui vainquit les <a href="#entry-Uzakaas" class="skt-link">Śakās</a>; il conquit la satrapie d'<a href="#entry-Uavanti" class="skt-link">Avanti</a>-<a href="#entry-Uujjayinii" class="skt-link">Ujjayinī</a>, dont il fit sa capitale; la tradition lui attribue à tort d'avoir fondé l'ère <a href="#entry-Uvikrama" class="skt-link">Vikrama</a>; le poète <a href="#entry-Ubhart_rhari_1" class="skt-link">Bhartṛhari_1</a> était son frère; il encouragea les arts, et la tradition dit qu'à sa cour vivaient neuf trésors d'érudition [<a href="#entry-navaratna" class="skt-link">navaratna</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. du roi <a href="#entry-Ucaalukya" class="skt-link">Cālukya</a> Vikramāditya_1, fils de <a href="#entry-Upulakezii_2" class="skt-link">Pulakeśī_2</a> et d'une fille de <a href="#entry-Udurviniita" class="skt-link">Durvinīta</a>; il régna à <a href="#entry-Uvaataapi" class="skt-link">Vātāpi</a> (mod. Badāmi) de 655 à 681; il établit les chroniques de la dynastie en 658; il captura <a href="#entry-Ukaa_nciipuram" class="skt-link">Kāñcīpuram</a> en 671 <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. du roi <a href="#entry-Ucaalukya" class="skt-link">Cālukya</a> Vikramāditya_2; il régna à <a href="#entry-Uvaataapi" class="skt-link">Vātāpi</a> de 733 à 746 <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. du roi <a href="#entry-Ucaalukya" class="skt-link">Cālukya</a> Vikramāditya_6; il régna à Kalyanī au 11⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle; il intrigua contre son frère aîné Someśvara_2, le détrôna en 1076, et fonda alors l'ère [<a href="#entry-sa_mvat" class="skt-link">saṃvat</a>] <a href="#entry-Uvikramacaalukya" class="skt-link">Vikramacālukya</a>; il contrôlait un vaste empire de la <a href="#entry-Ukaaverii" class="skt-link">Kāverī</a> à la <a href="#entry-Unarmadaa" class="skt-link">Narmadā</a>; il patronna les arts et les lettres; cf. <a href="#entry-Ubilha_na" class="skt-link">Bilhaṇa</a>; après sa mort en 1126 l'empire <a href="#entry-Ucaalukya" class="skt-link">Cālukya</a> se disloqua.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikramaafkadeva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vikramāṅkadeva</i> [<a href="#entry-afka" class="skt-link">aṅka</a>-<a href="#entry-deva" class="skt-link">deva</a>] <a href="#entry-vikramaafkadeva" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. du roi <a href="#entry-Ucaalukya" class="skt-link">Cālukya</a> Vikramāṅkadeva; cf. <a href="#entry-Uvikramaaditya_6" class="skt-link">Vikramāditya_6</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikramaafkadevacarita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vikramāṅkadevacarita</i> [<a href="#entry-carita" class="skt-link">carita</a>] <a href="#entry-vikramaafkadevacarita" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Vikramāṅkadevacarita «Exploits du roi <a href="#entry-Uvikramaafkadeva" class="skt-link">Vikramāṅkadeva</a>», panégyrique de la dynastie <a href="#entry-Ucaalukya" class="skt-link">Cālukya</a> de <a href="#entry-Ukalyaa_na" class="skt-link">Kalyāṇa</a>, composé pour le roi <a href="#entry-Uvikramaaditya_6" class="skt-link">Vikramāditya_6</a> par le poète de cour <a href="#entry-Ubilha_na" class="skt-link">Bilhaṇa</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vikramaafkadeva" class="skt-link">vikramāṅkadeva</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikramacaalukya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vikramacālukya</i> [<a href="#entry-caalukya" class="skt-link">cālukya</a>] <a href="#entry-vikramacaalukya" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. dynastie [<a href="#entry-sa_mvat" class="skt-link">saṃvat</a>] Vikramacālukya du Deccan, fondée en 1075 par <a href="#entry-Uvikramaaditya_6" class="skt-link">Vikramāditya_6</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikramapa_t_tana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vikramapaṭṭana</i> [<a href="#entry-pa_t_tana" class="skt-link">paṭṭana</a>] <a href="#entry-vikramapa_t_tana" class="skt-link">n.</a> géo. np. de la ville de Vikramapaṭṭana «capitale de <a href="#entry-Uvikramaaditya" class="skt-link">Vikramāditya</a>», épith. d'<a href="#entry-Uujjayinii" class="skt-link">Ujjayinī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikramapura">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vikramapura</i> [<a href="#entry-pura" class="skt-link">pura</a>] <a href="#entry-vikramapura" class="skt-link">n.</a> géo. np. de Vikramapura «ville de <a href="#entry-Uvikramaaditya" class="skt-link">Vikramāditya</a>»; cf. <a href="#entry-Uvikramapa_t_tana" class="skt-link">Vikramapaṭṭana</a> — <a href="#entry-vikramapurii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vikramapurī</i> id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikramasi_mhapurii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vikramasiṃhapurī</i> [<a href="#entry-si_mhapurii" class="skt-link">siṃhapurī</a>] <a href="#entry-vikramasi_mhapurii" class="skt-link">f.</a> géo. np. de la ville de Vikramasiṃhapurī, sur la côte d'<a href="#entry-Uandhra" class="skt-link">Andhra</a>; elle existe depuis le temps de l'empire <a href="#entry-Umaurya" class="skt-link">Maurya</a>; elle fit partie du royaume des <a href="#entry-Upallavaas" class="skt-link">Pallavās</a> du 4⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ au 6⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècles; mod. Nellore.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikramaziila">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vikramaśīla</i> [<a href="#entry-ziila" class="skt-link">śīla</a>] <a href="#entry-vikramaziila" class="skt-link">m.</a> géo. np. du monastère bd. de Vikramaśīla (mod. Antichak, 50 km est de Bhagalpur, <a href="#entry-Ubihaara" class="skt-link">Bihāra</a>); le roi <a href="#entry-Udharmapaala_1" class="skt-link">Dharmapāla_1</a> y fonda une Université à la fin du 8⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle, en réaction à un présumé déclin de <a href="#entry-Unaalandaa" class="skt-link">Nālandā</a>; une centaine de professeurs y enseignaient à un millier d'étudiants; le site fut détruit en 1198 par l'armée musulmane de Bakhtiar Khiliji combattant la dynastie <a href="#entry-Usena" class="skt-link">Sena</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikramorvazii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vikramorvaśī</i> [<a href="#entry-urvazii" class="skt-link">urvaśī</a>] <a href="#entry-vikramorvazii" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de la Vikramorvaśī, drame de <a href="#entry-Ukaalidaasa" class="skt-link">Kālidāsa</a> contant les amours de <a href="#entry-Upuruuravaa" class="skt-link">Purūravā</a> et d'<a href="#entry-Uurvazii" class="skt-link">Urvaśī</a> «conquise par sa valeur»; croyant qu'elle le quitte par jalousie, il est fou de douleur de la séparation avec l'être aimé [<a href="#entry-vipralambhaz_rfgaara" class="skt-link">vipralambhaśṛṅgāra</a>].<br> <a href="#entry-vikrama" class="skt-link">vikrama</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikraya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विक्रय</span> <i>vikraya</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vikrii" class="skt-link">vikrī</a>] <a href="#entry-vikraya" class="skt-link">m.</a> vente.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikrayaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विक्रयक</span> <i>vikrayaka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vikrii" class="skt-link">vikrī</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vikrayaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vikrayaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vikrayikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vikrayikā</i> vendeur — <a href="#entry-vikrayika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <i>vikrayika</i> id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikrayapattra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vikrayapattra</i> [<a href="#entry-pattra" class="skt-link">pattra</a>] <a href="#entry-vikrayapattra" class="skt-link">n.</a> facture.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikrayazaalaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vikrayaśālā</i> [<a href="#entry-zaalaa" class="skt-link">śālā</a>] <a href="#entry-vikrayazaalaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> boutique, commerce.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikrayin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vikrayin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vikrii" class="skt-link">vikrī</a>] ifc. a. <a href="#entry-vikrayin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vikrayin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vikrayi_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vikrayiṇī</i> qui a vendu ⟨iic.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> not. qui fait du trafic avec (<a href="#entry-maa_msa" class="skt-link">māṃsa</a>, <a href="#entry-soma" class="skt-link">soma</a>).<br> <i>somavikrayī</i> qui a vendu du <a href="#entry-soma" class="skt-link">soma</a> (blâmable).<br> <i>rasavikrayī</i> qui fait du trafic d'alcool.<br> <i>māṃsavikrayī</i> qui a vendu de la viande.<br> <a href="#entry-vikrayaka" class="skt-link">vikrayaka</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikrayya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विक्रय्य</span> <i>vikrayya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-vikrii" class="skt-link">vikrī</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vikrayya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vikrayya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vikrayyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vikrayyā</i> à vendre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikret_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विक्रेतृ</span> <i>vikretṛ</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vikrii" class="skt-link">vikrī</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vikret_r" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vikret_r" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vikretrii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vikretrī</i> qui vend — <a href="#entry-vikret_r" class="skt-link">m.</a> marchand.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikretavya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विक्रेतव्य</span> <i>vikretavya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">9</span>] pr. md. <i>(vikrīṇīte)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vikrīta</i><i>)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>vikrayya</i>, <i>vikretavya</i>, <i>vikreya</i><i>)</i> vendre; troquer contre ⟨i.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vikrīḍati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vikrīḍita</i><i>)</i> jouer, s'amuser; jouer avec ⟨<a href="#entry-saha" class="skt-link">saha</a>⟩.

  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikriita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विक्रीत</span> <i>vikrīta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vikrii" class="skt-link">vikrī</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vikriita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vikriita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vikriitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vikrītā</i> vendu — <a href="#entry-vikriita" class="skt-link">n.</a> vente.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikriyaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
