  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikruz">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विक्रुश्</span> <i>vikruś</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-kruz" class="skt-link">kruś</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vikrośati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vikruṣṭa</i><i>)</i> crier, appeler au secours; interpeller qqn. ⟨acc.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viku_n_th">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विकुण्ठ्</span> <i>vikuṇṭh</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-ku_n_th" class="skt-link">kuṇṭh</a>] [inusité sans pf.].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viku_n_tha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विकुण्ठ</span> <i>vikuṇṭha</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-ku_n_tha" class="skt-link">kuṇṭha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-viku_n_tha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-viku_n_tha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-viku_n_thaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vikuṇṭhā</i> aiguisé; pénétrant, irrésistible — <a href="#entry-viku_n_tha" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Vikuṇṭha, épith. de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a> «l'Immanent» [«qui imprègne tout»].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viku_n_thita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विकुण्ठित</span> <i>vikuṇṭhita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-viku_n_th" class="skt-link">vikuṇṭh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-viku_n_thita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-viku_n_thita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-viku_n_thitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vikuṇṭhitā</i> émoussé; obtus.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vikuk_si">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विकुक्षि</span> <i>vikukṣi</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-kuk_si" class="skt-link">kukṣi</a>] <a href="#entry-vikuk_si" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Vikukṣi «Glouton», fils aîné d'<a href="#entry-Uik_svaaku" class="skt-link">Ikṣvāku</a>, fondateur de la dynastie d'<a href="#entry-Uayodhyaa" class="skt-link">Ayodhyā</a> de la lignée solaire [<a href="#entry-suuryava_mza" class="skt-link">sūryavaṃśa</a>]; lorsque son père <a href="#entry-Uik_svaaku" class="skt-link">Ikṣvāku</a> voulut célébrer le <a href="#entry-mahaapralaya" class="skt-link">mahāpralaya</a> <a href="#entry-zraaddha" class="skt-link">śrāddha</a>, il partit dans la forêt chasser les bêtes du sacrifice; au retour, affamé, il préleva un lièvre dans le gibier pour le manger; le <a href="#entry-purohita" class="skt-link">purohita</a> <a href="#entry-Uvasi_s_tha" class="skt-link">Vasiṣṭha</a> refusa d'effectuer l'aspersion rituelle [<a href="#entry-prok_sa_na" class="skt-link">prokṣaṇa</a>] sur un reste, indigne d'un sacrifice; <a href="#entry-Uik_svaaku" class="skt-link">Ikṣvāku</a> bannit <a href="#entry-Uvikuk_si" class="skt-link">Vikukṣi</a>, qui sous le nom de <a href="#entry-Uzazaada" class="skt-link">Śaśāda</a> vécut comme un ermite; à la mort de son père il revint à <a href="#entry-Uayodhyaa" class="skt-link">Ayodhyā</a> pour régner; son fils est <a href="#entry-Ukakutstha" class="skt-link">Kakutstha</a> (ou [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] <a href="#entry-Ubaa_na_1" class="skt-link">Bāṇa_1</a>).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vila">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विल</span> <i>vila</i> cf. <a href="#entry-bila" class="skt-link">bila</a>.
  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

  </div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विलासन</span> <i>vilāsana</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vilas" class="skt-link">vilas</a>] <a href="#entry-vilaasana" class="skt-link">n.</a> jeu, délassement.
  </div>
</div>

[<a href="#entry-Ukaadambarii" class="skt-link">Kādambarī</a>] np. de la reine Vilāsavatī «Enjouée», épouse de <a href="#entry-Utaaraapii_da" class="skt-link">Tārāpīḍa</a>, mère de <a href="#entry-Ucandraapii_da_1" class="skt-link">Candrāpīḍa_1</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vilaasa" class="skt-link">vilāsa</a>
  </div>
</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विलासि</span> <i>vilāsi</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-vilaasin" class="skt-link">vilāsin</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vilaasin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विलासिन्</span> <i>vilāsin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vilas" class="skt-link">vilas</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vilaasin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vilaasin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vilaasinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vilāsinī</i> brillant, radieux; frémissant; gracieux, coquet; libertin, amoureux — <a href="#entry-vilaasin" class="skt-link">m.</a> amant — <a href="#entry-vilaasinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vilāsinī</i> coquette; bien-aimée; femme facile.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vilaasitaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vilāsitā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-vilaasitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> coquetterie; libertinage.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vilaasitva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vilak_s">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विलक्ष्</span> <i>vilakṣ</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-lak_s" class="skt-link">lakṣ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(vilakṣayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vilakṣita</i><i>)</i> distinguer, discerner; observer, percevoir, remarquer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> perdre de vue le but visé; être confus, perplexe ou embarrassé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vilak_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विलक्ष</span> <i>vilakṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-lak_sa" class="skt-link">lakṣa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vilak_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vilak_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vilak_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vilakṣā</i> sans but précis; sans caractère particulier <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui rate sa cible (flèche) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> inusité, étrange, extraordinaire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gêné, embarrassé, confus; étonné, surpris.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vilak_sa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विलक्षण</span> <i>vilakṣaṇa</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vilak_s" class="skt-link">vilakṣ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vilak_sa_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vilak_sa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vilak_sa_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vilakṣaṇā</i> qui a un caractère différent, non caractéristique <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> varié, multiple <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> sans définition précise; non significatif, vain — <a href="#entry-vilak_sa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> condition non caractéristique; état non pertinent.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vilak_sita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विलक्षित</span> <i>vilakṣita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vilak_s" class="skt-link">vilakṣ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vilak_sita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vilak_sita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vilak_sitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vilakṣitā</i> perçu, remarqué; distingué <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> embarrassé, confus, gêné; perplexe; ennuyé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vilamb">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विलम्ब्</span> <i>vilamb</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-lamb" class="skt-link">lamb</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(vilambate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vilambita</i><i>)</i> pendre, être suspendu à ⟨loc.⟩; rester en arrière, traîner, tarder <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> descendre (soleil).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vilamba">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विलम्ब</span> <i>vilamba</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vilamb" class="skt-link">vilamb</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vilamba" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vilamba" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vilambaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vilambā</i> qui pend — <a href="#entry-vilamba" class="skt-link">m.</a> fait de pendre ou d'être suspendu <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lenteur, retard, procrastination <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> astr. np. de Vilamba «Hésitant», fils de <a href="#entry-Unaaradii" class="skt-link">Nāradī</a>, personnifiant l'an 32 d'un cycle de vie [<a href="#entry-sa_mvatsara" class="skt-link">saṃvatsara</a>].<br> <i>vilambāt</i> avec retard, en retard.<br> <i>vilambena</i> id. <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> trop tard.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vilambana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विलम्बन</span> <i>vilambana</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vilamb" class="skt-link">vilamb</a>] <a href="#entry-vilambana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vilambanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vilambanā</i> lenteur, délai, procrastination.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vilambin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विलम्बिन्</span> <i>vilambin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vilamb" class="skt-link">vilamb</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vilambin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vilambin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vilambinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vilambinī</i> qui pend; qui tarde, hésitant — ifc. suspendu à.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vilambita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विलम्बित</span> <i>vilambita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vilamb" class="skt-link">vilamb</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vilambita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vilambita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vilambitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vilambitā</i> pendu, suspendu <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> retardé, ajourné, lent.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vilap">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विलप्</span> <i>vilap</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-lap" class="skt-link">lap</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vilapati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vilapita</i><i>)</i> gémir, se lamenter, se plaindre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vilapita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विलपित</span> <i>vilapita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vilap" class="skt-link">vilap</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vilapita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vilapita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vilapitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vilapitā</i> lamenté, plain — <a href="#entry-vilapita" class="skt-link">n.</a> lamentation.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vilas">

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vilasati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vilasita</i><i>)</i> briller, resplendir <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> vibrer; s'agiter, frétiller; s'amuser, folâtrer, jouer — ca. <i>(vilāsayati)</i> faire danser.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vilasat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vilasita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vilepana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विलेपन</span> <i>vilepana</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vilip" class="skt-link">vilip</a>] <a href="#entry-vilepana" class="skt-link">n.</a> fait d'enduire, onction.
  </div>
</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vilikh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विलिख्</span> <i>vilikh</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-likh" class="skt-link">likh</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">6</span>] pr. <i>(vilikhati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>likhita</i><i>)</i> gratter; lacérer; poncer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> (fig.) toucher, blesser (sentiments); offenser <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> écrire; graver, dessiner, peindre — ca. <i>(vilekhayati)</i> ca. <i>(vilikhāpayati)</i> faire écrire.
  </div>
</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विलिख</span> <i>vilikha</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vilikh" class="skt-link">vilikh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vilikha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vilikha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vilikhii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vilikhī</i> qui écrit.
  </div>
</div>

[<span class="skt-grammar">6</span>] pr. <i>(vilimpati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vilipta</i><i>)</i> abs. <i>(</i><i>vilipya</i><i>)</i> oindre, enduire; enduire de, barbouiller de; étaler un enduit sur ⟨acc.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vilipta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vilocana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विलोचन</span> <i>vilocana</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vilok" class="skt-link">vilok</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vilocana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vilocana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vilocanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vilocanā</i> qui fait voir — ifc. au regard — <a href="#entry-vilocana" class="skt-link">n.</a> œil.<br> <i>smerīkṛta</i> <i>vilocana</i> a. m. n. avec le regard souriant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vilok">

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vilokati)</i> ca. <i>(vilokayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vilokita</i><i>)</i> regarder, examiner; apercevoir — ps. <i>(vilokyate)</i> être visible.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viloka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विलोक</span> <i>viloka</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vilok" class="skt-link">vilok</a>] <a href="#entry-viloka" class="skt-link">m.</a> regard.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vilokita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विलोकित</span> <i>vilokita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vilok" class="skt-link">vilok</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vilokita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vilokita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vilokitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vilokitā</i> regardé, aperçu — <a href="#entry-vilokita" class="skt-link">n.</a> coup d'œil.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viloma">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विलोम</span> <i>viloma</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-loman" class="skt-link">loman</a>] a. <a href="#entry-viloma" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-viloma" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vilomaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vilomā</i> à rebours, à rebrousse-poil; à l'envers, dans l'ordre inverse; opp. <a href="#entry-anuloma" class="skt-link">anuloma</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> var. <i>viloman</i> f. chauve.<br> <i>vilomena</i> à l'envers.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vilomakaavya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vilomakāvya</i> [<a href="#entry-kaavya" class="skt-link">kāvya</a>] <a href="#entry-vilomakaavya" class="skt-link">n.</a> [<i>vilomākṣarakāvya</i>] lit. poème bidirectionnel, qui peut se lire aussi dans l'ordre inverse de ses syllabes; on attribue son invention à <a href="#entry-Usuuryadaasa" class="skt-link">Sūryadāsa</a>; on distingue la forme <i>viṣamākṣara</i>, avec deux énonciations distinctes, et la forme <a href="#entry-samaak_sara" class="skt-link">samākṣara</a> ou palindrome; cf. <a href="#entry-Uraamak_r_s_nakaavya" class="skt-link">Rāmakṛṣṇakāvya</a>, <a href="#entry-Uzriiraaghavayaadaviiya" class="skt-link">Śrīrāghavayādavīya</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-viloma" class="skt-link">viloma</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vilubh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विलुभ्</span> <i>vilubh</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-lubh" class="skt-link">lubh</a>] ca. <i>(vilobhayati)</i> exciter le désir, faire trouver du plaisir à ⟨loc.⟩; chercher à séduire, induire en tentation.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vilup">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विलुप्</span> <i>vilup</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-lup" class="skt-link">lup</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">6</span>] pr. <i>(vilumpati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vilupta</i><i>)</i> arracher, déchirer, égratigner.
  </div>
</div>

[<span class="skt-grammar">9</span>] pr. <i>(vimṛdnāti)</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vimardati)</i> réduire en poudre; détruire — ca. <i>(vimardayati)</i> broyer; détruire.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vim_rz">

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vimṛśati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vimṛṣṭa</i>, <i>vimṛṣita</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>pra</i><i>)</i> toucher, reconnaître par le toucher, passer la main sur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> considérer, examiner — ca. <i>(vimarśayati)</i> considérer, réfléchir sur.
  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विमान</span> <i>vimāna_1</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vimaa" class="skt-link">vimā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vimaana_1" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vimaana_1" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vimaanaa_1" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vimānā_1</i> qui parcourt d'un bout à l'autre — <a href="#entry-vimaana_1" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vimaana_1" class="skt-link">n.</a> myth. char aérien (d'un dieu), trône céleste; palanquin de transport d'une idole [<a href="#entry-muurti" class="skt-link">mūrti</a>] mobile <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> palais royal; sanctuaire d'un temple.
  </div>
</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विमान</span> <i>vimāna_2</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-maana_1" class="skt-link">māna_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vimaana_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vimaana_2" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vimaanaa_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vimānā_2</i> humilié, outragé — <a href="#entry-vimaana_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> dédain, mépris.
  </div>
</div>

    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विमान्य</span> <i>vimānya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-viman" class="skt-link">viman</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vimaanya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vimaanya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vimaanyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vimānyā</i> méprisable.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vimaarga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विमार्ग</span> <i>vimārga</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-maarga" class="skt-link">mārga</a>] <a href="#entry-vimaarga" class="skt-link">m.</a> chemin qui n'est pas le bon, fausse route.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vimaat_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विमातृ</span> <i>vimātṛ</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-maat_r" class="skt-link">mātṛ</a>] <a href="#entry-vimaat_r" class="skt-link">f.</a> belle-mère, marâtre (épouse de son père).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vimaat_rja">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vimātṛja</i> [<a href="#entry-ja" class="skt-link">ja</a>] <a href="#entry-vimaat_rja" class="skt-link">m.</a> demi-frère; syn. <a href="#entry-vaimaatra" class="skt-link">vaimātra</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vimaat_r" class="skt-link">vimātṛ</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vimada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vimala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विमल</span> <i>vimala</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-mala" class="skt-link">mala</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vimala" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vimala" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vimalaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vimalā</i> pur, immaculé; clair, limpide, transparent; brillant <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> astr. année lunaire (opp. <a href="#entry-maatula" class="skt-link">mātula</a>, année solaire) — f. cf. <a href="#entry-vimalaa" class="skt-link">vimalā</a>.<br> <i>vimale</i> adv. au lever du jour.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vimalaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विमला</span> <i>vimalā</i> [f. <a href="#entry-vimala" class="skt-link">vimala</a>] <a href="#entry-vimalaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> myth. np. de Vimalā, déesse tutélaire de la colline de <a href="#entry-Uniilagiri" class="skt-link">Nīlagiri</a>; elle possède un sanctuaire dans le temple de <a href="#entry-Ujagannaatha" class="skt-link">Jagannātha</a> à <a href="#entry-Upurii" class="skt-link">Purī</a>, et l'offrande [<a href="#entry-prasaada" class="skt-link">prasāda</a>] lui est offerte en premier.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vimalaadri">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vimalādri</i> [<a href="#entry-adri" class="skt-link">adri</a>] <a href="#entry-vimalaadri" class="skt-link">m.</a> géo. np. du Mont Vimalādri «Montagne pure», plus haut sommet du Gujarat (1031 m); cf. <a href="#entry-Ugirinagara" class="skt-link">Girinagara</a>, <a href="#entry-Uzatru_njaya" class="skt-link">Śatruñjaya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vimalaapa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vimalāpa</i> [<a href="#entry-aapa" class="skt-link">āpa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vimalaapa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vimalaapa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vimalaapaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vimalāpā</i> dont les eaux sont pures.<br> <a href="#entry-vimala" class="skt-link">vimala</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vimaladyu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vimaladyu</i> [<a href="#entry-dyu" class="skt-link">dyu</a>] <a href="#entry-vimaladyu" class="skt-link">m.</a> jour de beau temps.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vimalakiirti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vimalakīrti</i> [<a href="#entry-kiirti" class="skt-link">kīrti</a>] <a href="#entry-vimalakiirti" class="skt-link">m.</a> bd. np. de Vimalakīrti, riche marchand de <a href="#entry-Uvaizaalii_1" class="skt-link">Vaiśālī_1</a> «à la réputation irréprochable», expert du <a href="#entry-dharma" class="skt-link">dharma</a> et disciple laïc du <a href="#entry-Ubuddha" class="skt-link">Buddha</a>, qui selon la tradition envoya <a href="#entry-Uma_njuzrii" class="skt-link">Mañjuśrī</a> pour débattre avec lui.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vimalakiirtinirdeza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vimalakīrtinirdeśa</i> [<a href="#entry-nirdeza" class="skt-link">nirdeśa</a>] <a href="#entry-vimalakiirtinirdeza" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du Vimalakīrtinirdeśa «Instruction de <a href="#entry-Uvimalakiirti" class="skt-link">Vimalakīrti</a>».<br> <a href="#entry-vimalakiirti" class="skt-link">vimalakīrti</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vimalanaatha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vimalanātha</i> [<a href="#entry-naatha" class="skt-link">nātha</a>] <a href="#entry-vimalanaatha" class="skt-link">m.</a> jn. np. de Vimalanātha «Maître de la Pureté», 13⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ <a href="#entry-tiirthafkara" class="skt-link">tīrthaṅkara</a> mythique; son corps est jaune d'or, son symbole est un sanglier.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viman">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विमन्</span> <i>viman</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-man" class="skt-link">man</a>] ca. <i>(vimānayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vimata</i><i>)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>vimānya</i><i>)</i> manquer de respect à, humilier, traiter avec dédain, avec mépris; déshonorer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vimanaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विमना</span> <i>vimanā</i> [vn. <i>vimanas</i>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. md. <i>(vimanāyate)</i> être abattu, être découragé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vimanas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विमनस्</span> <i>vimanas</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-manas" class="skt-link">manas</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vimanas" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vimanas" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vimanas" class="skt-link">f.</a> découragé, abattu, désolé, déprimé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> mentalement dérangé; stupide <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> mal disposé; hostile.
  </div>
</div>

[DKC.] np. de Vimardaka «Broyeur», brute à la solde d'Apahāravarma.

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vimarza">

[théâtre] nœud de l'intrigue dans un drame; cet épisode suit le germe [<a href="#entry-garbha" class="skt-link">garbha</a>] et précède le dénouement [<a href="#entry-nirvaha_na" class="skt-link">nirvahaṇa</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-tantra" class="skt-link">tantra</a>] la Nature, émanation de <a href="#entry-Uzakti" class="skt-link">Śakti</a>, miroir de la conscience universelle de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> [<a href="#entry-prakaaza" class="skt-link">prakāśa</a>].
  </div>
</div>

  </div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vinadati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vinadita</i><i>)</i> faire du bruit; crier, hurler, rugir; remplir de cris, appeler à grands cris — ca. <i>(vinādayati)</i> faire retentir; provoquer des cris.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vinada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विनद</span> <i>vinada</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vinad" class="skt-link">vinad</a>] <a href="#entry-vinada" class="skt-link">m.</a> cri.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vinam">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विनम्</span> <i>vinam</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-nam" class="skt-link">nam</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vinamati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vinata</i><i>)</i> se courber, s'incliner — ca. <i>(vinamayati)</i> courber, faire ployer; bander (un arc).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vinata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विनत</span> <i>vinata</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vinam" class="skt-link">vinam</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vinata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vinata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vinataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vinatā</i> incliné, courbé, arqué <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> humble, humilié — <a href="#entry-vinataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vinatā</i> myth. np. de Vinatā «l'Humble», fille de <a href="#entry-Uprajaapati" class="skt-link">Prajāpati</a>, et de <a href="#entry-Unalaa" class="skt-link">Nalā</a>, épouse de <a href="#entry-Ukazyapa" class="skt-link">Kaśyapa</a>; [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] elle souhaita avoir deux fils plus forts que ceux de sa sœur <a href="#entry-Ukadruu" class="skt-link">Kadrū</a>; elle enfanta d'<a href="#entry-Uaru_na" class="skt-link">Aruṇa</a> et de <a href="#entry-Ugaru_da" class="skt-link">Garuḍa</a>, qui vola l'<a href="#entry-am_rta" class="skt-link">amṛta</a> pour la délivrer de la mort — <a href="#entry-vinati" class="skt-link">n.</a> <i>vinati</i> fait de s'incliner (devant ⟨loc.⟩).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vinaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विनय</span> <i>vinaya</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vinii" class="skt-link">vinī</a>] <a href="#entry-vinaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> enseignement (des valeurs morales), discipline <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> éducation, conduite <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bonne conduite, obéissance; décence, modestie <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bd. code disciplinaire (d'un ordre monastique) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Vinaya, fils de <a href="#entry-Udharma" class="skt-link">Dharma</a> et de <a href="#entry-Ukriyaa" class="skt-link">Kriyā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vinayasuutra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vinayasūtra</i> [<a href="#entry-suutra" class="skt-link">sūtra</a>] <a href="#entry-vinayasuutra" class="skt-link">n.</a> bd. np. du Vinayasūtra, code disciplinaire bd.<br> <a href="#entry-vinaya" class="skt-link">vinaya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vinayataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vinayatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-vinayataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> bonne conduite; modestie.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vinayavat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vinayavat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vinayavat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vinayavat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vinayavatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vinayavatī</i> qui a une bonne conduite; modeste — <a href="#entry-vinayavatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vinayavatī</i> lit. [DKC.] np. de Vinayavatī «Modeste»; elle adopta le bébé issu des amours de <a href="#entry-Uzuudraka_2" class="skt-link">Śūdraka_2</a> et d'<a href="#entry-Uaaryadaasii" class="skt-link">Āryadāsī</a>, développant l'amour maternel de sa future incarnation <a href="#entry-Ukaantimatii" class="skt-link">Kāntimatī</a> envers son fils <a href="#entry-Uarthapaala" class="skt-link">Arthapāla</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vinaz">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विनश्</span> <i>vinaś</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-naz_1" class="skt-link">naś_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. <i>(vinaśyati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vinaṣṭa</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>anu</i><i>)</i> périr, disparaître <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> être perdu, être ruiné — ca. <i>(vināśayati)</i> causer la ruine de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vinda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विन्द</span> <i>vinda</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vid_2" class="skt-link">vid_2</a>] ifc. <a href="#entry-vinda" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vindaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vindā</i> qui acquiert, qui possède; qui trouve.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vindhya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विन्ध्य</span> <i>vindhya</i> <a href="#entry-vindhya" class="skt-link">m.</a> [<i>vindhyagiri</i>] géo. nom de la chaîne des monts Vindhya <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de sa personnification <a href="#entry-Uvindhya" class="skt-link">Vindhya</a>; il s'inclina devant le <a href="#entry-_r_si" class="skt-link">ṛṣi</a> <a href="#entry-Uagasti" class="skt-link">Agasti</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vindhyaacala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vindhyācala</i> [<a href="#entry-acala" class="skt-link">acala</a>] <a href="#entry-vindhyaacala" class="skt-link">m.</a> géo. la chaîne des Monts <a href="#entry-Uvindhya" class="skt-link">Vindhya</a>; syn. <a href="#entry-vindhyagiri" class="skt-link">vindhyagiri</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. np. de Vindhyācala, site de pélerinage sur le Gange en amont de <a href="#entry-Uvaaraa_nasii" class="skt-link">Vārāṇasī</a> (loin des Monts <a href="#entry-Uvindhya" class="skt-link">Vindhya</a>, près de mod. Mirzapur, Uttar Pradesh); on y trouve le temple de <a href="#entry-Uvindhyavaasinii" class="skt-link">Vindhyavāsinī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vindhyaacalavaasinii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vindhyācalavāsinī</i> [<a href="#entry-vaasinii" class="skt-link">vāsinī</a>] <a href="#entry-vindhyaacalavaasinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> géo. np. de Vindhyācalavāsinī; cf. <a href="#entry-Uvindhyavaasinii" class="skt-link">Vindhyavāsinī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vindhyaavalii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vindhyāvalī</i> [<a href="#entry-aavalii" class="skt-link">āvalī</a>] <a href="#entry-vindhyaavalii" class="skt-link">f.</a> myth. np. de Vindhyāvalī «chaîne du <a href="#entry-Uvindhya" class="skt-link">Vindhya</a>», épouse du roi <a href="#entry-daitya" class="skt-link">daitya</a> <a href="#entry-Ubali" class="skt-link">Bali</a>, mère de <a href="#entry-Ubaa_na" class="skt-link">Bāṇa</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vindhya" class="skt-link">vindhya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vindhyagiri">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vindhyagiri</i> [<a href="#entry-giri" class="skt-link">giri</a>] <a href="#entry-vindhyagiri" class="skt-link">m.</a> géo. nom de la chaîne des monts <a href="#entry-Uvindhya" class="skt-link">Vindhya</a> traversant la péninsule indienne d'Est en Ouest et séparant l'Inde du Sud (Deccan) de la plaine Indo-Gangétique.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vindhyavaasin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vindhyavāsin</i> [<a href="#entry-vaasin_1" class="skt-link">vāsin_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vindhyavaasin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vindhyavaasin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vindhyavaasinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vindhyavāsinī</i> qui habite les monts <a href="#entry-Uvindhya" class="skt-link">Vindhya</a> — <a href="#entry-vindhyavaasinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vindhyavāsinī</i> myth. np. de Vindhyavāsinī, épith. de <a href="#entry-Udurgaa" class="skt-link">Durgā</a> «qui demeure au Mont <a href="#entry-Uvindhya" class="skt-link">Vindhya</a>»; son temple se trouve à <a href="#entry-Uvindhyaacala" class="skt-link">Vindhyācala</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vindu_1">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vindu_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विन्दु</span> <i>vindu_2</i> [<a href="#entry-vid_2" class="skt-link">vid_2</a><a href="#entry--u" class="skt-link">-u</a>] ifc. <a href="#entry-vindu_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> qui cherche; qui trouve; familier avec.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vinii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विनी</span> <i>vinī</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-nii_1" class="skt-link">nī_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vinayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vinīta</i><i>)</i> éloigner, chasser; dresser, discipliner; éduquer, instruire.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viniita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विनीत</span> <i>vinīta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vinii" class="skt-link">vinī</a>] a. <a href="#entry-viniita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-viniita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-viniitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vinītā</i> emmené, enlevé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> discipliné, éduqué, bien élevé, versé dans ⟨loc. iic.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> humble, modeste; correctement vêtu.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vinimaya">

  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विनिपात</span> <i>vinipāta</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vinipat" class="skt-link">vinipat</a>] <a href="#entry-vinipaata" class="skt-link">m.</a> coups; chute, ruine.

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vinipatati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vinipatita</i><i>)</i> s'écrouler — ca. <i>(vinipātayati)</i> abattre, détruire.
  </div>
</div>

</div>

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vinirdiśati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vinirdiṣṭa</i><i>)</i> indiquer, désigner qqc. ⟨acc.⟩ comme ⟨acc.⟩; destiner à ⟨loc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> déterminer, spécifier, définir; résoudre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vinirmaa">

[<span class="skt-grammar">3</span>] pr. md. <i>(vinirmimīte)</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(vinirmāti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vinirmita</i><i>)</i> façonner, fabriquer, construire, créer.
  </div>

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viniv_rt">

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(vinivartate)</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vinivartati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vinivṛtta</i><i>)</i> revenir sur ses pas, en arrière; s'en retourner <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> se retirer, cesser.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viniyoga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viniyogamantra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viniyogamantra</i> [<a href="#entry-mantra" class="skt-link">mantra</a>] <a href="#entry-viniyogamantra" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-viniyogamantra" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. formule qui attribue un sage [<a href="#entry-_r_si" class="skt-link">ṛṣi</a>] comme auteur-visionnaire à chaque hymne du <a href="#entry-U_rgveda" class="skt-link">Ṛgveda</a>, et indique leur mètre et leur ton.
  </div>

[<a href="#entry-miimaa_msaa" class="skt-link">mīmāṃsā</a>] injonction rituelle auxiliaire, par exemple spécifiant un instrument.<br> <a href="#entry-viniyoga" class="skt-link">viniyoga</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viniyuj">

[<span class="skt-grammar">7</span>] pr. md. <i>(viniyuṅkte)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>viniyukta</i><i>)</i> détacher, disjoindre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lancer une flèche à ⟨loc.⟩; assigner, destiner à, charger de ⟨dat. loc. <i>artham</i>⟩.
  </div>
</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">

[<span class="skt-grammar">5</span>] pr. <i>(viniścinoti)</i> pr. md. <i>(viniścinute)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>viniścita</i><i>)</i> abs. <i>(</i><i>viniścitya</i><i>)</i> inf. <i>(viniścetum)</i> délibérer, discuter; prendre en considération; décider, conclure.<br> <i>viniścetuṃ</i> <i>śakyo</i> <i>na</i> <i>sukhamiti</i> <i>vā</i> <i>duḥkhamiti</i> <i>vā</i> <i>prabodho</i> <i>nidrā</i> <i>vā</i> <i>kimu</i> <i>viṣavisarpaḥ</i> <i>kimu</i> <i>madaḥ</i> [<a href="#entry-Uuttararaamacarita" class="skt-link">Uttararāmacarita</a>] On n'est pas capable de prendre une décision, ni si on est en joie, ni si on est en peine, ni si on sort du sommeil, à plus forte raison si on est empoisonné ou ivre.
  </div>
</div>

Beas); elle marque la limite de la progression à l'Est d'Alexandre; myth. après que <a href="#entry-Uvizvaamitra" class="skt-link">Viśvāmitra</a> eut tué son fils, <a href="#entry-Uvasi_s_tha" class="skt-link">Vasiṣṭha</a> voulut se donner la mort en se jetant dans ses flots les mains liées, mais la rivière le refusa en déliant ses liens.

</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viparyaasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विपर्यास</span> <i>viparyāsa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-viparyas" class="skt-link">viparyas</a>] <a href="#entry-viparyaasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> fait de se retourner, de verser; retournement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> transposition, inversion; échange <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> contraire, opposé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> opposition; contrariété <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> erreur; misconception, illusion; perversité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> détérioration, dégradation — ifc. inverse, opposé de.<br> <i>stutiviparyāsa</i> [«tout le contraire d'une félicitation»] blâme.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viparyas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विपर्यस्</span> <i>viparyas</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-paryas" class="skt-link">paryas</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. md. <i>(paryasyate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>viparyasta</i><i>)</i> renverser, retourner <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> invertir, échanger <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> avoir une vue erronée, confondre — ca. <i>(viparyāsayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>viparyāsita</i><i>)</i> faire tourner, changer.<br> <i>viparyāsam</i> ind. alternativement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viparyasta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विपर्यस्त</span> <i>viparyasta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-viparyas" class="skt-link">viparyas</a>] a. <a href="#entry-viparyasta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-viparyasta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-viparyastaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viparyastā</i> retourné; inversé; opposé, contraire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. interchangé, inversé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. improprement conçu.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viparyaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विपर्यय</span> <i>viparyaya</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-viparii" class="skt-link">viparī</a>] a. <a href="#entry-viparyaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-viparyaya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-viparyayaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viparyayā</i> inverse, opposé, contraire (à ⟨g.⟩) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> inversé, renversé; inverti, pervers — <a href="#entry-viparyaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> tour, révolution <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> changement, transposition, échange; volte-face, revirement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> ordre inverse, opinion contraire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> contradiction, erreur; revers de fortune, malheur, calamité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>] l'erreur de jugement, un <a href="#entry-cittav_rtti" class="skt-link">cittavṛtti</a>.<br> <i>viparyaye</i> var. <i>viparyayeṇa</i>, <i>viparyayāt</i> dans le cas contraire.<br> <i>viparyayaṃ</i> <i>yā</i> se transformer en son contraire.<br> <i>viparyayam</i> <i>i</i> mal finir.<br> <i>kālaviparyayaḥ</i> laps de temps.
  </div>
</div>

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vipatati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vipatita</i><i>)</i> partir dans toutes les directions, exploser.<br> <i>mātiprākṣīḥ</i> <i>mā</i> <i>te</i> <i>mūrdhā</i> <i>vyapatat</i> Ne pose pas trop de questions, sinon ta tête va éclater.

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vipra">

  </div>
</div>

[<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. de Vipracitti «Sagace», aîné des <a href="#entry-daanavaas" class="skt-link">dānavās</a>; <a href="#entry-Usi_mhikaa" class="skt-link">Siṃhikā</a> était son épouse, <a href="#entry-Uraahu" class="skt-link">Rāhu</a> son fils; il fut tué par <a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a>, et revint sur terre comme <a href="#entry-Ujaraasandha" class="skt-link">Jarāsandha</a>.
  </div>
</div>
