<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vipratipadya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विप्रतिपद्य</span> <i>vipratipadya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-vipratipad" class="skt-link">vipratipad</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vipratipadya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vipratipadya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vipratipadyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vipratipadyā</i> contestable; à quoi l'on doit s'opposer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vipratipanna">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विप्रतिपन्न</span> <i>vipratipanna</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vipratipad" class="skt-link">vipratipad</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vipratipanna" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vipratipanna" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vipratipannaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vipratipannā</i> parti dans une autre direction <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> perplexe; confus; hésitant, incertain <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> d'opinion contraire; opposant <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> de jugement erroné; dans l'erreur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> interdit, prohibé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vipratipannabuddhi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vipratipannabuddhi</i> [<a href="#entry-buddhi" class="skt-link">buddhi</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vipratipannabuddhi" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vipratipannabuddhi" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vipratipannabuddhi" class="skt-link">f.</a> dont le raisonnement est erroné.<br> <a href="#entry-vipratipanna" class="skt-link">vipratipanna</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vipratipatti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विप्रतिपत्ति</span> <i>vipratipatti</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vipratipad" class="skt-link">vipratipad</a>] <a href="#entry-vipratipatti" class="skt-link">f.</a> différence d'opinion; contrariété, contradiction <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. incompatiblité entre concepts ou règles <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> perception erronée; erreur; suspicion envers ⟨loc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> aversion; hostilité; objection.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vipravas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विप्रवस्</span> <i>vipravas</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-pravas" class="skt-link">pravas</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vipravasati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>viproṣita</i><i>)</i> partir en voyage; partir à l'étranger; vivre à l'étranger.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viprayoga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विप्रयोग</span> <i>viprayoga</i> [act. <a href="#entry-viprayuj" class="skt-link">viprayuj</a>] <a href="#entry-viprayoga" class="skt-link">m.</a> dissociation, séparation; opp. <a href="#entry-sa_myoga" class="skt-link">saṃyoga</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viprayuj">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विप्रयुज्</span> <i>viprayuj</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-prayuj" class="skt-link">prayuj</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">7</span>] pr. <i>(viprayunakti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>viprayukta</i><i>)</i> séparer de, priver de ⟨i.⟩ — ps. <i>(viprayujyate)</i> être séparé de ⟨i.⟩ — ca. <i>(viprayojayati)</i> faire séparer, écarter; priver de ⟨i.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> libérer de ⟨i.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viprayukta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विप्रयुक्त</span> <i>viprayukta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-viprayuj" class="skt-link">viprayuj</a>] a. <a href="#entry-viprayukta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-viprayukta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-viprayuktaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viprayuktā</i> séparé; retiré <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> sans ⟨i.⟩; hors de, libéré de ⟨i.⟩ — ifc. absent de; sans.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vipriya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विप्रिय</span> <i>vipriya</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-priya" class="skt-link">priya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vipriya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vipriya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vipriyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vipriyā</i> désagréable, déplaisant; inamical (envers ⟨g. iic.⟩).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vipro_sita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विप्रोषित</span> <i>viproṣita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vipravas" class="skt-link">vipravas</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vipro_sita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vipro_sita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vipro_sitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viproṣitā</i> qui demeure au loin; parti pour ⟨acc.⟩; absent de ⟨abl.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vipsaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विप्सा</span> <i>vipsā</i> [relié à <a href="#entry-viipsaa" class="skt-link">vīpsā</a>] <a href="#entry-vipsaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> répétition, succession.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vipu_s_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विपुष्ट</span> <i>vipuṣṭa</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-pu_s_ta" class="skt-link">puṣṭa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vipu_s_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vipu_s_ta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vipu_s_taa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vipuṣṭā</i> bien nourri; maigre, affamé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vipula">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विपुल</span> <i>vipula</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-pula" class="skt-link">pula</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vipula" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vipula" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vipulaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vipulā</i> grand, gros, large, volumineux, étendu; abondant, important; intense; fort (not. bruit) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> noble — <a href="#entry-vipula" class="skt-link">m.</a> homme respectable — <a href="#entry-vipulaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vipulā</i> la Terre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phon. forme irrégulière du mètre <a href="#entry-aaryaa" class="skt-link">āryā</a>; opp. <a href="#entry-pathyaa" class="skt-link">pathyā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vipulaa_msa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vipulāṃsa</i> [<a href="#entry-a_msa" class="skt-link">aṃsa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vipulaa_msa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vipulaa_msa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vipulaa_msaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vipulāṃsā</i> aux larges épaules.<br> <a href="#entry-vipula" class="skt-link">vipula</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viraa_t">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विराट्</span> <i>virāṭ</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-viraaj_2" class="skt-link">virāj_2</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viraa_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विराट</span> <i>virāṭa</i> [<a href="#entry-viraa_t" class="skt-link">virāṭ</a>] <a href="#entry-viraa_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. de Virāṭa «Souverain», roi des <a href="#entry-matsyaas" class="skt-link">matsyās</a>; sa cour était à <a href="#entry-Uupaplavya" class="skt-link">Upaplavya</a>; il possédait de nombreux troupeaux; <a href="#entry-Usude_s_naa_1" class="skt-link">Sudeṣṇā_1</a> était sa reine, dont le frère <a href="#entry-Ukiicaka" class="skt-link">Kīcaka</a> commandait son armée; <a href="#entry-Uuttara" class="skt-link">Uttara</a> et <a href="#entry-Uuttaraa" class="skt-link">Uttarā</a> sont ses enfants; il hébergea les <a href="#entry-paa_n_davaas" class="skt-link">pāṇḍavās</a> sous divers déguisements lors de leur 13⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ année d'exil (cf. <a href="#entry-Ub_rhanna_daa" class="skt-link">Bṛhannaḍā</a>, <a href="#entry-Ukafka" class="skt-link">Kaṅka</a>, <a href="#entry-Uballava" class="skt-link">Ballava</a>, <a href="#entry-Ugranthika" class="skt-link">Granthika</a>, <a href="#entry-Utantipaala" class="skt-link">Tantipāla</a>); il fut tué lors de la grande bataille par <a href="#entry-Udro_na" class="skt-link">Droṇa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viraa_tanagara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>virāṭanagara</i> [<a href="#entry-nagara" class="skt-link">nagara</a>] <a href="#entry-viraa_tanagara" class="skt-link">n.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. de Virāṭanagara, capitale de <a href="#entry-Uviraa_ta" class="skt-link">Virāṭa</a>, où les <a href="#entry-paa_n_davaas" class="skt-link">pāṇḍavās</a> se cachèrent lors de leur 13⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ année d'exil; elle se trouvait au bord de la <a href="#entry-Uvetravatii" class="skt-link">Vetravatī</a>; aussi appelée <a href="#entry-Uupaplavya" class="skt-link">Upaplavya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viraa_taparvan">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>virāṭaparvan</i> [<a href="#entry-parvan" class="skt-link">parvan</a>] <a href="#entry-viraa_taparvan" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. 4⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ livre du <a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>, «du roi <a href="#entry-Uviraa_ta" class="skt-link">Virāṭa</a>».<br> <a href="#entry-viraa_ta" class="skt-link">virāṭa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viraa_tpuru_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>virāṭpuruṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-puru_sa" class="skt-link">puruṣa</a>] <a href="#entry-viraa_tpuru_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. l'Être Cosmique.<br> <a href="#entry-viraa_t" class="skt-link">virāṭ</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viraaddha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विराद्ध</span> <i>virāddha</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-viraadh" class="skt-link">virādh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-viraaddha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-viraaddha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-viraaddhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>virāddhā</i> contré; blessé, injurié.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viraadh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विराध्</span> <i>virādh</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-raadh" class="skt-link">rādh</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. <i>(virādhyati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>virādha</i><i>)</i> contrer, empêcher; blesser — ca. <i>(virādhayati)</i> désapprouver, se désolidariser de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viraadha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विराध</span> <i>virādha</i> [act. <a href="#entry-viraadh" class="skt-link">virādh</a>] <a href="#entry-viraadha" class="skt-link">m.</a> obstruction, opposition <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] np. de Virādha «Obstructeur», premier <a href="#entry-raak_sasa" class="skt-link">rākṣasa</a> rencontré par <a href="#entry-Uraama" class="skt-link">Rāma</a> dans la forêt <a href="#entry-Uda_n_dakaa" class="skt-link">Daṇḍakā</a>, d'épouvantable apparence; il tenta d'enlever <a href="#entry-Usiitaa" class="skt-link">Sītā</a>; <a href="#entry-Uraama" class="skt-link">Rāma</a> et <a href="#entry-Ulak_sma_na" class="skt-link">Lakṣmaṇa</a> lui coupèrent les mains et l'enterrèrent vivant; il leur révéla qu'il était le <a href="#entry-gandharva" class="skt-link">gandharva</a> <a href="#entry-Utumburu" class="skt-link">Tumburu</a> maudit par <a href="#entry-Ukubera" class="skt-link">Kubera</a>; <a href="#entry-Uraama" class="skt-link">Rāma</a> le libéra, il retrouva sa forme céleste, et indiqua aux princes le chemin de l'ermitage de <a href="#entry-Uzarabhafga" class="skt-link">Śarabhaṅga</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viraaga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विराग</span> <i>virāga</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-raaga" class="skt-link">rāga</a>] a. <a href="#entry-viraaga" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-viraaga" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-viraagaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>virāgā</i> qui est sans passion, qui a renoncé au monde; indifférent — <a href="#entry-viraaga" class="skt-link">m.</a> dégoût, aversion (envers ⟨loc. abl. iic.⟩); opp. <a href="#entry-raaga" class="skt-link">rāga</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> indifférence envers le monde.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viraagataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>virāgatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-viraagataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> indifférence au monde; stoïcisme.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viraagin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>virāgin</i> [<a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>] a. <a href="#entry-viraagin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-viraagin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-viraagi_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>virāgiṇī</i> indifférent (envers ⟨loc.⟩).<br> <a href="#entry-viraaga" class="skt-link">virāga</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viraaj_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विराज्</span> <i>virāj_1</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-raaj_1" class="skt-link">rāj_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(virājati)</i> pr. md. <i>(virājate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>virājita</i><i>)</i> briller, resplendir <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> régner sur ⟨g. acc.⟩, gouverner — ca. <i>(virājayati)</i> illuminer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viraaj_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विराज्</span> <i>virāj_2</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-viraaj_1" class="skt-link">virāj_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-viraaj_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-viraaj_2" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-viraaj_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> souverain — <a href="#entry-viraaj_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> roi, prince, souverain <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Virāṭ, la Puissance Créatrice ou Nourriture Divine personnifiée, épith. de <a href="#entry-Uprajaapati" class="skt-link">Prajāpati</a>, ou première création de <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a> issue de sa moitié mâle, donnant naissance par sa moitié femelle <a href="#entry-Uzataruupaa" class="skt-link">Śatarūpā</a> à <a href="#entry-Umanu" class="skt-link">Manu</a>-<a href="#entry-Usvaayambhuva" class="skt-link">Svāyaṃbhuva</a>, qui engendra les 10 géniteurs [<a href="#entry-prajaapati" class="skt-link">prajāpati</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. le Cosmos manifesté, support physique de l'Univers; macrocosme — <a href="#entry-viraaj_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> nom d'un mètre [<a href="#entry-chandas" class="skt-link">chandas</a>] védique.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viraama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विराम</span> <i>virāma</i> [act. <a href="#entry-viram" class="skt-link">viram</a>] <a href="#entry-viraama" class="skt-link">m.</a> cessation, arrêt; pause; repos <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. signe indiquant qu'une syllabe se termine par une consonne; cf. <a href="#entry-halanta" class="skt-link">halanta</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> abstention; fait de se désister; désintéressement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. milieu d'une stance, indiqué en écriture par le <a href="#entry-da_n_da" class="skt-link">daṇḍa</a> |.<br> <i>virāmaṃ</i> <i>yā</i> var. <i>virāmaṃprayā</i> s'arrêter, se reposer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viraava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विराव</span> <i>virāva</i> [act. <a href="#entry-viru" class="skt-link">viru</a>] <a href="#entry-viraava" class="skt-link">m.</a> bruit, bourdonnement; cri, hurlement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-virac">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विरच्</span> <i>virac</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-rac" class="skt-link">rac</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(viracayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>viracita</i><i>)</i> former, arranger; façonner, construire, ériger <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> inventer, composer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> porter, arborer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viracita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विरचित</span> <i>viracita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-virac" class="skt-link">virac</a>] a. <a href="#entry-viracita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-viracita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-viracitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viracitā</i> construit, arrangé; érigé; inventé, composé; porté <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> composé par, d'auteur ⟨i. iic.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-virah">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विरह्</span> <i>virah</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-rah" class="skt-link">rah</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(virahayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>virahita</i><i>)</i> quitter, abandonner.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viraha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विरह</span> <i>viraha</i> [act. <a href="#entry-virah" class="skt-link">virah</a>] <a href="#entry-viraha" class="skt-link">m.</a> séparation d'avec ⟨i.⟩, absence — ifc. manque de.<br> <i>virahīkṛ</i> séparer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-virahin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विरहिन्</span> <i>virahin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-virah" class="skt-link">virah</a>] a. <a href="#entry-virahin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-virahin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-virahi_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>virahiṇī</i> abandonné; désert, solitaire; seul <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> séparé de, délivré de, privé de ⟨i. g. iic.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> absent <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui s'abstient de ⟨iic.⟩ — <a href="#entry-virahi_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>virahiṇī</i> femme séparée de son mari ou amant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-virahita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विरहित</span> <i>virahita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-virah" class="skt-link">virah</a>] a. <a href="#entry-virahita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-virahita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-virahitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>virahitā</i> abandonné — ifc. séparé ou privé de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-virahitaat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विरहितात्</span> <i>virahitāt</i> à l'exception de ⟨g.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viraja">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विरज</span> <i>viraja</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-rajas" class="skt-link">rajas</a>] a. <a href="#entry-viraja" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-viraja" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-virajaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>virajā</i> propre, pur, non pollué <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> (au fig.) libéré des passions — <a href="#entry-viraja" class="skt-link">m.</a> np. Viraja «Immaculé» — <a href="#entry-virajaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>virajā</i> libérée des menstrues <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> np. Virajā «Immaculée».<br> <i>virajīkṛ</i> libérer (de la poussière ou des passions).<br> <i>virajībhū</i> se libérer (de la poussière ou des passions).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-virajaananda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>virajānanda</i> [<a href="#entry-aananda" class="skt-link">ānanda</a>] <a href="#entry-virajaananda" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. du <a href="#entry-Usvaamii" class="skt-link">Svāmī</a> Virajānanda <a href="#entry-Usarasvatii_2" class="skt-link">Sarasvatī_2</a> (1757–1868), né au Pañjāb, aveugle à l'âge de 5 ans; maître de sanskrit védique, il enseigna not. à <a href="#entry-Umathuraa" class="skt-link">Mathurā</a>; <a href="#entry-Usvaamii" class="skt-link">Svāmī</a> <a href="#entry-Udayaananda_1" class="skt-link">Dayānanda_1</a> <a href="#entry-Usarasvatii_2" class="skt-link">Sarasvatī_2</a> fut son élève.<br> <a href="#entry-viraja" class="skt-link">viraja</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-virajas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विरजस्</span> <i>virajas</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-rajas" class="skt-link">rajas</a>] a. <a href="#entry-virajas" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-virajas" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-virajas" class="skt-link">f.</a> cf. <a href="#entry-viraja" class="skt-link">viraja</a> — <a href="#entry-virajas" class="skt-link">m.</a> np. de Virajā «Pur»; myth. nom de nombreux sages.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-virakta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विरक्त</span> <i>virakta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vira_nj" class="skt-link">virañj</a>] a. <a href="#entry-virakta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-virakta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-viraktaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viraktā</i> indifférent, ne prenant plus d'intérêt à, n'éprouvant pas d'amour pour ⟨abl. loc. iic.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-virala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विरल</span> <i>virala</i> a. <a href="#entry-virala" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-virala" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-viralaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viralā</i> espacé, clairsemé; rare; pauvre en ⟨loc.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viram">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विरम्</span> <i>viram</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-ram" class="skt-link">ram</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(viramati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>virata</i><i>)</i> abs. <i>(</i><i>viramya</i><i>)</i> arrêter, cesser, finir <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> mettre un terme à, cesser de, renoncer à ⟨abl.⟩ — ca. <i>(viramayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>viramita</i><i>)</i> arrêter, faire cesser.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-virama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विरम</span> <i>virama</i> [act. <a href="#entry-viram" class="skt-link">viram</a>] <a href="#entry-virama" class="skt-link">m.</a> cessation, arrêt; abstention <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> coucher (du soleil) — ifc. renoncement à.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viramita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विरमित</span> <i>viramita</i> [ca. pp. <a href="#entry-viram" class="skt-link">viram</a>] a. <a href="#entry-viramita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-viramita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-viramitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viramitā</i> arrêté (de force).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viramya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विरम्य</span> <i>viramya</i> [abs. <a href="#entry-viram" class="skt-link">viram</a>] ind. ayant arrêté.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-virasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विरस</span> <i>virasa</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-rasa" class="skt-link">rasa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-virasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-virasa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-virasaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>virasā</i> insipide.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-virata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विरत</span> <i>virata</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-viram" class="skt-link">viram</a>] a. <a href="#entry-virata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-virata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-virataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viratā</i> arrêté (de son plein gré), terminé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui renonce à ⟨abl. loc. iic.⟩ — <a href="#entry-virata" class="skt-link">n.</a> (impers.) ce qui est arrêté.<br> <i>virataṃ</i> <i>vācā</i> la voix s'est arrêtée.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vira_nj">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विरञ्ज्</span> <i>virañj</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-ra_nj" class="skt-link">rañj</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. <i>(virajyati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>virakta</i><i>)</i> se décolorer, changer de couleur; renoncer aux passions, devenir indifférent, se désintéresser de ⟨abl. loc.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-virecana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विरेचन</span> <i>virecana</i> [act. <a href="#entry-viric" class="skt-link">viric</a>] <a href="#entry-virecana" class="skt-link">n.</a> méd. purge.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-virecin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विरेचिन्</span> <i>virecin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-viric" class="skt-link">viric</a>] a. <a href="#entry-virecin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-virecin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-virecinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>virecinī</i> qui purge.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vireka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विरेक</span> <i>vireka</i> [act. <a href="#entry-viric" class="skt-link">viric</a>] <a href="#entry-vireka" class="skt-link">n.</a> fait de purger; évacuation intestinale.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viric">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विरिच्</span> <i>viric</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-ric" class="skt-link">ric</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. md. <i>(viricyate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>virikta</i><i>)</i> se vider, se purger — ca. <i>(vireciyati)</i> vider, évacuer; purger.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-virikta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विरिक्त</span> <i>virikta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-viric" class="skt-link">viric</a>] a. <a href="#entry-virikta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-virikta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-viriktaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viriktā</i> évacué, vidé, purgé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viri_nca">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विरिञ्च</span> <i>viriñca</i> <a href="#entry-viri_nca" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Viriñca, un nom de <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viroc">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विरोच्</span> <i>viroc</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-viruc" class="skt-link">viruc</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(virocayati)</i> faire briller.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-virocana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विरोचन</span> <i>virocana</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-viroc" class="skt-link">viroc</a>] a. <a href="#entry-virocana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-virocana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-virocanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>virocanā</i> qui illumine, qui éclaire — <a href="#entry-virocana" class="skt-link">m.</a> soleil; lune <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Virocana «l'Éclatant», démon [<a href="#entry-daitya" class="skt-link">daitya</a>] fils de <a href="#entry-Uprahlaada" class="skt-link">Prahlāda</a>, père de <a href="#entry-Ubali" class="skt-link">Bali</a>; il dut s'incliner devant son rival <a href="#entry-Usudhanvaa" class="skt-link">Sudhanvā</a> pour les faveurs d'une belle.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-virodh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विरोध्</span> <i>virodh</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-virudh" class="skt-link">virudh</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(virodhayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>virodhita</i><i>)</i> rendre hostile, provoquer une brouille.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-virodha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विरोध</span> <i>virodha</i> [act. <a href="#entry-virudh" class="skt-link">virudh</a>] <a href="#entry-virodha" class="skt-link">m.</a> opposition, hostilité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> querelle, dissension, litige (entre ⟨g.⟩, avec ⟨i.-<a href="#entry-saha" class="skt-link">saha</a> iic.⟩) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. contradiction, antithèse, incohérence; incompatibilité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> incongruité; dommage; adversité, calamité; perversité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> (théâtre) événement contraire à la progression de l'intrigue <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> ennemi — ifc. conflit avec.<br> <i>virodhīkṛ</i> s'opposer, se révolter, faire objection; faire obstacle; chercher querelle.<br> <i>virodhāvirodhau</i> <i>nirūpayet</i> on doit examiner s'il y a ou non contradiction.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-virodhaabhaasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>virodhābhāsa</i> [<a href="#entry-aabhaasa" class="skt-link">ābhāsa</a>] <a href="#entry-virodhaabhaasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. rhét. contradiction apparente; ressemblance de qualités opposées.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-virodhaalafkaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>virodhālaṃkāra</i> [<a href="#entry-alafkaara" class="skt-link">alaṃkāra</a>] <a href="#entry-virodhaala_mkaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. figure de style de contradiction apparente.<br> <a href="#entry-virodha" class="skt-link">virodha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-virodhak_rt">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>virodhakṛt</i> [<a href="#entry-k_rt_2" class="skt-link">kṛt_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-virodhak_rt" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-virodhak_rt" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-virodhak_rt" class="skt-link">f.</a> provoquant la révolte, semant la discorde — <a href="#entry-virodhak_rt" class="skt-link">m.</a> ennemi <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> astr. np. de Virodhakṛt «Conflit», fils de <a href="#entry-Unaaradii" class="skt-link">Nāradī</a> personnifiant l'an 45 d'un cycle de vie [<a href="#entry-sa_mvatsara" class="skt-link">saṃvatsara</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-virodhaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विरोधक</span> <i>virodhaka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-virudh" class="skt-link">virudh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-virodhaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-virodhaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-virodhikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>virodhikā</i> qui s'oppose, qui fait obstacle; opposant; conflictuel <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> incompatible avec, en conflit avec ⟨g. iic.⟩ — ifc. obstacle à.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-virodhana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विरोधन</span> <i>virodhana</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-virudh" class="skt-link">virudh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-virodhana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-virodhana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-virodhanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>virodhanā</i> ifc. qui lutte contre — <a href="#entry-virodhana" class="skt-link">n.</a> conflit avec, contestation de ⟨g.⟩; objection à ⟨iic.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> incongruité; incohérence.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-virodhaparihaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>virodhaparihāra</i> [<a href="#entry-parihaara" class="skt-link">parihāra</a>] <a href="#entry-virodhaparihaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> retrait d'une incompatibilité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> réconciliation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. réconciliation de points de vue contradictoires.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-virodhi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विरोधि</span> <i>virodhi</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-virodhin" class="skt-link">virodhin</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-virodhin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विरोधिन्</span> <i>virodhin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-virudh" class="skt-link">virudh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-virodhin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-virodhin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-virodhinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>virodhinī</i> qui obstrue, qui empêche <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> contraire, contradictoire — <a href="#entry-virodhin" class="skt-link">m.</a> adversaire, ennemi <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> astr. np. de Virodhī «Obstacle», fils de <a href="#entry-Unaaradii" class="skt-link">Nāradī</a> personnifiant l'an 23 d'un cycle de vie — ifc. ennemi de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-virodhita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विरोधित</span> <i>virodhita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-virodh" class="skt-link">virodh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-virodhita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-virodhita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-virodhitaa_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>virodhitā_2</i> combattu, contesté; à qui on a cherché querelle, offensé; blessé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-virodhitaa_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>virodhitā_1</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-virodhitaa_1" class="skt-link">f.</a> opposition; inimitié; haine.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-virodhitva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>virodhitva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-virodhitva" class="skt-link">n.</a> suppression, obstruction.<br> <a href="#entry-virodhi" class="skt-link">virodhi</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viru">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विरु</span> <i>viru</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-ru" class="skt-link">ru</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(virauti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>viruta</i><i>)</i> faire du bruit (gazouiller, bourdonner, etc.); crier, hurler.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viruc">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विरुच्</span> <i>viruc</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-ruc_1" class="skt-link">ruc_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(virocate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>virūcita</i><i>)</i> briller, illuminer; exceller — ca. <i>(virocayati)</i> faire briller.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viruca">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विरुच</span> <i>viruca</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-viruc" class="skt-link">viruc</a>] <a href="#entry-viruca" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. formule magique à prononcer sur une arme.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viruda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विरुद</span> <i>viruda</i> var. <i>biruda</i> <a href="#entry-viruda" class="skt-link">m.</a> panégyrique ou surnom glorieux d'un prince; cf. <a href="#entry-Umahaamalla" class="skt-link">Mahāmalla</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> proclamation.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viruddha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विरुद्ध</span> <i>viruddha</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-virudh" class="skt-link">virudh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-viruddha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-viruddha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-viruddhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viruddhā</i> opposé, obstrué, empêché, bloqué; interdit, prohibé; exclu (de ⟨g. i. iic.⟩) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> uncertain, dangereux, douteux; incohérent, incompatible <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> contraire; hostile, adverse, ennemi <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> déplaisant, répugnant; désagréable, odieux, haineux (de ⟨iic.⟩) — <a href="#entry-viruddha" class="skt-link">n.</a> opposition, hostilité, répugnance <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. rhét. figure attribuant à son simili des propriétés contraires à sa nature.<br> <i>viruddham</i> de manière incongrue ou perverse.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-virudh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विरुध्</span> <i>virudh</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-rudh_2" class="skt-link">rudh_2</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">7</span>] pr. <i>(viruṇaddhi)</i> pr. md. <i>(virunddhe)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>viruddha</i><i>)</i> obstruer, empêcher, s'opposer à ⟨acc.⟩ — ps. <i>(virudhyate)</i> être opposé, être hostile à, lutter contre ⟨i. g. loc. <a href="#entry-prati" class="skt-link">prati</a>-acc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> contester; être réprimé — ca. <i>(virodhayati)</i> rendre hostile, provoquer une brouille.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viruupa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विरूप</span> <i>virūpa</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-ruupa" class="skt-link">rūpa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-viruupa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-viruupa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-viruupaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>virūpā</i> multicolore; multiforme; varié, différent <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> déformé, défiguré; difforme, monstrueux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de l'<a href="#entry-afgiras" class="skt-link">aṅgiras</a> Virūpa «Infirme», fils d'<a href="#entry-Uafgiraa" class="skt-link">Aṅgirā</a> — ifc. différent de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viruupaak_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>virūpākṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-ak_sa" class="skt-link">akṣa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-viruupaak_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-viruupaak_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-viruupaak_sii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>virūpākṣī</i> qui a les yeux déformés; qui a de nombreux yeux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Virūpākṣa, épith. de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> «aux trois yeux»; il était la divinité tutélaire de l'empire <a href="#entry-Ukar_naa_ta" class="skt-link">Karṇāṭa</a> de <a href="#entry-Uvijayanagara" class="skt-link">Vijayanagara</a> où se trouve son temple principal; la rivière <a href="#entry-Upampaa" class="skt-link">Pampā</a> est son épouse <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> géo. temple de <a href="#entry-Uviruupaak_sa" class="skt-link">Virūpākṣa</a>-<a href="#entry-Ulokezvara_1" class="skt-link">Lokeśvara_1</a> construit au 8⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle par les <a href="#entry-Ucaalukyaas" class="skt-link">Cālukyās</a> de <a href="#entry-Uvaataapi" class="skt-link">Vātāpi</a> à leur capitale de couronnement (mod. village de Pattadakal à 20 km de Badāmi) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Virūpākṣa_1, roi-démon fortuné; le vautour <a href="#entry-Unaa_dijafgha" class="skt-link">Nāḍijaṅgha</a> est son ami <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] np. de Virūpākṣa_2, <a href="#entry-dizaagaja" class="skt-link">diśāgaja</a> de l'Est <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de nombreux être surnaturels <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. de Virūpakṣa_3 <a href="#entry-Uraaya" class="skt-link">Rāya</a>, empereur de <a href="#entry-Uvijayanagara" class="skt-link">Vijayanagara</a> (1404–1405) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. de Virūpakṣa_4 <a href="#entry-Uraaya" class="skt-link">Rāya</a>, empereur de <a href="#entry-Uvijayanagara" class="skt-link">Vijayanagara</a> (1465–1485).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viruupin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>virūpin</i> [<a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>] <a href="#entry-viruupin" class="skt-link">m.</a> [«multiforme»] caméléon.<br> <a href="#entry-viruupa" class="skt-link">virūpa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vis_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विसृ</span> <i>visṛ</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-s_r" class="skt-link">sṛ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(visarati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>visṛta</i><i>)</i> se répandre, s'étendre — ca. <i>(visārayati)</i> envoyer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vis_r_s_ti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विसृष्टि</span> <i>visṛṣṭi</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vis_rj" class="skt-link">visṛj</a>] <a href="#entry-vis_r_s_ti" class="skt-link">f.</a> émission, création; descendance.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vis_rj">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विसृज्</span> <i>visṛj</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-s_rj_1" class="skt-link">sṛj_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">6</span>] pr. <i>(visṛjati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>visṛṣṭa</i><i>)</i> lancer, lâcher; répandre, émettre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lancer à ⟨loc. dat. <a href="#entry-prati" class="skt-link">prati</a>-acc.⟩ — ca. <i>(visarjayati)</i> faire répandre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vis_rp">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विसृप्</span> <i>visṛp</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-s_rp" class="skt-link">sṛp</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(visarpati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>visṛpta</i><i>)</i> ramper; passer en vol (se dit des flèches) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> se disperser; diffuser, s'étendre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> rôder; dérober — ca. <i>(visarpayati)</i> étendre, disperser — inf. <i>(visṛpas)</i> se répandre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-visa_mvaada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विसंवाद</span> <i>visaṃvāda</i> [act. <a href="#entry-visa_mvad" class="skt-link">visaṃvad</a>] <a href="#entry-visa_mvaada" class="skt-link">m.</a> manquement à sa parole; contradiction; objection à ⟨i. loc. iic.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-visa_mvaadaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विसंवादक</span> <i>visaṃvādaka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-visa_mvad" class="skt-link">visaṃvad</a>] a. <a href="#entry-visa_mvaadaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-visa_mvaadaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-visa_mvaadikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>visaṃvādikā</i> qui manque à sa parole; qui contredit.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-visa_mvad">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विसंवद्</span> <i>visaṃvad</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-sa_mvad" class="skt-link">saṃvad</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(visaṃvadati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>visamudita</i><i>)</i> revenir sur sa promesse, manquer à sa parole <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> contredire, lever une objection.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-visaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विसार</span> <i>visāra</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vis_r" class="skt-link">visṛ</a>] <a href="#entry-visaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> étalement, extension, diffusion.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-visaarin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विसारिन्</span> <i>visārin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vis_r" class="skt-link">visṛ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-visaarin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-visaarin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-visaari_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>visāriṇī</i> qui sort, qui diffuse, qui s'élance (de ⟨iic.⟩) — <a href="#entry-visaarin" class="skt-link">m.</a> poisson.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-visara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विसर</span> <i>visara</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vis_r" class="skt-link">visṛ</a>] <a href="#entry-visara" class="skt-link">m.</a> écoulement, dispersion, émission, étalement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> quantité, multitude, abondance.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-visarga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विसर्ग</span> <i>visarga</i> [<a href="#entry-vis_rj" class="skt-link">visṛj</a>] <a href="#entry-visarga" class="skt-link">m.</a> émission, lancer (not. de flèche); libération, répudiation; procréation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. création du monde du rite <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phon. altération du ‘<i>s</i>’ et du ‘<i>r</i>’ devant les sourdes et en finales, en un souffle sourd suivi d'une résonance vocalique; il est représenté par ‘<i>ḥ</i>’ en transcription; on distingue parfois la forme gutturale [<a href="#entry-jihvaamuuliiya" class="skt-link">jihvāmūlīya</a>] devant ‘<i>k</i>’ et ‘<i>kh</i>’ et la forme bilabiale [<a href="#entry-upadhmaaniiya" class="skt-link">upadhmānīya</a>] devant ‘<i>p</i>’ et ‘<i>ph</i>’.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-visarjana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विसर्जन</span> <i>visarjana</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vis_rj" class="skt-link">visṛj</a>] <a href="#entry-visarjana" class="skt-link">n.</a> cessation, fin <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> évacuation, décharge; renvoi <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> abandon, désertion <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> mise en liberté du bétail au pâturage <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. abandon d'une idole à la rivière à la fin d'un festival; not. au <a href="#entry-Umahaaraa_s_tra" class="skt-link">Mahārāṣṭra</a>, lors de l'<a href="#entry-anantavrata" class="skt-link">anantavrata</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-visarjaniiya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विसर्जनीय</span> <i>visarjanīya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] <a href="#entry-vis_rj" class="skt-link">visṛj</a>] <a href="#entry-visarjaniiya" class="skt-link">m.</a> phon. ancien nom du <a href="#entry-visarga" class="skt-link">visarga</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-visarpa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विसर्प</span> <i>visarpa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vis_rp" class="skt-link">visṛp</a>] <a href="#entry-visarpa" class="skt-link">m.</a> reptation; diffusion; extension <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> méd. éruption; maladie infectieuse provoquant un œdème cutané <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. (au théâtre) action ayant une conséquence néfaste par réaction en chaîne.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-visarpin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विसर्पिन्</span> <i>visarpin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vis_rp" class="skt-link">visṛp</a>] a. <a href="#entry-visarpin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-visarpin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-visarpi_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>visarpiṇī</i> qui rampe; qui surgit; issu de ⟨iic.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui rôde, qui tourne autour <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui se diffuse, qui s'étend, qui grossit <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> malade d'une tumeur — <a href="#entry-visarpin" class="skt-link">m.</a> tumeur maligne.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-visa_nj_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विसंज्ञ</span> <i>visaṃjña</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-sa_nj_naa_2" class="skt-link">saṃjñā_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-visa_mj_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-visa_mj_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-visa_mj_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>visaṃjñā</i> inconscient, hors de soi.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vism_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विस्मृ</span> <i>vismṛ</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-sm_r" class="skt-link">smṛ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vismarati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vismṛta</i><i>)</i> oublier.<br> <i>na</i> <i>vismaratu</i> n'oubliez pas.<br> <i>na</i> <i>kadāpi</i> <i>kutrāpi</i> <i>kasyāñcidavasthāyāmapi</i> <i>bhagavantam</i> <i>tasya</i> <i>kṛpām</i> <i>ca</i> <i>vismaret</i> En tous temps, en tous lieux, en toutes circonstances, on ne doit oublier Dieu et Sa grâce.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vism_rta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विस्मृत</span> <i>vismṛta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vism_r" class="skt-link">vismṛ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vism_rta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vism_rta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vism_rtaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vismṛtā</i> oublié <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui a oublié.<br> <i>adyāpi</i> <i>sā</i> <i>na</i> <i>mayā</i> <i>vismṛtā</i> même aujourd'hui, je ne l'oublie pas.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vismara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विस्मरण</span> <i>vismaraṇa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vism_r" class="skt-link">vismṛ</a>] <a href="#entry-vismara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> oubli.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vismaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विस्मय</span> <i>vismaya</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vismi" class="skt-link">vismi</a>] <a href="#entry-vismaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> étonnement, surprise, stupeur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vismayaanvita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vismayānvita</i> [<a href="#entry-anvita" class="skt-link">anvita</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vismayaanvita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vismayaanvita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vismayaanvitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vismayānvitā</i> frappé de stupeur.<br> <a href="#entry-vismaya" class="skt-link">vismaya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vismayin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विस्मयिन्</span> <i>vismayin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vismi" class="skt-link">vismi</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vismayin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vismayin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vismayinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vismayinī</i> étonné, surpris.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vismi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विस्मि</span> <i>vismi</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-smi" class="skt-link">smi</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(vismayate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vismita</i><i>)</i> s'étonner.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vismita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विस्मित</span> <i>vismita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vismi" class="skt-link">vismi</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vismita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vismita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vismitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vismitā</i> étonné.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vispa_s_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विस्पष्ट</span> <i>vispaṣṭa</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-spa_s_ta" class="skt-link">spaṣṭa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vispa_s_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vispa_s_ta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vispa_s_taa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vispaṣṭā</i> clair, évident, manifeste; intelligible.<br> <i>vispaṣṭam</i> acc. adv. clairement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-visphur">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विस्फुर्</span> <i>visphur</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-sphur" class="skt-link">sphur</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">6</span>] pr. <i>(visphurati)</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">6</span>] pr. <i>(viṣphurati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>visphurita</i><i>)</i> abs. <i>(</i><i>visphūrya</i><i>)</i> trembler, vibrer, frémir, palpiter (œil, lèvre) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> étinceler, scintiller; apparaître.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-visphurita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विस्फुरित</span> <i>visphurita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-visphur" class="skt-link">visphur</a>] a. <a href="#entry-visphurita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-visphurita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-visphuritaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>visphuritā</i> tremblant, vibrant, palpitant; étincelant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-visrambha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विस्रम्भ</span> <i>visrambha</i> [<a href="#entry-vizrambh" class="skt-link">viśrambh</a>] <a href="#entry-visrambha" class="skt-link">m.</a> cf. <a href="#entry-vizrambha" class="skt-link">viśrambha</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vist_rr">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विस्तॄ</span> <i>vistṝ</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-st_rr" class="skt-link">stṝ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">9</span>] pr. <i>(vistṛṇāti)</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">5</span>] pr. <i>(vistṛṇoti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vistīrṇa</i>, <i>vistṛta</i><i>)</i> tendre; étendre, répandre — pr. md. <i>(vistṛṇīte)</i> s'étendre, se répandre — ca. <i>(vistārayati)</i> étendre, étaler, déployer.<br> <i>vacanaṃ</i> <i>vistṝ</i> parler d'abondance.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vist_rta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विस्तृत</span> <i>vistṛta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vist_rr" class="skt-link">vistṝ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vist_rta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vist_rta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vis_rtaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>visṛtā</i> couvert de ⟨i. iic.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> étendu, ouvert; large, développé; extensif; long (histoire).<br> <i>vistṛtam</i> complétement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vistaar">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विस्तार्</span> <i>vistār</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-vist_rr" class="skt-link">vistṝ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(vistārayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vistārita</i><i>)</i> étendre, étaler, déployer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vistaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विस्तार</span> <i>vistāra</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vist_rr" class="skt-link">vistṝ</a>] <a href="#entry-vistaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> extension; ampleur, largeur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> exposé détaillé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vistaarin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विस्तारिन्</span> <i>vistārin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vist_rr" class="skt-link">vistṝ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vistaarin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vistaarin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vistaari_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vistāriṇī</i> qui s'étend; vaste.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vistaarita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विस्तारित</span> <i>vistārita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vistaar" class="skt-link">vistār</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vistaarita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vistaarita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vistaaritaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vistāritā</i> étendu, étalé, déployé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vistara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विस्तर</span> <i>vistara</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vist_rr" class="skt-link">vistṝ</a>] <a href="#entry-vistara" class="skt-link">m.</a> extension, expansion, agrandissement, développement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> multitude; intensité — <a href="#entry-vistaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vistarā</i> ifc. variété de.<br> <i>vistareṇa</i> var. <i>vistarāt</i> adv. en détail; <i>in extenso</i>.<br> <i>alam</i> <i>ativistareṇa</i> trève de longueurs; assez de détails oiseux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vistaratas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vistaratas</i> [<a href="#entry--tas" class="skt-link">-tas</a>] adv. en détail; <i>in extenso</i>.<br> <a href="#entry-vistara" class="skt-link">vistara</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vistiir_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विस्तीर्ण</span> <i>vistīrṇa</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vist_rr" class="skt-link">vistṝ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vistiir_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vistiir_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vistiir_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vistīrṇā</i> couvert de ⟨i. iic.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> étendu, large, nombreux; extensif; long (histoire).<br> <i>śatayojanavistīrṇa</i> s'étendant à des centaines de lieues à la ronde.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vit_r_s_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वितृष्ण</span> <i>vitṛṣṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-t_r_s_naa" class="skt-link">tṛṣṇā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vit_r_s_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vit_r_s_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vit_r_s_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vitṛṣṇā</i> libéré du désir; qui ne convoite pas — <a href="#entry-vit_r_s_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vitṛṣṇā</i> absence de désirs.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vit_r_s_naa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वितृष्णा</span> <i>vitṛṣṇā</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vit_r_s_1" class="skt-link">vitṛṣ_1</a>] <a href="#entry-vit_r_s_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> désir violent.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vit_r_s_nataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vitṛṣṇatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-vit_r_s_nataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> absence de convoitise, satisfaction.<br> <a href="#entry-vit_r_s_na" class="skt-link">vitṛṣṇa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vit_r_s_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वितृष्</span> <i>vitṛṣ_1</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-t_r_s_1" class="skt-link">tṛṣ_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. <i>(vitṛṣyati)</i> être assoiffé — ca. <i>(vitarṣayati)</i> assoiffer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vit_r_s_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वितृष्</span> <i>vitṛṣ_2</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-t_r_s_2" class="skt-link">tṛṣ_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vit_r_s_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vit_r_s_2" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vit_r_s_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> libéré de la soif ou du désir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vit_r_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वितृष</span> <i>vitṛṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-t_r_saa" class="skt-link">tṛṣā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vit_r_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vit_r_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vit_r_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vitṛṣā</i> libéré de la soif ou du désir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vit_rr">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वितॄ</span> <i>vitṝ</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-t_rr" class="skt-link">tṝ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vitarati)</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vitirati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vitīrṇa</i><i>)</i> traverser, imprégner <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> transporter au dehors, enlever <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> donner, accorder <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> produire, accomplir, réaliser — ca. <i>(vitārayati)</i> trier, filtrer, peigner; accomplir.<br> <i>āsanaṃ</i> <i>vitṝ</i> offrir un siège.<br> <i>uttaraṃ</i> <i>vitṝ</i> accorder une réponse.<br> <i>darśanaṃ</i> <i>vitṝ</i> autoriser la vue; accorder une audience.<br> <i>dvāraṃ</i> <i>vitṝ</i> accorder le passage.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vita_d">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वितड्</span> <i>vitaḍ</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-ta_d" class="skt-link">taḍ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(vitāḍayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vitāḍita</i><i>)</i> se défendre, frapper en retour; écraser <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> se battre contre ⟨loc.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vita_n_da">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वितण्ड</span> <i>vitaṇḍa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vita_d" class="skt-link">vitaḍ</a>] <a href="#entry-vita_n_da" class="skt-link">m.</a> serrure à trois gorges — <a href="#entry-vita_n_daa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vitaṇḍā</i> objection stérile; dérision; argutie, obstruction; controverse <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. rhét. critique ou moquerie de la thèse adverse; opp. <a href="#entry-vaada" class="skt-link">vāda</a>, <a href="#entry-jalpa" class="skt-link">jalpa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vita_s_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वितष्ट</span> <i>vitaṣṭa</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-ta_s_ta" class="skt-link">taṣṭa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vita_s_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vita_s_ta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vita_s_taa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vitaṣṭā</i> creusé, sculpté; aplani.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vitaala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विताल</span> <i>vitāla</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-taala" class="skt-link">tāla</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vitaala" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vitaala" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vitaalaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vitālā</i> à contre-temps.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vitaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वितान</span> <i>vitāna</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vitan" class="skt-link">vitan</a>] <a href="#entry-vitaana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vitaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> extension, expansion; grand volume, multitude, masse <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> accomplissement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vitala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वितल</span> <i>vitala</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-tala" class="skt-link">tala</a>] <a href="#entry-vitala" class="skt-link">n.</a> myth. np. du monde [<a href="#entry-loka" class="skt-link">loka</a>] Vitala, deuxième enfer souterrain.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vitan">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वितन्</span> <i>vitan</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-tan_1" class="skt-link">tan_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">8</span>] pr. <i>(vitanoti)</i> pr. md. <i>(vitanute)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vitata</i><i>)</i> étendre, étaler; s'étendre; allonger; tendre (arc, corde, tissu) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> exécuter, accomplir (le sacrifice); déployer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>tendo</i>; fr. tendre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vitap">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वितप्</span> <i>vitap</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-tap" class="skt-link">tap</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vitapati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vitapta</i><i>)</i> dégager de la chaleur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> forcer, pénétrer — pr. md. <i>(vitapate)</i> se réchauffer; être brûlant, se consumer — ca. <i>(vitāpayati)</i> réchauffer, chauffer.<br> <i>vitapate</i> <i>svaṃ</i> <i>pṛṣṭham</i> son dos lui brûle.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vitara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वितर</span> <i>vitara</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-tara" class="skt-link">tara</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vitara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vitara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vitaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vitarā</i> qui emmène plus loin (se dit d'un chemin).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vitara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वितरण</span> <i>vitaraṇa</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vit_rr" class="skt-link">vitṝ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vitara_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vitara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vitara_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vitaraṇā</i> qui traverse — <a href="#entry-vitara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> traversée <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> transfert; donation.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vitark">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वितर्क्</span> <i>vitark</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-tark" class="skt-link">tark</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(vitarkayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vitarkita</i><i>)</i> réfléchir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vitarka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वितर्क</span> <i>vitarka</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vitark" class="skt-link">vitark</a>] <a href="#entry-vitarka" class="skt-link">m.</a> réflexion; supposition, conjecture, probabilité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> discussion, argumentation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> doute, soupçon.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vitarkamudraa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vitarkamudrā</i> [<a href="#entry-mudraa" class="skt-link">mudrā</a>] <a href="#entry-vitarkamudraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> bd. geste de l'argumentation, ou de l'enseignement (originellement comme <a href="#entry-abhayamudraa" class="skt-link">abhayamudrā</a>, puis pouce et index de la main réunis).<br> <a href="#entry-vitarka" class="skt-link">vitarka</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vitastaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वितस्ता</span> <i>vitastā</i> <a href="#entry-vitastaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> géo. np. de la rivière Vitastā, qui prend naissance au sud-est de la vallée du <a href="#entry-Ukazmiira" class="skt-link">Kaśmīra</a>, coule à <a href="#entry-Uzriinagara" class="skt-link">Śrīnagara</a> et se jette dans la Chenāb au Puñjab; c'est l'Hydaspes des grecs qu'atteint Alexandre; mod. Jhelum.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vitasti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वितस्ति</span> <i>vitasti</i> <a href="#entry-vitasti" class="skt-link">f.</a> mesure de hauteur, vaut 12 pouces [<a href="#entry-afgula" class="skt-link">aṅgula</a>] (environ 23 cm); syn. <a href="#entry-taala" class="skt-link">tāla</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vitata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वितत</span> <i>vitata</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vitan" class="skt-link">vitan</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vitata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vitata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vitataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vitatā</i> étendu, étalé; qui couvre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> en tension (corde d'arc); tendu (arc) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> couvert; rempli <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> large; dégagé (route).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vitatadhanvan">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vitatadhanvan</i> [<a href="#entry-dhanvan" class="skt-link">dhanvan</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vitatadhanvan" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vitatadhanvan" class="skt-link">n.</a> qui a tendu son arc.<br> <a href="#entry-vitata" class="skt-link">vitata</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vitatha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वितथ</span> <i>vitatha</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-tathaa" class="skt-link">tathā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vitatha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vitatha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vitathaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vitathā</i> faux, incorrect; futile, non pertinent <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Vitatha «Bâtard», nom donné par <a href="#entry-Ubharata" class="skt-link">Bharata</a> à son fils adoptif <a href="#entry-Ubharadvaaja_1" class="skt-link">Bharadvāja_1</a> trouvé dans la forêt; il devint l'ermite <a href="#entry-Udiirghatamaa" class="skt-link">Dīrghatamā</a>.<br> <i>vithatena</i> adv. faussement.<br> <i>vitathaṃ</i> <i>kṛ</i> révoquer, annuler.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vitathaatmad_r_s_ti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vitathātmadṛṣṭi</i> [<a href="#entry-aatmad_r_s_ti" class="skt-link">ātmadṛṣṭi</a>] <a href="#entry-vitathaatmad_r_s_ti" class="skt-link">f.</a> bd. fausse conception du Soi.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vitathataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विवरण</span> <i>vivaraṇa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-viv_r" class="skt-link">vivṛ</a>] <a href="#entry-vivara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> acte d'ouvrir ou de découvrir <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> explication, interprétation, commentaire, traduction <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. np. du Vivaraṇa «Élucidation» de la <a href="#entry-Upa_ncapaadikaa" class="skt-link">Pañcapādikā</a>, dû à <a href="#entry-Uprakaazaatman" class="skt-link">Prakāśātman</a>; par ext., école phil. <a href="#entry-advaita" class="skt-link">advaita</a> qui en découle (opp. <a href="#entry-bhaamatii" class="skt-link">bhāmatī</a>) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. np. du Vivaraṇa_1, commentaire du <a href="#entry-Ukumaarasambhava" class="skt-link">Kumārasambhava</a> par Nārāyaṇa_4 <a href="#entry-Upa_n_dita" class="skt-link">Paṇḍita</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. np. du Vivaraṇa_2, commentaire de la <a href="#entry-Uparaatriizikaa" class="skt-link">Parātrīśikā</a> par <a href="#entry-Uabhinavagupta" class="skt-link">Abhinavagupta</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vivarta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विवर्त</span> <i>vivarta</i> [act. <a href="#entry-viv_rt" class="skt-link">vivṛt</a>] <a href="#entry-vivarta" class="skt-link">m.</a> changement, transformation; déviation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-vedaanta" class="skt-link">vedānta</a>] manifestation divine dans le monde phénoménal.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vivartana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विवर्तन</span> <i>vivartana</i> [act. <a href="#entry-viv_rt" class="skt-link">vivṛt</a>] <a href="#entry-vivartana" class="skt-link">n.</a> circulation, transformation.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vivartavaada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vivartavāda</i> [<a href="#entry-vaada" class="skt-link">vāda</a>] <a href="#entry-vivartavaada" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-vedaanta" class="skt-link">vedānta</a>] théorie ontologique de la réalité illusoire [<a href="#entry-maayika" class="skt-link">māyika</a>].<br> <a href="#entry-vivarta" class="skt-link">vivarta</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vivas_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vivasati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vivasita</i><i>)</i> quitter sa demeure, s'absenter — ca. <i>(vivāsayati)</i> bannir, congédier.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vivas_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विवस्</span> <i>vivas_2</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-vas_4" class="skt-link">vas_4</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">6</span>] pr. <i>(vyucchati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vyuṣṭa</i><i>)</i> véd. briller, resplendir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vivasvat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विवस्वत्</span> <i>vivasvat</i> [<a href="#entry-vivas_2" class="skt-link">vivas_2</a><a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vivasvat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vivasvat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vivasvatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vivasvatī</i> brillant, resplendissant, radieux; matinal — <a href="#entry-vivasvat" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. du radieux [<a href="#entry-aaditya" class="skt-link">āditya</a>] Vivasvān «Resplendissant», dieu-Soleil, père par <a href="#entry-Usara_nyuu" class="skt-link">Saraṇyū</a> des <a href="#entry-Uazvinau" class="skt-link">Aśvinau</a>, de <a href="#entry-Umanu" class="skt-link">Manu</a>-<a href="#entry-Uyama" class="skt-link">Yama</a>, et donc de la race humaine dans la lignée solaire [<a href="#entry-suuryava_mza" class="skt-link">sūryavaṃśa</a>]; il personnifie la loi morale — <a href="#entry-vivasvatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vivasvatī</i> myth. np. de Vivasvatī, ville du Soleil.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vivec">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विवेच्</span> <i>vivec</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-vivic" class="skt-link">vivic</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(vivecayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vivecita</i><i>)</i> séparer, distinguer; investiguer, examiner.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vivecaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विवेचक</span> <i>vivecaka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vivic" class="skt-link">vivic</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vivecaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vivecaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vivecikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vivecikā</i> qui discrimine, qui distingue; sage, judicieux — <a href="#entry-vivecaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> discriminant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vivecakataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vivecakatva">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vivecana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viveka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विवेक</span> <i>viveka</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vivic" class="skt-link">vivic</a>] <a href="#entry-viveka" class="skt-link">m.</a> séparation, distinction, discrimination; discernement, raisonnement: discussion, investigation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Viveka «Discernement», personnifiant l'Intelligence, fils de <a href="#entry-Umanas" class="skt-link">Manas</a> et <a href="#entry-Univ_rtti" class="skt-link">Nivṛtti</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. np. du Viveka_1 «Élucidation», commentaire avancé de <a href="#entry-Uhemacandra" class="skt-link">Hemacandra</a> à son <a href="#entry-Ualafkaaracuu_daama_ni" class="skt-link">Alaṅkāracūḍāmaṇi</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vivekaananda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vivekānanda</i> [<a href="#entry-aananda" class="skt-link">ānanda</a>] <a href="#entry-vivekaananda" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. du <a href="#entry-Usvaamii" class="skt-link">Svāmī</a> Vivekānanda «Joie du discernement», maître spirituel bengali (né Nārendranātha Datta, 1862–1902), disciple de <a href="#entry-Uraamak_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Rāmakṛṣṇa</a>; il visita l'Occident et écrivit de nombreux ouvrages; il créa la <a href="#entry-Uraamak_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Rāmakṛṣṇa</a> Mission à Belūr en 1897.<br> <a href="#entry-viveka" class="skt-link">viveka</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vivekacuu_daama_ni">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vivekacūḍāmaṇi</i> [<a href="#entry-cuu_daama_ni" class="skt-link">cūḍāmaṇi</a>] <a href="#entry-vivekacuu_daama_ni" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. np. du Vivekacūḍāmaṇi «Suprême fleuron du discernement», chef-d'œuvre philosophique de <a href="#entry-Uzafkaraacaarya" class="skt-link">Śaṅkarācārya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vivekataa">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viveki">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vivekin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विवेकिन्</span> <i>vivekin</i> [<a href="#entry-viveka" class="skt-link">viveka</a><a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vivekin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vivekin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vivekinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vivekinī</i> qui a un bon discernement; qui examine, qui investigue <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui raisonne bien; intelligent, malin <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> judicieux; sage.<br> <i>duḥkham</i> <i>eva</i> <i>sarvaṃ</i> <i>vivekinaḥ</i> [YS.] Tout n'est que souffrance pour le sage.
  </div>
</div>

</div>

</div>

[<span class="skt-grammar">7</span>] pr. <i>(vivinakti)</i> pr. md. <i>(viviṅkte)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vivikta</i><i>)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>vivecanīya</i><i>)</i> séparer, trier; distinguer, discriminer; trancher (une question) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> examiner, délibérer — ca. <i>(vivecayati)</i> séparer, distinguer; investiguer, examiner.

  </div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vivikta">

  </div>

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viyat">

  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viyogin">

  </div>
</div>

</div>

[<span class="skt-grammar">7</span>] pr. <i>(viyunakti)</i> pr. md. <i>(viyuṅkte)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>viyukta</i><i>)</i> séparer, priver de ⟨i.⟩.

</div>
