  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viz_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">विश्</span> <i>viś_1</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">6</span>] pr. <i>(viśati)</i> pr. md. <i>(viśate)</i> opt. <i>(viśet)</i> ps. <i>(viśyate)</i> fut. <i>(</i><i>vekṣyati</i><i>)</i> pft. <i>(viveśa)</i> aor. [<span class="skt-grammar">3</span>] <i>(avīviśat)</i> aor. [<span class="skt-grammar">7</span>] <i>(avikṣat)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>viṣṭa_1</i><i>)</i> inf. <i>(veṣṭum)</i> abs. <i>(</i><i>-viśya</i><i>)</i> fut. péri. <i>(veṣṭā)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>adhi</i>, <i>ā</i>, <i>upa</i>, <i>ni</i>, <i>pra</i><i>)</i> entrer, entrer dans, pénétrer; passer derrière ⟨acc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> s'installer, se poser, s'asseoir ⟨acc. loc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> se rendre à, aller vers ⟨acc.⟩; affluer, confluer; se livrer à ⟨dat.⟩ — ca. <i>(veśayati)</i> ps. <i>(veśyate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>veśita</i><i>)</i> faire entrer, faire asseoir, faire s'installer — dés. <i>(vivikṣati)</i> vouloir entrer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>vīcus</i>.

</div>

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizaakha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विशाख</span> <i>viśākha</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-zaakhaa" class="skt-link">śākhā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vizaakha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vizaakha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vizaakhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśākhā</i> qui fourche, qui branche <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> dépourvu de branche; manchot — <a href="#entry-vizaakha" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Viśākha «Cornu», être à tête de bélier issu du flanc droit de <a href="#entry-Uskanda" class="skt-link">Skanda</a> quand <a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a> le frappa de son foudre [<a href="#entry-vajra" class="skt-link">vajra</a>]; cet aspect de <a href="#entry-Uskanda" class="skt-link">Skanda</a> est associé à la fertilité, mais réputé dangereux pour les enfants; son symbole est le banyan; cf. <a href="#entry-Unaigame_sa" class="skt-link">Naigameṣa</a> — <a href="#entry-vizaakhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśākhā</i> du. <i>viśākhe</i> astr. np. de Viśākhe «Fourche», 14⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ astérisme lunaire [<a href="#entry-nak_satra" class="skt-link">nakṣatra</a>], corr. à une paire d'étoiles de la Balance; <a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a> et <a href="#entry-Uagni" class="skt-link">Agni</a> ensemble [<a href="#entry-Uindraagnii" class="skt-link">Indrāgnī</a>] y président; son symbole est l'arche décorée d'une guirlande; aussi appelé Viśākhā et plus tard <a href="#entry-Uraadhaa_2" class="skt-link">Rādhā_2</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizaakhadatta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśākhadatta</i> [<a href="#entry-datta" class="skt-link">datta</a>] <a href="#entry-vizaakhadatta" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. de Viśākhadatta, auteur du drame historique <a href="#entry-Umudraaraak_sasa" class="skt-link">Mudrārākṣasa</a>; il était de famille royale (du <a href="#entry-Ubihaara" class="skt-link">Bihāra</a>) et vécut vers le 6⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle; aussi connu comme Viśākhadeva, on lui attribue le drame <a href="#entry-Udeviicandragupta" class="skt-link">Devīcandragupta</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizaakhadeva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśākhadeva</i> [<a href="#entry-deva" class="skt-link">deva</a>] <a href="#entry-vizaakhadeva" class="skt-link">m.</a> cf. <a href="#entry-vizaakhadatta" class="skt-link">viśākhadatta</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vizaakha" class="skt-link">viśākha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizaala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विशाल</span> <i>viśāla</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-zaalaa" class="skt-link">śālā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vizaala" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vizaala" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vizaalaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśālā</i> vaste, spacieux, grand; important, éminent, illustre; puissant <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] np. du roi Viśāla «Illustre», fils d'<a href="#entry-Uik_svaaku" class="skt-link">Ikṣvāku</a> et d'<a href="#entry-Ualambu_saayaa" class="skt-link">Alambuṣāyā</a>; il fonda la ville de <a href="#entry-Uvizaalaa" class="skt-link">Viśālā</a>; <a href="#entry-Uhemacandra_1" class="skt-link">Hemacandra_1</a> est son fils — ifc. riche en — <a href="#entry-vizaalaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśālā</i> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] np. de la ville de Viśālā, capitale du roi <a href="#entry-Uvizaala" class="skt-link">Viśāla</a>, sur la <a href="#entry-Ugafgaa" class="skt-link">Gaṅgā</a>.<br> <i>viśālam</i> extensivement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizaalaak_sii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśālākṣī</i> [<a href="#entry-ak_sii" class="skt-link">akṣī</a>] <a href="#entry-vizaalaak_sii" class="skt-link">f.</a> myth. np. de Viśālākṣī «aux grands yeux», épith. de <a href="#entry-Ukaazii" class="skt-link">Kāśī</a> <a href="#entry-devii" class="skt-link">devī</a>, déesse tutélaire [<a href="#entry-adhi_s_thaatrii" class="skt-link">adhiṣṭhātrī</a>] de <a href="#entry-Ukaazii" class="skt-link">Kāśī</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vizaala" class="skt-link">viśāla</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizaarada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विशारद</span> <i>viśārada</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-zaarada" class="skt-link">śārada</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vizaarada" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vizaarada" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vizaaradaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśāradā</i> doué, habile; expert en, doué en, habile en ⟨g. loc. iic.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. fameux, célèbre (titre d'érudit).<br> <i>yuddhaviśārada</i> expert dans l'art de la guerre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizaaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विशाय</span> <i>viśāya</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vizii" class="skt-link">viśī</a>] <a href="#entry-vizaaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> tour de repos (alternant avec une veille).<br> <i>tavādya</i> <i>viśāyaḥ</i> c'est ton tour de dormir aujourd'hui.<br> <i>mama</i> <i>viśāyaḥ</i> c'est mon tour de dormir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विशद</span> <i>viśada</i> a. <a href="#entry-vizada" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vizada" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vizadaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśadā</i> clair, limpide, net; pur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> blanc, immaculé; brillant <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> mou, tendre (au toucher) — ifc. habile à, doué pour — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. <i>(viśadayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>viśadita</i><i>)</i> nettoyer, purifier; rendre clair, expliquer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizadita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विशदित</span> <i>viśadita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vizada" class="skt-link">viśada</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vizadita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vizadita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vizaditaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśaditā</i> purifié.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizafk">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विशङ्क्</span> <i>viśaṅk</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-zafk" class="skt-link">śaṅk</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(viśaṅkate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>viśaṅkita</i><i>)</i> avoir des appréhensions; craindre, redouter ⟨abl.⟩; se méfier de ⟨acc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> douter; soupçonner.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizafkaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विशङ्का</span> <i>viśaṅkā</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vizafk" class="skt-link">viśaṅk</a>] <a href="#entry-vizafkaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> hésitation; réserve (quand à ⟨loc.⟩); soupçon, inquiétude, doute; souci.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizalya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विशल्य</span> <i>viśalya</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-zalya" class="skt-link">śalya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vizalya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vizalya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vizalyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśalyā</i> [«sans pointe»] à qui on a retiré une flèche ou une épine; guéri d'une blessure — <a href="#entry-vizalyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśalyā</i> cf. <a href="#entry-vizalyakara_nii" class="skt-link">viśalyakaraṇī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizalyakara_nii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśalyakaraṇī</i> [<a href="#entry-kara_nii" class="skt-link">karaṇī</a>] <a href="#entry-vizalyakara_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> myth. herbe magique «qui guérit des blessures»; <a href="#entry-Uhanumaan" class="skt-link">Hanumān</a> la rapporta du mont <a href="#entry-Uv_r_sa" class="skt-link">Vṛṣa</a> pour guérir l'armée de <a href="#entry-Uraama" class="skt-link">Rāma</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vizalya" class="skt-link">viśalya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizam">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विशम्</span> <i>viśam</i> [acc. <a href="#entry-viz_2" class="skt-link">viś_2</a>] iic.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizampa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśampa</i> var. <i>viśaṃpa</i> [<a href="#entry-pa_2" class="skt-link">pa_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vizampa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vizampa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vizampaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśampā</i> qui protège le peuple — <a href="#entry-vizampa" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Viśampa, père de <a href="#entry-Uvaizampaayana" class="skt-link">Vaiśampāyana</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vizam" class="skt-link">viśam</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizaraaru">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विशरारु</span> <i>viśarāru</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-zaraaru" class="skt-link">śarāru</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vizaraaru" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vizaraaru" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vizaraaru" class="skt-link">f.</a> mis en pièces, dispersé, éparpillé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> périssable.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विशस</span> <i>viśasa</i> de <a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-zas" class="skt-link">śas</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विशय</span> <i>viśaya</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vizii" class="skt-link">viśī</a>] <a href="#entry-vizaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> doute, incertitude.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vize_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विशेष</span> <i>viśeṣa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vizi_s" class="skt-link">viśiṣ</a>] <a href="#entry-vize_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> discrimination, différence; distinction, avantage; opp. <a href="#entry-saamaanya" class="skt-link">sāmānya</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> spécification, particularité, caractéristique <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> espèce, catégo­rie, type <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-vaize_sika" class="skt-link">vaiśeṣika</a>] la catégorie [<a href="#entry-padaartha" class="skt-link">padārtha</a>] des substrats discriminatifs <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> marque frontale (indiquant la secte) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> distingué, extraordinaire.<br> <i>viśeṣāt</i> var. <i>viśeṣeṇa</i> adv. particulièrement, singulièrement; par excellence.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vize_sa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विशेषण</span> <i>viśeṣaṇa</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vizi_s" class="skt-link">viśiṣ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vize_sa_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vize_sa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vize_sa_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśeṣaṇā</i> qui distingue, qui spécifie — <a href="#entry-vize_sa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> spécification; marque distinctive, (signe de) distinction; excellence <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. attribut, qualificatif; prédicat, spécifieur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. attribut prédicatif (adjectif épithète ou nom subordonné (à son sujet [<a href="#entry-vize_sya" class="skt-link">viśeṣya</a>])); adjectif, apposition.<br> <i>viśeṣaṇīkṛ</i> gram. effectuer une prédication.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vize_sa_napuurvapada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśeṣaṇapūrvapada</i> [<a href="#entry-puurvapada" class="skt-link">pūrvapada</a>] <a href="#entry-vize_sa_napuurvapada" class="skt-link">n.</a> gram. composé <a href="#entry-karmadhaaraya" class="skt-link">karmadhāraya</a> dont le constituant gauche est prédicatif (comme <a href="#entry-diirghaka_n_tha" class="skt-link">dīrghakaṇṭha</a>).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vize_sa_nataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśeṣaṇatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-vize_sa_nataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> phil. particularité.<br> <i>viśeṣaṇatāviśeṣasambandha</i> phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] relation de qualification spécifique.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vize_sa_nobhayapada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśeṣaṇobhayapada</i> [<a href="#entry-ubhayapada" class="skt-link">ubhayapada</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vize_sa_nobhayapada" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vize_sa_nobhayapada" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vize_sa_nobhayapadaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśeṣaṇobhayapadā</i> gram. qualifie les composés <a href="#entry-karmadhaaraya" class="skt-link">karmadhāraya</a> dont les constituants sont des adjectifs coordonnés (comme <a href="#entry-snaataanulipta" class="skt-link">snātānulipta</a>).<br> <a href="#entry-vize_sa_na" class="skt-link">viśeṣaṇa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vize_saartha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśeṣārtha</i> [<a href="#entry-artha" class="skt-link">artha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vize_saartha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vize_saartha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vize_sarthaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśeṣarthā</i> dont l'objet est particulier — <a href="#entry-vize_saartha" class="skt-link">m.</a> distinction; différence.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vize_saarthatva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśeṣārthatva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-vize_saarthatva" class="skt-link">n.</a> fait que son objet est particulier.<br> <a href="#entry-vize_saartha" class="skt-link">viśeṣārtha</a> <br> <a href="#entry-vize_sa" class="skt-link">viśeṣa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vize_saj_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśeṣajña</i> [<a href="#entry-j_na" class="skt-link">jña</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vize_saj_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vize_saj_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vize_saj_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśeṣajñā</i> instruit [«qui sait distinguer»].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vize_saka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विशेषक</span> <i>viśeṣaka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vizi_s" class="skt-link">viśiṣ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vize_saka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vize_saka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vize_sikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśeṣikā</i> ifc. qui spécifie, qui distingue; qui caractérise — <a href="#entry-vize_saka" class="skt-link">n.</a> distinction, différence; spécification <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> marque distinctive; not. marque sectaire au front [<a href="#entry-tilaka" class="skt-link">tilaka</a>] — <a href="#entry-vize_saka" class="skt-link">m.</a> gram. figure de rhétorique, où l'on détaille les différences entre deux objets similaires.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vize_sakacchedya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśeṣakacchedya</i> [<a href="#entry-chedya" class="skt-link">chedya</a>] <a href="#entry-vize_sakacchedya" class="skt-link">n.</a> l'ornement du visage par un <a href="#entry-tilaka" class="skt-link">tilaka</a>, l'un des 64 arts [<a href="#entry-kalaa" class="skt-link">kalā</a>].<br> <a href="#entry-vize_saka" class="skt-link">viśeṣaka</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vize_sasuutra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśeṣasūtra</i> [<a href="#entry-suutra" class="skt-link">sūtra</a>] <a href="#entry-vize_sasuutra" class="skt-link">n.</a> gram. règle particulière (opp. à règle générale [<a href="#entry-utsargasuutra" class="skt-link">utsargasūtra</a>]).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vize_satantra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśeṣatantra</i> [<a href="#entry-tantra" class="skt-link">tantra</a>] <a href="#entry-vize_satantra" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. enseignement restreint à des initiés; désigne les textes <a href="#entry-saura" class="skt-link">saura</a>, <a href="#entry-zaiva" class="skt-link">śaiva</a> et <a href="#entry-paa_ncaraatra" class="skt-link">pāñcarātra</a>, ceux de la tradition <a href="#entry-atimaarga" class="skt-link">atimārga</a>, l'<a href="#entry-Uatharvaveda" class="skt-link">Atharvaveda</a>, les traités du <a href="#entry-saafkhya" class="skt-link">sāṃkhya</a> et du <a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>, les écritures bouddhistes et jaïnes, etc. la tradition <a href="#entry-zaiva" class="skt-link">śaiva</a> distingue un niveau plus ésotérique, le <a href="#entry-vize_satarazaastra" class="skt-link">viśeṣataraśāstra</a>; opp. <a href="#entry-saamaanya" class="skt-link">sāmānya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vize_satara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśeṣatara</i> [<a href="#entry--tara" class="skt-link">-tara</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vize_satara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vize_satara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vize_sataraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśeṣatarā</i> compar. très distingué; restreint.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vize_satarazaastra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśeṣataraśāstra</i> [<a href="#entry-zaastra" class="skt-link">śāstra</a>] <a href="#entry-vize_satarazaastra" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. enseignement ésotérique <a href="#entry-zaiva" class="skt-link">śaiva</a>; il ne peut être transmis que par un initié lié par les vœux de sa tradition <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bd. ensemble des textes de la tradition Vajrayāna.<br> <a href="#entry-vize_satara" class="skt-link">viśeṣatara</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vize_satas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśeṣatas</i> [<a href="#entry--tas" class="skt-link">-tas</a>] adv. singulièrement, extrêmement; principalement, particulièrement, surtout; plutôt — ifc. en proportion de, selon.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vize_savat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśeṣavat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vize_savat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vize_savat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vize_savatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśeṣavatī</i> qui a des mérites particuliers; excellent, éminent; supérieur à ⟨abl.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui poursuit un but particulier.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vize_savidhaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśeṣavidhāna</i> [<a href="#entry-vidhaana" class="skt-link">vidhāna</a>] <a href="#entry-vize_savidhaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> gram. prescription particulière à une règle.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vize_sin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विशेषिन्</span> <i>viśeṣin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vizi_s" class="skt-link">viśiṣ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vize_sin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vize_sin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vize_si_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśeṣiṇī</i> distinct, individuel — ifc. qui cherche à surpasser.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vize_sya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विशेष्य</span> <i>viśeṣya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-vizi_s" class="skt-link">viśiṣ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vize_sya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vize_sya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vize_syaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśeṣyā</i> phil. (objet) à spécifier, à déterminer — <a href="#entry-vize_sya" class="skt-link">n.</a> gram. substantif <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. sujet d'une prédication par un attribut [<a href="#entry-vize_sa_na" class="skt-link">viśeṣaṇa</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vize_syaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विशेष्यक</span> <i>viśeṣyaka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vizi_s" class="skt-link">viśiṣ</a>] ifc. a. <a href="#entry-vize_syaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vize_syaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vize_syakaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśeṣyakā</i> phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] qualifié par, déterminé par.<br> <i>ghaṭādiviśeṣyaka</i> qualifié de la qualité de pot.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vize_syataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśeṣyatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-vize_syataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> fait d'être spécifié, qualifié ou distingué <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. nature de substantif.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vize_syavize_sa_nabhaava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāva</i> [<a href="#entry-vize_sa_na" class="skt-link">viśeṣaṇa</a>-<a href="#entry-bhaava" class="skt-link">bhāva</a>] <a href="#entry-vize_syavize_sa_nabhaava" class="skt-link">m.</a> gram. relation de subordination; dépendance.<br> <a href="#entry-vize_sya" class="skt-link">viśeṣya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizi_s">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विशिष्</span> <i>viśiṣ</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-zi_s" class="skt-link">śiṣ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">7</span>] pr. <i>(viśinaṣṭi)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>viśiṣṭa</i><i>)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>viśeṣya</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>prati</i><i>)</i> distinguer, distinguer parmi, placer au dessus de ⟨i.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> se distinguer, surpasser — ps. <i>(viśiṣyate)</i> être distingué par ⟨i.⟩; se distinguer de ⟨abl. i.⟩; être supérieur à, surpasser, exceller.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizi_s_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विशिष्ट</span> <i>viśiṣṭa</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vizi_s" class="skt-link">viśiṣ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vizi_s_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vizi_s_ta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vizi_s_taa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśiṣṭā</i> distinct; distingué, remarquable; noble, prééminent, excellent <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. (objet) spécifié par un mot.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizi_s_taadvaita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśiṣṭādvaita</i> [<a href="#entry-advaita" class="skt-link">advaita</a>] <a href="#entry-vizi_s_taadvaita" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-vedaanta" class="skt-link">vedānta</a>] «non-dualité distinguée», position métaphysique opposée à la non-dualité indifférenciée de <a href="#entry-Uzafkara_1" class="skt-link">Śaṅkara_1</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizi_s_taadvaitavaada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśiṣṭādvaitavāda</i> [<a href="#entry-vaada" class="skt-link">vāda</a>] <a href="#entry-vizi_s_taadvaitavaada" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. doctrine de la «non-dualité distinguée», prêchée par <a href="#entry-Uraamaanuja" class="skt-link">Rāmānuja</a>; elle affirme la suprématie de <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a> sur le <a href="#entry-brahman" class="skt-link">brahman</a> impersonnel.<br> <a href="#entry-vizi_s_taadvaita" class="skt-link">viśiṣṭādvaita</a> <br> <a href="#entry-vizi_s_ta" class="skt-link">viśiṣṭa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizi_s_tavaizi_s_tya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśiṣṭavaiśiṣṭya</i> [<a href="#entry-vaizi_s_tya" class="skt-link">vaiśiṣṭya</a>] <a href="#entry-vizi_s_tavaizi_s_tya" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] le distingué et la distinction.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizi_s_tavaizi_s_tyaavagaahi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśiṣṭavaiśiṣṭyāvagāhi</i> [<a href="#entry-avagaahi" class="skt-link">avagāhi</a>] <a href="#entry-vizi_s_tavaizi_s_tyaavagaahi" class="skt-link">f.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] connaissance du distingué et de la distinction.<br> <a href="#entry-vizi_s_tavaizi_s_tya" class="skt-link">viśiṣṭavaiśiṣṭya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizi_s_tavidhaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśiṣṭavidhāna</i> [<a href="#entry-vidhaana" class="skt-link">vidhāna</a>] <a href="#entry-vizi_s_tavidhaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-miimaa_msaa" class="skt-link">mīmāṃsā</a>] interprétation distinguée d'une injonction permettant son interprétation comme visant un but unique; opp. <a href="#entry-vaakyabheda" class="skt-link">vākyabheda</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विशी</span> <i>viśī</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-zii_1" class="skt-link">śī_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. md. <i>(viśete)</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(śayate)</i> être allongé étendu; rester couché <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> douter.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-viziir_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विशीर्ण</span> <i>viśīrṇa</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-viz_rr" class="skt-link">viśṝ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-viziir_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-viziir_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-viziir_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśīrṇā</i> brisé, déchiré, broyé; dispersé, détruit; tombé (dent).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizikha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विशिख</span> <i>viśikha</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-zikhaa" class="skt-link">śikhā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vizikha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vizikha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vizikhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśikhā</i> sans mèche; chauve <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> sans pointe, émoussé (flèche) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> sans flamme (feu) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> astr. sans queue (comète) — <a href="#entry-vizikha" class="skt-link">m.</a> flèche — <a href="#entry-vizikhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśikhā</i> petite flèche; aiguille <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. np. de Viśikhā, confidente de <a href="#entry-Usatyabhaamaa" class="skt-link">Satyabhāmā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizle_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
