  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizle_sa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विश्लेषण</span> <i>viśleṣaṇa</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vizli_s" class="skt-link">viśliṣ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vizle_sa_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vizle_sa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vizle_sa_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśleṣaṇā</i> dissous, séparé — <a href="#entry-vizle_sa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> séparation; dissolution.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizli_s">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विश्लिष्</span> <i>viśliṣ</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-zli_s" class="skt-link">śliṣ</a>] ca. <i>(viśleṣayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>viśliṣṭa</i><i>)</i> séparer de ⟨abl.⟩; priver de ⟨i.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizli_s_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विश्लिष्ट</span> <i>viśliṣṭa</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vizli_s" class="skt-link">viśliṣ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vizli_s_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vizli_s_ta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vizli_s_taa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśliṣṭā</i> séparé, disjoint; mis à l'écart; disloqué; dissous.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizli_sya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विश्लिष्य</span> <i>viśliṣya</i> [abs. <a href="#entry-vizli_s" class="skt-link">viśliṣ</a>] ind. ayant séparé de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizodh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विशोध्</span> <i>viśodh</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-vizudh" class="skt-link">viśudh</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(viśodhayati)</i> purifier; justifier, disculper.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizodhana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विशोधन</span> <i>viśodhana</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vizudh" class="skt-link">viśudh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vizodhana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vizodhana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vizodhanii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśodhanī</i> qui purifie, qui nettoie — <a href="#entry-vizodhana" class="skt-link">m.</a> purification, nettoyage <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> méd. laxatif.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizodhaniiya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विशोधनीय</span> <i>viśodhanīya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] <a href="#entry-vizudh" class="skt-link">viśudh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vizodhaniiya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vizodhaniiya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vizodhaniiyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśodhanīyā</i> à purifier; à nettoyer; à rectifier.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizodhi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विशोधि</span> <i>viśodhi</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-vizodhin" class="skt-link">viśodhin</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizodhin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विशोधिन्</span> <i>viśodhin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vizudh" class="skt-link">viśudh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vizodhin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vizodhin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vizodhinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśodhinī</i> qui nettoie.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizodhitva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśodhitva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] ifc. <a href="#entry-vizodhitva" class="skt-link">n.</a> purification, nettoyage de ⟨iic.⟩.<br> <a href="#entry-vizodhi" class="skt-link">viśodhi</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizraam">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विश्राम्</span> <i>viśrām</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-vizram" class="skt-link">viśram</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(viśrāmayati)</i> faire se reposer, arrêter.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizraama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विश्राम</span> <i>viśrāma</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vizram" class="skt-link">viśram</a>] <a href="#entry-vizraama" class="skt-link">m.</a> repos, relaxation; calme, tranquillité; vacance <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> reprise de souffle après un effort <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phon. silence à la fin d'un <a href="#entry-paada" class="skt-link">pāda</a> (syn. <a href="#entry-yati_3" class="skt-link">yati_3</a>).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizraamakaala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśrāmakāla</i> [<a href="#entry-kaala_1" class="skt-link">kāla_1</a>] <a href="#entry-vizraamakaala" class="skt-link">m.</a> mod. période des vacances, congés.<br> <a href="#entry-vizraama" class="skt-link">viśrāma</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizraanta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विश्रान्त</span> <i>viśrānta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vizraam" class="skt-link">viśrām</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vizraanta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vizraanta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vizraantaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśrāntā</i> qui repose, qui s'est reposé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> arrêté, terminé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizraanti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विश्रान्ति</span> <i>viśrānti</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vizraam" class="skt-link">viśrām</a>] <a href="#entry-vizraanti" class="skt-link">f.</a> repos; arrêt, cessation, fin.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizrabdha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विश्रब्ध</span> <i>viśrabdha</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vizrambh" class="skt-link">viśrambh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vizrabdha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vizrabdha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vizrabdhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśrabdhā</i> confiant; sans peur, serein; calme, tranquille <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> se fiant à (avec <a href="#entry-prati" class="skt-link">prati</a>) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui inspire la confiance — ind. en confiance; sans réserves.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizram">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विश्रम्</span> <i>viśram</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-zram" class="skt-link">śram</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. <i>(viśrāmyati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>viśrānta</i><i>)</i> se reposer, s'arrêter; reposer sur ⟨loc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> avoir confiance, être à l'aise — ca. <i>(viśrāmayati)</i> faire se reposer, arrêter — ps. <i>(viśrāmyate)</i> être reposé.<br> <i>viśrāmyatām</i> (ps. imp.) assez! arrêtez!
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizrama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विश्रम</span> <i>viśrama</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vizram" class="skt-link">viśram</a>] <a href="#entry-vizrama" class="skt-link">m.</a> repos, relaxation.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizrambh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विश्रम्भ्</span> <i>viśrambh</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-zrambh" class="skt-link">śrambh</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(viśrambhate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>viśrabdha</i>, <i>viśrambhita</i><i>)</i> avoir confiance, se fier à ⟨loc.⟩ — ca. <i>(viśrāmbhayati)</i> inspirer confiance, rassurer.<br> <i>viśrabhya</i> ind. en confiance.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizrambha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विश्रम्भ</span> <i>viśrambha</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vizrambh" class="skt-link">viśrambh</a>] <a href="#entry-vizrambha" class="skt-link">m.</a> confiance (en ⟨loc. g. iic.⟩) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> familiarité; intimité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> détente, relaxation, relâchement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> posture de relaxation, utilisée par les récitants véd. pour l'accent grave [<a href="#entry-svarita" class="skt-link">svarita</a>] — <a href="#entry-vizrambhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśrambhā</i> ifc. confiance en.<br> <i>viśrambhāt</i> var. <i>viśrambheṇa</i> en toute confiance.<br> <i>viśrambhaṃ</i> <i>kṛ</i> gagner la confiance de ⟨g.⟩.<br> <i>kasmai</i> <i>viśrambhaṃ</i> <i>kathayāmi</i> à qui dois-je faire confiance?.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizrambha_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विश्रम्भण</span> <i>viśrambhaṇa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vizrambh" class="skt-link">viśrambh</a>] ifc. <a href="#entry-vizrambha_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> fait de gagner la confiance de ⟨iic.⟩.<br> <i>viśrambhaṇaṃ</i> <i>gam</i> gagner la confiance de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizrambha_niiya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विश्रम्भणीय</span> <i>viśrambhaṇīya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] <a href="#entry-vizrambh" class="skt-link">viśrambh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vizrambha_niiya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vizrambha_niiya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vizrambha_niiyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśrambhaṇīyā</i> digne de confiance; qui inspire confiance à ⟨g.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizrambhataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśrambhatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-vizrambhataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> confiance.<br> <i>viśrambhatāṃ</i> <i>gam</i> gagner la confiance de.<br> <a href="#entry-vizrambha" class="skt-link">viśrambha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizrambhin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विश्रम्भिन्</span> <i>viśrambhin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vizrambh" class="skt-link">viśrambh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vizrambhin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vizrambhin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vizrambhi_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśrambhiṇī</i> qui a confiance en ⟨iic.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui inspire confiance <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> confidentiel.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizravas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विश्रवस्</span> <i>viśravas</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-zravas" class="skt-link">śravas</a>] <a href="#entry-vizravas" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. du sage [<a href="#entry-_r_si" class="skt-link">ṛṣi</a>] Viśravā «le Très Glorieux», fils de <a href="#entry-Umaaninii" class="skt-link">Māninī</a> par <a href="#entry-Upulastya" class="skt-link">Pulastya</a> fâché de voir son fils <a href="#entry-Ukubera" class="skt-link">Kubera</a> le négliger au profit de son père <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a>; <a href="#entry-Uvizravaa" class="skt-link">Viśravā</a> est <a href="#entry-Upulastya" class="skt-link">Pulastya</a> réincarné pour enfanter <a href="#entry-Ukubera" class="skt-link">Kubera</a> par <a href="#entry-Ui_davi_daa" class="skt-link">Iḍaviḍā</a> mais aussi <a href="#entry-Uraava_na" class="skt-link">Rāvaṇa</a>, <a href="#entry-Ukumbhakar_na" class="skt-link">Kumbhakarṇa</a>, <a href="#entry-Ukhara" class="skt-link">Khara</a> et <a href="#entry-Uvibhii_sa_na" class="skt-link">Vibhīṣaṇa</a> par <a href="#entry-Ukezinii_2" class="skt-link">Keśinī_2</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizru">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विश्रु</span> <i>viśru</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-zru" class="skt-link">śru</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">5</span>] pr. <i>(viśṛṇoti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>viśruta</i><i>)</i> entendre distinctement — ps. <i>(viśrūyate)</i> être renommé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizruta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विश्रुत</span> <i>viśruta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vizru" class="skt-link">viśru</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vizruta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vizruta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vizrutaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśrutā</i> bien connu, renommé — <a href="#entry-vizruta" class="skt-link">n.</a> renommée.<br> <i>damayantī</i> <i>iti</i> <i>viśrutā</i> Elle s'appelle <a href="#entry-Udamayantii" class="skt-link">Damayantī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizuddha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विशुद्ध</span> <i>viśuddha</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vizudh" class="skt-link">viśudh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vizuddha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vizuddha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vizuddhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśuddhā</i> très pur; parfaitement purifié <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> achevé — ifc. qui a parachevé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizuddhacakra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśuddhacakra</i> [<a href="#entry-cakra" class="skt-link">cakra</a>] <a href="#entry-vizuddhacakra" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. [tantr.] 5⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ <a href="#entry-cakra" class="skt-link">cakra</a> du <a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a> tantr., situé au niveau du larynx; il est représenté par un lotus de 16 pétales mauves; un cercle blanc dans un triangle y symbolise l'éther, et porte le <a href="#entry-biijamantra" class="skt-link">bījamantra</a> ‘<i>haṃ</i>’; ce <a href="#entry-cakra" class="skt-link">cakra</a> contrôle le sens de l'ouïe; il est le centre psychique du Verbe Sacré.<br> <a href="#entry-vizuddha" class="skt-link">viśuddha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizuddhi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विशुद्धि</span> <i>viśuddhi</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vizudh" class="skt-link">viśudh</a>] <a href="#entry-vizuddhi" class="skt-link">f.</a> purification; pureté; vertu, sainteté <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> rectification, correction <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> rétribution, remboursement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> math. quantité à soustraire.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizuddhimaarga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśuddhimārga</i> [<a href="#entry-maarga" class="skt-link">mārga</a>] <a href="#entry-vizuddhimaarga" class="skt-link">m.</a> bd. la voie correcte <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. np. du Viśuddhimārga «Voie de la purification» (<a href="#entry-paali" class="skt-link">pāli</a> Visuddhimagga) de <a href="#entry-Ubuddhagho_sa" class="skt-link">Buddhaghoṣa</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vizuddhi" class="skt-link">viśuddhi</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizudh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विशुध्</span> <i>viśudh</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-zudh" class="skt-link">śudh</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. <i>(viśudhyati)</i> pr. md. <i>(viśudhyate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>viśuddha</i><i>)</i> devenir parfaitement pur — ca. <i>(viśodhayati)</i> purifier; justifier, disculper.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विश्व</span> <i>viśva</i> pn. <a href="#entry-vizva" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vizva" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vizvaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśvā</i> tout, total, entier; universel <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> omniprésent, qui contient tout — <a href="#entry-vizvaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśvā</i> la Terre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizvaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विश्वा</span> <i>viśvā</i> [<a href="#entry-vizva" class="skt-link">viśva</a>] iic. ⟨ifc.⟩ de tous.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizvaamitra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśvāmitra</i> [<a href="#entry-mitra" class="skt-link">mitra</a>] <a href="#entry-vizvaamitra" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] np. de Viśvāmitra «l'Ami de tous», l'un des sept sages [<a href="#entry-saptar_si" class="skt-link">saptarṣi</a>], fils du roi <a href="#entry-Ugaadhi" class="skt-link">Gādhi</a>, de <a href="#entry-gotra" class="skt-link">gotra</a> <a href="#entry-Ukauzika" class="skt-link">Kauśika</a>; lorsque sa sœur aînée la princesse <a href="#entry-Usatyavatii_1" class="skt-link">Satyavatī_1</a> épousa le brâhmane <a href="#entry-U_rciika" class="skt-link">Ṛcīka</a>, elle demanda à son beau-père <a href="#entry-Ubh_rgu" class="skt-link">Bhṛgu</a> un rite pour permettre à elle et à sa mère d'avoir un fils; ce seront respectivement <a href="#entry-Ujamadagni" class="skt-link">Jamadagni</a> et <a href="#entry-Uvizvaamitra" class="skt-link">Viśvāmitra</a>, mais une erreur rituelle provoqua la confusion des castes [<a href="#entry-var_nasafkara" class="skt-link">varṇasaṃkara</a>]; <a href="#entry-k_satriya" class="skt-link">kṣatriya</a> descendant de <a href="#entry-Upuruuravaa" class="skt-link">Purūravā</a>, de la race des <a href="#entry-bharataas" class="skt-link">bharatās</a>, il régna sur le <a href="#entry-Ukanyaakubja" class="skt-link">Kanyākubja</a> lorsque son père se retira à l'ermitage de <a href="#entry-U_rciika" class="skt-link">Ṛcīka</a>; il épousa <a href="#entry-Umaadhavii" class="skt-link">Mādhavī</a> dont il eut pour fils <a href="#entry-Ua_s_taka" class="skt-link">Aṣṭaka</a>; il s'opposa au <a href="#entry-braahma_na" class="skt-link">brāhmaṇa</a> <a href="#entry-Uvasi_s_tha" class="skt-link">Vasiṣṭha</a> auquel il tenta d'enlever <a href="#entry-Unandinii" class="skt-link">Nandinī</a>; pour devenir lui-même <a href="#entry-braahma_na" class="skt-link">brāhmaṇa</a>, aux fins de puissance, il fit des pénitences pendant des milliers d'années; il réalisa alors le destin de <a href="#entry-brahmar_si" class="skt-link">brahmarṣi</a> que l'erreur rituelle avait permis, et il devint le <a href="#entry-guru" class="skt-link">guru</a> de l'<a href="#entry-avataara" class="skt-link">avatāra</a> <a href="#entry-Uraama" class="skt-link">Rāma</a>; il se laissa séduire par la nymphe [<a href="#entry-apsaras" class="skt-link">apsaras</a>] <a href="#entry-Umenakaa" class="skt-link">Menakā</a> qui en engendra <a href="#entry-Uzakuntalaa" class="skt-link">Śakuntalā</a>, mais résolut de reprendre ses pénitences; on lui attribue l'essentiel du <a href="#entry-U_rgveda" class="skt-link">Ṛgveda</a>; il symbolise la volonté, la persévérance et la longévité; cf. <a href="#entry-Ukauzika" class="skt-link">Kauśika</a>, <a href="#entry-Ugaalava" class="skt-link">Gālava</a>, <a href="#entry-Ujaahnava" class="skt-link">Jāhnava</a>, <a href="#entry-Utrizafku" class="skt-link">Triśaṅku</a>, <a href="#entry-Uzaalafkaayana" class="skt-link">Śālaṅkāyana</a>, <a href="#entry-Uzuna_hzepha" class="skt-link">Śunaḥśepha</a>, <a href="#entry-Uharizcandra" class="skt-link">Hariścandra</a> — <a href="#entry-vizvaamitrii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśvāmitrī</i> géo. np. de la rivière Viśvāmitrī, au nord de la <a href="#entry-Unarmadaa" class="skt-link">Narmadā</a>; elle est réputée pour les banyans [<a href="#entry-va_ta" class="skt-link">vaṭa</a>] de ses rives; cf. <a href="#entry-Uva_tapattra" class="skt-link">Vaṭapattra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizvaanara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśvānara</i> [<a href="#entry-nara" class="skt-link">nara</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vizvaanara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vizvaanara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vizvaanaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśvānarā</i> commun à tous les hommes <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> np. d'un ascète.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizvaantara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśvāntara</i> [<a href="#entry-antara" class="skt-link">antara</a>] <a href="#entry-vizvaantara" class="skt-link">m.</a> bd. [VJ.] np. du roi Viśvāntara «Proche de tous» (<a href="#entry-paali" class="skt-link">pāli</a> Vessantara), incarnation antérieure du <a href="#entry-Ubuddha" class="skt-link">Buddha</a>; prince banni de son royaume, il abandonna toutes ses possessions, y compris son épouse et ses deux enfants, afin de se rendre libre de tous liens; mais <a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a> intervint, les réunit, et réintégra Viśvāntara à la cour de son père.<br> <a href="#entry-vizva" class="skt-link">viśva</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizvaapu_s">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśvāpuṣ</i> [<a href="#entry-pu_s_2" class="skt-link">puṣ_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vizvaapu_s" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vizvaapu_s" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vizvaapu_s" class="skt-link">f.</a> véd. à l'origine de tout.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizvaaraaj">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśvārāj</i> [<a href="#entry-raaj_2" class="skt-link">rāj_2</a>] <a href="#entry-vizvaaraaj" class="skt-link">m.</a> empereur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizvaas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विश्वास्</span> <i>viśvās</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-vizvas" class="skt-link">viśvas</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(viśvāsayati)</i> abs. <i>(</i><i>viśvāsya</i><i>)</i> rassurer, inspirer confiance à ⟨acc.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizvaasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विश्वास</span> <i>viśvāsa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vizvas" class="skt-link">viśvas</a>] <a href="#entry-vizvaasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> confiance (dans ⟨loc.⟩); foi en ⟨loc. i. iic.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> communication confidentielle, secret.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizvaasaghaata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśvāsaghāta</i> [<a href="#entry-ghaata" class="skt-link">ghāta</a>] <a href="#entry-vizvaasaghaata" class="skt-link">m.</a> abus de confiance, trahison.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizvaasaghaataka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśvāsaghātaka</i> [<a href="#entry-ghaataka" class="skt-link">ghātaka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vizvaasaghaataka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vizvaasaghaataka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vizvaasaghaatikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśvāsaghātikā</i> traître.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizvaasaprada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśvāsaprada</i> [<a href="#entry-prada" class="skt-link">prada</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vizvaasaprada" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vizvaasaprada" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vizvaasapradaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśvāsapradā</i> qui donne confiance.<br> <a href="#entry-vizvaasa" class="skt-link">viśvāsa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizvaasya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विश्वास्य</span> <i>viśvāsya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-vizvaas" class="skt-link">viśvās</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vizvaasya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vizvaasya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vizvaasyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśvāsyā</i> digne de confiance <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui doit être rassuré — ind. ayant mis en confiance.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizvaavasu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśvāvasu</i> [<a href="#entry-vasu" class="skt-link">vasu</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vizvaavasu" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vizvaavasu" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vizvaavasu" class="skt-link">f.</a> bienfaiteur universel, se dit de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a> — <a href="#entry-vizvaavasu" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Viśvāvasu, roi <a href="#entry-gandharva" class="skt-link">gandharva</a>-<a href="#entry-daanava" class="skt-link">dānava</a> géant à la beauté prodigieuse; <a href="#entry-Upramadvaraa" class="skt-link">Pramadvarā</a> est sa fille par <a href="#entry-Umenakaa" class="skt-link">Menakā</a>; [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] il provoqua en combat <a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a>, qui le transforma en le monstrueux ogre [<a href="#entry-raak_sasa" class="skt-link">rākṣasa</a>] <a href="#entry-Ukabandha" class="skt-link">Kabandha</a>; <a href="#entry-Uraama" class="skt-link">Rāma</a> le tua, et le libéra de son sortilège en le brûlant <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> astr. np. de Viśvāvasu «Colosse», personnifiant l'an 39 d'un cycle de vie [<a href="#entry-sa_mvatsara" class="skt-link">saṃvatsara</a>].<br> <a href="#entry-vizvaa" class="skt-link">viśvā</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizvagu_naadarza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśvaguṇādarśa</i> [<a href="#entry-gu_na" class="skt-link">guṇa</a>-<a href="#entry-aadarza" class="skt-link">ādarśa</a>] <a href="#entry-vizvagu_naadarza" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du Viśvaguṇādarśa «Miroir de toutes les qualités», poème satirique en style <a href="#entry-campuu" class="skt-link">campū</a> de <a href="#entry-Uvefka_taadhvarii" class="skt-link">Veṅkaṭādhvarī</a>; il met en scène les deux <a href="#entry-gandharvaas" class="skt-link">gandharvās</a> <a href="#entry-Uk_rzaanu" class="skt-link">Kṛśānu</a> et <a href="#entry-Uvizvaavasu" class="skt-link">Viśvāvasu</a> traversant le pays Tamil à bord d'un chariot céleste.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizvajit">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśvajit</i> [<a href="#entry-jit" class="skt-link">jit</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vizvajit" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vizvajit" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vizvajit" class="skt-link">f.</a> qui conquiert tout <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. sacrifice de toute-puissance; le magicien <a href="#entry-Uzukra" class="skt-link">Śukra</a> l'exécuta au bénéfice du roi des démons [<a href="#entry-asura" class="skt-link">asura</a>] <a href="#entry-Ubali" class="skt-link">Bali</a> pour lui donner la souveraineté sur les trois mondes <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. sacrifice expiatoire (don de toutes ses possessions); cf. <a href="#entry-sarvamedha" class="skt-link">sarvamedha</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizvakarman">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśvakarman</i> [<a href="#entry-karman" class="skt-link">karman</a>] <a href="#entry-vizvakarman" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. du dieu Viśvakarmā «Qui a tout fait», architecte de l'univers, artisan des dieux, forme d'<a href="#entry-Uagni" class="skt-link">Agni</a>, aussi appelé <a href="#entry-Utva_s_taa" class="skt-link">Tvaṣṭā</a> (ou considéré comme un fils de <a href="#entry-Utva_s_taa" class="skt-link">Tvaṣṭā</a>); il est père de <a href="#entry-Usa_nj_naa" class="skt-link">Sañjñā</a>; il rabota le huitième de l'éclat du Soleil pour l'atténuer, et en fabriqua le disque [<a href="#entry-cakra" class="skt-link">cakra</a>] de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>, le trident [<a href="#entry-trizuula" class="skt-link">triśūla</a>] de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>, et la lance [<a href="#entry-zakti" class="skt-link">śakti</a>] de <a href="#entry-Uskanda" class="skt-link">Skanda</a>; il fabriqua le char merveilleux <a href="#entry-Upu_spaka" class="skt-link">Puṣpaka</a> pour <a href="#entry-Ukubera" class="skt-link">Kubera</a>; il fabriqua deux arcs merveilleux; il donna le premier [<a href="#entry-Uzaivacaapa" class="skt-link">Śaivacāpa</a>] à <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> pour détruire <a href="#entry-Utripura" class="skt-link">Tripura</a>; il donnna le deuxième [<a href="#entry-Uvai_s_navacaapa" class="skt-link">Vaiṣṇavacāpa</a>] à <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>; les dieux voulurent tester leur suprématie, et <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a> arbitra un duel entre <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> et <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>, dont ce dernier sortit vainqueur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizvaksena">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विश्वक्सेन</span> <i>viśvaksena</i> <a href="#entry-vizvaksena" class="skt-link">m.</a> cf. <a href="#entry-vi_svaksena" class="skt-link">viṣvaksena</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizvam">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विश्वम्</span> <i>viśvam</i> [acc. <a href="#entry-vizva" class="skt-link">viśva</a>] iic.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizvambhara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśvaṃbhara</i> var. <i>viśvambhara</i> [<a href="#entry-bhara" class="skt-link">bhara</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vizva_mbhara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vizva_mbhara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vizva_mbharaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśvaṃbharā</i> qui supporte tout (qualifie not. l'Être Suprême) — <a href="#entry-vizva_mbhara" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. de Viśvambhara <a href="#entry-Umizra" class="skt-link">Miśra</a>, nom de naissance de <a href="#entry-Ucaitanya" class="skt-link">Caitanya</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vizvam" class="skt-link">viśvam</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizvamitra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśvamitra</i> [<a href="#entry-mitra" class="skt-link">mitra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vizvamitra" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vizvamitra" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vizvamitraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśvamitrā</i> ami de tous — <a href="#entry-vizvamitra" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Viśvamitra; cf. <a href="#entry-Uvizvaamitra" class="skt-link">Viśvāmitra</a>.<br> <i>viśvamitrasya</i> <i>rakṣati</i> <i>brahmedaṃ</i> <i>bharataṃ</i> <i>janam</i> [RV.] Cette parole de <a href="#entry-Uvizvamitra" class="skt-link">Viśvamitra</a> protège la nation de <a href="#entry-Ubharata" class="skt-link">Bharata</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizvanaatha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśvanātha</i> [<a href="#entry-naatha" class="skt-link">nātha</a>] <a href="#entry-vizvanaatha" class="skt-link">m.</a> géo. np. de Viśvanātha «Seigneur universel», l'un des 12 signes radieux de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> [<a href="#entry-jyotirlifga" class="skt-link">jyotirliṅga</a>]; il est associé à sa <a href="#entry-zakti" class="skt-link">śakti</a> <a href="#entry-Uannapuur_naa" class="skt-link">Annapūrṇā</a>; son sanctuaire à <a href="#entry-Uvaaraa_nasii" class="skt-link">Vārāṇasī</a> fut détruit par Aurangzeb en 1669; le temple mod. date de 1780, il est recouvert d'or <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> géo. np. du <a href="#entry-lifga" class="skt-link">liṅga</a> secondaire de <a href="#entry-Uraamezvara" class="skt-link">Rāmeśvara</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-raamalifgezvara" class="skt-link">rāmaliṅgeśvara</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. de Viśvanātha_1 <a href="#entry-Ukaviraaja" class="skt-link">Kavirāja</a>, poète qui vivait au <a href="#entry-Ukalifga" class="skt-link">Kaliṅga</a>, fils d'un dignitaire de la cour au début du 14⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle; il est l'auteur du traité poétique <a href="#entry-Usaahityadarpa_na" class="skt-link">Sāhityadarpaṇa</a>; il définit la poésie comme l'art d'assaisonner la phrase avec goût [<a href="#entry-rasa" class="skt-link">rasa</a>]; il écrivit un commentaire du <a href="#entry-Ukaavyaprakaaza" class="skt-link">Kāvyaprakāśa</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. de Viśvanātha_3, philosophe du 17⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle; il est l'auteur du <a href="#entry-Ubhaa_saapariccheda" class="skt-link">Bhāṣāpariccheda</a>, aussi appelé <a href="#entry-Ukaarikaavalii" class="skt-link">Kārikāvalī</a>; on lui attribue aussi le traité coutumier [<a href="#entry-sm_rti" class="skt-link">smṛti</a>] <a href="#entry-Umaa_msatattvaviveka" class="skt-link">Māṃsatattvaviveka</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. du logicien bengali Viśvanātha_4 <a href="#entry-Upa_ncaanana" class="skt-link">Pañcānana</a> (16⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle), auteur de la <a href="#entry-Unyaayasiddhaantamuktaavalii" class="skt-link">Nyāyasiddhāntamuktāvalī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizvapaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśvapā</i> [<a href="#entry-paa_3" class="skt-link">pā_3</a>] <a href="#entry-vizvapaa" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Viśvapā «Protecteur universel», épith. de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizvaruupa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśvarūpa</i> [<a href="#entry-ruupa" class="skt-link">rūpa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vizvaruupa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vizvaruupa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vizvaruupaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśvarūpā</i> multiforme, universel <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> changeant, multicolore (se dit des joyaux multicolores par diffraction) — <a href="#entry-vizvaruupa" class="skt-link">m.</a> véd. np. de Viśvarūpa, épith. du monstre tricéphale <a href="#entry-Utriziraa" class="skt-link">Triśirā</a>-<a href="#entry-Utvaa_s_tra" class="skt-link">Tvāṣṭra</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de Viśvarūpa_1, épith. de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a> «Multiforme»; on le représente avec 3 têtes d'homme, de lion et de sanglier, et 10 bras <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. de Viśvarūpa_2 <a href="#entry-Umizra" class="skt-link">Miśra</a>, frère aîné de <a href="#entry-Ucaitanya" class="skt-link">Caitanya</a>; renonçant au mariage arrangé par ses parents, il devint <a href="#entry-sannyaasin" class="skt-link">sannyāsin</a> sous le nom de <a href="#entry-Uzafkarara_nya" class="skt-link">Śaṅkararaṇya</a> <a href="#entry-Usvaamii" class="skt-link">Svāmī</a>; il finit sa vie à <a href="#entry-Upa_n_dharpur" class="skt-link">Paṇḍharpur</a>; dans la tradition <a href="#entry-bhakti" class="skt-link">bhakti</a>, il incarne <a href="#entry-Ubalaraama" class="skt-link">Balarāma</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizvaruupadarzana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśvarūpadarśana</i> [<a href="#entry-darzana" class="skt-link">darśana</a>] <a href="#entry-vizvaruupadarzana" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. vision de Dieu Multiforme; vision divine accordée par <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a> à <a href="#entry-Uarjuna" class="skt-link">Arjuna</a> dans le 11⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ chapitre de la <a href="#entry-Ugiitaa" class="skt-link">Gītā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizvaruupamahotsava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśvarūpamahotsava</i> [<a href="#entry-mahotsava" class="skt-link">mahotsava</a>] <a href="#entry-vizvaruupamahotsava" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. jour anniversaire du vœu de renoncement [<a href="#entry-sannyaasin" class="skt-link">sannyāsin</a>] de <a href="#entry-Uvizvaruupa_2" class="skt-link">Viśvarūpa_2</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vizvaruupa" class="skt-link">viśvarūpa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizvas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विश्वस्</span> <i>viśvas</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-zvas_1" class="skt-link">śvas_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(viśvasiti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>viśvasita</i><i>)</i> avoir confiance en ⟨g. loc.⟩; être rassuré — ca. <i>(viśvāsayati)</i> rassurer, inspirer confiance à ⟨acc.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizvasa_msk_rtadina">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśvasaṃskṛtadina</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_msk_rta" class="skt-link">saṃskṛta</a>-<a href="#entry-dina" class="skt-link">dina</a>] <a href="#entry-vizvasa_msk_rtadina" class="skt-link">n.</a> soc. «jour du sanskrit», célébré à la pleine lune <a href="#entry-zraava_nii" class="skt-link">śrāvaṇī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizvatas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśvatas</i> [<a href="#entry--tas" class="skt-link">-tas</a>] adv. de tous côtés; universellement.<br> <i>viśvato</i> <i>bhayāt</i> hors de tout péril.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizvavaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśvavāra</i> [<a href="#entry-vaara" class="skt-link">vāra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vizvavaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vizvavaara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vizvavaaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśvavārā</i> qui accorde tous les trésors <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> chéri de tous — <a href="#entry-vizvavaaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśvavārā</i> exposition, exhibition.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizvavasu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśvavasu</i> [<a href="#entry-vasu" class="skt-link">vasu</a>] <a href="#entry-vizvavasu" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Viśvavasu, 4⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ fils de <a href="#entry-Ujamadagni" class="skt-link">Jamadagni</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizvavidyaalaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśvavidyālaya</i> [<a href="#entry-vidyaalaya" class="skt-link">vidyālaya</a>] <a href="#entry-vizvavidyaalaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> université.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizvazcandra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśvaścandra</i> [<a href="#entry-zcandra" class="skt-link">ścandra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vizvazcandra" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vizvazcandra" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vizvazcandraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśvaścandrā</i> qui brille de partout.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizve">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विश्वे</span> <i>viśve</i> [nom. pl. <a href="#entry-vizva" class="skt-link">viśva</a>] iic.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizvedeva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>viśvedeva</i> [<a href="#entry-deva" class="skt-link">deva</a>] <a href="#entry-vizvedeva" class="skt-link">m.</a> pl. myth. np. du collectif Viśvedevās, «Tous les dieux»; astr. ils président le <a href="#entry-nak_satra" class="skt-link">nakṣatra</a> des <a href="#entry-Uuttaraa_saa_dhaas" class="skt-link">Uttarāṣāḍhās</a> (σ du Sagittaire).<br> <a href="#entry-vizve" class="skt-link">viśve</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vizya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">विश्य</span> <i>viśya</i> [<a href="#entry-viz_1" class="skt-link">viś_1</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vizya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vizya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vizyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>viśyā</i> appartenant à la communauté — <a href="#entry-vizya" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. homme de la 3⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ classe.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-voc">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वोच्</span> <i>voc</i> [aor. <a href="#entry-vac" class="skt-link">vac</a>] subj. <i>(vocat)</i> (péremptoire) qu'il parle.<br> <i>maivaṃ</i> <i>vocaḥ</i> ne parle pas ainsi!
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vopadeva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">वोपदेव</span> <i>vopadeva</i> <a href="#entry-vopadeva" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. de Vopadeva, poète et grammairien de la cour de <a href="#entry-Uhemaadri_1" class="skt-link">Hemādri_1</a> à <a href="#entry-Udevagiri" class="skt-link">Devagiri</a> au Bengale (13⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle); on lui doit not. la grammaire <a href="#entry-Umugdhabodha" class="skt-link">Mugdhabodha</a> et le <a href="#entry-dhaatupaa_tha" class="skt-link">dhātupāṭha</a> <a href="#entry-Ukavikalpadruma" class="skt-link">Kavikalpadruma</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vra_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्रण</span> <i>vraṇa</i> <a href="#entry-vra_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> blessure, plaie; cicatrice — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. <i>(vraṇayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vraṇita</i><i>)</i> blesser, ulcérer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>vulnus</i>; fr. vulnérable.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vra_nita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्रणित</span> <i>vraṇita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vra_na" class="skt-link">vraṇa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vra_nita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vra_nita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vra_nitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vraṇitā</i> blessé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vraata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्रात</span> <i>vrāta</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vrata" class="skt-link">vrata</a>] <a href="#entry-vraata" class="skt-link">m.</a> multitude, foule; groupe, compagnie; troupe <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> assistance à un mariage — <a href="#entry-vraata" class="skt-link">n.</a> travail manuel; travail occasionnel à la journée.<br> <i>vrātam</i> en nombre, en foule; en troupe.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vraatiina">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्रातीन</span> <i>vrātīna</i> [<a href="#entry-vraata" class="skt-link">vrāta</a><a href="#entry--iina" class="skt-link">-īna</a>] <a href="#entry-vraatiina" class="skt-link">m.</a> ouvrier manuel; ouvrier migrant travaillant à la journée.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vraatya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्रात्य</span> <i>vrātya</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vrata" class="skt-link">vrata</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vraatya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vraatya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vraatyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vrātyā</i> nomade; errant — <a href="#entry-vraatya" class="skt-link">m.</a> véd. membre d'une secte de magiciens-shamans, associés aux <a href="#entry-rudraas" class="skt-link">rudrās</a>; ils exécutaient une cérémonie de 12 jours au solstice d'hiver pour ramener le soleil, avec un sacrifice de chiens, et utilisaient des dés en os de mouton polis <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. membre d'une communauté non brahmanique; exclu, hors-caste; personne déchue de sa caste, paria <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. not. brâhmane parti à l'étranger sans raison de force majeure <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> vagabond; saisonnier, migrant <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. étudiant brahmanique en vacances, mendiant des vaches en bande.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vraatyastoma">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vrātyastoma</i> [<a href="#entry-stoma" class="skt-link">stoma</a>] <a href="#entry-vraatyastoma" class="skt-link">n.</a> soc. cérémonie de réintégration ou d'intégration d'un <a href="#entry-vraatya" class="skt-link">vrātya</a> dans la communauté brahmanique.<br> <a href="#entry-vraatya" class="skt-link">vrātya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vraj">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्रज्</span> <i>vraj</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vrajati)</i> aor. [<span class="skt-grammar">5</span>] <i>(avrājīt)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vrajita</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>pari</i>, <i>pra</i><i>)</i> véd. être du bétail; paître <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> aller, marcher, s'avancer, circuler; déambuler; s'en aller; suivre le cours de sa vie.<br> <i>antaṃ</i> <i>vraj</i> aller jusqu'au bout.<br> <i>jarāṃ</i> <i>vraj</i> vieillir.<br> <i>jīvan</i> <i>vraj</i> avoir la vie sauve.<br> <i>padbhyāṃ</i> <i>vraj</i> aller à pied.<br> <i>punar</i> <i>vraj</i> renaître.<br> <i>mṛtyuṃ</i> <i>vraj</i> mourir.<br> <i>vyāpāraṃ</i> <i>vraj</i> s'occuper de ⟨loc.⟩.<br> <i>sukhaṃ</i> <i>vraj</i> se sentir bien, être à l'aise.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vraja">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्रज</span> <i>vraja</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vraj" class="skt-link">vraj</a>] <a href="#entry-vraja" class="skt-link">m.</a> troupe, troupeau; pâturage, parc à bestiaux, bergerie <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [BhP.] np. du lieu-dit Vraja «Pâturage», près de <a href="#entry-Umathuraa" class="skt-link">Mathurā</a>, où habitait le berger <a href="#entry-Unanda" class="skt-link">Nanda</a>, et où <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a> passa sa jeunesse avec les bouvières [<a href="#entry-gopii" class="skt-link">gopī</a>]; mod. Braj; cf. <a href="#entry-Uv_rji" class="skt-link">Vṛji</a>, <a href="#entry-Uv_rndaavana" class="skt-link">Vṛndāvana</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> route, chemin — <a href="#entry-vraja" class="skt-link">n.</a> errance, voyage.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vrajaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्रजक</span> <i>vrajaka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vraj" class="skt-link">vraj</a>] <a href="#entry-vrajaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> ascète mendiant nomade.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vrajana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्रजन</span> <i>vrajana</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vraj" class="skt-link">vraj</a>] <a href="#entry-vrajana" class="skt-link">n.</a> fait de voyager; errance, exil.<br> <i>anyatra</i> <i>vrajana</i> en déplacement ailleurs.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vrajita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्रजित</span> <i>vrajita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vraj" class="skt-link">vraj</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vrajita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vrajita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vrajitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vrajitā</i> parti — <a href="#entry-vrajita" class="skt-link">n.</a> errance.<br> <i>anyena</i> <i>vrajita</i> parti par une autre route.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vrajyaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्रज्या</span> <i>vrajyā</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vraj" class="skt-link">vraj</a>] <a href="#entry-vrajyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> voyage; déplacement; allure <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> marche; invasion.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vrata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्रत</span> <i>vrata</i> [act. <a href="#entry-v_r_2" class="skt-link">vṛ_2</a>] <a href="#entry-vrata" class="skt-link">n.</a> règle, observance; sphère d'action; manière de vivre, conduite; devoir individuel <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> vœu; pratique religieuse, chasteté <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> jn. observance rituelle <a href="#entry-jaina" class="skt-link">jaina</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-mahaavrata" class="skt-link">mahāvrata</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> jour de jeûne rituel — <a href="#entry-vrataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vratā</i> ifc. qui ne mange ou ne boit que <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>verbum</i>; ang. word; fr. verbe.<br> <i>vratāt</i> par suite d'un vœu.<br> <i>vrataṃ</i> <i>car</i> observer un vœu (not. de chasteté).<br> <i>vrataṃ</i> <i>dhṛ</i> observer un vœu.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vratabandha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vratabandha</i> [<a href="#entry-bandha" class="skt-link">bandha</a>] <a href="#entry-vratabandha" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. cérémonie d'investiture du cordon sacré [<a href="#entry-upaviita" class="skt-link">upavīta</a>]; syn. <a href="#entry-upanayana" class="skt-link">upanayana</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. restriction liée à l'observance d'un vœu.<br> <a href="#entry-vrata" class="skt-link">vrata</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vratati">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्रतति</span> <i>vratati</i> [<a href="#entry-v_rt_1" class="skt-link">vṛt_1</a>] <a href="#entry-vratati" class="skt-link">f.</a> liane <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> expansion; fait de couvrir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vratin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्रतिन्</span> <i>vratin</i> [<a href="#entry-vrata" class="skt-link">vrata</a><a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vratin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vratin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vratinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vratinī</i> qui observe des vœux — <a href="#entry-vratin" class="skt-link">m.</a> ascète; homme pieux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vratya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्रत्य</span> <i>vratya</i> [<a href="#entry-vrata" class="skt-link">vrata</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vratya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vratya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vratyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vratyā</i> obéissant; pieux; fidèle (à ⟨g.⟩) — <a href="#entry-vratya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <i>vratya</i> soc. conforme à une observance religieuse — <a href="#entry-vratya" class="skt-link">n.</a> soc. nourriture appropriée à un jour de jeûne.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vrazc">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्रश्च्</span> <i>vraśc</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">6</span>] pr. <i>(vṛścati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vṛkṇa</i><i>)</i> aor. [<span class="skt-grammar">5</span>] <i>(avraścīt)</i> aor. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] <i>(avrākṣīt)</i> aor. [<span class="skt-grammar">3</span>] <i>(avivraścat)</i> déchirer, découper — ca. <i>(vraścayati)</i> faire déchirer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vrazcana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्रश्चन</span> <i>vraścana</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vrazc" class="skt-link">vraśc</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vrazcana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vrazcana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vrazcanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vraścanā</i> (ce ou celui) qui découpe <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> à découper — <a href="#entry-vrazcana" class="skt-link">n.</a> scie; ciseau <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> coupure, incision; blessure <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> sève, latex coulant de l'incision de l'écorce d'un arbre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vrii_d">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्रीड्</span> <i>vrīḍ</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(vrīḍate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vrīḍita</i><i>)</i> avoir honte.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vrii_daa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्रीडा</span> <i>vrīḍā</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vrii_d" class="skt-link">vrīḍ</a>] <a href="#entry-vrii_daa" class="skt-link">f.</a> pudeur, timidité; honte.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vrii_daavat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vrīḍāvat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vrii_daavat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vrii_daavat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vrii_daavatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vrīḍāvatī</i> honteux, intimidé, confus.<br> <a href="#entry-vrii_daa" class="skt-link">vrīḍā</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vrii_dita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्रीडित</span> <i>vrīḍita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vrii_d" class="skt-link">vrīḍ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vrii_dita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vrii_dita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vrii_ditaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vrīḍitā</i> honteux, confus; timide — <a href="#entry-vrii_dita" class="skt-link">n.</a> honte, confusion.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vriihi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्रीहि</span> <i>vrīhi</i> <a href="#entry-vriihi" class="skt-link">m.</a> riz <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. grains de riz.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vya_msaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यंसक</span> <i>vyaṃsaka</i> <a href="#entry-vya_msaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> tricheur; escroc.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्या</span> <i>vyā</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vyayati)</i> pr. md. <i>(vyayate)</i> aor. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] <i>(avyat)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vīta</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>upa</i>, <i>sam</i><i>)</i> envelopper, couvrir; protéger, cacher.<br> <i>vovyāt</i> qu'il vous protège.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaa_da">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्याड</span> <i>vyāḍa</i> a. <a href="#entry-vyaa_da" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaa_da" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaa_daa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vyāḍā</i> méchant, cruel; cf. <a href="#entry-vyaala" class="skt-link">vyāla</a> — <a href="#entry-vyaa_da" class="skt-link">m.</a> fauve.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaa_di">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्याडि</span> <i>vyāḍi</i> [<a href="#entry-vyaa_da" class="skt-link">vyāḍa</a>] <a href="#entry-vyaa_di" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. du grammairien antique Vyāḍi; on lui attribue le <a href="#entry-Uvyaa_diiyaparibhaa_saav_rtti" class="skt-link">Vyāḍīyaparibhāṣāvṛtti</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaa_diiya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vyāḍīya</i> [<a href="#entry--iiya" class="skt-link">-īya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vyaa_diiya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaa_diiya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaa_diiyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vyāḍīyā</i> produit par <a href="#entry-Uvyaa_di" class="skt-link">Vyāḍi</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaa_diiyaparibhaa_saav_rtti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vyāḍīyaparibhāṣāvṛtti</i> [<a href="#entry-paribhaa_saav_rtti" class="skt-link">paribhāṣāvṛtti</a>] <a href="#entry-vyaa_diiyaparibhaa_saav_rtti" class="skt-link">f.</a> gram. np. de la Vyāḍīyaparibhāṣāvṛtti, qui discute des métarègles de la grammaire de <a href="#entry-Upaa_nini" class="skt-link">Pāṇini</a>; elle est traditionnellement attribuée à <a href="#entry-Uvyaa_di" class="skt-link">Vyāḍi</a>, mais sans doute plus récente.<br> <a href="#entry-vyaa_diiya" class="skt-link">vyāḍīya</a> <br> <a href="#entry-vyaa_di" class="skt-link">vyāḍi</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaacak_s">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्याचक्ष्</span> <i>vyācakṣ</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-aacak_s" class="skt-link">ācakṣ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. md. <i>(vyācaṣṭe)</i> expliquer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaadaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यादा</span> <i>vyādā</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-aadaa" class="skt-link">ādā</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">3</span>] pr. md. <i>(vyādatte)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vyātta</i>, <i>vyādita</i><i>)</i> ouvrir grand, not. la bouche [<a href="#entry-mukha" class="skt-link">mukha</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> accepter; recevoir (de ⟨loc. i. abl.⟩).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaadaaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यादाय</span> <i>vyādāya</i> [<a href="#entry-vyaadaa" class="skt-link">vyādā</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vyaadaaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaadaaya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaadaayaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vyādāyā</i> ayant ouvert (not. la bouche).<br> <i>vyādāyaḥ</i> <i>svapiti</i> il dort la bouche ouverte.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaadha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्याध</span> <i>vyādha</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vyadh" class="skt-link">vyadh</a>] <a href="#entry-vyaadha" class="skt-link">m.</a> chasseur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaadhaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्याधा</span> <i>vyādhā</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-aadhaa" class="skt-link">ādhā</a>] ps. <i>(vyādhīyate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vyādhita</i>, <i>vyāhita</i><i>)</i> être indisposé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaadhapatafga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vyādhapataṅga</i> [<a href="#entry-patafga" class="skt-link">pataṅga</a>] <a href="#entry-vyaadhapatafga" class="skt-link">m.</a> natu. libellule.<br> <a href="#entry-vyaadha" class="skt-link">vyādha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaadhi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्याधि</span> <i>vyādhi</i> [instr. <a href="#entry-vyaadhaa" class="skt-link">vyādhā</a>] <a href="#entry-vyaadhi" class="skt-link">m.</a> maladie; not. lèpre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> douleur, souffrance; tourment, souci — ifc. peste de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaadhita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्याधित</span> <i>vyādhita</i> var. <i>vyāhita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vyaadhaa" class="skt-link">vyādhā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vyaadhita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaadhita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaadhitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vyādhitā</i> malade, souffrant, maladif.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaadhuu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्याधू</span> <i>vyādhū</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-aadhuu" class="skt-link">ādhū</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">5</span>] pr. <i>(vyādhunoti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vyādhūta</i><i>)</i> agiter, remuer; disperser (not. vent).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaadita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यादित</span> <i>vyādita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vyaadaa" class="skt-link">vyādā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vyaadita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaadita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaaditaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vyāditā</i> grand ouvert, vaste.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaaditaasya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vyāditāsya</i> [<a href="#entry-aasya" class="skt-link">āsya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vyaaditaasya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaaditaasya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaaditaasyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vyāditāsyā</i> qui a la bouche grande ouverte.<br> <a href="#entry-vyaadita" class="skt-link">vyādita</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaaghaata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्याघात</span> <i>vyāghāta</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vyaahan" class="skt-link">vyāhan</a>] <a href="#entry-vyaaghaata" class="skt-link">m.</a> frappe, coup; fait de battre, de blesser <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> agitation, désordre; obstacle, empêchement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. contradiction, incohérence <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. procédé rhétorique [<a href="#entry-alafkaara" class="skt-link">alaṃkāra</a>] de description d'effets opposés de mêmes causes.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaaghaataka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्याघातक</span> <i>vyāghātaka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vyaahan" class="skt-link">vyāhan</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vyaaghaataka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaaghaataka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaaghaatikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vyāghātikā</i> qui frappe; qui s'oppose, qui résiste.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaaghra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्याघ्र</span> <i>vyāghra</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-aaghra" class="skt-link">āghra</a>] <a href="#entry-vyaaghra" class="skt-link">m.</a> natu. zoo. tigre; myth. les tigres descendent de <a href="#entry-Uzaarduulii" class="skt-link">Śārdūlī</a> (ou de <a href="#entry-Uda_m_s_traa" class="skt-link">Daṃṣṭrā</a>) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> héros («un tigre parmi les hommes») — <a href="#entry-vyaaghrii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vyāghrī</i> natu. tigresse <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hi. <i>bāgha</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaaghrapaada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vyāghrapāda</i> [<a href="#entry-paada" class="skt-link">pāda</a>] <a href="#entry-vyaaghrapaada" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. épith. du <a href="#entry-_r_si" class="skt-link">ṛṣi</a> Vyāghrapāda, à qui poussèrent des pattes de tigre afin qu'il puisse cueillir en haut des arbres des fleurs non souillées même par des abeilles, afin de les offrir à <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>-<a href="#entry-Una_taraaja" class="skt-link">Naṭarāja</a>; on le représente en compagnie de <a href="#entry-Upata_njali_1" class="skt-link">Patañjali_1</a> au corps de serpent <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. grammairien éponyme du 2⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle ant., accompli [<a href="#entry-siddha_1" class="skt-link">siddha_1</a>], auquel on attribue le Daśaka.<br> <a href="#entry-vyaaghra" class="skt-link">vyāghra</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaaghrapad">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vyāghrapad</i> [<a href="#entry-pad_2" class="skt-link">pad_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vyaaghrapad" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaaghrapad" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaaghrapad" class="skt-link">f.</a> qui a un pied de tigre — <a href="#entry-vyaaghrapad" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. de Vyāghrapād, auteur d'hymnes du RV.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaah_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्याहृ</span> <i>vyāhṛ</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-aah_r" class="skt-link">āhṛ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vyāharati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vyāhṛta</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>abhi</i>, <i>pra</i><i>)</i> prononcer, dire, parler.<br> <i>nāmabhir</i> <i>vyāhṛ</i> appeler par leurs noms.<br> <i>praśnān</i> <i>vyāhṛ</i> répondre à des questions.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaah_rta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्याहृत</span> <i>vyāhṛta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vyaah_r" class="skt-link">vyāhṛ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vyaah_rta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaah_rta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaah_rtaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vyāhṛtā</i> prononcé, dit — <a href="#entry-vyaah_rta" class="skt-link">n.</a> conversation.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaah_rti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्याहृति</span> <i>vyāhṛti</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vyaah_r" class="skt-link">vyāhṛ</a>] <a href="#entry-vyaah_rti" class="skt-link">f.</a> énonciation, déclaration, proclamation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> véd. exclamation rituelle, not. lors des libations; proclamation du nom des 7 mondes célestes [<a href="#entry-loka" class="skt-link">loka</a>], ou seulement des 3 premiers [<a href="#entry-vyaah_rtitraya" class="skt-link">vyāhṛtitraya</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaah_rtitraya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vyāhṛtitraya</i> [<a href="#entry-traya" class="skt-link">traya</a>] <a href="#entry-vyaah_rtitraya" class="skt-link">n.</a> myth. proclamation rituelle des 3 mondes célestes [<a href="#entry-lokatraya" class="skt-link">lokatraya</a>]: <a href="#entry-bhuur" class="skt-link">bhūr</a> <a href="#entry-bhuvar" class="skt-link">bhuvar</a> <a href="#entry-svar_3" class="skt-link">svar_3</a> (cf. <a href="#entry-bhuu_2" class="skt-link">bhū_2</a>).<br> <a href="#entry-vyaah_rti" class="skt-link">vyāhṛti</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaahan">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्याहन्</span> <i>vyāhan</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-aahan" class="skt-link">āhan</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(vyāhanti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vyāhata</i><i>)</i> frapper, fouler; repousser, empêcher.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaahita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्याहित</span> <i>vyāhita</i> cf. <a href="#entry-vyaadhita" class="skt-link">vyādhita</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaaja">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्याज</span> <i>vyāja</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vya_nj" class="skt-link">vyañj</a>] <a href="#entry-vyaaja" class="skt-link">m.</a> apparence, imitation, plagiat; tromperie, fraude; prétexte, dissimulation — <a href="#entry-vyaajaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vyājā</i> ifc. qui a l'apparence de; qui se fait passer pour, prétextant être; faux.<br> <i>vyājena</i> var. <i>vyajāt</i> faussement; traîtreusement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaajaguru">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vyājaguru</i> [<a href="#entry-guru" class="skt-link">guru</a>] <a href="#entry-vyaajaguru" class="skt-link">m.</a> prétendu maître.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaajastuti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vyājastuti</i> [<a href="#entry-stuti" class="skt-link">stuti</a>] <a href="#entry-vyaajastuti" class="skt-link">f.</a> éloge feint ou ironique.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaajasupta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vyājasupta</i> [<a href="#entry-supta" class="skt-link">supta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vyaajasupta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaajasupta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaajasuptaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vyājasuptā</i> qui feint le sommeil.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaajokti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vyājokti</i> [<a href="#entry-ukti" class="skt-link">ukti</a>] <a href="#entry-vyaajokti" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. rhét. (figure de style) paroles trompeuses, dissimulation; le fait dissimulé doit être suggéré mais nié; syn. <a href="#entry-apahnuti" class="skt-link">apahnuti</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vyaaja" class="skt-link">vyāja</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaak_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्याकृ</span> <i>vyākṛ</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-aak_r" class="skt-link">ākṛ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">8</span>] pr. <i>(vyākaroti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vyākṛta</i><i>)</i> développer, expliquer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaak_rta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्याकृत</span> <i>vyākṛta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vyaak_r" class="skt-link">vyākṛ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vyaak_rta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaak_rta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaak_rtaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vyākṛtā</i> développé, déroulé; analysé, expliqué <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> transformé, changé; traduit (du ⟨iic.⟩) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. manifeste.<br> <i>ibrīyabhāṣāto</i> <i>vyākṛta</i> traduit de l'hébreu.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaakara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्याकरण</span> <i>vyākaraṇa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vyaak_r" class="skt-link">vyākṛ</a>] <a href="#entry-vyaakara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> séparation, distinction; analyse, description, développement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> révélation, communication; création <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. la grammaire, un des 6 traités annexes du <a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a> [<a href="#entry-vedaafga" class="skt-link">vedāṅga</a>]; analyse grammaticale.<br> <i>dvādaśabhirvarṣaiḥ</i> <i>vyākaraṇam</i> <i>śrūyate</i> On doit étudier la grammaire pendant 12 ans.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaakara_naacaarya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vyākaraṇācārya</i> [<a href="#entry-aacaarya" class="skt-link">ācārya</a>] <a href="#entry-vyaakara_naacaarya" class="skt-link">m.</a> professeur de grammaire.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaakara_nacuu_daama_ni">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vyākaraṇacūḍāmaṇi</i> [<a href="#entry-cuu_daama_ni" class="skt-link">cūḍāmaṇi</a>] <a href="#entry-vyaakara_nacuu_daama_ni" class="skt-link">m.</a> diplôme de grammairien expert.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaakara_natiirtha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vyākaraṇatīrtha</i> [<a href="#entry-tiirtha" class="skt-link">tīrtha</a>] <a href="#entry-vyaakara_natiirtha" class="skt-link">n.</a> certificat d'études sanskrites.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaakara_nottamaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vyākaraṇottamā</i> [<a href="#entry-uttamaa" class="skt-link">uttamā</a>] <a href="#entry-vyaakara_nottamaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> diplôme supérieur d'études sanskrites.<br> <a href="#entry-vyaakara_na" class="skt-link">vyākaraṇa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaakhyaa_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्याख्या</span> <i>vyākhyā_1</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-aakhyaa_1" class="skt-link">ākhyā_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(vyākhyāti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vyākhyāta</i><i>)</i> expliquer, exposer en détail, commenter.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaakhyaa_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्याख्या</span> <i>vyākhyā_2</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vyaakhyaa_1" class="skt-link">vyākhyā_1</a>] <a href="#entry-vyaakhyaa_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> explication, commentaire; élaboration <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. glose.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaakhyaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्याख्यान</span> <i>vyākhyāna</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vyaakhyaa_1" class="skt-link">vyākhyā_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vyaakhyaana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaakhyaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaakhyaanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vyākhyānā</i> qui explique, qui glose <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui ressemble à ⟨g.⟩ — <a href="#entry-vyaakhyaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> récit, exposé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. interprétation, sémantique; explication détaillée; cf. <a href="#entry-bhaa_sya" class="skt-link">bhāṣya</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> narration; récitation.<br> <i>lakṣyānusāri</i> <i>vyākhyānam</i> [Nāgojībhaṭṭa] L'interprétation est conforme aux règles (de <a href="#entry-Upaa_nini" class="skt-link">Pāṇini</a>).<br> <i>padacchedaḥ</i> <i>padārthoktir</i> <i>vigraho</i> <i>vākyayojanā</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>ākṣepo'tha</i> <i>samādhānaṃ</i> <i>vyākhyānaṃ</i> <i>ṣaḍvidhaṃ</i> <i>matam</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> Segmenter et donner le sens des mots, faire l'analyse morphologique et structurelle de la phrase, soulever les objections et y répondre, voilà les 6 buts prescrits à une interprétation textuelle.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaakhyaanamaalaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vyākhyānamālā</i> [<a href="#entry-maalaa" class="skt-link">mālā</a>] <a href="#entry-vyaakhyaanamaalaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de la Vyākhyānamālā «Guirlande de commentaires».<br> <a href="#entry-vyaakhyaana" class="skt-link">vyākhyāna</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaakhyaata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्याख्यात</span> <i>vyākhyāta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vyaakhyaa_1" class="skt-link">vyākhyā_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vyaakhyaata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaakhyaata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaakhyaataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vyākhyātā</i> raconté, exposé; détaillé; expliqué, commenté, discuté.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaakhyaayukti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vyākhyāyukti</i> [<a href="#entry-yukti" class="skt-link">yukti</a>] <a href="#entry-vyaakhyaayukti" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de la Vyākhyāyukti (ou Vyākhyāyuktiśāstra), ouvrage de grammaire dû à <a href="#entry-Uvasubandhu" class="skt-link">Vasubandhu</a>; on n'en connaît qu'une traduction tibétaine.<br> <a href="#entry-vyaakhyaa_2" class="skt-link">vyākhyā_2</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaakula">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्याकुल</span> <i>vyākula</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-aakula" class="skt-link">ākula</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vyaakula" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaakula" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaakulaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vyākulā</i> troublé, agité; bouleversé, ému; embrouillé, en désordre; en transe — ifc. plein de; occupé de, absorbé par, sous l'empire de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaakulataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vyākulatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-vyaakulataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> peine, émotion, distraction; trouble, anxiété; perplexité, confusion <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> émoi, excitation; nervosité, impatience.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaakulatva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vyākulatva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-vyaakulatva" class="skt-link">n.</a> peine, émotion, trouble.<br> <a href="#entry-vyaakula" class="skt-link">vyākula</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्याल</span> <i>vyāla</i> [relié à <a href="#entry-vyaa_da" class="skt-link">vyāḍa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vyaala" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaala" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaalii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vyālī</i> cruel, méchant, féroce; extravagant — <a href="#entry-vyaala" class="skt-link">m.</a> bête féroce, fauve; serpent; animal sauvage féroce (opp. <a href="#entry-m_rga" class="skt-link">mṛga</a>) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. griffon; il est souvent représenté terrassant un éléphant, symbole de la victoire de l'hindouisme sur le bouddhisme; syn. <a href="#entry-zarabha" class="skt-link">śarabha</a> — <a href="#entry-vyaalii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vyālī</i> serpent femelle <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. serpent du cycle des renaissances.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaapti">

[<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] validité de l'inférence entre l'hypothèse [<a href="#entry-hetu" class="skt-link">hetu</a>] et la conclusion [<a href="#entry-saadhya" class="skt-link">sādhya</a>] on établit que l'hypothèse cause la conclusion en montrant que la conclusion est inhérente à la nature de l'hypothèse; on distingue l'inférence positive [<a href="#entry-anvayavyaapti" class="skt-link">anvayavyāpti</a>] et celle par contradiction [<a href="#entry-vyatirekavyaapti" class="skt-link">vyatirekavyāpti</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-navyanyaaya" class="skt-link">navyanyāya</a>] concomitance inévitable, corrélation.<br> <i>sāhacaryaniyamaḥ</i> <i>vyāptiḥ</i> [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] L'inhérence est une association obligée.
  </div>
</div>

[<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] np. du Vyāptipañcakarahasya, commentaire par <a href="#entry-Umathuraanaatha_1" class="skt-link">Mathurānātha_1</a> du <a href="#entry-vyaaptipa_ncaka" class="skt-link">vyāptipañcaka</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vyaaptipa_ncaka" class="skt-link">vyāptipañcaka</a>

[<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] qui expose la loi de concomitance; se dit de la clause d'exemple à l'appui [<a href="#entry-udaahara_na" class="skt-link">udāharaṇa</a>] dans le syllogisme quintuple [<a href="#entry-pa_ncaavayava" class="skt-link">pañcāvayava</a>].<br> <a href="#entry-vyaapti" class="skt-link">vyāpti</a>
  </div>
</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्याप्य</span> <i>vyāpya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-vyaap" class="skt-link">vyāp</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vyaapya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaapya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaapyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vyāpyā</i> perméable, pénétrable; imprégné de ⟨iic.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] qualifiable; qui peut servir de prédicat — <a href="#entry-vyaapya" class="skt-link">n.</a> substrat d'une hypothèse.<br> <i>vahnivyāpyo</i> <i>dhūmaḥ</i> [«la fumée est imprégnée de feu»] Il n'y a pas de fumée sans feu.

</div>

</div>
