  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यास</span> <i>vyāsa</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-aasa_1" class="skt-link">āsa_1</a>] <a href="#entry-vyaasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> séparation, division <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> diffusion, extension; exposé, rapport détaillé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> largeur, épaisseur, diamètre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> compilateur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. du sage [<a href="#entry-_r_si" class="skt-link">ṛṣi</a>] Vyāsa «le Compilateur (du <a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>)», fils de l'ascète <a href="#entry-Uparaazara" class="skt-link">Parāśara</a> et de <a href="#entry-Ukaalii_1" class="skt-link">Kālī_1</a>-<a href="#entry-Usatyavatii" class="skt-link">Satyavatī</a>, et donc demi-frère de <a href="#entry-Ubhii_sma" class="skt-link">Bhīṣma</a> et de <a href="#entry-Uvicitraviirya" class="skt-link">Vicitravīrya</a>; né miraculeusement [<a href="#entry-Udvaipaayana_1" class="skt-link">Dvaipāyana_1</a>] sur un île de la <a href="#entry-Uyamunaa" class="skt-link">Yamunā</a>, adulte dès sa conception, il y vécut comme ermite; sa mère le fit revenir dans le monde par devoir de <a href="#entry-niyoga" class="skt-link">niyoga</a> pour épouser (par la foudre de son regard) les 2 veuves de <a href="#entry-Uvicitraviirya" class="skt-link">Vicitravīrya</a>, <a href="#entry-Uambikaa_1" class="skt-link">Ambikā_1</a> pour concevoir <a href="#entry-Udh_rtaraa_s_tra" class="skt-link">Dhṛtarāṣṭra</a>, et <a href="#entry-Uambaalikaa_1" class="skt-link">Ambālikā_1</a> pour concevoir <a href="#entry-Upaa_n_du" class="skt-link">Pāṇḍu</a>; lorsqu'il voulut un 3⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ enfant, <a href="#entry-Uambikaa_1" class="skt-link">Ambikā_1</a> déguisa une de ses servantes en substitution, dont il engendra <a href="#entry-Uvidura" class="skt-link">Vidura</a>; on lui attribue la compilation du <a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mahābhārata</a> et des récits sacrés [<a href="#entry-puraa_na" class="skt-link">purāṇa</a>]; il est aussi appelé compositeur du <a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a> [<a href="#entry-Uvedavyaasa" class="skt-link">Vedavyāsa</a>]; on le célèbre à <a href="#entry-gurupuur_nimaa" class="skt-link">gurupūrṇimā</a>; c'est l'un des 7 immortels [<a href="#entry-cira_njiivin" class="skt-link">ciraṃjīvin</a>]; il fit de grandes pénitences pour prier <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> de lui accorder un fils; ayant obtenu son vœu, il retourna à son ermitage [<a href="#entry-aazrama" class="skt-link">āśrama</a>] où la nymphe [<a href="#entry-apsaras" class="skt-link">apsaras</a>] <a href="#entry-Ugh_rtaacii" class="skt-link">Ghṛtācī</a> lui apparut sous la forme d'un perroquet [<a href="#entry-zuka" class="skt-link">śuka</a>]; devant sa beauté il perdit sa semence d'où naquit le sage <a href="#entry-Uzuka" class="skt-link">Śuka</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. de Vyāsa_1 l'«Éditeur», auteur du <a href="#entry-Uyogabhaa_sya" class="skt-link">Yogabhāṣya</a>, premier commentaire du <a href="#entry-Uyogasuutra" class="skt-link">Yogasūtra</a>; il pourrait être <a href="#entry-Upata_njali_2" class="skt-link">Patañjali_2</a> lui-même, et aurait vécu entre le 4⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ et le 7⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècles.<br> <i>vyāsocchiṣṭaṃ</i> <i>jagatsarvam</i> <a href="#entry-Uvyaasa" class="skt-link">Vyāsa</a> a régurgité la Terre entière (dans le <a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaasabhaa_sya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vyāsabhāṣya</i> [<a href="#entry-bhaa_sya" class="skt-link">bhāṣya</a>] <a href="#entry-vyaasabhaa_sya" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. du Vyāsabhāsya, commentaire du <a href="#entry-Uyogasuutra" class="skt-link">Yogasūtra</a> de <a href="#entry-Upata_njali_2" class="skt-link">Patañjali_2</a>, attribué à <a href="#entry-Uvyaasa_1" class="skt-link">Vyāsa_1</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Uyogabhaa_sya" class="skt-link">Yogabhāṣya</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vyaasa" class="skt-link">vyāsa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaasafga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यासङ्ग</span> <i>vyāsaṅga</i> [<a href="#entry-vyaasa_nj" class="skt-link">vyāsañj</a>] <a href="#entry-vyaasafga" class="skt-link">m.</a> attachement excessif, forte adhérence <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> dévotion à, addiction à ⟨loc. iic.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> distraction, égarement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> détachement, séparation.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaasajya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यासज्य</span> <i>vyāsajya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-vyaasa_nj" class="skt-link">vyāsañj</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vyaasajya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaasajya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaasajyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vyāsajyā</i> à connecter avec, à attacher, à coller <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui doit être associé à.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaasajyaceta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vyāsajyaceta</i> [<a href="#entry-cetas" class="skt-link">cetas</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vyaasajyaceta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaasajyaceta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaasajyacetaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vyāsajyacetā</i> attaché en pensée à.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaasajyav_rtti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vyāsajyavṛtti</i> [<a href="#entry-v_rtti" class="skt-link">vṛtti</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vyaasajyav_rtti" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaasajyav_rtti" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaasajyav_rtti" class="skt-link">f.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] (qualité) résidant en plusieurs objects.<br> <a href="#entry-vyaasajya" class="skt-link">vyāsajya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaasakta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यासक्त</span> <i>vyāsakta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vyaasa_nj" class="skt-link">vyāsañj</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vyaasakta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaasakta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaasaktaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vyāsaktā</i> dévoué à, attaché à; connecté avec; dépendant de <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> engagé dans, occupé à ⟨loc. iic.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> embrassé, étreint <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> détaché, disjoint de <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> distrait, confus; perplexe.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaasatiirtha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vyāsatīrtha</i> [<a href="#entry-tiirtha" class="skt-link">tīrtha</a>] <a href="#entry-vyaasatiirtha" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. de Vyāsatīrtha, mystique érudit de l'ordre <a href="#entry-dvaita" class="skt-link">dvaita</a> de <a href="#entry-Umadhva" class="skt-link">Madhva</a> (~1460–1539); né Yatirāja à Mysore, il fut initié par Brahmanyatīrtha comme le renonçant <a href="#entry-Uvyaasatiirtha" class="skt-link">Vyāsatīrtha</a>; il étudia à <a href="#entry-Ukaa_ncii" class="skt-link">Kāñcī</a> puis à Mulbagal; il dirigea le temple de Tirupati de 1486 à 1498; il joignit <a href="#entry-Uvijayanagara" class="skt-link">Vijayanagara</a> à la demande de <a href="#entry-Usaluva" class="skt-link">Saluva</a> <a href="#entry-Unarasi_mha_4" class="skt-link">Narasiṃha_4</a>; il fut le <a href="#entry-raajaguru" class="skt-link">rājaguru</a> de l'empereur <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_nadeva" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇadeva</a> <a href="#entry-Uraaya" class="skt-link">Rāya</a>; c'était un dialecticien inégalé dans les débats; on lui doit le <a href="#entry-Unyaayaam_rta" class="skt-link">Nyāyāmṛta</a>, le <a href="#entry-Utarkataa_n_dava" class="skt-link">Tarkatāṇḍava</a>, la <a href="#entry-Utaatparyacandrikaa_1" class="skt-link">Tātparyacandrikā_1</a>, et le <a href="#entry-Ubhedojjiivana" class="skt-link">Bhedojjīvana</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaasa_nj">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यासञ्ज्</span> <i>vyāsañj</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-aasa_nj" class="skt-link">āsañj</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vyāsajati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vyāsakta</i><i>)</i> s'attacher excessivement; adhérer fortement; se fixer sur ⟨loc. iic.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaatta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यात्त</span> <i>vyātta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vyaadaa" class="skt-link">vyādā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vyaatta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaatta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaattaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vyāttā</i> grand ouvert, vaste — <a href="#entry-vyaatta" class="skt-link">n.</a> gueule ou bouche ouverte.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaattaanana">

[BhG.] dit de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a> prêt à détruire l'univers.<br> <a href="#entry-vyaatta" class="skt-link">vyātta</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaav_rt">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यावृत्</span> <i>vyāvṛt</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-aav_rt_1" class="skt-link">āvṛt_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(vyāvartate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vyāvṛtta</i><i>)</i> se séparer de ⟨i.⟩; se diviser, bifurquer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> être distinct de, incompatible avec ⟨abl.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> se détourner de, se débarasser de ⟨i. abl.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> s'en aller, partir; s'achever, disparaître; se coucher (not. soleil) — ca. md. <i>(vyāvartayate)</i> séparer, diviser; isoler de ⟨i.⟩; écarter; reprendre; se rétracter <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> disperser, refouler; anéantir, annuler.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaav_rtta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यावृत्त</span> <i>vyāvṛtta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vyaav_rt" class="skt-link">vyāvṛt</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vyaav_rtta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaav_rtta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaav_rttaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vyāvṛttā</i> divisé, fendu; détourné, retourné; débarrassé de ⟨i. abl. iic.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> incompatible (avec ⟨iic.⟩); disparu, parti, cessé.
  </div>
</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vyāvṛttaśiras</i> [<a href="#entry-ziras" class="skt-link">śiras</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vyaav_rttaziras" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaav_rttaziras" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaav_rttaziras" class="skt-link">f.</a> qui détourne la tête.<br> <a href="#entry-vyaav_rtta" class="skt-link">vyāvṛtta</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaav_rtti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यावृत्ति</span> <i>vyāvṛtti</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vyaav_rt" class="skt-link">vyāvṛt</a>] <a href="#entry-vyaav_rtti" class="skt-link">f.</a> fait de se débarrasser de ⟨abl.⟩; fait d'être exclu ou frustré de.
  </div>
</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaavahaarika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यावहारिक</span> <i>vyāvahārika</i> [vr. <a href="#entry-vyavahaara" class="skt-link">vyavahāra</a><a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vyaavahaarika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaavahaarika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaavahaarikii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vyāvahārikī</i> phil. contingent des affaires humaines; pragmatique, empirique, courant; opp. <a href="#entry-paaramaarthika" class="skt-link">pāramārthika</a> (réel), opp. <a href="#entry-praatibhaasika" class="skt-link">prātibhāsika</a> (illusoire).
  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaavartaka">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaavartana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यावर्तन</span> <i>vyāvartana</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vyaav_rt" class="skt-link">vyāvṛt</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vyaavartana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaavartana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaavartanii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vyāvartanī</i> qui exclut, qui enlève — ifc. qui se détourne de — <a href="#entry-vyaavartana" class="skt-link">n.</a> tournant (d'une route); anneau (d'un serpent); bobine.
  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaayaamaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vyāyāmaka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vyaayaamaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaayaamaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaayaamikii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vyāyāmikī</i> relatif à la culture physique; athlétique — <a href="#entry-vyaayaamikii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vyāyāmikī</i> l'athlétisme, l'un des 64 arts [<a href="#entry-kalaa" class="skt-link">kalā</a>].<br> <i>vyāyāmikīnāṃ</i> <i>vidyānāṃ</i> <i>jñānam</i> la culture physique.
  </div>
</div>

</div>

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vyāyacchati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vyāyata</i><i>)</i> étendre — pr. md. <i>(vyāyacchate)</i> s'efforcer à, lutter pour ⟨loc.⟩ — ca. <i>(vyāyamayati)</i> s'exercer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaayata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

[<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] non-concomitance dans un syllogisme; opp. <a href="#entry-sahacaara" class="skt-link">sahacāra</a>.

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyabhicaaribhaava">

d'esprit transitoire, humeur passagère (opp. <a href="#entry-sthaayibhaava" class="skt-link">sthāyibhāva</a>); on en dénombre 34: l'indifférence [<a href="#entry-nirveda" class="skt-link">nirveda</a>], la lassitude [<a href="#entry-glaani" class="skt-link">glāni</a>], l'appréhension [<a href="#entry-zafkaa" class="skt-link">śaṅkā</a>], l'envie [<a href="#entry-asuuyaa" class="skt-link">asūyā</a>], l'ivresse [<a href="#entry-mada" class="skt-link">mada</a>], la lassitude [<a href="#entry-zrama" class="skt-link">śrama</a>], la paresse [<a href="#entry-aalasya" class="skt-link">ālasya</a>], le découragement [<a href="#entry-dainya" class="skt-link">dainya</a>], l'inquiétude [<a href="#entry-cintaa" class="skt-link">cintā</a>], l'égarement [<a href="#entry-moha" class="skt-link">moha</a>], le souvenir [<a href="#entry-sm_rti" class="skt-link">smṛti</a>], la résolution [<a href="#entry-dh_rti" class="skt-link">dhṛti</a>], la timidité [<a href="#entry-vrii_daa" class="skt-link">vrīḍā</a>], l'inconstance [<a href="#entry-capalataa" class="skt-link">capalatā</a>], le plaisir [<a href="#entry-har_sa" class="skt-link">harṣa</a>], l'excitation [<a href="#entry-aavega" class="skt-link">āvega</a>], la stupidité [<a href="#entry-ja_dataa" class="skt-link">jaḍatā</a>], l'orgueil [<a href="#entry-garva" class="skt-link">garva</a>], le désespoir [<a href="#entry-vi_saada" class="skt-link">viṣāda</a>], l'impatience [<a href="#entry-autsukya" class="skt-link">autsukya</a>], la somnolence [<a href="#entry-nidraa_2" class="skt-link">nidrā_2</a>], l'épilepsie [<a href="#entry-apasmaara" class="skt-link">apasmāra</a>], la léthargie [<a href="#entry-supta" class="skt-link">supta</a>], l'inattention [<a href="#entry-vibodha_1" class="skt-link">vibodha_1</a>], l'impatience [<a href="#entry-amar_sa" class="skt-link">amarṣa</a>], la dissimulation [<a href="#entry-avahitthaa" class="skt-link">avahitthā</a>], la colère [<a href="#entry-ugrataa" class="skt-link">ugratā</a>], la sagesse [<a href="#entry-mati" class="skt-link">mati</a>], la réprimande [<a href="#entry-upaalambha" class="skt-link">upālambha</a>], la maladie [<a href="#entry-vyaadhi" class="skt-link">vyādhi</a>], la folie [<a href="#entry-unmaada" class="skt-link">unmāda</a>], l'agonie [<a href="#entry-mara_na" class="skt-link">maraṇa</a>], la crainte [<a href="#entry-traasa" class="skt-link">trāsa</a>] et la réflexion [<a href="#entry-vitarka" class="skt-link">vitarka</a>].<br> <a href="#entry-vyabhicaari" class="skt-link">vyabhicāri</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyabhicaarin">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyabhicar">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यभिचर्</span> <i>vyabhicar</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-abhicar" class="skt-link">abhicar</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vyabhicarati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vyabhicarita</i><i>)</i> mal se comporter envers ⟨acc. g.⟩; offenser, injurier <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pratiquer la sorcellerie <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> transgresser; pécher.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyabhra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यभ्र</span> <i>vyabhra</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-abhra" class="skt-link">abhra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vyabhra" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vyabhra" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vyabhraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vyabhrā</i> sans nuages.<br> <i>vyabhre</i> adv. par beau temps.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyac">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यच्</span> <i>vyac</i> de <a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-a_nc" class="skt-link">añc</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyacas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यचस्</span> <i>vyacas</i> [<a href="#entry-vyac" class="skt-link">vyac</a>] <a href="#entry-vyacas" class="skt-link">n.</a> étendue, capacité; espace ouvert; degré de liberté.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyadh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यध्</span> <i>vyadh</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. <i>(vidhyati)</i> pft. <i>(vivyādha)</i> aor. [<span class="skt-grammar">3</span>] <i>(avīvidhat)</i> aor. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] <i>(avyātsīt)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>viddha</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>apa</i>, <i>ā</i>, <i>ni</i><i>)</i> percer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> percer, blesser; atteindre (par ⟨i.⟩ une flèche) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> aiguillonner, stimuler <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> infliger qqc. ⟨i.⟩ à qqn. ⟨acc.⟩ — ps. <i>(vidhyate)</i> être percé, être blessé — ca. <i>(vyādhayati)</i> percer.<br> <i>dhanuṣāvidhyati</i> il perce avec (la flèche issue de) son arc.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyadha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यध</span> <i>vyadha</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vyadh" class="skt-link">vyadh</a>] <a href="#entry-vyadha" class="skt-link">m.</a> action de percer, de blesser <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> blessure.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyadhikara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यधिकरण</span> <i>vyadhikaraṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-adhikara_na" class="skt-link">adhikaraṇa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vyadhikara_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vyadhikara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vyadhikara_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vyadhikaraṇā</i> gram. non congru à; qui n'a pas la même dénotation que; mis à un autre cas que; opp. <a href="#entry-samaanaadhikara_na" class="skt-link">samānādhikaraṇa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyadhikara_nabahuvriihi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vyadhikaraṇabahuvrīhi</i> [<a href="#entry-bahuvriihi" class="skt-link">bahuvrīhi</a>] <a href="#entry-vyadhikara_nabahuvriihi" class="skt-link">m.</a> gram. composé déterminatif hétérodénotationnel, comme <a href="#entry-ka_n_thekaala" class="skt-link">kaṇṭhekāla</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vyadhikara_na" class="skt-link">vyadhikaraṇa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyafgya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यङ्ग्य</span> <i>vyaṅgya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-vya_nj" class="skt-link">vyañj</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vyafgya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vyafgya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vyafgyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vyaṅgyā</i> manifeste, perceptible <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. (sens) suggéré, insinué; sous-entendu — <a href="#entry-vyafgya" class="skt-link">m.</a> mod. satire.<br> <i>guṇībhūtavyaṅgya</i> lit. (poésie) où le sens suggéré est secondaire; opp. <a href="#entry-dhvani" class="skt-link">dhvani</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyafgyacitra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vyaṅgyacitra</i> [<a href="#entry-citra" class="skt-link">citra</a>] <a href="#entry-vyafgyacitra" class="skt-link">n.</a> mod. dessin humoristique; bande dessinée.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyafgyokti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vyaṅgyokti</i> [<a href="#entry-ukti" class="skt-link">ukti</a>] <a href="#entry-vyafgyokti" class="skt-link">f.</a> insinuation; sous-entendu.<br> <a href="#entry-vyafgya" class="skt-link">vyaṅgya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyafka_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यङ्कट</span> <i>vyaṅkaṭa</i> <a href="#entry-vyafka_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> géo. np. de la colline de Vyaṅkaṭa, cf. <a href="#entry-vefka_ta" class="skt-link">veṅkaṭa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyagra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यग्र</span> <i>vyagra</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-agra" class="skt-link">agra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vyagra" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vyagra" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vyagraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vyagrā</i> distrait, inattentif [«qui ne dirige son attention sur aucun point particulier»] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> agité; obsédé, occupé de ⟨i. iic.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyagrataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vyagratā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-vyagrataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> occupation intense (à ⟨iic.⟩); concentration <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> perplexité, confusion.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyagratva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vyagratva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-vyagratva" class="skt-link">n.</a> distraction <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> confusion, agitation — ifc. concentration sur.<br> <a href="#entry-vyagra" class="skt-link">vyagra</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaja">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यज</span> <i>vyaja</i> [instr. <a href="#entry-viij" class="skt-link">vīj</a>] <a href="#entry-vyaja" class="skt-link">m.</a> éventail.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyajana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यजन</span> <i>vyajana</i> [act. <a href="#entry-viij" class="skt-link">vīj</a>] <a href="#entry-vyajana" class="skt-link">n.</a> fait d'éventer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> éventail <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> mod. ventilateur — <a href="#entry-vyajanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vyajanā</i> ifc. id.<br> <i>vyajanīkṛ</i> utiliser comme éventail.<br> <i>vyajanībhū</i> servir d'éventail.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyakta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यक्त</span> <i>vyakta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vya_nj" class="skt-link">vyañj</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vyakta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vyakta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vyaktaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vyaktā</i> clair, limpide; visible, perceptible; manifeste, évident.<br> <i>vyaktam</i> adv. manifestement, de toute évidence.<br> <i>vyaktīkṛ</i> rendre manifeste, rendre évident.<br> <i>vyaktībhū</i> devenir manifeste ou évident; se distinguer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyakti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaktitva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vyaktitva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-vyaktitva" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] individualité, particularité.<br> <i>ghaṭavyaktitva</i> phil. fait d'être un pot particulier; distingue le pot dont il est question d'un pot arbitraire.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaktiviveka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vyaktiviveka</i> [<a href="#entry-viveka" class="skt-link">viveka</a>] <a href="#entry-vyaktiviveka" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du Vyaktiviveka «Investigation de la suggestion», ouvrage d'esthétique littéraire de <a href="#entry-Umahimabha_t_ta" class="skt-link">Mahimabhaṭṭa</a> (11⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle); il emprunte à <a href="#entry-Udharmakiirti" class="skt-link">Dharmakīrti</a> et critique la théorie du <a href="#entry-dhvani" class="skt-link">dhvani</a> d'<a href="#entry-Uaanandavardhana" class="skt-link">Ānandavardhana</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaktizakti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaktizaktivaada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vyaktiśaktivāda</i> [<a href="#entry-vaada" class="skt-link">vāda</a>] <a href="#entry-vyaktizaktivaada" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. doctrine du particularisme du sens.<br> <a href="#entry-vyaktizakti" class="skt-link">vyaktiśakti</a> <br> <a href="#entry-vyakti" class="skt-link">vyakti</a>
  </div>
</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyantara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यन्तर</span> <i>vyantara</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-antara" class="skt-link">antara</a>] <a href="#entry-vyantara" class="skt-link">n.</a> absence de distinction <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> intervalle — <a href="#entry-vyantara" class="skt-link">m.</a> jn. [«être intermédiaire»] classe de divinités subalternes, comprenant les <a href="#entry-pizaacaas" class="skt-link">piśācās</a>, <a href="#entry-bhuutaas" class="skt-link">bhūtās</a>, <a href="#entry-yak_saas" class="skt-link">yakṣās</a>, <a href="#entry-raak_sasaas" class="skt-link">rākṣasās</a>, <a href="#entry-kinnaraas" class="skt-link">kinnarās</a>-<a href="#entry-kimpuru_saas" class="skt-link">kimpuruṣās</a>, <a href="#entry-mahoragaas" class="skt-link">mahoragās</a> et <a href="#entry-gandharvaas" class="skt-link">gandharvās</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-vyantaradevataa" class="skt-link">vyantaradevatā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyantaradevataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vyantaradevatā</i> [<a href="#entry-devataa" class="skt-link">devatā</a>] <a href="#entry-vyantaradevataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> soc. divinité intermédiaire.<br> <a href="#entry-vyantara" class="skt-link">vyantara</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyapaazraya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यपाश्रय</span> <i>vyapāśraya</i> [obj. <a href="#entry-vyapaazri" class="skt-link">vyapāśri</a>] <a href="#entry-vyapaazraya" class="skt-link">m.</a> refuge, abri, support — ifc. qui a recours à, qui a foi en, qui a confiance en.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyapaazri">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यपाश्रि</span> <i>vyapāśri</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-apaazri" class="skt-link">apāśri</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vyapāśrayati)</i> pr. md. <i>(vyapāśrayate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vyapāśrita</i><i>)</i> chercher refuge en, avoir recours à <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> adhérer à (doctrine), admettre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyapadeza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यपदेश</span> <i>vyapadeśa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vyapadiz" class="skt-link">vyapadiś</a>] <a href="#entry-vyapadeza" class="skt-link">m.</a> désignation, nom, titre; nom de famille, race <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> convocation, mobilisation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> prétexte, apparence.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyapadezin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यपदेशिन्</span> <i>vyapadeśin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vyapadiz" class="skt-link">vyapadiś</a>] ifc. a. <a href="#entry-vyapadezin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vyapadezin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vyapadezinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vyapadeśinī</i> qui se dissimule sous, qui prend pour prétexte.<br> <i>dharma</i> <i>kañcuka</i> <i>vyapadeśin</i> hypocrite [«qui se dissimule sous l'habit du devoir»].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyapadezya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यपदेश्य</span> <i>vyapadeśya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-vyapadiz" class="skt-link">vyapadiś</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vyapadezya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vyapadezya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vyapadezyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vyapadeśyā</i> à désigner, à nommer; à blâmer; qui mérite un titre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. exprimable.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyapadiz">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यपदिश्</span> <i>vyapadiś</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-apadiz" class="skt-link">apadiś</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vyapadiśati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vyapadiṣṭa</i><i>)</i> nommer, désigner <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> prétexter, prétendre que, faire passer ⟨acc.⟩ pour ⟨acc.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyapagam">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यपगम्</span> <i>vyapagam</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-apagam" class="skt-link">apagam</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vyapagacchati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vyapagata</i><i>)</i> s'éloigner, s'en aller, se dissiper; fuir, disparaître.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyapagata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यपगत</span> <i>vyapagata</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vyapagam" class="skt-link">vyapagam</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vyapagata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vyapagata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vyapagataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vyapagatā</i> parti.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyapek_s">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यपेक्ष्</span> <i>vyapekṣ</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-apek_s" class="skt-link">apekṣ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(vyapekṣate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vyapekṣita</i><i>)</i> considérer, faire attention à, prendre égard à <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> attendre; avoir en vue, désirer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyapek_saa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यपेक्षा</span> <i>vyapekṣā</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vyapek_s" class="skt-link">vyapekṣ</a>] <a href="#entry-vyapek_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> considération; attente <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. accord; collocation — ifc. en ce qui concerne; conformément à.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyapek_sita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यपेक्षित</span> <i>vyapekṣita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vyapek_s" class="skt-link">vyapekṣ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vyapek_sita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vyapek_sita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vyapek_sitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vyapekṣitā</i> attendu, conforme; mutuellement relié.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyartha">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyavahaaramayuukha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vyavahāramayūkha</i> [<a href="#entry-mayuukha" class="skt-link">mayūkha</a>] <a href="#entry-vyavahaaramayuukha" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du Vyavahāramayūkha, résumé de lois dû à <a href="#entry-Uniilaka_n_tha_4" class="skt-link">Nīlakaṇṭha_4</a> <a href="#entry-Ubha_t_ta" class="skt-link">Bhaṭṭa</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vyavahaara" class="skt-link">vyavahāra</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyavahaarapaada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vyavahārapāda</i> [<a href="#entry-paada" class="skt-link">pāda</a>] <a href="#entry-vyavahaarapaada" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. l'une des 4 étapes d'un procès: plainte, défense, preuve et sentence.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyavahaarapada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vyavahārapada</i> [<a href="#entry-pada" class="skt-link">pada</a>] <a href="#entry-vyavahaarapada" class="skt-link">n.</a> soc. titre de loi; citation légale, énoncé d'un litige.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyavahaaratas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vyavahāratas</i> [<a href="#entry--tas" class="skt-link">-tas</a>] adv. selon la procédure; en pratique; par convention.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyavahara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यवहरण</span> <i>vyavaharaṇa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vyavah_r" class="skt-link">vyavahṛ</a>] <a href="#entry-vyavahara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> fait de parier ou de faire des affaires <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> litige légal, contentieux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyavahita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यवहित</span> <i>vyavahita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vyavadhaa" class="skt-link">vyavadhā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vyavahita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vyavahita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vyavahitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vyavahitā</i> interrompu, séparé; empêché, entravé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyavasaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यवसा</span> <i>vyavasā</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-avasaa" class="skt-link">avasā</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. <i>(vyavasyati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vyavasita</i><i>)</i> se décider, se résoudre à ⟨acc.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyavasaaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यवसाय</span> <i>vyavasāya</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vyavasaa" class="skt-link">vyavasā</a>] <a href="#entry-vyavasaaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> détermination, résolution.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyavasaayin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यवसायिन्</span> <i>vyavasāyin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vyavasaa" class="skt-link">vyavasā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vyavasaayin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vyavasaayin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vyavasaayinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vyavasāyinī</i> résolu.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyavasita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यवसित</span> <i>vyavasita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vyavasaa" class="skt-link">vyavasā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vyavasita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vyavasita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vyavasitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vyavasitā</i> décidé, arrêté, entrepris; dont on est sûr <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> résolu, décidé à ⟨loc. dat. inf.⟩; qui s'est convaincu — <a href="#entry-vyavasita" class="skt-link">n.</a> décision; entreprise; resolution, détermination.<br> <i>vyavasitam</i> (impers.) il est sûr que; il est décidé que.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyavasthaa_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यवस्था</span> <i>vyavasthā_1</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-avasthaa_1" class="skt-link">avasthā_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(vyavatiṣṭhate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vyavasthita</i><i>)</i> s'arrêter, faire halte; s'apprêter à ⟨dat.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> être établi logiquement — ca. <i>(vyavasthāpayati)</i> établir, déterminer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyavasthaa_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यवस्था</span> <i>vyavasthā_2</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vyavasthaa_1" class="skt-link">vyavasthā_1</a>] <a href="#entry-vyavasthaa_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> particularité, singularité, caractéristique; distinction, séparation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> constance; conviction, opinion arrêtée <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. not. édit d'un lettré [<a href="#entry-zaastrin" class="skt-link">śāstrin</a>] concernant une observance <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> état, circonstance.<br> <i>varṇavyavasthā</i> soc. caste comme caractéristique de l'Hindouisme.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyavasthaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यवस्थान</span> <i>vyavasthāna</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vyavasthaa_1" class="skt-link">vyavasthā_1</a>] <a href="#entry-vyavasthaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> persévérance, fermeté; condition.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyavasthita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यवस्थित</span> <i>vyavasthita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vyavasthaa_1" class="skt-link">vyavasthā_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vyavasthita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vyavasthita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vyavasthitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vyavasthitā</i> placé, situé; se trouvant à, compris dans ⟨iic.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> dépendant de, décidé à ⟨loc.⟩; défini, bien établi; constant, invariable.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vya_nj">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यञ्ज्</span> <i>vyañj</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-a_nj" class="skt-link">añj</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">7</span>] pr. <i>(vyanikti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vyakta</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>abhi</i><i>)</i> véd. oindre complètement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> décorer, embellir <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> rendre visible, révéler, manifester — pr. md. <i>(vyaṅkte)</i> se manifester — ps. <i>(vyajyate)</i> être révélé, être exprimé — ca. <i>(vyañjayati)</i> révéler, manifester.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vya_njana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यञ्जन</span> <i>vyañjana</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vya_nj" class="skt-link">vyañj</a>] <a href="#entry-vya_njana" class="skt-link">n.</a> signe, indication; indice, symptôme; insigne, marque; caractère sexuel <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> condiment, sauce, curry <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> suggestion; expression figurée; remarque piquante, ironie — <a href="#entry-vya_njana" class="skt-link">m.</a> phon. consonne — <a href="#entry-vya_njanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vyañjanā</i> gram. sens suggestif d'un mot ou d'une phrase; allusion, sous-entendu; opp. <a href="#entry-abhidhaa_2" class="skt-link">abhidhā_2</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-dhvani" class="skt-link">dhvani</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyoma">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्योम</span> <i>vyoma</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-vyoman" class="skt-link">vyoman</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyomacaarin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vyomacārin</i> [<a href="#entry-caarin" class="skt-link">cārin</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vyomacaarin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vyomacaarin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vyomacaari_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vyomacāriṇī</i> qui se déplace dans les airs — <a href="#entry-vyomacaarin" class="skt-link">m.</a> oiseau; être divin; corps céleste.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyomacaaripura">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vyomacāripura</i> [<a href="#entry-pura" class="skt-link">pura</a>] <a href="#entry-vyomacaaripura" class="skt-link">n.</a> myth. np. de Vyomacāripura, la «Cité volante» du roi <a href="#entry-Uharizcandra" class="skt-link">Hariścandra</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vyomacaarin" class="skt-link">vyomacārin</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyomamaarga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyomamaaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vyomamāya</i> [<a href="#entry-maaya" class="skt-link">māya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vyomamaaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vyomamaaya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vyomamaayii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vyomamāyī</i> [«qui mesure le ciel»] qui atteint les cieux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyoman">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्योमन्</span> <i>vyoman</i> [<a href="#entry-vyaa" class="skt-link">vyā</a>] <a href="#entry-vyoman" class="skt-link">m.</a> ciel, air, éther; espace; syn. <a href="#entry-viyat" class="skt-link">viyat</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> math. symb. le nombre zéro.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyomavatii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vyomavatī</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] <a href="#entry-vyomavatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de la Vyomavatī, commentaire du <a href="#entry-Upadaarthadharmasafgraha" class="skt-link">Padārthadharmasaṃgraha</a> dû à <a href="#entry-Uvyomaziva" class="skt-link">Vyomaśiva</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyomayaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vyomayāna</i> [<a href="#entry-yaana" class="skt-link">yāna</a>] <a href="#entry-vyomayaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> myth. char céleste conduisant un dieu dans les airs; syn. <a href="#entry-vimaana_1" class="skt-link">vimāna_1</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyomaziva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vyomaśiva</i> [<a href="#entry-ziva" class="skt-link">śiva</a>] <a href="#entry-vyomaziva" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. du philosophe Vyomaśiva (~900–960), auteur de la <a href="#entry-Uvyomavatii" class="skt-link">Vyomavatī</a>, traité de doctrine discriminative [<a href="#entry-vaize_sika" class="skt-link">vaiśeṣika</a>].<br> <a href="#entry-vyoma" class="skt-link">vyoma</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyudita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्युदित</span> <i>vyudita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vivad" class="skt-link">vivad</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vyudita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vyudita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vyuditaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vyuditā</i> discuté, débattu; disputé, contredit.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyutpaadaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्युत्पादक</span> <i>vyutpādaka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-vyutpad" class="skt-link">vyutpad</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vyutpaadaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vyutpaadaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vyutpaadikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vyutpādikā</i> gram. qui produit; productif.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyutpaadana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्युत्पादन</span> <i>vyutpādana</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vyutpad" class="skt-link">vyutpad</a>] <a href="#entry-vyutpaadana" class="skt-link">n.</a> gram. explication étymologique; dérivation de ⟨abl.⟩; analyse grammaticale.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyutpad">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्युत्पद्</span> <i>vyutpad</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-utpad" class="skt-link">utpad</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. md. <i>(vyutpadyate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vyutpanna</i><i>)</i> se produire, être issu <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. dériver étymologiquement de ⟨abl.⟩ — ca. <i>(vyutpādayati)</i> faire se produire, créer, causer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. dériver de; faire remonter à une racine.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyutpanna">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्युत्पन्न</span> <i>vyutpanna</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vyutpad" class="skt-link">vyutpad</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vyutpanna" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vyutpanna" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vyutpannaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vyutpannā</i> issu, dérivé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. explicable par l'étymologie; not. dérivé d'une racine verbale <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. dérivé par la grammaire de <a href="#entry-Upaa_nini" class="skt-link">Pāṇini</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> savant en, accompli en, versé en ⟨i.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyutpatti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्युत्पत्ति</span> <i>vyutpatti</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vyutpad" class="skt-link">vyutpad</a>] <a href="#entry-vyutpatti" class="skt-link">f.</a> production, origine, mode de formation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. dérivation, étymologie <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> développement, perfectionnement, accroissement (not. du savoir) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> expertise, science, érudition.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyutpattinimitta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vyutpattinimitta</i> [<a href="#entry-nimitta" class="skt-link">nimitta</a>] <a href="#entry-vyutpattinimitta" class="skt-link">n.</a> gram. sens étymologique strict d'un mot.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyutpattipak_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vyutpattipakṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-pak_sa" class="skt-link">pakṣa</a>] <a href="#entry-vyutpattipak_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> gram. dogme instituant que tout nominal est dérivé d'une racine verbale; il est défendu par <a href="#entry-Uyaaska" class="skt-link">Yāska</a> et <a href="#entry-Uzaaka_taayana_1" class="skt-link">Śākaṭāyana_1</a>; opp. <a href="#entry-avyutpattipak_sa" class="skt-link">avyutpattipakṣa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyutpattivaada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>vyutpattivāda</i> [<a href="#entry-vaada" class="skt-link">vāda</a>] <a href="#entry-vyutpattivaada" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du Vyutpattivāda, traité de sémantique dû à <a href="#entry-Ugadaadhara" class="skt-link">Gadādhara</a> <a href="#entry-Ubha_t_taacaarya" class="skt-link">Bhaṭṭācārya</a>, en termes de <a href="#entry-navyanyaaya" class="skt-link">navyanyāya</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-vyutpatti" class="skt-link">vyutpatti</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyutthaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्युत्था</span> <i>vyutthā</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-utthaa" class="skt-link">utthā</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vyuttiṣṭhati)</i> pr. md. <i>(vyuttiṣṭhate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vyutthita</i><i>)</i> s'élever; se détourner de, s'écarter de ⟨abl.⟩ — ca. <i>(vyutthāpayati)</i> écarter, éloigner; être en désaccord sur ⟨acc.⟩.<br> <i>dharmāt</i> <i>vyutthā</i> s'écarter du devoir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyutthaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्युत्थान</span> <i>vyutthāna</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vyutthaa" class="skt-link">vyutthā</a>] <a href="#entry-vyutthaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> éveil <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> abandon; fait de s'écarter de son devoir <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>] retour au monde des perceptions, éveil yogique.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyutthita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्युत्थित</span> <i>vyutthita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vyutthaa" class="skt-link">vyutthā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vyutthita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vyutthita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vyutthitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vyutthitā</i> agité, excité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>] qui s'éveille de l'état de <a href="#entry-samaadhi" class="skt-link">samādhi</a> — <a href="#entry-vyutthita" class="skt-link">n.</a> divergence d'opinion.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyuu_dha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यूढ</span> <i>vyūḍha</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-vyuuh" class="skt-link">vyūh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-vyuu_dha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-vyuu_dha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-vyuu_dhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>vyūḍhā</i> écarté, distribué; disposé en ordre de bataille.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyuuh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यूह्</span> <i>vyūh</i> [<a href="#entry-vi" class="skt-link">vi</a>-<a href="#entry-uuh" class="skt-link">ūh</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(vyūhati)</i> pr. md. <i>(vyūhate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>vyūḍha</i><i>)</i> écarter, diviser; étaler, réarranger <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> disposer en ordre de bataille.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-vyuuha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">व्यूह</span> <i>vyūha</i> [act. <a href="#entry-vyuuh" class="skt-link">vyūh</a>] <a href="#entry-vyuuha" class="skt-link">m.</a> distribution, disposition; réarrangement, transposition <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> ordre de bataille; cf. <a href="#entry-cakravyuuha" class="skt-link">cakravyūha</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. émanation divine; il y en a 4 manifestations: <a href="#entry-Upuru_sottama" class="skt-link">Puruṣottama</a>, <a href="#entry-Usafkar_sa_na" class="skt-link">Saṃkarṣaṇa</a>, <a href="#entry-Upradyumna" class="skt-link">Pradyumna</a> et <a href="#entry-Uaniruddha" class="skt-link">Aniruddha</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> raisonnement, spéculation.
  </div>
</div>
